  /* MISSION */
  if (phase === 'mission') {
    const showReview = cameFromResult && result?.review && questions

    if (showReview) {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

            <div className="px-5 md:px-7 py-4 md:py-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
              <div className="min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em]" style={{ color: '#22d3ee', textShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }}>
                    {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL EXAM' : 'SIDE QUEST ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>

                â† BACK TO RESULT
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-center py-2">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.4em] text-[var(--m-cyan)]">

              EXAM REVIEW Â· LEARN FROM YOUR ANSWERS
              <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] animate-pulse" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {questions.map((q, qi) => {
            const rv = result.review!.find(r => r.id === q.id)
            if (!rv) return null
            const userIdx = rv.user_index
            const correctIdx = rv.correct_index
            const isCorrect = userIdx === correctIdx
            return (

                  style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderLeft: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderRight: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderLeft: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderRight: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />

                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 mb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
                      Q{String(qi + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-lg" style={{ color: isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
                      {isCorrect ? 'âœ“' : 'âœ—'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest"
                    style={{ color: isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
                    {isCorrect ? 'CORRECT' : 'INCORRECT'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="text-sm md:text-base font-semibold mb-4 text-[var(--m-text)]">
                  {q.question}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {q.options.map((opt, oi) => {
                    const isUser = oi === userIdx
                    const isAnswer = oi === correctIdx
                    let border = 'var(--m-border)'
                    let bg = 'transparent'
                    let color = 'var(--m-text-muted)'
                    let marker = ''
                    if (isAnswer) { border = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.6)'; bg = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.08)'; color = '#10b981'; marker = 'âœ“ correct' }
                    else if (isUser && !isCorrect) { border = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.6)'; bg = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.08)'; color = '#ef4444'; marker = 'âœ— your answer' }
                    return (
                      <div key={oi} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5"
                        style={{ border: '1px solid ' + border, background: bg, color }}>
                        <span className="font-mono shrink-0 w-5">{String.fromCharCode(65 + oi)}</span>
                        <span className="flex-1">{opt}</span>
                        {marker && <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-wider shrink-0">{marker}</span>}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>

                {!isCorrect && (
                  <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t text-xs md:text-sm" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.20)' }}>
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                      <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-mono tracking-widest shrink-0">ðŸ’¡ TIP</span>
                      <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">
                        Correct answer is <span style={{ color: '#10b981' }}>{String.fromCharCode(65 + correctIdx)}</span>. Re-read the question â€” the pattern matters.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}

          <button onClick={backToResult}
            className="w-full border border-[var(--m-cyan)]/40 text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[var(--m-cyan-soft)] transition">
            â† BACK TO RESULT
          </button>
        </div>
      )
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-8 md:space-y-10">
        <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-px z-10" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #22d3ee 50%, transparent 100%)', opacity: 0.75 }} />

          <div className="px-5 md:px-7 py-4 md:py-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em]" style={{ color: '#22d3ee', textShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }}>
                  {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL EXAM' : 'SIDE QUEST ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-base md:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--m-text)] truncate">
                {lessonTitle}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[var(--m-cyan)] shrink-0">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] animate-pulse" />
              IN PROGRESS
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {videoUrl && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 md:mb-5">
              <span className="inline-block w-1 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ background: '#22d3ee', boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }} />
              <span className="text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>
                QUEST BRIEFING
              </span>
              <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.4) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black border border-[var(--m-border)]">
              {videoUrl.includes('youtube') || videoUrl.includes('youtu.be') ? (
                <iframe src={'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + extractYouTubeId(videoUrl)} title={lessonTitle}
                  allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
                  allowFullScreen className="w-full h-full" />
              ) : (<video src={videoUrl} controls className="w-full h-full" />)}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {content && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 md:mb-5">
              <span className="inline-block w-1 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ background: '#22d3ee', boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }} />
              <span className="text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>
                {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM INSTRUCTIONS' : 'QUEST CODEX'}
              </span>
              <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.4) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="m-hud-panel">
              <span className="m-hud-scan" />
              <div className="m-hud-header">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
                  CODEX
                  <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM BRIEF' : 'LESSON BODY'}</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ color: '#3a4250', opacity: 0.7 }}>MERIDIAN / v1</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 md:p-8"><CodexContent content={content} /></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {completed ? (
          <div className="m-panel border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/20 p-5 md:p-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
              <span className="text-2xl">âœ“</span>
              <span className="tracking-wider">MISSION COMPLETE</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3">
              <button onClick={finishMission}
                className="text-sm text-green-400/70 hover:text-green-400 underline text-center px-4 py-2">
                Retake exam
              </button>
              {nextHref && (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  NEXT: {(nextTitle?.toUpperCase() || 'CONTINUE')} â†’
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button onClick={finishMission}
            className="m-hud-corners w-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-10 py-4 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
            âœ“ FINISH MISSION â€” TAKE EXAM â†’
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  /* EXAM */
  if (phase === 'exam') {
    if (questions === null) {
      return (
        <div className="m-panel m-hud-corners p-12 text-center text-[var(--m-text-dim)] font-mono text-sm">
          LOADING EXAM...
        </div>
      )
    }
    if (questions.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="m-panel m-hud-corners p-6 md:p-8">
            <div className="m-label mb-2">{isFinalExam ? 'Final Exam' : 'Practice Exam'}</div>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-6">No questions yet. The instructor is preparing this exam.</p>
            <button onClick={submit} disabled={submitting}
              className="bg-white text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-neutral-200">
              {submitting ? 'COMPLETING...' : 'âœ“ COMPLETE MISSION'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }

    const answeredCount = Object.keys(answers).length
    const progressPct = Math.round((answeredCount / questions.length) * 100)
    const q = questions[examIndex]
    const isLast = examIndex === questions.length - 1
    const isFirst = examIndex === 0
    const selectedForQ = answers[q.id]

    return (
      <div className="space-y-3 md:space-y-6">
        <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

          <div className="px-4 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 border-b" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.15)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 md:mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[var(--m-cyan)]">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] animate-pulse" />
                {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL EXAM' : 'PRACTICE EXAM'}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
                Q{String(examIndex + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/{String(questions.length).padStart(2, '0')}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ background: '#1e2633' }}>
              <div className="h-full transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: progressPct + '%', background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)', boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
              <span>{answeredCount}/{questions.length} ANSWERED</span>
              <span>PASS {passThreshold}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="px-4 md:px-8 py-5 md:py-8">
            <div className="text-base md:text-xl font-bold mb-5 md:mb-6 leading-relaxed text-[var(--m-text)]">
              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = selectedForQ === idx
                return (
                  <button key={idx} type="button"
                    onClick={() => setAnswers(a => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))}
                    className={'w-full text-left text-sm md:text-base rounded-lg px-3 md:px-4 py-3 md:py-3.5 border transition-all flex items-center gap-3 ' + (selected ? 'border-[var(--m-cyan)] bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.10)] text-[var(--m-text)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:bg-white/[0.02]')}
                    style={{ boxShadow: selected ? '0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.20)' : 'none' }}>
                    <span className={'shrink-0 w-6 h-6 md:w-7 md:h-7 rounded flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[10px] md:text-xs border ' + (selected ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black border-[var(--m-cyan)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)]')}>
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex-1">{opt}</span>
                    {selected && <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--m-cyan)] shrink-0 hidden sm:inline">âœ“</span>}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && <div className="text-red-400 text-sm font-mono">ERROR: {error}</div>}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.max(0, i - 1)); scrollTop() }}
            disabled={isFirst}
            className="flex-1 border border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
            â† PREV
          </button>
          {isLast ? (
            <button onClick={submit} disabled={submitting}
              className={'flex-[2] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition ' + (submitting ? 'bg-[var(--m-surface)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)] border border-[var(--m-border)] cursor-not-allowed' : allAnswered ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black hover:bg-cyan-300 m-pulse' : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30')}>
              {submitting ? 'ANALYZING...' : allAnswered ? 'â–¸ SUBMIT' : 'â–¸ SUBMIT (' + unansweredCount + ')'}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.min(questions.length - 1, i + 1)); scrollTop() }}
              className="flex-[2] bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
              NEXT â†’
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  /* RESULT */
  if (phase === 'result' && result) {
    const passed = result.passed
    const isNewBest = !!result.is_new_best
    const previousBest = result.previous_best ?? 0
    const bestScore = result.best_score ?? result.score
    const attempts = result.attempts ?? 1
    const xpTotal = result.xp_total ?? 0
    const xpBase = result.xp_base ?? 0
    const xpBonus = result.xp_bonus ?? 0

    return (
      <>
        {showDiscipline && <DisciplineScreen onDone={() => {
          setShowDiscipline(false)
          requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
        }} />}
        <div className={'m-panel m-hud-corners p-8 md:p-14 text-center relative overflow-hidden ' + (passed ? 'border-green-700/50' : 'border-red-800/50')}>
          {isNewBest && passed && (
            <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md border"
              style={{ color: '#22d3ee', borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.5)', background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)' }}>
              âš¡ NEW HIGHSCORE
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-5xl md:text-6xl mb-4">{passed ? 'ðŸ†' : 'âœ—'}</div>
          <div className={'text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] mb-3 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION STATUS: CLEARED' : 'MISSION STATUS: FAILED'}
          </div>
          <h2 className={'text-2xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-8 md:mb-10 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION COMPLETE' : 'MISSION FAILED'}
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4 max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10">
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">SCORE</div>
              <div className={'text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>{result.score}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">CORRECT</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{result.correct}/{result.total}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">BEST</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>{bestScore}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">ATTEMPTS</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{attempts}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {passed && (
            <div className="max-w-md mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10 border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-4 text-left">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-3">XP BREAKDOWN</div>
              {xpBase > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">First clear</span>
                  <span className="text-green-400 font-mono">+{xpBase} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpBonus > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">New highscore bonus</span>
                  <span className="font-mono" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>+{xpBonus} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpTotal === 0 && <div className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">No new XP this attempt â€” already cleared.</div>}
              {xpTotal > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-[var(--m-border)] font-bold">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text)]">Total</span>
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-mono">+{xpTotal} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {previousBest > 0 && isNewBest && (
                <div className="text-xs mt-3" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>Beat your previous best of {previousBest}%</div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {passed ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
              <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REVIEW QUESTIONS
              </button>
              <button onClick={retry}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REPLAY FOR HIGHSCORE
              </button>
              {nextHref ? (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  NEXT: {(nextTitle?.toUpperCase() || 'CONTINUE')} â†’
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button onClick={() => goNext('/courses/' + slug)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  RETURN TO COURSE â†’
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-8 md:mb-10 max-w-md mx-auto">
                You need {passThreshold}% to clear this mission. Review your answers and try again.
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
                <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                  className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                  REVIEW QUESTIONS
                </button>
                <button onClick={retry}
                  className="bg-red-500 text-white font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-red-400 transition m-pulse">
                  RETRY MISSION
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </>
    )
  }

  return null
}

function extractYouTubeId(url: string): string | null {
  const match = url.match(
    /(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  )
  return match ? match[1] : null
}

'use client'

  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
}

export default function QuizSection({
  lessonId,
  initialCompleted,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  initialCompleted: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) {
        setError(error.message)
        setQuestions([])
        return
      }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId])

  async function submit(finalAnswers: Record<string, number>) {
    setSubmitting(true)
    setError(null)

    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      p_answers: finalAnswers,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setSubmitting(false)
      return
    }

    const r = (data as QuizResult[])[0]
    setResult(r)
    if (r.passed) {
      setCompleted(true)
      router.refresh()
    }
    setSubmitting(false)
  }

  // Completed
  if (completed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
          <span className="text-xl">âœ“</span>
          <span>Quest Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm text-green-400 font-mono">
          {result ? `${result.score}% Â· ` : ''}+50 XP
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Loading
  if (questions === null) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6 text-center text-[var(--m-text-dim)] text-sm">
        Loading practice exam...
      </div>
    )
  }

  // No quiz â€” one-click complete
  if (questions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-3 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => submit({})}
          disabled={submitting}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
        >
          {submitting ? 'Completing...' : 'âœ“ Complete Side Quest'}
        </button>
      </>
    )
  }

  // Failed state
  if (result && !result.passed) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-red-400 font-semibold mb-1">
          âœ— Not passed â€” {result.correct} / {result.total} ({result.score}%)
        </div>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5">
          You need 80% to unlock the next quest. Review the Codex and try again.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
            setStarted(true)
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Retake Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Intro state
  if (!started) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">
          {questions.length} question{questions.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
        </h3>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5 leading-relaxed">
          You need <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-semibold">80%</span>{' '}
          or higher to pass and unlock the next quest.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setStarted(true)
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Start Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Taking exam
  const allAnswered = questions.every((q) => answers[q.id] !== undefined)

  return (
    <div className="m-panel p-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] font-mono">
          {Object.keys(answers).length} / {questions.length} answered
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-6 mb-6">
        {questions.map((q, i) => (
          <div key={q.id}>
            <div className="text-sm font-medium mb-3 leading-relaxed">
              <span className="text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2 font-mono">
                Q{i + 1}.
              </span>
              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = answers[q.id] === idx
                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setAnswers((a) => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))
                    }
                    className={`w-full text-left text-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 border transition ${
                      selected
                        ? 'border-cyan-500/60 bg-cyan-500/[0.08] text-[var(--m-text)]'
                        : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2">
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    {opt}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && <div className="mb-4 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>}

      <button
        onClick={() => submit(answers)}
        disabled={!allAnswered || submitting}
        className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-40 transition"
      >
        {submitting
          ? 'Checking...'
          : allAnswered
          ? 'Submit Exam'
          : `Answer all ${questions.length} questions`}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

export default async function CourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title, description, track, level')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  // Read is_admin directly off the profile row
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('is_admin')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const isAdmin = profile?.is_admin === true

  const { data: enrollment } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments')
    .select('id, progress')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const { data: sagasData } = await supabase
    .from('modules')
    .select(`
      id, title, description, order_index,
      missions(
        id, title, description, order_index,
        lessons(id, title, order_index, is_final_exam, pass_threshold)
      )
    `)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  const sagas = (sagasData ?? []) as unknown as Saga[]

  const { data: progressData } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('lesson_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('completed', true)

  const completedIds = (progressData ?? []).map((p: { lesson_id: string }) => p.lesson_id)
  const completedSet = new Set<string>(completedIds)

  sagas.forEach(s => {
    s.missions = (s.missions ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    s.missions.forEach(m => {
      m.lessons = (m.lessons ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    })
  })

  const totalLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.missions.reduce((a, m) => a + (m.lessons?.length ?? 0), 0),
    0
  )
  const doneLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) =>
      sum +
      s.missions.reduce(
        (a, m) => a + (m.lessons ?? []).filter(l => completedSet.has(l.id)).length,
        0
      ),
    0
  )
  const overallPct = totalLessons > 0 ? Math.round((doneLessons / totalLessons) * 100) : 0

  let defaultOpenIndex = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < sagas.length; i++) {
    const hasIncomplete = sagas[i].missions.some(m =>
      (m.lessons ?? []).some(l => !completedSet.has(l.id))
    )
    if (hasIncomplete) {
      defaultOpenIndex = i
      break
    }
    if (i === sagas.length - 1) defaultOpenIndex = i
  }

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <Link
          href="/courses"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition mb-8"
        >
          â† BACK TO COURSES
        </Link>

        <div className="mb-10 md:mb-14">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <span
              className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-2 py-1 rounded"
              style={{
                color: '#22d3ee',
                background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)',
                border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
              }}
            >
              {course.track === 'en_to_nl' ? 'EN â†’ NL' : course.track === 'nl_to_en' ? 'NL â†’ EN' : course.track?.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
              {course.level}
            </span>
            {enrollment && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#10b981] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#10b981]" />
                ENROLLED
              </span>
            )}
            {isAdmin && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#f59e0b] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#f59e0b]" />
                ADMIN Â· ALL UNLOCKED

            )}
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e5e9f0] mb-4 leading-tight">
            {course.title}
          </h1>

          {course.description && (
            <p className="text-sm md:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#8892a6] max-w-2xl mb-8">

            </p>
          )}

          {!enrollment ? (
            <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} enrolled={false} />
          ) : (
            <div className="max-w-lg">
              <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2">

                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#22d3ee] tabular-nums">
                  {doneLessons} / {totalLessons} Â· {overallPct}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <div
                className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden"

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { enrollInCourse } from '@/app/actions/enroll'

export default function EnrollButton({
  courseId,
  enrolled,
}: {
  courseId: string
  enrolled: boolean
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  if (enrolled) {
    return (
      <span className="text-green-400 text-sm font-semibold">âœ“ Enrolled</span>
    )
  }

  async function handleClick() {
    setLoading(true)
    await enrollInCourse(courseId)
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleClick}
      disabled={loading}
      className="bg-white text-black text-sm font-semibold rounded-full px-5 py-1.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      {loading ? 'Enrolling...' : 'Enroll'}
    </button>
  )
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import DashboardStats from '@/components/DashboardStats'
import DashboardWidgets from '@/components/DashboardWidgets'
import DashboardActivityLog from '@/components/DashboardActivityLog'

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*, shards').eq('id', user.id).single()
  
  const xp = profile?.xp || 0
  const shards = profile?.shards || 0
  const { data: combatLevelData } = await supabase.rpc('get_combat_level', { p_user_id: user.id })
  const combatLevel = combatLevelData || 1
  let level = 1
  if (xp >= 2500) level = 2
  if (xp >= 6000) level = 3
  if (xp >= 12000) level = 4

  const { data: enrollments } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments')
    .select('course_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .limit(1)

  let activeCourse = null
  let overallPct = 0

  if (enrollments && enrollments.length > 0) {
    const courseId = enrollments[0].course_id
    const { data: course } = await supabase.from('courses').select('*').eq('id', courseId).single()
    
    if (course) {
      activeCourse = course
      
      const { data: progressData } = await supabase
        .from('lesson_progress')
        .select('lesson_id')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .eq('completed', true)
        
      const completedSet = new Set((progressData ?? []).map(p => p.lesson_id))
      
      const { data: modules } = await supabase
        .from('modules')
        .select(`id, missions ( id, lessons ( id ) )`)
        .eq('course_id', course.id)
        
      let totalLessons = 0
      let doneLessons = 0
      
      if (modules) {
        modules.forEach(m => {
          m.missions.forEach(mission => {
            totalLessons += mission.lessons.length
            mission.lessons.forEach(lesson => {
              if (completedSet.has(lesson.id)) doneLessons++
            })
          })
        })
      }
      
      overallPct = totalLessons > 0 ? Math.round((doneLessons / totalLessons) * 100) : 0
    }
  }

  const username = user?.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Architect'

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user?.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto w-full">
        
        <div className="mb-8">
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-6xl font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-white tracking-wide mb-2 drop-shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] capitalize">
            Welcome back, <span className="text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-[#22d3ee] to-[#c084fc]">{username}</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[#8892a6] font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-lg italic">
            Review your daily operations and continue your path to mastery.
          </p>
        </div>

        <DashboardStats xp={xp} combatLevel={combatLevel} initialShards={shards} />

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
          
          <div className="lg:col-span-8 flex flex-col gap-6">
            
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-white tracking-[0.15em] uppercase">Current Curriculum</h2>
                <div className="h-px flex-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/20 to-transparent" />
              </div>
              
              {activeCourse ? (
                <div className="dash-hero rounded-xl p-8 flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer group">
                  <div className="relative z-10 mb-6">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#22d3ee] mb-3">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm bg-[#22d3ee]/10 border border-[#22d3ee]/20">EN â†’ NL</span>

                    <h3 className="text-3xl font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-white mb-3 group-hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition-colors">{activeCourse.title}</h3>
                    <p className="text-[#8892a6] font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-lg max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
                      {activeCourse.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                    <Link href={`/courses/${activeCourse.slug}`} className="dash-btn-primary px-6 py-2.5 rounded-md font-mono text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase flex items-center gap-2">

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
      redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/reset-password`,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-2">Reset your password</h1>

        {sent ? (
          <div className="mt-6">
            <div className="border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm text-green-400 mb-4">
              âœ“ Reset link sent to <strong>{email}</strong>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
              Check your inbox. The link will take you to a page where you can
              choose a new password.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-6">
              Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
            </p>

            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Email
            </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send reset link'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, use, useRef, useLayoutEffect, Suspense } from 'react'
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { trackResume } from '@/lib/resume' // <-- ADDED IMPORT

function playPageFlip() {
  try {
    const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext
    if (!AudioContext) return
    const ctx = new AudioContext()
    const bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * 0.4
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate)
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0)
    for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1
    const noise = ctx.createBufferSource()
    noise.buffer = buffer
    const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
    filter.type = 'bandpass'
    filter.frequency.value = 1000
    filter.Q.value = 0.5
    const gain = ctx.createGain()
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime)
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.1, ctx.currentTime + 0.05)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.3)
    noise.connect(filter)
    filter.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(ctx.destination)
    noise.start()
  } catch (e) {}
}

const renderContent = (content: string) => {
  if (!content) return null
  const blocks = content.split(/\n\s*\n/)
  
  return blocks.map((block, i) => {
    const text = block.trim()
    if (!text) return null

    const inlineHtml = text
      .replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong style="color: #111; font-weight: 700;">$1</strong>')
      .replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em style="color: #444;">$1</em>')

    if (text.startsWith('# ')) {
      return (
        <div key={i} style={{ breakBefore: i === 0 ? 'auto' : 'column' }}>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold mb-8 mt-4 font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] text-[#111] text-center tracking-tight break-words" style={{ breakInside: 'avoid' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: inlineHtml.replace('# ', '') }} />
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    if (text.startsWith('## ')) {
      return <h2 key={i} className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold mt-8 mb-4 font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] text-[#111] break-words" style={{ breakAfter: 'avoid', breakInside: 'avoid' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: inlineHtml.replace('## ', '') }} />
    }

    if (text.startsWith('> ')) {
      return (
        <div key={i} className="my-6 py-4 px-6 bg-[#f4efe3] border-y border-[#d4af37]/30 rounded-lg text-center" style={{ breakInside: 'avoid' }}>
          <p className="font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] italic text-[#3a3a3a] text-[0.95em] leading-relaxed break-words" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: inlineHtml.replace('> ', '') }} />
        </div>
      )
    }

    if (text.startsWith('- ')) {
      const items = text.split('\n').map(li => li.trim().replace(/^-\s*/, ''))
      return (
        <ul key={i} className="list-disc pl-6 mb-6 space-y-2 font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-[#2a2a2a]">
          {items.map((li, j) => (
            <li key={j} className="break-words" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: li.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>') }} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )
    }

    return (
      <p 
        key={i} 
        className={`mb-5 leading-[1.8] text-[#2a2a2a] font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-justify break-words ${i === 1 ? 'first-letter:float-left first-letter:text-6xl first-letter:leading-[0.8] first-letter:pr-3 first-letter:pt-1 first-letter:font-bold first-letter:font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] first-letter:text-[#d4af37]' : ''}`} 
        style={{ textAlign: 'justify', hyphens: 'auto', orphans: 3, widows: 3 }}
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: inlineHtml }} 
      />
    )
  })
}

function ReaderContent({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = use(params)
  const router = useRouter()
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const shouldResume = searchParams.get('resume') === 'true'

  const [book, setBook] = useState<any>(null)
  const [chapters, setChapters] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(shouldResume)
  const [hasReadIntro, setHasReadIntro] = useState(shouldResume)
  const [fontSize, setFontSize] = useState(16)
  const [pageIndex, setPageIndex] = useState(0)
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1)
  
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = useState(false)
  const [bookmarkStatus, setBookmarkStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error'>('idle')
  
  const [isFinishing, setIsFinishing] = useState(false)
  const [isCompleted, setIsCompleted] = useState(false)

  const [ambientOn, setAmbientOn] = useState(false)
  const audioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null)

  const [savedProgressPct, setSavedProgressPct] = useState(0)
  const [progressLoaded, setProgressLoaded] = useState(false)
  const hasAppliedProgress = useRef(false)

  const textRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const mobileScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    audioRef.current = new Audio('https://cdn.pixabay.com/download/audio/2022/02/07/audio_3a2e78f64e.mp3')
    audioRef.current.loop = true
    audioRef.current.volume = 0.2
  }, [])

  const toggleAmbientSound = () => {
    if (ambientOn) audioRef.current?.pause()
    else audioRef.current?.play()
    setAmbientOn(!ambientOn)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkMobile = () => setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < 768)
    checkMobile()
    window.addEventListener('resize', checkMobile)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', checkMobile)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data: b } = await supabase.from('library_books').select('*').eq('slug', slug).maybeSingle()
      if (!b) { setLoading(false); setProgressLoaded(true); return }
      setBook(b)

      const { data: chs } = await supabase
        .from('library_chapters')
        .select('id, title, content')
        .eq('book_id', b.id)
        .order('chapter_number', { ascending: true })
      
      if (chs) setChapters(chs)

      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      let dbProg = 0
      
      if (session?.user) {
        const { data: prog } = await supabase
          .from('library_progress')
          .select('scroll_percentage, completed_at')
          .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
          .eq('book_id', b.id)
          .maybeSingle()
        
        if (prog) {
          dbProg = prog.scroll_percentage
          if (prog.completed_at) setIsCompleted(true)

          await supabase.from('library_progress')
            .update({ updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
            .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
            .eq('book_id', b.id)
        } else {
          await supabase.from('library_progress').insert({
            user_id: session.user.id,
            book_id: b.id,
            scroll_percentage: 0,
            is_bookmarked: false,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
          })
        }
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('progress-updated'))
      }

      const localProgStr = localStorage.getItem(`bookmark_${b.id}`)
      const localProg = localProgStr ? parseFloat(localProgStr) : 0
      
      const finalProg = Math.max(dbProg, localProg)
      
      setSavedProgressPct(finalProg)
      setLoading(false)
      setProgressLoaded(true)
    }
    load()
  }, [slug, supabase])

  const fullBookContent = chapters.map(ch => ch.content).join('\n\n');

  const handleBookmark = async () => {
    setBookmarkStatus('saving')

    try {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      if (!session?.user) throw new Error("You must be logged in.")

      let percentage = 0
      if (isMobile && mobileScrollRef.current) {
        const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = mobileScrollRef.current
        const scrollableHeight = scrollHeight - clientHeight
        percentage = scrollableHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / scrollableHeight) * 100 : 0
      } else {
        percentage = totalPages > 1 ? (pageIndex / (totalPages - 1)) * 100 : 0
      }

      localStorage.setItem(`bookmark_${book.id}`, percentage.toString())

      // Save the bookmark and the progress
      const { error } = await supabase.from('library_progress').upsert({
        user_id: session.user.id,
        book_id: book.id,
        scroll_percentage: Math.round(percentage),
        is_bookmarked: true, // Force true
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }, { onConflict: 'user_id,book_id' })

      if (error) throw error

      // --- THE MAGIC TRACKER: SAVES TO SIDEBAR AND SUPABASE ---
      await trackResume(
        'ebook', 
        book.id, 
        book.title, 
        `/library/ebooks/${book.slug}/read?resume=true`,
        { page: pageIndex, scrollPercentage: percentage }
      )
      // --------------------------------------------------------

      setBookmarkStatus('saved')
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('progress-updated'))
      
      // Redirect back to the library after a short delay
      setTimeout(() => {
        router.push('/library/ebooks')
      }, 800)

    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err)
      alert(`Database Error: ${err.message}`)
      setBookmarkStatus('error')
      setTimeout(() => setBookmarkStatus('idle'), 2000)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      async function saveOnExit() {
        const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
        if (!session?.user || !book) return
        
        let percentage = 0
        if (isMobile && mobileScrollRef.current) {
          const { scrollTop, scrollHeight, clientHeight } = mobileScrollRef.current
          const scrollableHeight = scrollHeight - clientHeight
          percentage = scrollableHeight > 0 ? (scrollTop / scrollableHeight) * 100 : 0
        } else {
          percentage = totalPages > 1 ? (pageIndex / (totalPages - 1)) * 100 : 0
        }

        await supabase.from('library_progress').upsert({
          user_id: session.user.id,
          book_id: book.id,
          scroll_percentage: Math.round(percentage),
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'user_id,book_id' })
      }
      saveOnExit()
    }
  }, [book, isMobile, pageIndex, totalPages, supabase])

  const handleFinishBook = async () => {
    if (!book) return
    setIsFinishing(true)
    
    try {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      if (!session?.user) return

      const { data: existingProgress } = await supabase
        .from('library_progress')
        .select('completed_at')
        .eq('user_id', session.user.id)
        .eq('book_id', book.id)
        .maybeSingle()

      const isFirstTimeCompletion = !existingProgress?.completed_at

      await supabase.from('library_progress').upsert({
        user_id: session.user.id,
        book_id: book.id,
        scroll_percentage: 100,
        completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }, { onConflict: 'user_id,book_id' })

      if (isFirstTimeCompletion) {
        const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('xp').eq('id', session.user.id).single()
        const currentXp = profile?.xp || 0
        const reward = book.xp_reward || 250
        await supabase.from('profiles').update({ xp: currentXp + reward }).eq('id', session.user.id)
      }
      
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('progress-updated'))
      router.push('/library/ebooks')
      router.refresh()

    } catch (err) {
      setIsFinishing(false)
    }
  }

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || !fullBookContent || isMobile || !progressLoaded || hasAppliedProgress.current) return;

    let retries = 0;
    const maxRetries = 30;

    const checkAndApply = () => {
      if (textRef.current) {
        const { scrollWidth, clientWidth } = textRef.current;
        if (clientWidth > 0) {
          const calc = Math.round(scrollWidth / clientWidth);
          const newTotal = Math.max(1, calc);

          if (newTotal > 1) {
            setTotalPages(newTotal);
            if (savedProgressPct > 0) {
              const targetPage = Math.round((savedProgressPct / 100) * (newTotal - 1));
              setPageIndex(Math.min(targetPage, newTotal - 1));
            }
            hasAppliedProgress.current = true;
            return true;
          }
        }
      }
      return false;
    }

    if (checkAndApply()) return;

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      retries++;
      if (checkAndApply() || retries >= maxRetries) {
        clearInterval(interval);
        if (retries >= maxRetries) hasAppliedProgress.current = true;
      }
    }, 100);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [fullBookContent, fontSize, isOpen, isMobile, progressLoaded, savedProgressPct]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && isMobile && savedProgressPct > 0 && mobileScrollRef.current && !hasAppliedProgress.current && progressLoaded) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const { scrollHeight, clientHeight } = mobileScrollRef.current!;
        const scrollableHeight = scrollHeight - clientHeight;
        if (scrollableHeight > 0) {
          mobileScrollRef.current!.scrollTop = (savedProgressPct / 100) * scrollableHeight;
          hasAppliedProgress.current = true
        }
      }, 500);
    }
  }, [isOpen, isMobile, savedProgressPct, progressLoaded])

  const turnPage = useCallback((direction: 'next' | 'prev') => {
    if (!isOpen || isMobile) return
    if (direction === 'next' && pageIndex + 1 < totalPages) {
      playPageFlip()
      setPageIndex(p => p + 1)
    } else if (direction === 'prev' && pageIndex > 0) {
      playPageFlip()
      setPageIndex(p => p - 1)
    }
  }, [isOpen, isMobile, pageIndex, totalPages])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen || isMobile) return
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') turnPage('next')
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') turnPage('prev')
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
  }, [isOpen, isMobile, turnPage])

  if (loading) return <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050810] flex items-center justify-center text-[#22d3ee] font-mono tracking-widest animate-pulse">ESTABLISHING CONNECTION...</div>
  if (!book) return <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050810] flex items-center justify-center text-red-500 font-mono">BOOK NOT FOUND</div>

  if (!isOpen) {
    const coverGradient = 
      book.accent_color === '#22d3ee' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #052a38 0%, #010a0f 100%)' : 
      book.accent_color === '#f59e0b' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #3a1d0e 0%, #1a0e06 100%)' : 
      book.accent_color === '#8b5cf6' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #2a104a 0%, #0a0514 100%)' :
      book.accent_color === '#10b981' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #062b1f 0%, #010a08 100%)' :
      book.accent_color === '#ec4899' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #4c0519 0%, #1a0e06 100%)' :
      book.accent_color === '#f97316' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #431407 0%, #1a0e06 100%)' :
      book.accent_color === '#84cc16' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #1a2e05 0%, #010a08 100%)' :
      'linear-gradient(135deg, #111111 0%, #050505 100%)';

    const glowColor = book.accent_color || '#d4af37';
    const style = book.cover_style || 'classic';

    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050810] flex items-center justify-center p-6" style={{ perspective: '2000px' }}>
        <div className="relative w-full max-w-[420px] aspect-[2/3] cursor-pointer group transition-all duration-700 hover:rotate-y-[-10deg] hover:scale-[1.02]"
          onClick={() => { setIsOpen(true); playPageFlip(); }}>
          
          <div className="absolute top-1 bottom-1 -right-2 w-3 bg-[#e0d8c8] rounded-r-md border-y border-r border-[#c0b8a8] shadow-[inset_-1px_0_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] z-0" />
          <div className="absolute top-2 bottom-2 -right-4 w-3 bg-[#d4ccbc] rounded-r-md border-y border-r border-[#b0a898] z-0" />
          <div className="absolute -bottom-2 left-1 right-1 h-3 bg-[#e0d8c8] rounded-b-md border-x border-b border-[#c0b8a8] z-0" />

          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-r-lg rounded-l-sm overflow-hidden shadow-[0_35px_70px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9),0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] border border-white/5"
            style={{ background: coverGradient }}>
            
            <div className="absolute inset-0 book-leather" />
            
            <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-0 w-12 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/95 via-black/50 to-transparent z-30 mix-blend-multiply" />
            <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-12 w-px bg-white/10 z-30" />
            
            {style === 'classic' && (
              <>
                <div className="absolute top-[12%] left-0 w-12 h-1.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/10 to-transparent z-20 border-b border-black/60 shadow-sm" />
                <div className="absolute top-[20%] left-0 w-12 h-1.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-white/10 to-transparent z-20 border-b border-black/60 shadow-sm" />
                <div className="absolute inset-5 left-16 border-2 border-white/20 rounded-sm z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                <div className="absolute inset-6 left-[4.25rem] border border-white/10 rounded-sm z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                <div className="absolute top-5 left-16 w-5 h-5 border-t-4 border-l-4 z-10" style={{ borderColor: glowColor }} />
                <div className="absolute bottom-5 right-5 w-5 h-5 border-b-4 border-r-4 z-10" style={{ borderColor: glowColor }} />
              </>
            )}

            {style === 'cyber' && (
              <>
                <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-10 z-10" style={{ backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 1px, transparent 1px)', backgroundSize: '30px 30px' }} />
                <div className="absolute top-8 left-16 w-8 h-8 border-t-2 border-l-2 z-10 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.5)]" style={{ borderColor: glowColor }} />
                <div className="absolute bottom-8 right-8 w-8 h-8 border-b-2 border-r-2 z-10 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.5)]" style={{ borderColor: glowColor }} />
              </>
            )}

            {style === 'minimal' && (
              <>
                <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-[15%] h-px bg-white/20 z-10" />
                <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-[15%] h-px bg-white/20 z-10" />
              </>
            )}

            {style === 'gold' && (
              <>
                <div className="absolute inset-4 left-16 border-2 border-[#d4af37]/60 rounded-sm z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                <div className="absolute inset-5 left-[4.5rem] border border-[#d4af37]/30 rounded-sm z-10 pointer-events-none" />
                <div className="absolute top-4 left-16 w-8 h-8 border-t-4 border-l-4 border-[#d4af37] z-10" />
                <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 w-8 h-8 border-b-4 border-r-4 border-[#d4af37] z-10" />
              </>
            )}

            <div className="relative z-20 flex flex-col h-full pl-20 pr-8 py-12 justify-between items-center text-center">
              
              <div className="text-[9px] font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] tracking-[0.6em] text-white/60 w-full border-b border-white/10 pb-4">
                MERIDIAN ACADEMY
              </div>
              
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center w-full mt-4">
                <h2 
                  className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-[#fdfbf7] to-[#b0a898] leading-tight mb-6 tracking-wide"
                  style={{ textShadow: '0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)' }}
                >
                  {book.title}
                </h2>
                
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full justify-center mb-6 opacity-80">
                  <div className="h-px w-12 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent to-white" />
                  <div className="w-2 h-2 rotate-45" style={{ backgroundColor: glowColor }} />
                  <div className="h-px w-12 bg-gradient-to-l from-transparent to-white" />
                </div>
                
                <div className="text-base font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] italic text-white/70 px-4 leading-relaxed max-w-sm">
                  {book.subtitle}
                </div>
              </div>
              
              <div className="text-[8px] font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] tracking-[0.5em] text-white/40 w-full border-t border-white/10 pt-4 mt-auto">
                DIGITAL RENAISSANCE SERIES
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500 z-40 pointer-events-none" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (isOpen && !hasReadIntro) {
    return (
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#050810] z-[100]">
        <div className="w-[400px] h-[550px] bg-[#fcf9f2] rounded-lg shadow-2xl p-8 flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden" style={{ border: '1px solid #d4af37' }}>
          <div className="absolute inset-2 border border-[#d4af37]/40 pointer-events-none" />
          <div className="text-center mt-8">
            <h3 className="font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] text-[#8b7355] text-xl tracking-widest uppercase">Ex Libris</h3>
            <div className="w-12 h-px bg-[#d4af37] mx-auto mt-2 mb-8" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-center px-8">
            <p className="font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-[#2a2a2a] italic text-lg mb-4">This manuscript belongs to</p>
            <p className="font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] text-2xl font-bold text-[#111] border-b-2 border-[#d4af37]/50 pb-2">
              Meridian Scholar
            </p>
            <p className="font-mono text-[#8892a6] text-xs tracking-widest mt-4 uppercase">Architect-in-Training</p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center mb-8">
            <p className="font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-[#8b7355] text-sm mb-4">Inscribed into the Meridian Academy Library</p>
            <button 
              onClick={() => setHasReadIntro(true)} 
              className="bg-[#111] text-white font-mono tracking-widest text-[10px] uppercase px-6 py-3 rounded hover:bg-[#333] transition"
            >
              Begin Reading â†’
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const leftPageNumber = (pageIndex * 2) + 1;
  const rightPageNumber = (pageIndex * 2) + 2;
  const totalBookPages = totalPages * 2;

  return (
    <div className="h-screen w-screen bg-[#050810] flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden font-sans selection:bg-[#22d3ee] selection:text-black">
      
      <header className="h-14 md:h-16 bg-[#0a0f16] border-b border-[#1e2633] flex items-center justify-between px-3 md:px-6 shrink-0 z-50">
        
        <div className="flex justify-start flex-1 gap-2 md:gap-3">
          <button 
            onClick={() => router.push('/library/ebooks')} 
            className="px-3 md:px-4 py-1.5 md:py-2 rounded border border-red-500 text-red-500 bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white font-bold text-[10px] md:text-xs tracking-wider transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(239,68,68,0.4)] animate-pulse"
          >
            âœ• QUIT
          </button>
          
          <button 
            onClick={handleBookmark} 
            disabled={bookmarkStatus === 'saving' || bookmarkStatus === 'saved'}
            className={`px-3 md:px-4 py-1.5 md:py-2 rounded border font-bold text-[10px] md:text-xs tracking-wider transition-all disabled:opacity-50 ${
              bookmarkStatus === 'error' ? 'border-red-500 text-red-500 bg-red-500/10' :
              bookmarkStatus === 'saved' ? 'border-[#10b981] text-[#10b981] bg-[#10b981]/10' :
              'border-[#22d3ee] text-[#22d3ee] bg-[#22d3ee]/10 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.4)]'
            }`}
          >
            {bookmarkStatus === 'saving' ? 'SAVING...' : bookmarkStatus === 'error' ? 'ERROR âœ•' : bookmarkStatus === 'saved' ? 'SAVED âœ“' : 'ðŸ”– BOOKMARK'}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="hidden md:flex justify-center relative flex-1">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#d4af37]/20 to-transparent blur-md pointer-events-none" />
          <span className="text-[12px] font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] tracking-[0.3em] text-[#f5e6c8] font-bold relative z-10 text-center truncate">
            {book.title.toUpperCase()}
          </span>
        </div>
        
        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 md:gap-6 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 md:gap-2 border border-[#1e2633] rounded bg-[#141b26] p-0.5 md:p-1">
            <button onClick={() => setFontSize(f => Math.max(12, f - 2))} className="w-6 h-6 md:w-8 md:h-8 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#22d3ee] hover:text-black rounded text-[#8892a6] text-[10px] md:text-xs font-mono transition-colors">A-</button>
            <span className="text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono w-4 md:w-6 text-center text-[#a5f3fc]">{fontSize}</span>
            <button onClick={() => setFontSize(f => Math.min(28, f + 2))} className="w-6 h-6 md:w-8 md:h-8 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#22d3ee] hover:text-black rounded text-[#8892a6] text-[10px] md:text-xs font-mono transition-colors">A+</button>
            <button onClick={toggleAmbientSound} className={`w-8 h-8 rounded border ml-2 flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${ambientOn ? 'bg-[#f59e0b]/20 border-[#f59e0b] text-[#f59e0b]' : 'border-transparent text-[#8892a6] hover:text-white'}`}>
              {ambientOn ? 'ðŸ”Š' : 'ðŸ”‡'}
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.1em] md:tracking-[0.2em] text-[#22d3ee] text-right">
            {isMobile ? `SCROLLING` : `PAGES ${leftPageNumber}-${rightPageNumber} / ${totalBookPages}`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden bg-[#050810]" style={{ perspective: '2000px' }}>
        
        {!isMobile && (
          <>
            <button onClick={() => turnPage('prev')} disabled={pageIndex === 0} className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 left-6 md:left-12 w-10 h-10 md:w-14 md:h-14 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#0a0f16]/80 backdrop-blur border border-[#22d3ee]/30 text-[#22d3ee] hover:bg-[#22d3ee] hover:text-black transition-all disabled:opacity-20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed z-50 text-lg md:text-xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2)]">â—‚</button>
            <button onClick={() => turnPage('next')} disabled={pageIndex + 1 >= totalPages} className="absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 right-6 md:right-12 w-10 h-10 md:w-14 md:h-14 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#0a0f16]/80 backdrop-blur border border-[#22d3ee]/30 text-[#22d3ee] hover:bg-[#22d3ee] hover:text-black transition-all disabled:opacity-20 disabled:cursor-not-allowed z-50 text-lg md:text-xl shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2)]">â–¸</button>
          </>
        )}

        <div className="relative w-full max-w-[1000px] md:max-w-[1300px] h-full md:h-[85vh] md:max-h-[850px] md:rounded-r-2xl md:rounded-l-lg bg-[#fcf9f2] shadow-none md:shadow-[0_35px_60px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9),0_0_40px_rgba(34,211,238,0.05)] border-0 md:border border-[#e5e0d0]">
          
          <div className="hidden md:block absolute top-1 bottom-1 -right-2 w-2 bg-[#e5e0d0] rounded-r-xl border border-[#d4cfc0] z-0" />
          <div className="hidden md:block absolute top-2 bottom-2 -right-3 w-2 bg-[#fcf9f2] rounded-xl border border-[#d4cfc0] z-0" />

            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

        {isMobile ? 'SCROLL TO READ' : 'USE ARROWS TO TURN PAGES'}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import LibraryClient from './LibraryClient'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function EbooksPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: books } = await supabase
    .from('library_books')
    .select('*')
    .eq('published', true)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('library_progress')
    .select('book_id, scroll_percentage, updated_at, is_bookmarked')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)

  const latestProgress = progress?.sort((a, b) => 
    new Date(b.updated_at).getTime() - new Date(a.updated_at).getTime()
  )[0]

  const latestBook = books?.find(b => b.id === latestProgress?.book_id)
  const progressMap = new Map(progress?.map(p => [p.book_id, p.scroll_percentage]) || [])

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <LibraryClient 
        initialBooks={books || []} 
        progressMap={progressMap} 
        latestBook={latestBook}
        allProgress={progress || []}
      />
    </AppShell>
  )
}

            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 10px #22d3ee' }} />

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import SiblingNav from '@/components/SiblingNav'
import CopyButton from '@/components/CopyButton'
import ResumeTracker from '@/components/ResumeTracker'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'

export const revalidate = 0

export default async function PromptDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  const { data: spec, error } = await supabase
    .from('study_specs')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', resolvedParams.id)
    .single()

  if (error || !spec) notFound()

  const { data: siblings } = await supabase
    .from('study_specs')
    .select('id, title')
    .eq('category', spec.category)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })

  const currentIndex = siblings?.findIndex(s => s.id === spec.id) ?? -1
  const prev = currentIndex > 0 ? siblings![currentIndex - 1] : null
  const next = currentIndex < (siblings?.length ?? 0) - 1 ? siblings![currentIndex + 1] : null

  const promptText = spec.content || spec.prompt || spec.body || spec.description || "Prompt content goes here..."

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user?.email ?? undefined}>
      {/* THE MAGIC TRACKER */}
      <ResumeTracker type="spec" id={spec.id} title={spec.title} href={`/library/prompts/${spec.id}`} />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-24 font-sans w-full min-h-screen pt-12 relative z-10">
        
        <Link href="/library/prompts" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#8892a6] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition-colors mb-12">
          <span>&larr;</span> BACK TO PROTOCOLS
        </Link>

        <div className="mb-12 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end justify-between gap-6">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-4">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee]" />
              {spec.category}
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-white mb-4 tracking-wide drop-shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2)]">
              {spec.title}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-[#8892a6] text-lg font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] italic max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
              {spec.description}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="shrink-0">
            <CopyButton text={promptText} />
          </div>

        <div className="relative p-[1px] rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#22d3ee]/80 via-[#3b82f6]/40 to-[#8b5cf6]/80 shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15)] group hover:shadow-[0_0_70px_rgba(34,211,238,0.3)] transition-all duration-500">
