import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import SiblingNav from '@/components/SiblingNav'
import ResumeTracker from '@/components/ResumeTracker'
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'

export const revalidate = 0

interface VaultStep {
  num: string
  title: string
  color: string
  content: string
}

export default async function VaultDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  const { data: entry, error } = await supabase
    .from('knowledge_vault')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', resolvedParams.id)
    .single()

  if (error || !entry) notFound()

  const { data: siblings } = await supabase
    .from('knowledge_vault')
    .select('id, title')
    .eq('discipline', entry.discipline)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })

  const currentIndex = siblings?.findIndex(s => s.id === entry.id) ?? -1
  const prev = currentIndex > 0 ? siblings![currentIndex - 1] : null
  const next = currentIndex < (siblings?.length ?? 0) - 1 ? siblings![currentIndex + 1] : null

  const sections = [
    { label: 'DETAILED EXPLANATION', data: entry.detailed_explanation, type: 'text' },
    { label: 'FIRST PRINCIPLES', data: entry.first_principles, type: 'list' },
    { label: 'ANALOGIES', data: entry.analogies, type: 'quote' },
    { label: 'CONNECTIONS', data: entry.connections, type: 'tags' },
    { label: 'APPLICATIONS', data: entry.applications, type: 'list' },
    { label: 'FURTHER QUESTIONS', data: entry.further_questions, type: 'terminal' }
  ].filter(sec => sec.data && (Array.isArray(sec.data) ? sec.data.length > 0 : sec.data.trim() !== ''))

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user?.email ?? undefined}>
      {/* THE MAGIC TRACKER */}
      <ResumeTracker type="vault" id={entry.id} title={entry.title} href={`/library/vault/${entry.id}`} />

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-24 font-sans w-full min-h-screen pt-12 relative z-10">
        
        <Link href="/library/vault" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#8892a6] hover:text-[#f59e0b] transition-colors mb-12">
          <span>&larr;</span> BACK TO VAULT
        </Link>

        <div className="mb-16">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#f59e0b] mb-4">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rotate-45 bg-[#f59e0b] shadow-[0_0_10px_#f59e0b] animate-[spin_4s_linear_infinite]" />
            {entry.discipline}
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl md:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-white mb-6 tracking-wide drop-shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(245,158,11,0.2)]">
            {entry.title}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-[#8892a6] text-xl font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] italic max-w-2xl leading-relaxed">
            "{entry.core_concept}"
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* THE TIMELINE UI */}
        <div className="relative border-l-2 border-white/5 ml-4 md:ml-6 space-y-16 pb-12 mb-16">
          {sections.map((section, index) => {
            const colors = ['#22d3ee', '#c084fc', '#ec4899', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#ef4444'];
            const color = colors[index % colors.length];
            const stepNum = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0');

            return (
              <div key={section.label} className="relative pl-10 md:pl-14 group">
                
                <div 
                  className="absolute -left-[21px] top-0 w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[10px] font-bold bg-[#0a0f18] border-2 z-10 transition-all duration-500 group-hover:scale-110"
                  style={{ borderColor: color, color: color, boxShadow: `0 0 15px ${color}40` }}
                >
                  {stepNum}
                </div>

                <div className="pt-1">
                  <h3 
                    className="text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase mb-4 font-bold drop-shadow-md"
                    style={{ color: color }}
                  >
                    {section.label}
                  </h3>
                  
                  <div className="prose prose-invert max-w-none">
                    {section.type === 'text' && (
                      <p className="text-[#e5e9f0] font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-xl leading-relaxed">
                        {section.data}
                      </p>
                    )}

                    {section.type === 'list' && Array.isArray(section.data) && (
                      <ul className="space-y-4">
                        {section.data.map((item: string, i: number) => (
                          <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-4">
                            <span style={{ color }} className="mt-1.5 text-xs drop-shadow-md">â—†</span>
                            <span className="text-[#e5e9f0] font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-xl leading-relaxed">
                              {item}
                            </span>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    )}

                    {section.type === 'quote' && Array.isArray(section.data) && (
                      <div className="space-y-4">
                        {section.data.map((item: string, i: number) => (
                          <p key={i} className="text-[#c8d0dd] font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] text-xl italic leading-relaxed pl-4 border-l border-white/10">
                            "{item}"
                          </p>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {section.type === 'tags' && Array.isArray(section.data) && (
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                        {section.data.map((item: string, i: number) => (
                          <span key={i} className="px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-sm font-mono text-[#e5e9f0]">
                            {item}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {section.type === 'terminal' && Array.isArray(section.data) && (
                      <div className="space-y-3 font-mono text-sm">

                            <span className="text-white/30">{'>'}</span>
                            <span>{item}</span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>

        <SiblingNav prev={prev} next={next} basePath="/library/vault" accent="gold" />
      </div>

  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import ProfileClient from './ProfileClient'

export default async function ProfilePage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id, email, full_name, username, role, created_at')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        {/* header */}
        <div className="mb-8 md:mb-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-2">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            PROFILE
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-[0.15em] text-[#e5e9f0]">
            OPERATOR
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2 text-[#8892a6]">
            Your account and identity inside Meridian Academy.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ProfileClient
          email={profile?.email ?? user.email ?? ''}
          username={profile?.username ?? ''}
          fullName={profile?.full_name ?? ''}
          role={profile?.role ?? 'member'}
          joinedAt={profile?.created_at ?? ''}
        />
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

// FILE: app/profile/ProfileClient.tsx
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Props = {
  email: string
  username: string
  fullName: string
  role: string
  joinedAt: string
}

export default function ProfileClient({
  email,
  username,
  fullName,
  role,
  joinedAt,
}: Props) {
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [name, setName] = useState(fullName)
  const [savingName, setSavingName] = useState(false)
  const [nameMsg, setNameMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [savingPw, setSavingPw] = useState(false)
  const [pwMsg, setPwMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  async function saveName() {
    setSavingName(true)
    setNameMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ full_name: name })
      .eq('email', email)

    if (error) {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Name updated.' })
    }
    setSavingName(false)
  }

  async function updatePassword() {
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: 'Password must be at least 6 characters.' })
      return
    }
    setSavingPw(true)
    setPwMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Password updated.' })
      setPassword('')
    }
    setSavingPw(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* IDENTITY */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.72)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          boxShadow: '0 0 60px rgba(34,211,238,0.10)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          IDENTITY
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <InfoRow label="EMAIL" value={email} mono />
          <InfoRow label="USERNAME" value={username || 'â€”'} mono />
          <InfoRow label="ROLE" value={role.toUpperCase()} />
          {joinedAt && (
            <InfoRow
              label="JOINED"
              value={new Date(joinedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
                day: 'numeric',
                month: 'long',
                year: 'numeric',
              })}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* DISPLAY NAME */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          DISPLAY NAME
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">FULL NAME</label>
        <input
          value={name}
          onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Your name"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={saveName}
            disabled={savingName || name === fullName}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingName ? 'SAVING...' : 'â–¸ SAVE'}
          </button>
          {nameMsg && (
            <span className="text-xs font-mono"
              style={{ color: nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{nameMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PASSWORD */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          SECURITY
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">NEW PASSWORD</label>
        <input
          type="password"
          value={password}
          onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="At least 6 characters"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={updatePassword}
            disabled={savingPw || password.length === 0}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingPw ? 'UPDATING...' : 'â–¸ UPDATE PASSWORD'}
          </button>
          {pwMsg && (
            <span className="text-xs font-mono"
              style={{ color: pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{pwMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* console hint */}
      <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-5 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] flex-wrap">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[#22d3ee]">TAB</span>
          <span>NAVIGATE FIELDS</span>
        </span>
        <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[#22d3ee]">CLICK</span>
          <span>SAVE</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function InfoRow({
  label,
  value,
  mono = false,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  mono?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-2 border-b last:border-b-0"

      </span>
      <span
        className={`text-sm text-right min-w-0 truncate ${mono ? 'font-mono' : ''}`}
        style={{ color: '#e5e9f0' }}
      >
        {value}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}

// FILE: app/reset-password/page.tsx  (URL: /reset-password)

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
      if (data.user) setReady(true)
    })
  }, [supabase])

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Passwords do not match')
      return
    }
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setError('Password must be at least 6 characters')
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }
    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-6">Choose a new password</h1>

        {!ready ? (
          <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
            Verifying reset link...
          </p>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              New password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-4 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Confirm password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Updating...' : 'Update password'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'

  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')

  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('')

'use client'

type Variant = 'landing' | 'dashboard' | 'learning'

export default function AcademyBackground({
  variant = 'dashboard',
}: {
  variant?: Variant | string
}) {
  const v = (variant as Variant) || 'dashboard'
  const richer = v === 'landing'
  const quieter = v === 'learning'

  return (
    <div className="m-bg-root" aria-hidden>
      <div className="m-bg-base" />

      <div
        className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-a"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 0.75 : quieter ? 0.28 : 0.5,
        }}
      />
      <div
        className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-b"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 0.65 : quieter ? 0.22 : 0.42,
        }}
      />
      {!quieter && (
        <div
          className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-c"
          style={{ opacity: richer ? 0.5 : 0.28 }}
        />
      )}

      <div
        className="m-bg-grid"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 1 : quieter ? 0.35 : 0.7,
        }}
      />

      {!quieter && <div className="m-bg-horizon" />}

      <div className="m-bg-vignette" />
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import Sidebar from './Sidebar'
import MobileNav from './MobileNav'
import ContextSidebar from './ContextSidebar'
import CommandCenter from './CommandCenter'
import AcademyBackground from './AcademyBackground'
import { installZoneTracker } from '@/lib/navZone'

export default function AppShell({
  children,
  userEmail,
  variant = 'dashboard',
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
  userEmail?: string
  variant?: 'dashboard' | 'learning'
}) {
  const [focusMode, setFocusMode] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    return installZoneTracker()
  }, [])

  return (
    <div className="h-screen w-screen flex overflow-hidden relative" style={{ background: '#050810' }}>
      <AcademyBackground variant={variant} />
      
      <div className="relative flex w-full h-full overflow-hidden" style={{ zIndex: 1 }}>
        
        {/* LEFT SIDEBAR */}
        {!focusMode && (
          <div className="w-64 shrink-0 hidden md:block overflow-hidden relative">
            <Sidebar userEmail={userEmail} />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* MAIN CONTENT */}
        <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 overflow-hidden relative bg-[#050810]">
          
          {/* FIX: Hard hide the MobileNav on desktop so it can't bleed */}
          <div className="md:hidden w-full shrink-0">
            <MobileNav userEmail={userEmail} />
          </div>
          
          <main className="flex-1 min-w-0 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar relative">
            <div className="w-full px-4 sm:px-6 md:px-8 lg:px-12 pt-6 md:pt-10 pb-16 md:pb-24">
              {children}
            </div>
          </main>

          <button
            onClick={() => setFocusMode(!focusMode)}
            className="fixed top-6 right-6 z-[60] group flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-2 border-[#22d3ee]/50 bg-[#050810]/80 backdrop-blur hover:bg-[#22d3ee]/20 hover:border-[#22d3ee] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.4)] transition-all"
            title={focusMode ? "Show Portals" : "Focus Mode (Hide Portals)"}
          >
            <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-[#22d3ee] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
              {focusMode ? (
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M4 8V4m0 0h4M4 4l5 5m11-1V4m0 0h-4m4 0l-5 5M4 16v4m0 0h4m-4 0l5-5m11 5l-5-5m5 5v-4m0 4h-4" />
              ) : (
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M4 8V4m0 0h4M4 4l5 5m11-1V4m0 0h-4m4 0l-5 5M4 16v4m0 0h4m-4 0l5-5m11 5l-5-5m5 5v-4m0 4h-4" />
              )}
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* RIGHT SIDEBAR */}
        {!focusMode && (
          <div className="w-80 shrink-0 hidden xl:block overflow-hidden relative">
            <ContextSidebar userEmail={userEmail} />
          </div>
        )}

        <CommandCenter userEmail={userEmail} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

interface SkillRow { slug: string, name: string, icon: string, accent_color: string, xp: number, level: number }

const SKILL_ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
  dutch: 'ðŸ‡³ðŸ‡±', english: 'ðŸ‡¬ðŸ‡§', communication: 'ðŸ’¬',
  first_principles: 'ðŸ§ ', mental_models: 'ðŸ—ºï¸', systems_thinking: 'âš™ï¸',
  programming: 'ðŸ’»', prompt_engineering: 'ðŸ¤–', architecture: 'ðŸ—ï¸',
  strategy: 'â™Ÿï¸', finance: 'ðŸ“ˆ', logic: 'ðŸ§©',
  philosophy: 'ðŸ›ï¸', writing: 'âœï¸', design: 'ðŸŽ¨',
}

const SKILL_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  dutch: '#22d3ee', english: '#3b82f6', communication: '#8b5cf6',
  first_principles: '#f59e0b', mental_models: '#f97316', systems_thinking: '#ec4899',
  programming: '#10b981', prompt_engineering: '#14b8a6', architecture: '#06b6d4',
  strategy: '#ef4444', finance: '#eab308', logic: '#a855f7',
  philosophy: '#d946ef', writing: '#f43f5e', design: '#fb923c',
}

export default function CombatPanel() {
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<SkillRow[]>([])
  const [combatLevel, setCombatLevel] = useState(1)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const supabase = createClient()

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      const { data: domains } = await supabase.from('skill_domains').select('id, slug, name, icon, accent_color')
      const { data: allSkills } = await supabase.from('skills').select('id, slug, name, domain_id')
      
      let progress: any[] = []
      if (user) {
        const { data: p } = await supabase.from('user_skill_progress').select('skill_id, xp, level').eq('user_id', user.id)
        if (p) progress = p
        const { data: combat } = await supabase.rpc('get_combat_level', { p_user_id: user.id })
        if (combat) setCombatLevel(combat as number)
      }

      if (allSkills && domains) {
        const progressMap = new Map((progress || []).map((p: any) => [p.skill_id, p]))
        const domainMap = new Map(domains.map((d: any) => [d.id, d]))
        
        const rows: SkillRow[] = allSkills.map((s: any) => {
          const p = progressMap.get(s.id)
          return {
            slug: s.slug,
            name: s.name,
            icon: SKILL_ICONS[s.slug] || 'â—ˆ',
            accent_color: SKILL_COLORS[s.slug] || '#22d3ee',
            xp: p ? p.xp : 0,
            level: p ? p.level : 1,
          }
        }).sort((a: SkillRow, b: SkillRow) => {
          if (a.xp > 0 && b.xp === 0) return -1
          if (a.xp === 0 && b.xp > 0) return 1
          return b.xp - a.xp
        })
        setSkills(rows)
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    setLoading(false)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load()
    window.addEventListener('meridian-skill-updated', load)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('meridian-skill-updated', load)
  }, [])

  if (loading) return <div className="brief-box p-6 lg:col-span-2 h-64 animate-pulse" style={{ '--accent-color': '#c084fc' } as any} />

  return (
    <div className="brief-box p-6 lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col" style={{ '--accent-color': '#c084fc' } as any}>
      <div className="relative z-10 mb-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] tracking-wider" style={{ color: '#c084fc', textShadow: '0 0 30px rgba(192,132,252,0.6)' }}>
            {combatLevel}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-xs font-mono tracking-widest text-[#c084fc] font-bold mb-1">COMBAT LEVEL</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-wider text-[#8892a6]">DIGITAL RENAISSANCE ARCHITECT</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-wider text-[#566074] mt-1">{skills.length} SKILLS UNLOCKED</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 flex-1 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-x-6 gap-y-3">
          {skills.map((skill) => {
            const pct = Math.min(100, ((skill.xp % 500) / 500) * 100)
            const isActive = skill.xp > 0
            return (
              <div key={skill.slug} className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded border text-sm" style={{ borderColor: skill.accent_color + '60', backgroundColor: skill.accent_color + '15', color: skill.accent_color }}>
                  {skill.icon}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-baseline mb-1">
                    <span className={'text-[11px] font-mono truncate font-bold ' + (isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#8892a6]')}>{skill.name}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold shrink-0 ml-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 border border-white/10" style={{ color: skill.accent_color }}>LVL {skill.level}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-black rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/5">
                    <div className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-1000" style={{ width: pct + '%', backgroundColor: skill.accent_color, boxShadow: '0 0 8px ' + skill.accent_color }} />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE PATH: components\CommandCenter.tsx

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import CombatPanel from './CombatPanel'

const MERIDIAN_QUOTES = [
  "The most powerful tool is a disciplined mind.",
  "Knowledge is a map; wisdom is the compass.",
  "We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.",
  "To understand the universe, you must first understand the observer.",
  "Information is cheap. Synthesis is priceless.",
  "The map is not the territory.",
  "Entropy is the default state. Order requires energy."
]

const DIRECTIVES = [
  "Synthesize two unrelated concepts from the Vault today.",
  "Read one Master Prompt and apply it to a real-world problem.",
  "Log three new insights into the Data Scratchpad.",
  "Refactor a prompt to be 50% shorter but 2x more effective.",
  "Identify a first principle from your current field of study.",
  "Connect a biological concept to a business strategy."
]

export default function CommandCenter({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const prefix = userEmail ? userEmail + '_' : 'guest_'

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(25 * 60)
  const [isRunning, setIsRunning] = useState(false)
  const [note, setNote] = useState('')
  const [sysLog, setSysLog] = useState('SYSTEM STANDBY')
  const [directive, setDirective] = useState(DIRECTIVES[0])
  const [shards, setShards] = useState(0)
  const [sysTime, setSysTime] = useState('')
  const [questLog, setQuestLog] = useState<any[]>([])
  
  const [missions, setMissions] = useState([
    { id: 1, text: 'Access the Vault', completed: false },
    { id: 2, text: 'Complete a Focus Session', completed: false },
    { id: 3, text: 'Log data in Scratchpad (>15 chars)', completed: false },
    { id: 4, text: 'Run "status" in Terminal', completed: false },
  ])

  const [terminalInput, setTerminalInput] = useState('')
  const [terminalLogs, setTerminalLogs] = useState<string[]>([
    'MERIDIAN OS v2.0.4 initialized...',
    'Connection to Vault established.',
    'Type "help" for a list of commands.'
  ])
  const terminalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)

  const logEvent = async (action: string, xp: number) => {
    try {
      const existingLog = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_log') || '[]')
      const newEvent = { timestamp: Date.now(), action, xp }
      const updatedLog = [newEvent, ...existingLog].slice(0, 50)
      localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'meridian_log', JSON.stringify(updatedLog))
      setQuestLog(updatedLog)
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      const { createClient } = await import('@/lib/supabase/client')
      const supabase = createClient()
      await supabase.rpc('award_shards', { shard_amount: xp, activity_reason: action })
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event('meridian-shards-updated'))
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('award_shards failed', e)
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOpen = (e: any) => {
      setIsOpen(true)
      const section = e?.detail?.section
      if (section) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          const el = document.querySelector(`[data-cc-section="${section}"]`)
          if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' })
        }, 150)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('open-command-center', handleOpen as any)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('open-command-center', handleOpen as any)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    const savedNote = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_scratchpad')
    if (savedNote) setNote(savedNote)
    const savedMissions = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_missions')
    if (savedMissions) { try { setMissions(JSON.parse(savedMissions)) } catch (e) {} }
    const savedShards = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_shards')
    if (savedShards) setShards(parseInt(savedShards))
    const savedLog = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_log')
    if (savedLog) { try { setQuestLog(JSON.parse(savedLog)) } catch (e) {} }

    setDirective(DIRECTIVES[Math.floor(Math.random() * DIRECTIVES.length)])
    
    const clock = setInterval(() => {
      const now = new Date()
      setSysTime(now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour12: false }))
    }, 1000)
    return () => clearInterval(clock)
  }, [prefix])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'meridian_scratchpad', note)
    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'meridian_missions', JSON.stringify(missions))
    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'meridian_shards', shards.toString())
  }, [note, missions, shards, prefix])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    const mission = missions.find((m: any) => m.id === 3)
    if (note.length > 15 && mission && !mission.completed) {
      setMissions((prev: any) => prev.map((m: any) => m.id === 3 ? { ...m, completed: true } : m))
      setShards((s: number) => s + 25)
      setSysLog('DATA LOGGED. MISSION COMPLETE. +25 SHARDS.')
      logEvent('Logged data in Scratchpad', 25)
    }
  }, [note, missions, prefix])

  useEffect(() => {
    let interval: NodeJS.Timeout
    if (isRunning && timeLeft > 0) {
      interval = setInterval(() => setTimeLeft((prev) => prev - 1), 1000)
    } else if (timeLeft === 0) {
      setIsRunning(false)
      setSysLog('FOCUS SESSION COMPLETE. +50 SHARDS')
      setShards((prev: number) => prev + 50)
      logEvent('Completed Focus Session', 50)
      const mission = missions.find((m: any) => m.id === 2)
      if (mission && !mission.completed) {
        setMissions((prev: any) => prev.map((m: any) => m.id === 2 ? { ...m, completed: true } : m))
      }
    }
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [isRunning, timeLeft, missions])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (terminalRef.current) terminalRef.current.scrollTop = terminalRef.current.scrollHeight
  }, [terminalLogs])

  const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
    const m = Math.floor(seconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')
    const s = (seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')
    return m + ':' + s
  }

  const toggleTimer = () => {
    setIsRunning(!isRunning)
    setSysLog(isRunning ? 'FOCUS PAUSED' : 'FOCUS ENGAGED // DO NOT DISTURB')
  }
  const resetTimer = () => {
    setTimeLeft(25 * 60)
    setIsRunning(false)
    setSysLog('SYSTEM STANDBY')
  }
  const cycleDirective = () => {
    let newDir = directive
    while (newDir === directive) {
      newDir = DIRECTIVES[Math.floor(Math.random() * DIRECTIVES.length)]
    }
    setDirective(newDir)
  }

  const handleVaultClick = () => {
    const mission = missions.find((m: any) => m.id === 1)
    if (mission && !mission.completed) {
      setMissions((prev: any) => prev.map((m: any) => m.id === 1 ? { ...m, completed: true } : m))
      setShards((s: number) => s + 25)
      setSysLog('VAULT ACCESSED. MISSION COMPLETE. +25 SHARDS.')
      logEvent('Accessed Knowledge Vault', 25)
    }
  }

  const purgeCache = () => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    localStorage.removeItem(prefix + 'meridian_scratchpad')
    localStorage.removeItem(prefix + 'meridian_missions')
    localStorage.removeItem(prefix + 'meridian_shards')
    localStorage.removeItem(prefix + 'meridian_log')
    setNote('')
    setShards(0)
    setQuestLog([])
    setMissions([
      { id: 1, text: 'Access the Vault', completed: false },
      { id: 2, text: 'Complete a Focus Session', completed: false },
      { id: 3, text: 'Log data in Scratchpad (>15 chars)', completed: false },
      { id: 4, text: 'Run "status" in Terminal', completed: false },
    ])
    setSysLog('CACHE PURGED. SYSTEM RESET.')
    setTerminalLogs((prev: string[]) => [...prev, '> CACHE PURGED. SYSTEM RESET.'])
  }

  const handleCommand = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && terminalInput.trim()) {
      const cmd = terminalInput.toLowerCase().trim()
      let response = ''
      
      switch(cmd) {
        case 'help': response = 'COMMANDS: help, status, xp, quote, clear'; break;
        case 'status': 
          response = 'SYSTEM NOMINAL. FOCUS: ' + (isRunning ? 'ENGAGED' : 'STANDBY') + '. SHARDS: ' + shards
          const mission = missions.find((m: any) => m.id === 4)
          if (mission && !mission.completed) {
            setMissions((prev: any) => prev.map((m: any) => m.id === 4 ? { ...m, completed: true } : m))
            setShards((s: number) => s + 25)
            response += ' | PROTOCOL ACKNOWLEDGED. +25 SHARDS.'
            setSysLog('TERMINAL OVERRIDE. MISSION COMPLETE. +25 SHARDS.')
            logEvent('Ran System Diagnostics', 25)
          }
          break;
        case 'xp': response = 'SHARDS: ' + shards; break;
        case 'quote': response = MERIDIAN_QUOTES[Math.floor(Math.random() * MERIDIAN_QUOTES.length)]; break;
        case 'clear': setTerminalLogs([]); setTerminalInput(''); return;
        default: response = 'Command not recognized: "' + cmd + '". Type "help".'
      }
      setTerminalLogs((prev: string[]) => [...prev, '> ' + terminalInput, response])
      setTerminalInput('')
    }
  }

  return (
    <>
      <button
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(true)}
        className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[100] flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 bg-[#050810] border-2 border-[#22d3ee] px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-[#22d3ee] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(34,211,238,0.4)] hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(34,211,238,0.8)] transition-all duration-300 group"
      >
        <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-xl border border-[#22d3ee]/50 animate-ping opacity-30" />
        <svg className="w-5 h-5 group-hover:animate-pulse drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee] mb-0.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M9 19v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2zm0 0V9a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v10m-6 0a2 2 0 002 2h2a2 2 0 002-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v14a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2z"></path>
        </svg>
        <span className="font-mono text-[9px] tracking-widest font-bold">STATS</span>
      </button>

      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-2 md:p-8 bg-black/95 animate-in fade-in duration-300">
          
          <div className="crisp-bg relative w-full max-w-7xl h-[95vh] md:h-[90vh] border border-[#22d3ee]/30 shadow-[0_0_100px_rgba(34,211,238,0.1)] overflow-hidden font-sans flex flex-col rounded-lg"
               style={{ clipPath: 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 20px), calc(100% - 20px) 100%, 0 100%)' }}>
            
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 md:p-6 border-b border-[#22d3ee]/20 bg-[#020408] shrink-0 relative z-10">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center w-2 h-2">
                  <div className="absolute w-full h-full bg-[#22d3ee] rounded-full animate-ping opacity-50" />
                  <div className="w-2 h-2 bg-[#22d3ee] rounded-full shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee]" />
                </div>
                <h2 className="font-mono text-[10px] md:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] md:tracking-[0.4em] text-white uppercase sharp-cyan">Meridian Bridge</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono text-[#10b981] tracking-[0.1em] hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#10b981]/10 px-3 py-1 rounded border border-[#10b981]/30">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-[#10b981] rounded-full animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_#10b981]" />
                  {sysTime}
                </div>
                <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} className="text-[#8892a6] hover:text-white transition-colors bg-white/5 p-1.5 rounded-md border border-white/10 hover:border-white/30">
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 md:p-8 pb-32 md:pb-8 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-6 relative z-10 flex-1">
              
              {/* 1. Combat Panel (Spans 2 columns on desktop) */}
              <div className="md:col-span-2 lg:col-span-2">
                <CombatPanel />
              </div>

              {/* 2. Active Quests */}
              <div className="brief-box p-4 md:p-6 flex flex-col justify-between" style={{ '--accent-color': '#10b981' } as any}>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#10b981] mb-4 uppercase flex justify-between items-center font-bold">
                    Active Quests
                    <span className="text-[8px] bg-[#10b981]/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-[#10b981]/30">SYNC</span>
                  </h3>
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    {missions.map((mission: any) => (
                      <div 
                        key={mission.id} 
                        className={'flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded border transition-all ' + (mission.completed ? 'bg-[#10b981]/10 border-[#10b981]/30 text-[#10b981]' : 'bg-black/40 border-white/5 text-[#566074]')}
                      >
                        <div className={'w-4 h-4 border rounded flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ' + (mission.completed ? 'border-[#10b981] bg-[#10b981]/20' : 'border-white/10')}>
                          {mission.completed && <svg className="w-3 h-3" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="3" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-wider font-bold leading-tight">{mission.text}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}

FILE PATH: components\ContentArrowNav.tsx

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { getActiveZone, setActiveZone, onZoneChange } from '@/lib/navZone'
import { unlockAudio, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

export default function ContentArrowNav({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1)
  const [zoneActive, setZoneActive] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    return onZoneChange(z => {
      setZoneActive(z === 'content')
      if (z !== 'content') setActiveIndex(-1)
    })
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!zoneActive) return
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const el = ref.current
      if (!el) return
      const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
      if (items.length === 0) return
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (active) {
        const tag = active.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || active.isContentEditable) return
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio(); playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i === -1 ? 0 : i + 1 >= items.length ? 0 : i + 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio(); playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i === -1 ? items.length - 1 : i - 1 < 0 ? items.length - 1 : i - 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const idx = activeIndex < 0 ? 0 : activeIndex
        const target = items[idx]
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault()
          unlockAudio(); playConfirmSound()
          target.click()
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  }, [zoneActive, activeIndex])

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
    items.forEach((it, i) => {
      if (zoneActive && i === activeIndex && activeIndex >= 0) {
        it.setAttribute('data-nav-active', 'true')
      } else {
        it.removeAttribute('data-nav-active')
      }
    })
  }, [activeIndex, zoneActive])

  return <div ref={ref} data-nav-zone="content">{children}</div>
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'

export default function CopyButton({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
    setCopied(true)
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000)
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleCopy}
      className={`group relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-3 rounded-lg font-mono text-xs tracking-widest uppercase transition-all duration-300 border overflow-hidden ${
        copied 
          ? 'bg-[#10b981]/10 border-[#10b981]/50 text-[#10b981] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)]' 
          : 'bg-[#22d3ee]/10 border-[#22d3ee]/40 text-[#22d3ee] hover:bg-[#22d3ee]/20 hover:border-[#22d3ee]/80 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.3)]'
      }`}
    >
      <span className="relative z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
        {copied ? (
          <>
            <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"></path></svg>
            COPIED
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M8 16H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h8a2 2 0 012 2v2m-6 12h8a2 2 0 002-2v-8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-8a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z"></path></svg>

  )

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { hasFlag, getPracticeMinutes } from '@/lib/activity'

const GOALS = [
  { id: 'side_quest', label: 'Complete 1 Side Quest', xp: 20 },
  { id: 'codex', label: 'Review Quest Codex', xp: 10 },
  { id: 'practice', label: 'Practice 15 minutes', xp: 15 },
  { id: 'prompt', label: 'Review a Prompt Spec', xp: 10 },
  { id: 'library', label: 'Read 1 Library entry', xp: 15 },
  { id: 'flashcard', label: 'Flashcard session', xp: 10 },
]

export default function DailyGoal({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({})
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  const supabase = createClient()

  useEffect(() => {
    async function check() {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      if (!user) { setMounted(true); return }

      const today = new Date()
      today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0)
      const todayIso = today.toISOString()

      const results: Record<string, boolean> = {}

      // 1. Side Quest â€” lesson completed today
      const { data: lessons } = await supabase
        .from('lesson_progress')
        .select('completed_at')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .eq('completed', true)
        .gte('completed_at', todayIso)
        .limit(1)
      results.side_quest = (lessons?.length ?? 0) > 0

      // 2. Codex â€” local flag (set by QuestPlayer when opening a lesson)
      results.codex = hasFlag('codex', userEmail)

      // 3. Practice â€” accumulated Pomodoro minutes today
      results.practice = getPracticeMinutes(userEmail) >= 15

      // 4. Prompt â€” user_resume_state updated today for spec
      const { data: prompts } = await supabase
        .from('user_resume_state')
        .select('updated_at')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .eq('resource_type', 'spec')
        .gte('updated_at', todayIso)
        .limit(1)
      results.prompt = (prompts?.length ?? 0) > 0

      // 5. Library â€” library_progress updated today
      const { data: reads } = await supabase
        .from('library_progress')
        .select('updated_at')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .gte('updated_at', todayIso)
        .limit(1)
      results.library = (reads?.length ?? 0) > 0

      // 6. Flashcard â€” local flag
      results.flashcard = hasFlag('flashcard', userEmail)

      setStatus(results)
      setMounted(true)
    }

    check()
    const interval = setInterval(check, 8000)
    return () => clearInterval(interval)
  }, [supabase, userEmail])

  if (!mounted) return null

  const done = GOALS.filter(g => status[g.id]).length
  const earnedXp = GOALS.reduce((sum, g) => sum + (status[g.id] ? g.xp : 0), 0)
  const totalXp = GOALS.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.xp, 0)
  const pct = (done / GOALS.length) * 100
  const allDone = done === GOALS.length

  return (
    <div className="brief-box p-4" style={{ '--accent-color': allDone ? '#10b981' : '#22d3ee' } as any}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full animate-pulse" style={{ background: allDone ? '#10b981' : '#22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-[#8892a6]">DAILY GOAL</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold" style={{ color: allDone ? '#10b981' : '#566074' }}>{done}/{GOALS.length}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2">
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074]">DAILY XP</span>
        <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums text-[#a5f3fc]">{earnedXp}<span className="text-[10px] text-[#3a4250] font-normal"> / {totalXp}</span></span>
      </div>
      <div className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-4 bg-black border border-white/5">
        <div className="h-full transition-all duration-500" style={{ width: pct + '%', background: allDone ? '#10b981' : 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)', boxShadow: allDone ? '0 0 10px rgba(16,185,129,0.6)' : '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)' }} />
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        {GOALS.map((goal) => {
          const complete = status[goal.id] || false
          return (
            <div key={goal.id} className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 -mx-2">
              <span className={'shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] ' + (complete ? 'bg-[#22d3ee] border-[#22d3ee] text-black' : 'border-[#2d3748]')}>
                {complete && 'âœ“'}
              </span>
              <span className={'flex-1 ' + (complete ? 'text-[#3a4250] line-through' : 'text-[#e5e9f0]')}>{goal.label}</span>
              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tabular-nums shrink-0" style={{ color: complete ? '#10b981' : '#3a4250' }}>+{goal.xp}</span>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
      {allDone && (
        <div className="mt-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-center text-[#10b981] rounded-md py-2 border border-[#10b981]/40 bg-[#10b981]/10">âœ“ ALL GOALS COMPLETE</div>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'

interface LogEvent {
  timestamp: number
  action: string
  xp: number
}

export default function DashboardActivityLog({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const [log, setLog] = useState<LogEvent[]>([])
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false)
  const prefix = userEmail ? userEmail + '_' : 'guest_'

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') {
      setLoaded(true)
      return
    }
    const savedLog = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_log')
    if (savedLog) setLog(JSON.parse(savedLog))
    setLoaded(true)
  }, [prefix])

  if (!loaded) return <div className="p-4 animate-pulse text-xs font-mono text-[#566074]">Syncing logs...</div>

  if (log.length === 0) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-xs font-mono text-[#566074]">No activity logged today. Open the Command Center to begin.</div>
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {log.map((event, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="ps5-log-row">
          <span className="text-[#10b981] font-bold mt-0.5">[OK]</span>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="text-[#e5e9f0] font-bold">{event.action}</div>
            <div className="text-[9px] text-[#566074]">{new Date(event.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString()}</div>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[#22d3ee] font-bold text-sharp-cyan">+{event.xp} XP</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function DashboardStats({ xp, combatLevel, initialShards }: { xp: number, combatLevel: number, initialShards: number }) {
  const [shards, setShards] = useState(initialShards)
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0)
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(combatLevel)
  const supabase = createClient()

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
        if (data.user) {
          supabase.from('profiles').select('shards').eq('id', data.user.id).single().then(({ data: p }) => {
            if (p) setShards(p.shards || 0)
          })
          supabase.rpc('get_combat_level', { p_user_id: data.user.id }).then(({ data: c }) => {
            if (c) setLevel(c as number)
          })
        }
      })
    }
    window.addEventListener('meridian-shards-updated', handleUpdate)
    window.addEventListener('meridian-skill-updated', handleUpdate)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('meridian-shards-updated', handleUpdate)
      window.removeEventListener('meridian-skill-updated', handleUpdate)
    }
  }, [supabase])

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-8">
      <div className="dash-stat-card p-5 rounded-lg relative overflow-hidden group">
        <h3 className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#8892a6] uppercase mb-2">Combat Level</h3>
        <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
          <span className="text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-white tracking-wider">LVL {level}</span>

'use client'
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'
import QuickActions from './QuickActions'

type Tool = 'focus' | 'notes' | 'stats'

export default function DashboardWidgets({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const prefix = userEmail ? userEmail + '_' : 'guest_'
  const [nextMission, setNextMission] = useState({ label: 'PENDING DIRECTIVE', text: 'Access the Vault', action: '/library/vault' })
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    const savedMissions = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_missions')
    if (savedMissions) {
      const missions = JSON.parse(savedMissions)
      const pending = missions.find((m: any) => !m.completed)
      if (pending) {
        let action = '/dashboard'
        if (pending.text.includes('Vault')) action = '/library/vault'
        if (pending.text.includes('Focus')) action = 'command-center-focus'
        if (pending.text.includes('Scratchpad')) action = 'command-center-notes'
        if (pending.text.includes('Terminal')) action = 'command-center-stats'
        setNextMission({ label: 'PENDING DIRECTIVE', text: pending.text, action })
      } else {
        setNextMission({ label: 'ALL CLEAR', text: 'Awaiting new assignments.', action: '/dashboard' })
      }
    }
    setLoaded(true)
  }, [prefix])

  function openTool(section: Tool) {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-command-center', { detail: { section } }))
  }

  function openNextObjective() {
    if (nextMission.action === 'command-center-focus') openTool('focus')
    else if (nextMission.action === 'command-center-notes') openTool('notes')
    else if (nextMission.action === 'command-center-stats') openTool('stats')
    else window.location.href = nextMission.action
  }

  if (!loaded) return <div className="h-64 animate-pulse bg-white/5 rounded-lg w-full" />

  const isCC = nextMission.action.startsWith('command-center')

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6 w-full">
      <div className="ps5-panel flex flex-col">
        <div className="ps5-panel-header">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#f59e0b]"><span className="w-2 h-2 bg-[#f59e0b] rounded-full animate-pulse" /> Next Objective</span>
        </div>
        <div className="p-5 flex flex-col justify-center">
          <div className="border-l-2 border-[#f59e0b] pl-4 py-1 mb-4">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#f59e0b] mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold">{nextMission.label}</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-mono text-white font-bold">{nextMission.text}</div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={openNextObjective} className="game-btn w-full py-3 text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            {isCC ? 'Execute Directive' : 'Go to Destination'} <span className="text-base">â†’</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <QuickActions />
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react'
import { getResume, ResumeType } from '@/lib/resume'

export default function DynamicResumeMission() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  const [mission, setMission] = useState({ label: 'START MISSION', title: 'Dutch Mastery', href: '/courses/english-to-dutch-mastery' })

  const getContextType = useCallback((): ResumeType => {
    if (pathname.startsWith('/courses')) return 'course'
    if (pathname.startsWith('/library/prompts')) return 'spec'
    if (pathname.startsWith('/library/vault')) return 'vault'
    // FIX: Library defaults to Ebook
    if (pathname.startsWith('/library')) return 'ebook' 
    return 'course' // Dashboard defaults to Course
  }, [pathname])

  const resolveContext = useCallback(async () => {
    const type = getContextType()
    const saved = await getResume(type)

    if (saved) {
      const labels = { course: 'RESUME COURSE', ebook: 'RESUME READING', spec: 'RESUME SPEC', vault: 'RESUME VAULT' }
      setMission({ label: labels[type], title: saved.title, href: saved.href })
    } else {
      const fallbacks = {
        course: { label: 'START COURSE', title: 'Dutch Mastery', href: '/courses/english-to-dutch-mastery' },
        ebook: { label: 'EXPLORE LIBRARY', title: 'Browse Ebooks', href: '/library/ebooks' },
        spec: { label: 'EXPLORE SPECS', title: 'Browse Prompts', href: '/library/prompts' },
        vault: { label: 'EXPLORE VAULT', title: 'Browse Vault', href: '/library/vault' }
      }
      setMission(fallbacks[type])
    }
  }, [getContextType])

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true)
    resolveContext()
    const handleUpdate = () => resolveContext()
    window.addEventListener('meridian-resume-updated', handleUpdate)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('meridian-resume-updated', handleUpdate)
  }, [pathname, resolveContext])

  if (!mounted) return <div className="h-[60px] w-full bg-[#0a0f16] border border-white/5 rounded-xl animate-pulse" />

  return (
    <Link href={mission.href} className="group/btn flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-[#050810] border border-[#22d3ee]/30 hover:border-[#22d3ee] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2)] transition-all pulse-cyan relative z-10 overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 w-1 h-full bg-[#22d3ee] opacity-50 group-hover/btn:opacity-100 shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee] transition-opacity" />
      <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0 pl-1">
        <span className="text-[8px] font-mono text-[#8892a6] tracking-widest mb-1">{mission.label}</span>
        <span className="text-xs text-white truncate font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] tracking-wide group-hover/btn:text-[#22d3ee] transition-colors">{mission.title}</span>
      </div>
      <span className="text-[#22d3ee] text-lg group-hover/btn:translate-x-1 transition-transform drop-shadow-[0_0_5px_#22d3ee]">â†’</span>
    </Link>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import AcademyBackground from './AcademyBackground'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { triggerNav } from './NavLoader'
import {
  unlockAudio, isAudioUnlocked, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound,
  playInitializingSound, playTickSound, startAmbientHum,
} from '@/lib/sounds'

type MenuIcon = 'play' | 'book' | 'library' | 'users' | 'user'
type MenuItem = { href: string; label: string; sub: string; icon: MenuIcon; primary?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }

const LOADER_MS = 2500

function MenuGlyph({ type }: { type: MenuIcon }) {
  const common = { fill: 'none' as const, stroke: 'currentColor' as const, viewBox: '0 0 24 24', strokeWidth: 1.6, strokeLinecap: 'round' as const, strokeLinejoin: 'round' as const }
  switch (type) {
    case 'play': return <svg {...common}><path d="M5 3l14 9-14 9V3z" /></svg>
    case 'book': return <svg {...common}><path d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253" /></svg>
    case 'library': return <svg {...common}><path d="M19 11H5m14 0a2 2 0 012 2v6a2 2 0 01-2 2H5a2 2 0 01-2-2v-6a2 2 0 012-2m14 0V9a2 2 0 00-2-2M5 11V9a2 2 0 012-2m0 0V5a2 2 0 012-2h6a2 2 0 012 2v2M7 7h10" /></svg>
    case 'users': return <svg {...common}><path d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" /></svg>
    case 'user': return <svg {...common}><path d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z" /></svg>
  }
}

export default function HomeScreen({
  loggedIn, continueHref = '/dashboard', continueLabel = 'CONTINUE', continueSub = 'Resume your journey',
}: { loggedIn: boolean; continueHref?: string; continueLabel?: string; continueSub?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'loading' | 'menu'>('loading')
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(-1)
  const [pulse, setPulse] = useState(0)
  const lastTickRef = useRef(0)
  const soundPlayedRef = useRef(false)
  const stopAmbientRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'loading') return
    if (!soundPlayedRef.current && isAudioUnlocked()) { soundPlayedRef.current = true; playInitializingSound(2200) }
    function retryOnGesture() { unlockAudio(); if (!soundPlayedRef.current) { soundPlayedRef.current = true; playInitializingSound(2200) } }
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', retryOnGesture, { once: true })
    window.addEventListener('keydown', retryOnGesture, { once: true })
    const start = Date.now()
    const DURATION = 2000
    const tick = setInterval(() => {
      const p = Math.min(100, Math.round(((Date.now() - start) / DURATION) * 100))
      setProgress(p)
      const step = Math.floor(p / 12.5)
      if (step > lastTickRef.current && p < 100) { lastTickRef.current = step; playTickSound(p) }
      if (p >= 100) { clearInterval(tick); setTimeout(() => setPhase('menu'), 320) }
    }, 40)
    const dt = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.')), 300)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', retryOnGesture)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', retryOnGesture)
      clearInterval(tick); clearInterval(dt)
    }
  }, [phase])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'menu') return
    stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()
    function onGesture() {
      unlockAudio()
      if (!stopAmbientRef.current) stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()
      else { stopAmbientRef.current(); stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum() }
    }
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onGesture, { once: true })
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onGesture, { once: true })
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onGesture)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onGesture)
      if (stopAmbientRef.current) { stopAmbientRef.current(); stopAmbientRef.current = null }
    }
  }, [phase])

  const items: MenuItem[] = loggedIn
    ? [
        { href: continueHref, label: continueLabel, sub: continueSub, icon: 'play', primary: true },
        { href: '/courses', label: 'COURSES', sub: 'Browse the curriculum', icon: 'book' },
        { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY', sub: 'E-books Â· Specs Â· Vault', icon: 'library' },
        { href: '/community', label: 'COMMUNITY', sub: 'Journal Â· Channels Â· Leaderboard', icon: 'users' },
        { href: '/profile', label: 'PROFILE', sub: 'Account settings', icon: 'user' },
      ]
    : [
        { href: '/signup', label: 'NEW GAME', sub: 'Create a free account', icon: 'play', primary: true },
        { href: '/login', label: 'CONTINUE', sub: 'Log into an existing account', icon: 'user' },
        { href: '/courses', label: 'COURSES', sub: 'Browse the curriculum', icon: 'book' },
        { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY', sub: 'E-books Â· Specs Â· Vault', icon: 'library' },
      ]

  function navigateWithLoader(href: string) {
    unlockAudio(); playConfirmSound(); triggerNav()
    setTimeout(() => router.push(href), LOADER_MS)
  }
  function moveSelection(delta: number) {
    unlockAudio(); playSelectSound()
    setSelected(s => {
      if (s === -1) return delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1
      return (s + delta + items.length) % items.length
    })
    setPulse(p => p + 1)
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'menu') return
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const target = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (target) {
        const tag = target.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || target.isContentEditable) return
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') { e.preventDefault(); moveSelection(1) }
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); moveSelection(-1) }
      else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault()
        const idx = selected < 0 ? 0 : selected
        const it = items[idx]
        if (it && !it.disabled) navigateWithLoader(it.href)
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [phase, selected, items.length])

  if (phase === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)' }} />
        <div className="absolute pointer-events-none" style={{ top: '15%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)', width: '70vw', height: '70vw', maxWidth: 800, maxHeight: 800, background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0%, transparent 60%)' }} />
        <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center">
          <LogoEmblem size={280} className="mb-4" />
          <div className="w-72 md:w-96 mt-8">
            <div className="h-[2px] bg-[#1e2633] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div className="h-full transition-all duration-75" style={{ width: `${progress}%`, background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)', boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.9)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between mt-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]"><span>INITIALIZING{dots}</span><span>{progress}%</span></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-screen flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden">
      <AcademyBackground variant="landing" />

      <header className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b border-[#22d3ee]/10 backdrop-blur-md shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#10b981] animate-pulse" />ONLINE
        </div>
        <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
          <span>BUILD v1.0</span><span>EU-WEST</span><span>{new Date().getFullYear()}</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col items-center px-5 sm:px-6 py-4 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center my-auto">
          <LogoEmblem size={200} className="mb-4 sm:mb-6 shrink-0" />

          <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl rounded-3xl overflow-hidden" style={{
            background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,16,24,0.85) 0%, rgba(3,6,12,0.95) 100%)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.14)',
            boxShadow: '0 40px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 60px rgba(34,211,238,0.08), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(24px)',

function MenuRow({
  item, index, selected, pulseKey, onHover, onActivate,
}: { item: MenuItem; index: number; selected: boolean; pulseKey: number; onHover: () => void; onActivate: () => void }) {
  if (item.disabled) {
    return (
      <li>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-2xl px-4 py-4 opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed border border-transparent">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono w-5 text-center text-[#3a4250]">{String(index).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
            <div>
              <div className="text-base font-bold tracking-[0.15em] text-[#566074]">{item.label}</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#3a4250]">{item.sub}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#3a4250]">LOCKED</span>
        </div>
      </li>
    )
  }

  return (
    <li className="relative">
      <button
        type="button"
        onMouseEnter={onHover}
        onClick={onActivate}
        key={pulseKey}
        className={`group relative w-full text-left flex items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl px-3 py-3.5 md:py-4 transition-all duration-300 ${
          selected
            ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#22d3ee]/18 via-[#22d3ee]/6 to-transparent border border-[#22d3ee]/40 shadow-[0_10px_30px_-10px_rgba(34,211,238,0.5),inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)] translate-x-1'
            : 'border border-transparent hover:bg-white/[0.03] hover:border-white/5'
        }`}
      >
        <span className={`absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[3px] rounded-r-full transition-all duration-300 ${selected ? 'h-9 bg-[#22d3ee] shadow-[0_0_15px_#22d3ee]' : 'h-0 bg-transparent'}`} />

        <div className={`shrink-0 w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-all duration-300 ${
          selected
            ? 'bg-[#22d3ee]/15 text-[#22d3ee] border border-[#22d3ee]/40 shadow-[inset_0_0_12px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2),0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.2)]'
            : 'bg-white/[0.04] text-[#8892a6] border border-white/[0.06]'
        }`}>
          <div className="w-5 h-5"><MenuGlyph type={item.icon} /></div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2.5 mb-1">
            <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest tabular-nums transition-colors ${selected ? 'text-[#22d3ee]' : 'text-[#3a4250]'}`}>
              {String(index).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
            <span className={`text-base md:text-lg font-bold tracking-[0.08em] truncate transition-colors ${selected ? 'text-white' : item.primary ? 'text-[#e5e9f0]' : 'text-[#c8d0dd]'}`}>
              {item.label}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className={`text-[10px] md:text-[11px] font-mono truncate tracking-wider transition-colors ${selected ? 'text-[#22d3ee]/85' : 'text-[#8892a6]'}`}>

interface Block {
  type: string
  text?: string
  level?: number
  items?: string[]
  ordered?: boolean
  attribution?: string
  src?: string
  caption?: string
}

export default function ArticleBody({ blocks }: { blocks: Block[] }) {
  if (!blocks || !Array.isArray(blocks)) return null

  return (
    <div className="article-body">
      {blocks.map((block, i) => {
        switch (block.type) {
          case 'h2':
            return (
              <h2 key={i} className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-white mb-5 mt-12 first:mt-0 leading-tight tracking-tight">
                {block.text}
              </h2>
            )
          case 'h3':
            return (
              <h3 key={i} className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-4 mt-8 leading-tight">
                {block.text}
              </h3>
            )
          case 'p':
            return (
              <p key={i} className="text-[17px] md:text-[19px] leading-[1.75] text-[#c8d0dd] mb-6">
                {block.text}
              </p>
            )
          case 'quote':
            return (
              <blockquote key={i} className="my-10 pl-6 md:pl-8 border-l-2 border-[#22d3ee]">
                <p className="text-xl md:text-2xl leading-relaxed italic text-white font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)] mb-3">
                  "{block.text}"
                </p>
                {block.attribution && (
                  <cite className="text-sm font-mono tracking-widest text-[#8892a6] uppercase not-italic">
                    â€” {block.attribution}
                  </cite>
                )}
              </blockquote>
            )
          case 'callout':
            return (
              <div key={i} className="my-8 p-6 rounded-lg border-l-4 border-[#22d3ee] bg-[#22d3ee]/5">
                <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] uppercase mb-2">Editor's Note</div>
                <p className="text-base md:text-lg leading-relaxed text-white italic">
                  {block.text}
                </p>
              </div>
            )
          case 'list':
            if (!block.items) return null
            return (
              <ul key={i} className={`my-6 space-y-3 ${block.ordered ? 'list-decimal' : 'list-disc'} pl-6 md:pl-8`}>
                {block.items.map((item, j) => (
                  <li key={j} className="text-[17px] md:text-[19px] leading-relaxed text-[#c8d0dd]">
                    {item}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )
          case 'image':
            return (
              <figure key={i} className="my-10">
                <img
                  src={block.src}
                  alt={block.caption || ''}
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-white/5"
                />
                {block.caption && (
                  <figcaption className="mt-3 text-sm text-[#8892a6] italic text-center font-[family-name:var(--font-garamond)]">
                    {block.caption}
                  </figcaption>
                )}
              </figure>
            )
          case 'divider':
            return <hr key={i} className="my-12 border-white/10" />
          default:
            return null
        }
      })}
    </div>
  )
}
