'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function BookmarkButton({ articleId }: { articleId: string }) {
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const supabase = createClient()

  useEffect(() => {
    async function check() {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      if (!user) { setLoading(false); return }
      const { data } = await supabase.from('journal_bookmarks')
        .select('id').eq('user_id', user.id).eq('article_id', articleId).maybeSingle()
      setSaved(!!data)
      setLoading(false)
    }
    check()
  }, [articleId, supabase])

  async function toggle() {
    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
    if (!user) return
    if (saved) {
      await supabase.from('journal_bookmarks').delete().eq('user_id', user.id).eq('article_id', articleId)
      setSaved(false)
    } else {
      await supabase.from('journal_bookmarks').insert({ user_id: user.id, article_id: articleId })
      setSaved(true)
    }
  }

  if (loading) return <div className="w-10 h-10" />

  return (
    <button
      onClick={toggle}
      className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center border transition-all ${
        saved
          ? 'border-[#f59e0b] bg-[#f59e0b]/10 text-[#f59e0b]'
          : 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-[#8892a6] hover:text-white hover:border-white/30'
      }`}
      title={saved ? 'Remove bookmark' : 'Bookmark article'}
    >
      <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill={saved ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M5 5a2 2 0 012-2h10a2 2 0 012 2v16l-7-3.5L5 21V5z" />
      </svg>
    </button>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export default function ReadingProgress() {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)

  useEffect(() => {
    function onScroll() {
      const article = document.querySelector('[data-article-body]') as HTMLElement
      if (!article) return
      const start = article.offsetTop
      const height = article.offsetHeight
      const scrolled = window.scrollY - start
      const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (scrolled / (height - window.innerHeight * 0.5)) * 100))
      setProgress(pct)
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    onScroll()
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [])

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[2px] bg-transparent z-50 pointer-events-none">
      <div
        className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#22d3ee] via-[#8b5cf6] to-[#ec4899] transition-[width] duration-150 shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee]"
        style={{ width: progress + '%' }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ReadingProgressTracker({ articleId, userId }: { articleId: string; userId: string }) {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(false)
  const lastSave = useRef<number>(0)
  const supabase = createClient()

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!userId) return

    // Load existing progress
    async function load() {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from('journal_reading_progress')
        .select('scroll_percentage, completed')
        .eq('user_id', userId)
        .eq('article_id', articleId)
        .maybeSingle()
      if (data) {
        setProgress(data.scroll_percentage || 0)
        setCompleted(data.completed || false)
      }
    }
    load()

    // Track scroll
    function onScroll() {
      const article = document.querySelector('[data-article-body]') as HTMLElement
      if (!article) return
      const rect = article.getBoundingClientRect()
      const total = article.offsetHeight
      const scrolled = Math.max(0, -rect.top + window.innerHeight * 0.3)
      const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((scrolled / (total - window.innerHeight * 0.7)) * 100))
      
      if (pct > progress) {
        setProgress(pct)
        if (pct >= 90 && !completed) setCompleted(true)
        
        // Debounced save (max once per 3s)
        const now = Date.now()
        if (now - lastSave.current > 3000) {
          lastSave.current = now
          supabase.from('journal_reading_progress').upsert({
            user_id: userId,
            article_id: articleId,
            scroll_percentage: pct,
            completed: pct >= 90,
            updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          }, { onConflict: 'user_id,article_id' })
        }
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true })
    onScroll()
    return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll)
  }, [articleId, userId, supabase])

  // Top progress bar
  return (
    <div className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-[3px] z-50 pointer-events-none bg-white/5">
      <div
        className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#f59e0b] via-[#8b5cf6] to-[#ec4899] transition-[width] duration-150 shadow-[0_0_12px_#f59e0b]"
        style={{ width: progress + '%' }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'

interface Mission {
  id: number
  text: string
  completed: boolean
}

export default function LiveDashboardMissions() {
  const [missions, setMissions] = useState<Mission[]>([])
  const [shards, setShards] = useState(0)
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    // Read the live state from the Command Center extension
    const savedMissions = localStorage.getItem('meridian_missions')
    const savedShards = localStorage.getItem('meridian_shards')
    
    if (savedMissions) setMissions(JSON.parse(savedMissions))
    if (savedShards) setShards(parseInt(savedShards))
    
    setLoaded(true)
  }, [])

  if (!loaded) return <div className="h-64 animate-pulse bg-white/5 rounded-lg" />

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-white tracking-[0.1em] uppercase">
          Active Directives

          <svg className="w-3 h-3" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2L2 22h20L12 2zm0 3.8l7.5 14.2H4.5L12 5.8zM11 16h2v2h-2v-2zm0-6h2v4h-2v-4z"/></svg>

FILE PATH: components\NavLoader.tsx

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { pickQuote, type DisciplineQuote } from '@/lib/discipline'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { unlockAudio, playTransitionSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

const EVENT_NAME = 'meridian:nav-start'

export function triggerNav() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
  const fn = (window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav
  if (typeof fn === 'function') {
    fn()
  } else {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT_NAME))
  }
}

export default function NavLoader() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
  const [fading, setFading] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<DisciplineQuote | null>(null)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')

  const prevPathRef = useRef(pathname)
  const startedAtRef = useRef(0)
  const progressRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)
  const fallbackRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function clearProgress() {
      if (progressRef.current) {
        clearInterval(progressRef.current)
        progressRef.current = null
      }
    }
    function clearFallback() {
      if (fallbackRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fallbackRef.current)
        fallbackRef.current = null
      }
    }

    function start() {
      clearProgress()
      clearFallback()
      setQuote(pickQuote())
      setProgress(0)
      setFading(false)
      setVisible(true)
      startedAtRef.current = Date.now()

      unlockAudio()
      playTransitionSound(1400)

      progressRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAtRef.current
        const p = Math.min(88, Math.round((elapsed / 2200) * 88))
        setProgress(p)
        if (p >= 88 && progressRef.current) {
          clearInterval(progressRef.current)
          progressRef.current = null
        }
      }, 30)

      fallbackRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setProgress(100)
        setFading(true)
        setTimeout(() => {
          setVisible(false)
          setFading(false)
        }, 320)
      }, 8000)
    }

    ;(window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav = start
    window.addEventListener(EVENT_NAME, start)

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(EVENT_NAME, start)
      delete (window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav
      clearProgress()
      clearFallback()
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevPathRef.current === pathname) return
    prevPathRef.current = pathname
    if (!visible) return

    const paintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setProgress(100)
      setFading(true)
      setTimeout(() => {
        setVisible(false)
        setFading(false)
      }, 400)
    }, 250)

    return () => clearTimeout(paintTimer)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return
    const id = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.')), 320)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [visible])

  if (!visible || !quote) return null

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-8 pointer-events-none"
      style={{
        zIndex: 9999,
        opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,
        transition: 'opacity 0.38s ease-out',
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0"
        style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)' }}
      />
      <div
        className="absolute pointer-events-none"
        style={{
          top: '15%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          width: '70vw', height: '70vw', maxWidth: 800, maxHeight: 800,
          background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0%, transparent 60%)',
        }}
      />

      <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center max-w-2xl text-center">
        <LogoEmblem size={180} className="mb-6" />

        <div
          className="text-xl md:text-2xl leading-relaxed italic mb-6"
          style={{
            fontFamily: 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif',
            color: '#e5e9f0',
            textShadow: '0 0 24px rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          }}
        >
          &ldquo;{quote.text}&rdquo;
        </div>

        <div
          className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.4em] uppercase"
          style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}
        >
          â€” {quote.author}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute bottom-16 flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
        <div
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            letterSpacing: '0.4em',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
            color: '#566074',
            fontWeight: 500,
          }}
        >
          LOADING{dots}
        </div>
        <div className="h-[2px] w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-full" style={{ background: '#1e2633' }}>
          <div
            className="h-full transition-all duration-75"
            style={{
              width: `${progress}%`,
              background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
              boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.9)',
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function PomodoroTimer({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const prefix = userEmail ? userEmail + '_' : 'guest_'
  const [type, setType] = useState<SessionType>('focus')
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'work' | 'break'>('work')
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(SESSIONS.focus.mins * 60)
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false)
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState(0)
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const storedDate = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-date')
    const storedCount = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-count')
    if (storedDate === today && storedCount) {
      setSessions(parseInt(storedCount))
    } else {
      localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-date', today)
      localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-count', '0')
      setSessions(0)
    }
    setMounted(true)
  }, [prefix])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      if (mode === 'work') { addPracticeSeconds(1, userEmail) }
      setSeconds((s) => {
        if (s <= 1) {
          if (mode === 'work') {
            const today = new Date().toDateString()
            const storedDate = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-date')
            const storedCount = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-count')
            const current = storedDate === today && storedCount ? parseInt(storedCount) : 0
            const next = current + 1
            localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-date', today)
            localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-pomo-count', String(next))
            setSessions(next)
            setMode('break')
            return BREAK_MINS * 60
          } else {
            setMode('work')
            return SESSIONS[type].mins * 60
          }
        }
        return s - 1
      })
    }, 1000)
    return () => { if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current) }
  }, [running, mode, type, prefix])

  function selectType(t: SessionType) {
    setRunning(false); setType(t); setMode('work'); setSeconds(SESSIONS[t].mins * 60)
  }
  function toggle() { setRunning((r) => !r) }
  function reset() { setRunning(false); setMode('work'); setSeconds(SESSIONS[type].mins * 60) }

  if (!mounted) return null

  const total = mode === 'work' ? SESSIONS[type].mins * 60 : BREAK_MINS * 60
  const elapsed = total - seconds
  const pct = (elapsed / total) * 100
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
  const secs = seconds % 60
  const isWork = mode === 'work'
  const accent = isWork ? SESSIONS[type].accent : '#f59e0b'
  const R = 40
  const C = 2 * Math.PI * R
  const dash = (pct / 100) * C

  return (
    <div className="brief-box p-4" style={{ '--accent-color': accent } as any}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full animate-pulse" style={{ background: accent }} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest font-bold" style={{ color: accent }}>{isWork ? 'FOCUS' : 'BREAK'}</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#566074]">{sessions} DONE</span>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 mb-4">
        {(Object.keys(SESSIONS) as SessionType[]).map((k) => {
          const s = SESSIONS[k]; const active = k === type
          return (
            <button key={k} onClick={() => selectType(k)} className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] py-1.5 rounded transition-all" style={{ color: active ? s.accent : '#566074', background: active ? 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)' : 'transparent', border: '1px solid ' + (active ? s.accent + '55' : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.12)') }}>{s.label} MIN</button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center mb-4" style={{ height: 110 }}>
        <svg width="110" height="110" className="absolute -rotate-90">
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r={R} fill="none" stroke="rgba(30,38,51,0.9)" strokeWidth="3" />
          <circle cx="55" cy="55" r={R} fill="none" stroke={accent} strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={C} strokeDashoffset={C - dash} style={{ transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 0.5s linear', filter: 'drop-shadow(0 0 6px ' + accent + 'aa)' }} />
        </svg>
        <div className="text-center relative">
          <div className="text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums leading-none" style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', textShadow: '0 0 20px ' + accent + '66' }}>{String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:{String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}</div>
          <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#3a4250] mt-1.5">{isWork ? 'WORK' : 'REST'}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <button onClick={toggle} className="flex-1 text-black text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-md py-2.5 transition" style={{ background: accent }}>{running ? 'Pause' : 'Start'}</button>
        <button onClick={reset} className="px-3 border border-[#2d3748] text-[#8892a6] hover:text-[#e5e9f0] hover:border-[#22d3ee]/40 text-xs rounded-md py-2 transition">â†º</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import { markFlashcardUsed } from '@/lib/activity'

type Cat = 'verbs' | 'nouns' | 'phrases'

const CAT_LABELS: Record<Cat, string> = {
  verbs: 'VERBS',
  nouns: 'NOUNS',
  phrases: 'PHRASES',
}

const WORDS: Record<Cat, { nl: string; en: string }[]> = {
  verbs: [
    { nl: 'leren',    en: 'to learn' },
    { nl: 'spreken',  en: 'to speak' },
    { nl: 'denken',   en: 'to think' },
    { nl: 'werken',   en: 'to work' },
    { nl: 'wonen',    en: 'to live' },
    { nl: 'lezen',    en: 'to read' },
    { nl: 'schrijven',en: 'to write' },
    { nl: 'drinken',  en: 'to drink' },
    { nl: 'eten',     en: 'to eat' },
    { nl: 'slapen',   en: 'to sleep' },
  ],
  nouns: [
    { nl: 'water',  en: 'water' },
    { nl: 'boek',   en: 'book' },
    { nl: 'huis',   en: 'house' },
    { nl: 'hand',   en: 'hand' },
    { nl: 'school', en: 'school' },
    { nl: 'vriend', en: 'friend' },
    { nl: 'morgen', en: 'morning' },
    { nl: 'avond',  en: 'evening' },
    { nl: 'tijd',   en: 'time' },
    { nl: 'wereld', en: 'world' },
  ],
  phrases: [
    { nl: 'goedemorgen',   en: 'good morning' },
    { nl: 'dank je',       en: 'thank you' },
    { nl: 'alsjeblieft',   en: 'please' },
    { nl: 'tot ziens',     en: 'goodbye' },
    { nl: 'hoe gaat het?', en: 'how are you?' },
    { nl: 'goedenavond',   en: 'good evening' },
    { nl: 'het spijt me',  en: 'I am sorry' },
    { nl: 'geen probleem', en: 'no problem' },
  ],
}

export default function QuickFlashcard({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const [cat, setCat] = useState<Cat>('verbs')
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(0)
  const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState(false)
  const [seen, setSeen] = useState<Record<Cat, Set<number>>>({
    verbs: new Set(),
    nouns: new Set(),
    phrases: new Set(),
  })

  const list = WORDS[cat]
  const card = list[index % list.length]
  const seenCount = seen[cat].size

  const next = useCallback(() => {
    setIndex((i) => (i + 1) % list.length)
    setFlipped(false)
  }, [list.length])

  function selectCat(c: Cat) {
    setCat(c)
    setIndex(0)
    setFlipped(false)
  }

  function flip() {
    markFlashcardUsed(userEmail)
    setFlipped((f) => !f)
    // mark as seen when revealed
    setSeen((prev) => {
      const nextSets = { ...prev }
      const s = new Set(nextSets[cat])
      s.add(index)
      nextSets[cat] = s
      return nextSets
    })
  }

  const progress = (seenCount / list.length) * 100

  return (
    <div className="m-hud-panel">
      <span className="m-hud-scan" />
      <div className="m-hud-header">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" />
          FLASHCARD
        </div>
        <span style={{ color: '#566074' }}>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/{String(list.length).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        {/* Category tabs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 mb-3">
          {(Object.keys(CAT_LABELS) as Cat[]).map((k) => {
            const active = k === cat
            return (
              <button
                key={k}
                onClick={() => selectCat(k)}
                className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] py-1.5 rounded transition-all"
                style={{
                  color: active ? '#a5f3fc' : '#566074',
                  background: active ? 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)' : 'transparent',
                  border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'rgba(34,211,238,0.45)' : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.12)'),
                }}
              >
                {CAT_LABELS[k]}
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Card */}
        <button
          onClick={flip}
          className="w-full h-28 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center px-4 transition mb-3 group"
          style={{
            border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.25)',
            background: flipped
              ? 'rgba(139,92,246,0.05)'
              : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.03)',
          }}
        >
          <div className="text-center">
            {flipped ? (
              <div className="text-base font-semibold text-[#c4b5fd]">
                {card.en}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                className="text-2xl font-bold text-[#a5f3fc]"
                style={{ textShadow: '0 0 16px rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }}
              >
                {card.nl}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-[#3a4250] mt-2.5 tracking-[0.25em] group-hover:text-[#566074] transition">
              {flipped ? 'CLICK TO FLIP BACK' : 'CLICK TO REVEAL'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </button>

        {/* Progress + next */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] shrink-0">
            {seenCount}/{list.length}
          </span>
          <div className="flex-1 h-[2px] rounded-full overflow-hidden"
            style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.9)' }}>
            <div
              className="h-full transition-all duration-500"
              style={{
                width: progress + '%',
                background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={next}
            className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#22d3ee] hover:text-white transition shrink-0"
          >
            NEXT â†’
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

type Tab = 'notes' | 'dutch' | 'business'
const TABS: Record<Tab, { label: string; placeholder: string }> = {
  notes: { label: 'NOTES', placeholder: 'Jot down thoughts, questions, ideas...' },
  dutch: { label: 'DUTCH', placeholder: 'New words, phrases, grammar rules...' },
  business: { label: 'BUSINESS', placeholder: 'Concepts, frameworks, insights...' },
}

export default function QuickNotes({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const prefix = userEmail ? userEmail + '_' : 'guest_'
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('notes')
  const [texts, setTexts] = useState<Record<Tab, string>>({ notes: '', dutch: '', business: '' })
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false)
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    const loaded: Record<Tab, string> = {
      notes: localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-notes-notes') || '',
      dutch: localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-notes-dutch') || '',
      business: localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-notes-business') || '',
    }
    setTexts(loaded)
    setMounted(true)
  }, [prefix])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mounted || !prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    setSaved(false)
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-notes-notes', texts.notes)
      localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-notes-dutch', texts.dutch)
      localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-notes-business', texts.business)
      setSaved(true)
      setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 1200)
    }, 600)
    return () => clearTimeout(t)
  }, [texts, mounted, prefix])

  if (!mounted) return null

  const current = texts[tab]
  const words = current.trim() ? current.trim().split(/\s+/).length : 0

  function clear() {
    if (!window.confirm('Clear this note?')) return
    setTexts((t) => ({ ...t, [tab]: '' }))
  }

  return (
    <div className="brief-box p-4" style={{ '--accent-color': '#22d3ee' } as any}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-[#8892a6]">QUICK NOTES</span>
        </div>
        {saved ? <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#10b981]">SAVED</span> : <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#3a4250]">{words}w</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 mb-3">
        {(Object.keys(TABS) as Tab[]).map((k) => {
          const active = k === tab
          const hasContent = texts[k].trim().length > 0
          return (
            <button key={k} onClick={() => setTab(k)} className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] py-1.5 rounded transition-all relative" style={{ color: active ? '#a5f3fc' : '#566074', background: active ? 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)' : 'transparent', border: '1px solid ' + (active ? 'rgba(34,211,238,0.45)' : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.12)') }}>
              {TABS[k].label}
              {hasContent && !active && <span className="absolute top-1 right-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" style={{ width: 4, height: 4 }} />}
            </button>
          )
        })}
      </div>
      <textarea value={current} onChange={(e) => setTexts((t) => ({ ...t, [tab]: e.target.value }))} placeholder={TABS[tab].placeholder} rows={6} className="w-full rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-xs text-[#e5e9f0] placeholder:text-[#3a4250] outline-none resize-none font-mono leading-relaxed transition-colors mb-2 bg-black/40 border border-[#22d3ee]/20 focus:border-[#22d3ee]/50" />
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#3a4250]">{words} WORDS Â· {current.length} CHARS</span>
        <button onClick={clear} className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-red-400 transition">CLEAR</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import Link from 'next/link'

interface NavItem {
  id: string
  title: string
}

interface SiblingNavProps {
  prev: NavItem | null
  next: NavItem | null
  basePath: string
  accent?: 'cyan' | 'gold'
}

export default function SiblingNav({ prev, next, basePath, accent = 'cyan' }: SiblingNavProps) {
  const isCyan = accent === 'cyan'
  const hoverText = isCyan ? 'group-hover:text-[#22d3ee]' : 'group-hover:text-[#f59e0b]'
  const borderColor = isCyan ? 'group-hover:border-[#22d3ee]' : 'group-hover:border-[#f59e0b]'
  const glow = isCyan ? 'group-hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(34,211,238,0.25)]' : 'group-hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(245,158,11,0.25)]'
  const textAccent = isCyan ? 'text-[#22d3ee]' : 'text-[#f59e0b]'
  const bgHover = isCyan ? 'group-hover:bg-[#22d3ee]/5' : 'group-hover:bg-[#f59e0b]/5'
  const lineColor = isCyan ? 'bg-[#22d3ee]' : 'bg-[#f59e0b]'

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mt-24 pt-12 border-t border-white/5 w-full">
      {prev ? (
        <Link 
          href={`${basePath}/${prev.id}`}
          className={`group relative flex flex-col justify-center p-8 bg-[#050810]/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 transition-all duration-500 ${borderColor} ${glow} ${bgHover} overflow-hidden`}
          style={{ clipPath: 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 20px), calc(100% - 20px) 100%, 0 100%)' }}
        >
          {/* Animated Side Bar */}
          <div className={`absolute top-0 left-0 w-[3px] h-full ${lineColor} opacity-30 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 shadow-[0_0_15px_currentColor]`} />
          
          <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] mb-3 flex items-center gap-3 text-[#8892a6] transition-colors ${hoverText}`}>
            <span className="text-xl transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:-translate-x-2">{'\u2190'}</span> PREVIOUS DATA
          </span>
          <span className={`text-2xl font-bold text-white transition-all duration-300 ${hoverText} font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] tracking-wide`}>
            {prev.title}
          </span>
        </Link>
      ) : <div className="hidden md:block" />}

      {next ? (
        <Link 
          href={`${basePath}/${next.id}`}
          className={`group relative flex flex-col justify-center p-8 bg-[#050810]/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 transition-all duration-500 ${borderColor} ${glow} ${bgHover} overflow-hidden text-right`}
          style={{ clipPath: 'polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 20px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 20px))' }}

'use client'
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import DynamicResumeMission from './DynamicResumeMission'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { triggerNav } from './NavLoader'
import { unlockAudio, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound } from '@/lib/sounds'
import { getActiveZone, onZoneChange } from '@/lib/navZone'

const NAV = [
  { href: '/dashboard', label: 'OVERVIEW' },
  { href: '/courses', label: 'MY COURSES' },
  { href: '/community', label: 'COMMUNITY' },
  { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY' },
  { href: '/profile', label: 'PROFILE' },
]

export default function Sidebar({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const path = usePathname()
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [zoneActive, setZoneActive] = useState(getActiveZone() === 'sidebar')
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<number | null>(null)
  
  const [userStats, setUserStats] = useState({ xp: 0, level: 'Novice' })

  const selectedRef = useRef(0)
  const routerRef = useRef(router)

  useEffect(() => { selectedRef.current = selected }, [selected])
  useEffect(() => { routerRef.current = router }, [router])

  useEffect(() => {
    async function fetchStats() {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
      if (!session) return
      
      const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('xp').eq('id', session.user.id).single()
      
      let lvl = 'Novice'
      if (profile?.xp > 2500) lvl = 'Avid Reader'
      if (profile?.xp > 6000) lvl = 'Builder'
      if (profile?.xp > 12000) lvl = 'Systems Thinker'
      
      setUserStats({ xp: profile?.xp || 0, level: lvl })
    }
    fetchStats()
  }, [supabase])

  useEffect(() => {
    const idx = NAV.findIndex(n => path === n.href || path?.startsWith(n.href + '/'))
    if (idx >= 0) setSelected(idx)
  }, [path])

  useEffect(() => {
    return onZoneChange(z => setZoneActive(z === 'sidebar'))
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!zoneActive) return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (active) {
        const tag = active.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || active.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setSelected(s => {
          const next = (s + 1) % NAV.length
          selectedRef.current = next
          return next
        })
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setSelected(s => {
          const next = (s - 1 + NAV.length) % NAV.length
          selectedRef.current = next
          return next
        })
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playConfirmSound()
        const item = NAV[selectedRef.current]
        if (item) {
          triggerNav()
          routerRef.current.push(item.href)
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  }, [zoneActive])

  async function quitToMainMenu() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    router.push('/')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <aside
      data-nav-zone="sidebar"
      className="hidden md:flex md:flex-col w-72 shrink-0 h-full relative overflow-hidden bg-[#080c14] z-50 border-r border-white/5"
    >
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-[2px] z-20" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #22d3ee 50%, transparent 100%)', opacity: 0.8 }} />
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-20 border-t-2 border-l-2 border-[#22d3ee]/50" />
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-20 border-b-2 border-r-2 border-[#22d3ee]/50" />

      <div className="p-5 border-b border-white/5 shrink-0 relative z-10">
        <Link
          href="/"
          onClick={() => { unlockAudio(); playConfirmSound(); triggerNav(); }}
          className="flex items-center gap-3 group relative rounded-md transition-all hover:bg-white/5 p-2 -m-2"
        >
          <span className="relative shrink-0">
            <span className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none" style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%)', filter: 'blur(10px)' }} />
            <LogoEmblem size={40} />
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-white leading-none font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)]">MERIDIAN</div>
            <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.4em] text-[#22d3ee] mt-1">ACADEMY</div>
          </div>
        </Link>
      </div>

      {/* TACTICAL HUD (XP & DYNAMIC RESUME) */}
      <div className="px-4 pt-6 pb-2 relative z-10">
        <div className="rounded-xl p-4 epic-card epic-card-cyan bg-[#0a0f16] relative overflow-hidden group">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#22d3ee]/10 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" />
          
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 relative z-10">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#22d3ee]">RANK: {userStats.level.toUpperCase()}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#f59e0b] font-bold">{userStats.xp} XP</span>
          </div>
          
          <DynamicResumeMission />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="px-5 pt-4 pb-2 relative z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#3a4250]">PRIMARY NAV</span>
          <span className="flex-1 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-[#22d3ee]/20 to-transparent" />
        </div>
      </div>

      <nav className="flex-1 px-3 space-y-1.5 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar relative z-10 pt-2">
        {NAV.map((item, i) => {
          const active = path === item.href || path?.startsWith(item.href + '/')
          const isSelected = selected === i
          const showSelected = isSelected && zoneActive
          const isHover = hovered === i

          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              onClick={() => { unlockAudio(); playConfirmSound(); triggerNav(); }}
              onMouseEnter={() => { setHovered(i); if (selected !== i) setSelected(i); }}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}
              className={`group relative flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.15em] transition-all duration-300 ${
                showSelected ? 'bg-[#22d3ee]/10 text-white border border-[#22d3ee]/50 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15)] scanline-active' : 
                active ? 'bg-[#22d3ee]/5 text-white border border-[#22d3ee]/20' : 
                isHover ? 'bg-white/5 text-[#c8d0dd]' : 'text-[#8892a6] border border-transparent'
              }`}
            >
              <span className={`text-[9px] font-mono transition-colors w-5 ${showSelected || active ? 'text-[#22d3ee]' : 'text-[#3a4250]'}`}>
                {String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}

                </span>
              )}

          )

      </nav>

        <button onClick={quitToMainMenu} className="w-full text-left px-4 py-3 rounded-lg transition-all group relative overflow-hidden mb-4 flex items-center gap-3 border border-red-500/20 bg-red-500/5 hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:border-red-500/50">
          <span className="text-base leading-none text-red-500 opacity-70 group-hover:opacity-100">â»</span>

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type SkillNode = {
  id: string
  name: string
  description: string
  unlocked: boolean
}

const PROGRESSION: SkillNode[] = [
  { id: 'novice', name: 'Digital Novice', description: 'The journey begins.', unlocked: true },
  { id: 'reader', name: 'Avid Reader', description: 'Consumed foundational texts.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'builder', name: 'Builder', description: 'Applied first principles.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'systems_thinker', name: 'Systems Thinker', description: 'See invisible feedback loops.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'language_architect', name: 'Language Architect', description: 'Master communication grids.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'disciplined_mind', name: 'Disciplined Mind', description: 'Unbreakable focus.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'systems_architect', name: 'Digital Systems Architect', description: 'Master of complex systems.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'renaissance', name: 'Digital Renaissance Architect', description: 'The pinnacle of interdisciplinary mastery.', unlocked: false },
]

export default function SkillTree() {
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<SkillNode[]>(PROGRESSION)
  const [xp, setXp] = useState(0)
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(1)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadSkills() {
      const supabase = createClient()
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      if (!user) return

      const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('xp, level').eq('id', user.id).single()
      if (profile) {
        setXp(profile.xp || 0)
        setLevel(profile.level || 1)
      }

      const { data: userSkills } = await supabase.from('user_skills').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id)

      if (userSkills) {
        const merged = PROGRESSION.map(skill => {
          const dbSkill = userSkills.find(us => us.skill_name === skill.name)
          return dbSkill ? { ...skill, unlocked: dbSkill.unlocked } : skill
        })
        setSkills(merged)
      }
    }
    loadSkills()
  }, [])

  const xpForNextLevel = Math.floor(100 * Math.pow(level, 1.5))
  const progressPercent = Math.min(100, Math.floor((xp / xpForNextLevel) * 100))

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-5">
      
      {/* Level Progress Bar */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#22d3ee] tracking-wider font-bold">LEVEL {level}</span>
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-white">{xp} / {isNaN(xpForNextLevel) ? '---' : xpForNextLevel} XP</span>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full h-2 bg-[#1e2633] rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[#22d3ee]/20">
          <div className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#22d3ee] to-[#3b82f6] transition-all duration-1000" style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Progression List */}
      <div className="relative border-l border-[#1e2633] ml-2 pl-4 space-y-5 pb-2">
        {skills.map((skill, index) => {
          const isCurrent = !skill.unlocked && (index === 0 || skills[index - 1].unlocked);
          
          return (
            <div key={skill.id} className="relative group">
              {/* Timeline Dot */}
              <div 
                className={`absolute -left-[21px] top-1 w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-colors duration-300 ${
                  skill.unlocked 
                    ? 'bg-[#22d3ee] border-[#22d3ee] shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee]' 
                    : isCurrent 
                      ? 'bg-[#0a0f16] border-[#8b5cf6] animate-pulse' 
                      : 'bg-[#0a0f16] border-[#3a4250]'
                }`} 
              />
              
              <div className={`transition-opacity ${skill.unlocked ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-60'}`}>
                <div className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${skill.unlocked ? 'text-white' : isCurrent ? 'text-[#8b5cf6]' : 'text-[#566074]'}`}>
                  {skill.name}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#8892a6] mt-0.5">
                  {skill.description}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function CommentsSection({ articleId, userId, accent = '#f59e0b' }: { articleId: string; userId: string; accent?: string }) {
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [replyTo, setReplyTo] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const supabase = createClient()

  async function load() {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('blog_comments').select('id, content, created_at, user_id, parent_id').eq('article_id', articleId).order('created_at')
    if (data && data.length > 0) {
      const ids = [...new Set(data.map((c: any) => c.user_id))]
      const { data: profiles } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, full_name, email').in('id', ids)
      const names = new Map((profiles || []).map((p: any) => [p.id, p.full_name || p.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Architect']))
      setComments(data.map((c: any) => ({ ...c, author_name: names.get(c.user_id) || 'Architect' })))
    } else setComments([])
    setLoading(false)
  }

  useEffect(() => { load() }, [articleId])

  async function post() {
    if (!text.trim() || !userId) return
    await supabase.from('blog_comments').insert({ article_id: articleId, user_id: userId, content: text.trim(), parent_id: replyTo })
    setText(''); setReplyTo(null); load()
  }

  const roots = comments.filter(c => !c.parent_id)
  const repliesOf = (id: string) => comments.filter(c => c.parent_id === id)

  if (loading) return <div className="mt-16 h-32 animate-pulse bg-white/5 rounded-xl" />

  return (
    <div className="mt-16 pt-10 border-t border-white/10">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-6">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-[family-name:var(--font-cinzel)] font-bold text-white tracking-widest uppercase">Comments Â· {comments.length}</h2>
        <div className="h-px flex-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-white/20 to-transparent" />
      </div>
      <div className="mb-8">
        {replyTo && <div className="mb-2 text-[10px] font-mono" style={{ color: accent }}>Replying... <button onClick={() => setReplyTo(null)} className="text-[#8892a6] ml-2">âœ•</button></div>}
        <textarea value={text} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder="Share your thoughts..." rows={3} className="w-full bg-[#0a0f16] border border-white/10 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm text-white placeholder-[#566074] focus:outline-none resize-none" />
        <div className="flex justify-end mt-2"><button onClick={post} disabled={!text.trim()} className="game-btn px-6 py-2 text-xs disabled:opacity-40">Post Comment</button></div>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {roots.map(c => (
          <div key={c.id} className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-[#0a0f16]">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <div className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold text-black" style={{ backgroundColor: accent }}>{c.author_name?.charAt(0)}</div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{c.author_name}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#566074]">{new Date(c.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-[#c8d0dd] mb-2">{c.content}</p>
            <button onClick={() => setReplyTo(c.id)} className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest" style={{ color: accent }}>Reply</button>
            {repliesOf(c.id).length > 0 && (
              <div className="ml-6 mt-3 space-y-3 border-l border-white/10 pl-4">
                {repliesOf(c.id).map(r => (
                  <div key={r.id}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1"><span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{r.author_name}</span></div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-[#c8d0dd]">{r.content}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        {roots.length === 0 && <div className="text-center py-8 text-[#566074] font-mono text-xs">Be the first to comment.</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export default function MessageFeed({ channelId, userId, accent }: { channelId: string; userId: string; accent: string }) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [polls, setPolls] = useState<any[]>([])
  const [text, setText] = useState('')
  const [showPoll, setShowPoll] = useState(false)
  const [pollQ, setPollQ] = useState('')
  const [pollOpts, setPollOpts] = useState(['', ''])
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const supabase = createClient()

  async function load() {
    const { data: msgs } = await supabase.from('channel_messages').select('id, content, created_at, user_id').eq('channel_id', channelId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(100)
    if (msgs && msgs.length > 0) {
      const ids = [...new Set(msgs.map((m: any) => m.user_id))]
      const { data: profiles } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, full_name, email').in('id', ids)
      const names = new Map((profiles || []).map((p: any) => [p.id, p.full_name || p.email?.split('@')[0] || 'Architect']))
      setMessages(msgs.reverse().map((m: any) => ({ ...m, author_name: names.get(m.user_id) })))
    } else setMessages([])

    const { data: pls } = await supabase.from('channel_polls').select('id, question, options, user_id, created_at').eq('channel_id', channelId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(10)
    if (pls && pls.length > 0) {
      const pollIds = pls.map((p: any) => p.id)
      const { data: votes } = await supabase.from('channel_poll_votes').select('poll_id, option_index, user_id').in('poll_id', pollIds)
      setPolls(pls.map((p: any) => ({ ...p, votes: (votes || []).filter((v: any) => v.poll_id === p.id) })))
    } else setPolls([])
  }

  useEffect(() => { load() }, [channelId])

  useEffect(() => {
    const ch = supabase.channel('msg-' + channelId)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'channel_messages', filter: `channel_id=eq.${channelId}` }, () => load())
      .subscribe()
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(ch) }
  }, [channelId])

  useEffect(() => { bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }) }, [messages.length])

  async function send() {
    if (!text.trim() || !userId) return
    await supabase.from('channel_messages').insert({ channel_id: channelId, user_id: userId, content: text.trim() })
    setText(''); load()
  }

  async function createPoll() {
    if (!pollQ.trim() || !userId) return
    const opts = pollOpts.filter(o => o.trim())
    if (opts.length < 2) return
    await supabase.from('channel_polls').insert({ channel_id: channelId, user_id: userId, question: pollQ.trim(), options: opts })
    setPollQ(''); setPollOpts(['', '']); setShowPoll(false); load()
  }

  async function vote(pollId: string, idx: number) {
    if (!userId) return
    await supabase.from('channel_poll_votes').upsert({ poll_id: pollId, user_id: userId, option_index: idx }, { onConflict: 'poll_id,user_id' })
    load()
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 py-4 px-4">
        {polls.map(p => {
          const total = p.votes.length
          const myVote = p.votes.find((v: any) => v.user_id === userId)
          return (
            <div key={p.id} className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-white/10 bg-[#0a0f16]" style={{ borderTopColor: accent, borderTopWidth: 2 }}>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase mb-2" style={{ color: accent }}>ðŸ“Š Poll</div>
              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-3">{p.question}</div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {(p.options as string[]).map((opt: string, idx: number) => {
                  const count = p.votes.filter((v: any) => v.option_index === idx).length
                  const pct = total > 0 ? (count / total) * 100 : 0
                  const isMine = myVote?.option_index === idx
                  return (
                    <button key={idx} onClick={() => vote(p.id, idx)} className="w-full text-left relative rounded border border-white/10 p-2 overflow-hidden">
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-20" style={{ width: pct + '%', backgroundColor: accent }} />
                      <div className="relative flex justify-between"><span className="text-xs text-white">{opt} {isMine && 'âœ“'}</span><span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8892a6]">{count} Â· {Math.round(pct)}%</span></div>
                    </button>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-[9px] font-mono text-[#566074] uppercase">{total} votes</div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
        {messages.length === 0 && polls.length === 0 && <div className="text-center py-12 text-[#566074] font-mono text-xs">No messages yet. Start the conversation.</div>}
        {messages.map(m => (
          <div key={m.id} className="flex gap-3">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-black" style={{ backgroundColor: accent }}>{m.author_name?.charAt(0)}</div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 mb-1"><span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{m.author_name}</span><span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-[#566074]">{new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}</span></div>
              <p className="text-sm text-[#c8d0dd] break-words">{m.content}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div ref={bottomRef} />
      </div>

      {showPoll && (
        <div className="border-t border-white/10 p-4 bg-[#0a0f16]">
          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-[#f59e0b] mb-2">New Poll</div>
          <input value={pollQ} onChange={e => setPollQ(e.target.value)} placeholder="Question" className="w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white mb-2" />
          {pollOpts.map((o, i) => <input key={i} value={o} onChange={e => { const n = [...pollOpts]; n[i] = e.target.value; setPollOpts(n) }} placeholder={`Option ${i + 1}`} className="w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white mb-1" />)}
          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
            <button onClick={() => setPollOpts([...pollOpts, ''])} className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#8892a6]">+ Option</button>
            <button onClick={createPoll} className="game-btn px-4 py-1.5 text-[10px] ml-auto">Create</button>
            <button onClick={() => setShowPoll(false)} className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] text-[#8892a6]">Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="border-t border-white/10 p-3 flex gap-2 items-end bg-[#0a0f16]">
        <button onClick={() => setShowPoll(true)} className="w-9 h-9 rounded border border-white/10 text-[#8892a6] hover:text-[#f59e0b] flex items-center justify-center" title="Create poll">ðŸ“Š</button>
        <textarea value={text} onChange={e => setText(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); send() } }} placeholder="Message..." rows={1} className="flex-1 bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white placeholder-[#566074] resize-none" />
        <button onClick={send} className="game-btn px-4 py-2 text-xs">Send</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// FILE: components/Starfield.tsx
'use client'

export default function Starfield() {
  const stars = Array.from({ length: 70 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    left: `${(i * 37 + 7) % 100}%`,
    top: `${(i * 53 + 13) % 100}%`,
    size: 1 + (i % 2),
    delay: `${(i % 8) * 0.35}s`,
    duration: `${4 + (i % 6)}s`,
    bright: i % 5 === 0,
  }))

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none overflow-hidden">
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0"
        style={{
          background:
            'radial-gradient(ellipse at top, rgba(34,211,238,0.05) 0%, transparent 60%)',
        }}
      />
      {stars.map(s => (
        <span
          key={s.id}
          className="absolute rounded-full"
          style={{
            left: s.left,
            top: s.top,
            width: s.size,
            height: s.size,
            background: s.bright ? '#e5e9f0' : '#22d3ee',
            boxShadow: s.bright
              ? '0 0 6px rgba(229,233,240,0.7)'
              : '0 0 5px rgba(34,211,238,0.75)',
            animation: `starTwinkle ${s.duration} ease-in-out infinite`,
            animationDelay: s.delay,
          }}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE PATH: components\StudyStreak.tsx

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const TIERS = [
  { min: 0,  label: 'INITIATE', accent: '#566074' },
  { min: 1,  label: 'BRONZE',   accent: '#cd7c4a' },
  { min: 3,  label: 'SILVER',   accent: '#a5b4c4' },
  { min: 7,  label: 'GOLD',     accent: '#f59e0b' },
  { min: 14, label: 'PLATINUM', accent: '#22d3ee' },
  { min: 30, label: 'MERIDIAN', accent: '#a5f3fc' },
]
const WEEK_LABELS = ['M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S', 'S']

function getTier(days: number) {
  let t = TIERS[0]
  for (const tier of TIERS) if (days >= tier.min) t = tier
  return t
}

export default function StudyStreak({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const prefix = userEmail ? userEmail + '_' : 'guest_'
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0)
  const [best, setBest] = useState(0)
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0)
  const [checkedIn, setCheckedIn] = useState(false)
  const [week, setWeek] = useState<boolean[]>(Array(7).fill(false))
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)

  function buildWeek(streakVal: number, todayDone: boolean) {
    const w = Array(7).fill(false)
    const jsDay = new Date().getDay()
    const displayIdx = jsDay === 0 ? 6 : jsDay - 1
    const effective = todayDone ? streakVal : Math.max(0, streakVal)
    for (let i = 0; i < 7 && i <= displayIdx; i++) {
      if (i < effective) w[displayIdx - i] = true
    }
    return w
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-streak')
    const lastCheck = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-streak-last')
    const storedBest = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-streak-best')
    const storedTotal = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-streak-total')
    const parsed = stored ? parseInt(stored) : 0
    const bestVal = storedBest ? parseInt(storedBest) : 0
    const totalVal = storedTotal ? parseInt(storedTotal) : 0

    setBest(bestVal); setTotal(totalVal)

    if (lastCheck === today) {
      setStreak(parsed); setCheckedIn(true); setWeek(buildWeek(parsed, true))
    } else {
      const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toDateString()
      const carried = lastCheck === yesterday ? parsed : 0
      setStreak(carried); setCheckedIn(false); setWeek(buildWeek(carried, false))
    }
    setMounted(true)
  }, [prefix])

  function checkIn() {
    if (!prefix || prefix === 'guest_') return
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const lastCheck = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-streak-last')
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'm-streak')
    const parsed = stored ? parseInt(stored) : 0
    const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toDateString()
    const nextStreak = lastCheck === yesterday ? parsed + 1 : 1

    const newBest = Math.max(nextStreak, best)
    const newTotal = total + 1

    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-streak', String(nextStreak))
    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-streak-last', today)
    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-streak-best', String(newBest))
    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'm-streak-total', String(newTotal))

    setStreak(nextStreak); setBest(newBest); setTotal(newTotal); setCheckedIn(true); setWeek(buildWeek(nextStreak, true))
  }

  if (!mounted) return null
  const tier = getTier(streak)

  return (
    <div className="brief-box p-4" style={{ '--accent-color': tier.accent } as any}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ background: tier.accent }} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest font-bold text-[#8892a6]">STUDY STREAK</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold" style={{ color: tier.accent }}>{tier.label}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="text-center mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-center gap-2">
          <div className="text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums leading-none" style={{ color: tier.accent, textShadow: '0 0 22px ' + tier.accent + '88' }}>{streak}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#566074]">{streak === 1 ? 'DAY' : 'DAYS'}</div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#3a4250] mt-1.5">CURRENT STREAK</div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 mb-3 px-1">
        {WEEK_LABELS.map((label, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
            <div className="rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: 8, height: 8, background: week[i] ? tier.accent : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.12)', boxShadow: week[i] ? '0 0 8px ' + tier.accent : 'none' }} />
            <span className="text-[8px] font-mono tracking-widest" style={{ color: week[i] ? tier.accent : '#3a4250' }}>{label}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-3">
        <div className="rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/10">
          <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] mb-0.5">BEST</div>
          <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[#a5f3fc] tabular-nums">{best} d</div>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-md px-3 py-2 bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/10">
          <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] mb-0.5">TOTAL</div>
          <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[#c4b5fd] tabular-nums">{total} d</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {checkedIn ? (
        <div className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-[0.15em] text-center text-[#10b981] rounded-md py-2 border border-[#10b981]/40 bg-[#10b981]/10">âœ“ CHECKED IN</div>
      ) : (
        <button onClick={checkIn} className="w-full bg-[#22d3ee] text-black text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-md py-2.5 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">Check In Today</button>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

interface CourseProgress { id: string; title: string; pct: number; href: string }

export default function SyllabusProgress({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const [courses, setCourses] = useState<CourseProgress[]>([])
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
  const supabase = createClient()

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      if (!user) { setLoading(false); return }

      const { data: enrollments } = await supabase
        .from('enrollments').select('course_id').eq('user_id', user.id)

      if (!enrollments || enrollments.length === 0) { setLoading(false); return }

      const { data: completedLessons } = await supabase
        .from('lesson_progress').select('lesson_id')
        .eq('user_id', user.id).eq('completed', true)
      const completedSet = new Set((completedLessons || []).map((l: any) => l.lesson_id))

      const list: CourseProgress[] = []
      for (const enroll of enrollments) {
        const { data: course } = await supabase
          .from('courses').select('id, title, slug').eq('id', enroll.course_id).single()
        if (!course) continue

        const { data: modules } = await supabase
          .from('modules').select(`id, missions ( id, lessons ( id ) )`).eq('course_id', course.id)

        let total = 0, done = 0
        modules?.forEach((m: any) => {
          m.missions?.forEach((mission: any) => {
            total += mission.lessons?.length || 0
            mission.lessons?.forEach((lesson: any) => {
              if (completedSet.has(lesson.id)) done++
            })
          })
        })

        list.push({ id: course.id, title: course.title, pct: total > 0 ? Math.round((done / total) * 100) : 0, href: `/courses/${course.slug}` })
      }
      setCourses(list)
      setLoading(false)
    }
    load()
  }, [supabase, userEmail])

  if (loading) return <div className="brief-box p-4 h-24 animate-pulse" style={{ '--accent-color': '#10b981' } as any} />

  if (courses.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="brief-box p-4" style={{ '--accent-color': '#10b981' } as any}>
        <h3 className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] mb-3" style={{ color: '#10b981' }}>Syllabus</h3>
        <p className="text-xs font-mono text-[#c8d0dd] mb-3">Not enrolled in any course.</p>
        <a href="/courses" className="block text-center py-2 text-[9px] font-mono tracking-widest uppercase text-[#10b981] border border-[#10b981]/30 rounded hover:bg-[#10b981]/10 transition">Browse Courses</a>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="brief-box p-4" style={{ '--accent-color': '#10b981' } as any}>
      <h3 className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] mb-3" style={{ color: '#10b981' }}>Syllabus Progress</h3>
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {courses.map(c => (
          <a key={c.id} href={c.href} className="block group">
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white mb-1.5 group-hover:text-[#10b981] transition-colors">{c.title}</div>
            <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-black rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/5 mb-1">
              <div className="h-full bg-[#10b981] shadow-[0_0_10px_#10b981] transition-all duration-500" style={{ width: c.pct + '%' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="text-right text-[10px] font-mono text-[#10b981] font-bold">{c.pct}% COMPLETE</div>
          </a>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useEffect } from 'react'

export default function ThemeProvider({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = (localStorage.getItem('m-theme') as 'dark' | 'light') || 'dark'
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', stored)
  }, [])

  return <>{children}</>
}

// FILE: components/ThemeToggle.tsx

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

export default function ThemeToggle({ compact = false }: { compact?: boolean }) {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<'dark' | 'light'>('dark')
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const stored = (localStorage.getItem('m-theme') as 'dark' | 'light') || 'dark'
    setTheme(stored)
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  function toggle() {
    const next = theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'
    setTheme(next)
    localStorage.setItem('m-theme', next)
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', next)
  }

  if (!mounted) return null

  if (compact) {
    return (
      <button
        onClick={toggle}
        aria-label="Toggle theme"
        className="p-2 rounded-lg text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] hover:bg-white/[0.03] transition text-lg"
      >
        {theme === 'dark' ? 'â˜€' : 'â˜¾'}
      </button>
    )
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={toggle}
      className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] hover:bg-white/[0.03] transition"
    >
      <span className="text-base w-5 text-center opacity-80">
        {theme === 'dark' ? 'â˜€' : 'â˜¾'}
      </span>
      <span className="font-medium">
        {theme === 'dark' ? 'Light mode' : 'Dark mode'}
      </span>
    </button>
  )
}

'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'

export default function CopyButton({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)

  const handleCopy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)
    setCopied(true)
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000)
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleCopy}
      className="w-full md:w-auto bg-[#22d3ee] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs uppercase px-8 py-4 rounded-md hover:bg-cyan-300 transition-colors shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.3)]"
    >
      {copied ? 'COPIED TO CLIPBOARD âœ“' : 'COPY MASTER PROMPT'}
    </button>
  )
}

// Tracks daily activity flags used by auto-checked Daily Goals
// Every key is prefixed by user email so accounts never leak into each other

function prefix(userEmail?: string) {
  return userEmail ? userEmail + '_' : 'guest_'
}

function todayKey() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
}

export function markCodexOpened(userEmail?: string) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(`${prefix(userEmail)}activity_codex_${todayKey()}`, '1')
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function markFlashcardUsed(userEmail?: string) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(`${prefix(userEmail)}activity_flashcard_${todayKey()}`, '1')
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function addPracticeSeconds(seconds: number, userEmail?: string) {
  try {
    const key = `${prefix(userEmail)}activity_practice_sec_${todayKey()}`
    const current = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(key) || '0')
    localStorage.setItem(key, String(current + seconds))
  } catch (e) {}
}

export function getPracticeMinutes(userEmail?: string): number {
  try {
    const key = `${prefix(userEmail)}activity_practice_sec_${todayKey()}`
    const seconds = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(key) || '0')
    return Math.floor(seconds / 60)
  } catch (e) { return 0 }
}

export function hasFlag(flag: 'codex' | 'flashcard', userEmail?: string): boolean {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(`${prefix(userEmail)}activity_${flag}_${todayKey()}`) === '1'
  } catch (e) { return false }
}

import { cache } from 'react'
import { createClient } from './supabase/server'

export const getCurrentUser = cache(async () => {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
  return user
})

export const getCurrentProfile = cache(async () => {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
  if (!user) return null
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .single()
  return data
})

  const i =
    seed === undefined

'use client'
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'

export function useScrollRestoration(containerRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>) {
  const pathname = usePathname()

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = containerRef.current
    if (!el) return

    // 1. Restore Scroll Position
    const saved = sessionStorage.getItem(`scroll-${pathname}`)
    if (saved) {
      // Small timeout ensures the DOM is fully painted before we scroll
      const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
        el.scrollTop = parseInt(saved, 10)
      }, 50)
      return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId)
    }

    // 2. Save Scroll Position on Scroll
    const handleScroll = () => {
      sessionStorage.setItem(`scroll-${pathname}`, el.scrollTop.toString())
    }

    el.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true })
    return () => el.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll)
  }, [pathname, containerRef])
}

export type NavZone = 'sidebar' | 'content'

type ZoneStore = {
  active: NavZone
  listeners: Set<(z: NavZone) => void>
}

function getStore(): ZoneStore {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return { active: 'content', listeners: new Set() }
  }
  const w = window as unknown as { __meridianZone?: ZoneStore }
  if (!w.__meridianZone) {
    w.__meridianZone = { active: 'content', listeners: new Set() }
  }
  return w.__meridianZone
}

export function getActiveZone(): NavZone {
  return getStore().active
}

export function setActiveZone(zone: NavZone) {
  const store = getStore()
  if (store.active === zone) return
  store.active = zone
  store.listeners.forEach((l) => l(zone))
}

export function onZoneChange(cb: (z: NavZone) => void) {
  const store = getStore()
  store.listeners.add(cb)
  return () => {
    store.listeners.delete(cb)
  }
}

export function installZoneTracker() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {}
  function onClick(e: MouseEvent) {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null
    if (!target) return
    const el = target.closest('[data-nav-zone]') as HTMLElement | null
    if (!el) return
    const zone = el.getAttribute('data-nav-zone')
    if (zone === 'sidebar' || zone === 'content') {
      setActiveZone(zone)
    }
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', onClick, true)
  return () => document.removeEventListener('click', onClick, true)
}

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'

function parseRSS(xml: string) {
  const items: any[] = []
  const rssRegex = /<item>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/g
  const atomRegex = /<entry>([\s\S]*?)<\/entry>/g
  const regex = rssRegex.test(xml) ? /<item>([\s\S]*?)<\/item>/g : atomRegex
  let match
  while ((match = regex.exec(xml)) !== null) {
    const itemContent = match[1]
    const getTag = (tag: string) => {
      const cdataMatch = itemContent.match(new RegExp(`<${tag}><!\\[CDATA\\[([\\s\\S]*?)\\]\\]></${tag}>`))
      if (cdataMatch) return cdataMatch[1]
      const normalMatch = itemContent.match(new RegExp(`<${tag}[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)</${tag}>`))
      return normalMatch ? normalMatch[1].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim() : ''
    }
    const linkMatch = itemContent.match(/<link[^>]*href="([^"]+)"/)
    const link = linkMatch ? linkMatch[1] : getTag('link')
    let pubDate = getTag('pubDate') || getTag('published') || getTag('updated')
    try {
      const d = new Date(pubDate)
      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) pubDate = new Date().toISOString()
      else pubDate = d.toISOString()
    } catch { pubDate = new Date().toISOString() }

    const title = getTag('title')
    const url = link || getTag('guid')
    if (title && url) {
      items.push({
        title,
        url,
        excerpt: getTag('description').substring(0, 280).replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').trim() + '...',
        published_at: pubDate,
      })
    }
  }
  return items
}

export async function fetchAndStoreNews() {
  const supabase = createClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
  )

  // Purge older than 20 days
  const twentyDaysAgo = new Date()
  twentyDaysAgo.setDate(twentyDaysAgo.getDate() - 20)
  await supabase.from('daily_news').delete().lt('published_at', twentyDaysAgo.toISOString())

  // Fetch in parallel
  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    FEEDS.map(async (feed) => {
      try {
        const response = await fetch(feed.url, {
          headers: { 'User-Agent': 'MeridianAcademy/1.0 (RSS Reader)' },
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(6000),
        })
        if (!response.ok) return []
        const xml = await response.text()
        const items = parseRSS(xml)
        // FETCH 5 PER FEED (Instead of 2) to guarantee coverage
        return items.slice(0, 5).map(item => ({
          ...item,
          source: feed.source,
          category: feed.category,
        }))
      } catch (e) {
        return []
      }
    })
  )

  const allArticles: any[] = []
  results.forEach(r => {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') allArticles.push(...r.value)
  })

  if (allArticles.length === 0) return { count: 0 }

  // Insert in chunks
  let totalInserted = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < allArticles.length; i += 50) {
    const chunk = allArticles.slice(i, i + 50)
    const { error } = await supabase.from('daily_news').upsert(chunk, { onConflict: 'url' })
    if (!error) totalInserted += chunk.length
  }

  return { count: totalInserted, fetched: allArticles.length, sources: FEEDS.length }
}

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export type ResumeType = 'course' | 'ebook' | 'spec' | 'vault';

async function getPrefix(): Promise<string> {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
  return user ? user.id + '_' : 'guest_'
}

export async function trackResume(
  type: ResumeType, 
  id: string, 
  title: string, 
  href: string, 
  progressData: any = {}
) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const prefix = await getPrefix()
  
  try {
    const record = { type, id, title, href, timestamp: Date.now(), progressData };
    localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'meridian_resume_' + type, JSON.stringify(record));
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('meridian-resume-updated'));
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
    if (!user) return

    await supabase.from('user_resume_state').upsert({
      user_id: user.id,
      resource_type: type,
      resource_id: id,
      title: title,
      href: href,
      progress_data: progressData,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    }, { onConflict: 'user_id, resource_type' })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[Meridian] DB Sync failed:', err);
  }
}

export async function getResume(type: ResumeType) {
  const prefix = await getPrefix()
  
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(prefix + 'meridian_resume_' + type);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (parsed.href && parsed.title) return parsed;
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    const supabase = createClient()
    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
    if (!user) return null

    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('user_resume_state')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .eq('resource_type', type)
      .single()

    if (data) {
      const record = { type, id: data.resource_id, title: data.title, href: data.href, timestamp: Date.now(), progressData: data.progress_data }
      localStorage.setItem(prefix + 'meridian_resume_' + type, JSON.stringify(record))
      return record
    }
  } catch {}
  return null;
}

export async function awardSkillXp(skillSlug: string, xpAmount: number, reason: string) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { error } = await supabase.rpc('award_skill_xp', {
    p_skill_slug: skillSlug,
    p_xp_amount: xpAmount,
    p_reason: reason,
  })
  if (error) {
    console.error('[Meridian Skills] Award failed:', error)
    throw error
  }
}

export async function getCombatLevel(): Promise<number> {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
  if (!user) return 1
  const { data } = await supabase.rpc('get_combat_level', { p_user_id: user.id })
  return (data as number) || 1
}
