type SoundsStore = {
  ctx: AudioContext | null
  unlocked: boolean
}

function getStore(): SoundsStore {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return { ctx: null, unlocked: false }
  }
  const w = window as unknown as { __meridianSounds?: SoundsStore }
  if (!w.__meridianSounds) {
    w.__meridianSounds = { ctx: null, unlocked: false }
  }
  return w.__meridianSounds
}

function getCtx(): AudioContext | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null
  const store = getStore()
  if (!store.ctx) {
    const w = window as unknown as {
      AudioContext?: typeof AudioContext
      webkitAudioContext?: typeof AudioContext
    }
    const Ctor = w.AudioContext || w.webkitAudioContext
    if (!Ctor) return null
    store.ctx = new Ctor()
  }
  if (store.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
    store.ctx.resume().catch(() => {})
  }
  return store.ctx
}

export function unlockAudio() {
  const store = getStore()
  if (store.unlocked) return
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return
  if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
    ctx.resume().then(() => { store.unlocked = true }).catch(() => {})
  } else {
    store.unlocked = true
  }
}

export function isAudioUnlocked() {
  const store = getStore()
  return store.unlocked && store.ctx !== null && store.ctx.state === 'running'
}

export function playInitializingSound(durationMs = 2200) {
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return
  const dur = durationMs / 1000
  const t0 = ctx.currentTime

  const noiseLen = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * dur)
  const noiseBuffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, noiseLen, ctx.sampleRate)
  const data = noiseBuffer.getChannelData(0)
  for (let i = 0; i < noiseLen; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1
  const noise = ctx.createBufferSource()
  noise.buffer = noiseBuffer
  const noiseFilter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
  noiseFilter.type = 'bandpass'
  noiseFilter.Q.value = 6
  noiseFilter.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, t0)
  noiseFilter.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(2800, t0 + dur)
  const noiseGain = ctx.createGain()
  noiseGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0)
  noiseGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.10, t0 + 0.6)
  noiseGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.10, t0 + dur - 0.5)
  noiseGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur)
  noise.connect(noiseFilter)
  noiseFilter.connect(noiseGain)
  noiseGain.connect(ctx.destination)
  noise.start(t0)
  noise.stop(t0 + dur)

  const sweep = ctx.createOscillator()
  const sweepGain = ctx.createGain()
  sweep.connect(sweepGain)
  sweepGain.connect(ctx.destination)
  sweep.type = 'sine'
  sweep.frequency.setValueAtTime(180, t0)
  sweep.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(720, t0 + dur)
  sweepGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0)
  sweepGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.08, t0 + 0.5)
  sweepGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, t0 + dur - 0.4)
  sweepGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur)
  sweep.start(t0)
  sweep.stop(t0 + dur)

  const sub = ctx.createOscillator()
  const subGain = ctx.createGain()
  sub.connect(subGain)
  subGain.connect(ctx.destination)
  sub.type = 'sine'
  sub.frequency.setValueAtTime(40, t0)
  sub.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(90, t0 + dur)
  subGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0)
  subGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.09, t0 + 0.4)
  subGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.09, t0 + dur - 0.4)
  subGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur)
  sub.start(t0)
  sub.stop(t0 + dur)

  const bell = ctx.createOscillator()
  const bellGain = ctx.createGain()
  bell.connect(bellGain)
  bellGain.connect(ctx.destination)
  bell.type = 'sine'
  bell.frequency.value = 1568
  const bellStart = t0 + dur - 0.3
  bellGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, bellStart)
  bellGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.18, bellStart + 0.03)
  bellGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, bellStart + 0.75)
  bell.start(bellStart)
  bell.stop(bellStart + 0.85)
}

export function playTransitionSound(durationMs = 1400) {
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return
  const dur = durationMs / 1000
  const t0 = ctx.currentTime

  const noiseLen = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * dur)
  const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, noiseLen, ctx.sampleRate)
  const d = buf.getChannelData(0)
  for (let i = 0; i < noiseLen; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1
  const noise = ctx.createBufferSource()
  noise.buffer = buf
  const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
  filter.type = 'lowpass'
  filter.Q.value = 4
  filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(2400, t0)
  filter.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(400, t0 + dur)
  const nGain = ctx.createGain()
  nGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0)
  nGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.06, t0 + 0.15)
  nGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur)
  noise.connect(filter)
  filter.connect(nGain)
  nGain.connect(ctx.destination)
  noise.start(t0)
  noise.stop(t0 + dur)

  const notes = [
    { freq: 880, delay: 0.05, gain: 0.09 },
    { freq: 1318.5, delay: 0.35, gain: 0.08 },
  ]
  notes.forEach(({ freq, delay, gain: peak }) => {
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
    const g = ctx.createGain()
    osc.connect(g)
    g.connect(ctx.destination)
    osc.type = 'sine'
    osc.frequency.value = freq
    const t = t0 + delay
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t)
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(peak, t + 0.03)
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.9)
    osc.start(t)
    osc.stop(t + 1.0)
  })
}

export function startAmbientHum(): () => void {
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return () => {}

  const osc1 = ctx.createOscillator()
  const osc2 = ctx.createOscillator()
  const osc3 = ctx.createOscillator()
  const gain = ctx.createGain()
  const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()

  osc1.type = 'sine'
  osc1.frequency.value = 55
  osc2.type = 'sine'
  osc2.frequency.value = 82.5
  osc3.type = 'triangle'
  osc3.frequency.value = 165

  filter.type = 'lowpass'
  filter.frequency.value = 320
  filter.Q.value = 0.7

  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, ctx.currentTime)
  gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.03, ctx.currentTime + 2.5)

  osc1.connect(filter)
  osc2.connect(filter)
  osc3.connect(filter)
  filter.connect(gain)
  gain.connect(ctx.destination)

  osc1.start()
  osc2.start()
  osc3.start()

  return () => {
    const t = ctx.currentTime
    gain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t)
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(gain.gain.value, t)
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.6)
    setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        osc1.stop()
        osc2.stop()
        osc3.stop()
      } catch {
        /* already stopped */
      }
    }, 800)
  }
}

export function playTickSound(progress = 0) {
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return
  const baseFreq = 1200 + (progress / 100) * 1400
  const t = ctx.currentTime

  const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
  const gain = ctx.createGain()
  osc.connect(gain)
  gain.connect(ctx.destination)
  osc.type = 'sine'
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(baseFreq, t)
  osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(baseFreq * 1.15, t + 0.05)
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t)
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.035, t + 0.006)
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.09)
  osc.start(t)
  osc.stop(t + 0.1)

  const sheen = ctx.createOscillator()
  const sheenGain = ctx.createGain()
  sheen.connect(sheenGain)
  sheenGain.connect(ctx.destination)
  sheen.type = 'sine'
  sheen.frequency.value = baseFreq * 2
  sheenGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t)
  sheenGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.012, t + 0.003)
  sheenGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.06)
  sheen.start(t)
  sheen.stop(t + 0.08)
}

export function playPassSound() {
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return
  const t0 = ctx.currentTime
  const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5, 1318.5]
  notes.forEach((freq, i) => {
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
    const gain = ctx.createGain()
    osc.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(ctx.destination)
    osc.type = 'triangle'
    osc.frequency.value = freq
    const t = t0 + i * 0.09
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.16, t + 0.015)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.55)
    osc.start(t)
    osc.stop(t + 0.6)

    const sh = ctx.createOscillator()
    const shG = ctx.createGain()
    sh.connect(shG)
    shG.connect(ctx.destination)
    sh.type = 'sine'
    sh.frequency.value = freq * 2
    shG.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t)
    shG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.04, t + 0.02)
    shG.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + 0.4)
    sh.start(t)
    sh.stop(t + 0.45)
  })
}

export function playPageFlipSound() {
  const ctx = getCtx()
  if (!ctx) return

  const dur = 0.4
  const t0 = ctx.currentTime

  const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate * dur), ctx.sampleRate)
  const data = buf.getChannelData(0)
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1

  const noise = ctx.createBufferSource()
  noise.buffer = buf

  const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
  filter.type = 'bandpass'
  filter.frequency.value = 1100
  filter.Q.value = 0.6

  const gain = ctx.createGain()
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0)
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.09, t0 + 0.05)
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur)

  noise.connect(filter)
  filter.connect(gain)
  gain.connect(ctx.destination)
  noise.start(t0)
  noise.stop(t0 + dur)
}

import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()

  return createServerClient(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll() {
          return cookieStore.getAll()
        },
        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
          try {
            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
            )
          } catch {}
        },
      },
    }
  )
}

export interface Level {
  level: number
  name: string
  xpRequired: number
}

export const LEVELS: Level[] = [
  { level: 1, name: 'Digital Novice', xpRequired: 0 },
  { level: 2, name: 'Avid Reader', xpRequired: 2500 },
  { level: 3, name: 'Builder', xpRequired: 6000 },
  { level: 4, name: 'Systems Thinker', xpRequired: 12000 },
  { level: 5, name: 'Language Architect', xpRequired: 20000 },
  { level: 6, name: 'Disciplined Mind', xpRequired: 35000 },
  { level: 7, name: 'Digital Systems Architect', xpRequired: 50000 },
  { level: 8, name: 'Digital Renaissance Architect', xpRequired: 100000 },
]

export function getLevelData(currentXp: number) {
  let currentLevel = LEVELS[0]
  let nextLevel: Level | null = LEVELS[1]

  for (let i = 0; i < LEVELS.length; i++) {
    if (currentXp >= LEVELS[i].xpRequired) {
      currentLevel = LEVELS[i]
      nextLevel = LEVELS[i + 1] || null
    }
  }

  const xpInCurrentLevel = currentXp - currentLevel.xpRequired
  const xpNeededForNext = nextLevel ? nextLevel.xpRequired - currentLevel.xpRequired : 1
  const progressPercent = nextLevel
    ? Math.min(100, (xpInCurrentLevel / xpNeededForNext) * 100)
    : 100

  return {
    currentLevel,
    nextLevel,
    progressPercent,
    xpInCurrentLevel,
    xpNeededForNext
  }
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

type Book = {
  id: string
  slug: string
  title: string
  subtitle: string
  description: string
  accent_color: string
  category: string
}

export default async function EbooksPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  // Fetch books
  const { data: books } = await supabase
    .from('library_books')
    .select('*')
    .eq('published', true)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  // Fetch progress
  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('library_progress')
    .select('book_id, scroll_percentage')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)

  const progressMap = new Map(progress?.map(p => [p.book_id, p.scroll_percentage]) || [])

  // 🎯 SORT LOGIC: Unread/In-Progress first, Completed at the bottom
  const sortedBooks = (books || []).sort((a, b) => {
    const progA = progressMap.get(a.id) || 0
    const progB = progressMap.get(b.id) || 0
    
    if (progA === 100 && progB !== 100) return 1
    if (progB === 100 && progA !== 100) return -1
    return 0
  })

  const categories = Array.from(new Set(sortedBooks?.map(b => b.category) || ['Languages and Communication']))

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-24">
        <Link href="/library" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition mb-8">
          ← BACK TO LIBRARY
        </Link>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-3">

            LIBRARY

            FOUNDATIONAL BOOKS
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">
              {books?.length || 0} original manuscripts included with your membership.

-- SQL SCHEMA FOR MERIDIAN ACADEMY
CREATE TABLE library_progress (
  user_id uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  book_id uuid REFERENCES library_books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  scroll_percentage integer DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT timezone('utc'::text, now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, book_id)
);
ALTER TABLE library_progress ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Users can view their own progress" ON library_progress FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can insert their own progress" ON library_progress FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update their own progress" ON library_progress FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

'use client'

import ThemeToggle from './ThemeToggle'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { triggerNav } from './NavLoader'
import { unlockAudio, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound } from '@/lib/sounds'
import { getActiveZone, onZoneChange } from '@/lib/navZone'

const NAV = [
  { href: '/dashboard', label: 'OVERVIEW' },
  { href: '/courses', label: 'MY COURSES' },
  { href: '/community', label: 'COMMUNITY' },
  { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY' },
  { href: '/profile', label: 'PROFILE' },
]

export default function Sidebar({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const path = usePathname()
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [zoneActive, setZoneActive] = useState(getActiveZone() === 'sidebar')
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const selectedRef = useRef(0)
  const routerRef = useRef(router)

  useEffect(() => { selectedRef.current = selected }, [selected])
  useEffect(() => { routerRef.current = router }, [router])

  useEffect(() => {
    const idx = NAV.findIndex(n => path === n.href || path?.startsWith(n.href + '/'))
    if (idx >= 0) setSelected(idx)
  }, [path])

  useEffect(() => {
    return onZoneChange(z => setZoneActive(z === 'sidebar'))
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!zoneActive) return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (active) {
        const tag = active.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || active.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setSelected(s => {
          const next = (s + 1) % NAV.length
          selectedRef.current = next
          return next
        })
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setSelected(s => {
          const next = (s - 1 + NAV.length) % NAV.length
          selectedRef.current = next
          return next
        })
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playConfirmSound()
        const item = NAV[selectedRef.current]
        if (item) {
          triggerNav()
          routerRef.current.push(item.href)
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  }, [zoneActive])

  async function quitToMainMenu() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    router.push('/')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <aside
      data-nav-zone="sidebar"
      className="hidden md:flex md:flex-col w-64 shrink-0 h-full relative overflow-hidden"
      style={{
        background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8,12,20,0.72) 0%, rgba(6,10,16,0.62) 40%, rgba(4,8,14,0.85) 100%)',
        borderRight: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.12)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(14px)',
      }}
    >
      {/* Top scan line */}
      <span
        className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-px z-20"
        style={{
          background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(34,211,238,0.85) 50%, transparent 100%)',
          opacity: 0.75,
        }}
      />

      {/* Top-left corner bracket */}
      <span
        className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-20"
        style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)', borderLeft: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }}
      />
      {/* Bottom-right corner bracket */}
      <span
        className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-20"
        style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)', borderRight: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }}
      />

      {/* LOGO / HEADER */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b shrink-0 relative z-10" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.10)' }}>
        <Link
          href="/"
          onClick={() => {
            unlockAudio()
            playConfirmSound()
            triggerNav()
          }}
          className="flex items-center gap-3 group relative rounded-md px-2 py-2 -mx-1 transition-all hover:bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.04)]"
        >
          <span className="relative shrink-0">
            <span
              className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none"
              style={{
                background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.28) 0%, transparent 70%)',
                filter: 'blur(10px)',
              }}
            />
            <LogoEmblem size={44} />
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.22em] text-[#e5e9f0] leading-none">
              MERIDIAN
            </div>
            <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.42em] text-[#22d3ee] mt-1">
              ACADEMY
            </div>
          </div>
        </Link>

        {/* HUD strip */}
        <div
          className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 rounded"
          style={{
            border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.14)',
            background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.03)',
          }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full" style={{ background: '#10b981', boxShadow: '0 0 6px rgba(16,185,129,0.8)' }} />
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074]">ONLINE</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#3a4250]">v1.0</span>
        </div>

                setHovered(i)

                background: showSelected
                  ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.18) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.05) 100%)'
                  : active
                  ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.03) 100%)'
                  : isHover
                  ? 'rgba(34,211,238,0.04)'
                  : 'transparent',
                border: showSelected
                  ? '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.55)'
                  : active
                  ? '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.25)'

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type SkillNode = {
  id: string
  name: string
  description: string
  unlocked: boolean
}

const PROGRESSION: SkillNode[] = [
  { id: 'novice', name: 'Digital Novice', description: 'The journey begins.', unlocked: true },
  { id: 'reader', name: 'Avid Reader', description: 'Consumed foundational texts.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'builder', name: 'Builder', description: 'Applied first principles.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'systems_thinker', name: 'Systems Thinker', description: 'See invisible feedback loops.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'language_architect', name: 'Language Architect', description: 'Master communication grids.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'disciplined_mind', name: 'Disciplined Mind', description: 'Unbreakable focus.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'systems_architect', name: 'Digital Systems Architect', description: 'Master of complex systems.', unlocked: false },
  { id: 'renaissance', name: 'Digital Renaissance Architect', description: 'The pinnacle of interdisciplinary mastery.', unlocked: false },
]

export default function SkillTree() {
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<SkillNode[]>(PROGRESSION)
  const [xp, setXp] = useState(0)
  const [level, setLevel] = useState(1)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadSkills() {
      const supabase = createClient()
      const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
      if (!user) return

      const { data: profile } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('xp, level').eq('id', user.id).single()
      if (profile) {
        setXp(profile.xp || 0)
        setLevel(profile.level || 1)
      }

      const { data: userSkills } = await supabase.from('user_skills').select('*').eq('user_id', user.id)

      if (userSkills) {
        const merged = PROGRESSION.map(skill => {
          const dbSkill = userSkills.find(us => us.skill_name === skill.name)
          return dbSkill ? { ...skill, unlocked: dbSkill.unlocked } : skill
        })
        setSkills(merged)
      }
    }
    loadSkills()
  }, [])

  const xpForNextLevel = Math.floor(100 * Math.pow(level, 1.5))
  const progressPercent = Math.min(100, Math.floor((xp / xpForNextLevel) * 100))

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col gap-5">
      
      {/* Level Progress Bar */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#22d3ee] tracking-wider font-bold">LEVEL {level}</span>
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-white">{xp} / {isNaN(xpForNextLevel) ? '---' : xpForNextLevel} XP</span>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full h-2 bg-[#1e2633] rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-[#22d3ee]/20">
          <div className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#22d3ee] to-[#3b82f6] transition-all duration-1000" style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Progression List */}
      <div className="relative border-l border-[#1e2633] ml-2 pl-4 space-y-5 pb-2">
        {skills.map((skill, index) => {
          const isCurrent = !skill.unlocked && (index === 0 || skills[index - 1].unlocked);
          
          return (
            <div key={skill.id} className="relative group">
              {/* Timeline Dot */}
              <div 
                className={`absolute -left-[21px] top-1 w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 transition-colors duration-300 ${
                  skill.unlocked 
                    ? 'bg-[#22d3ee] border-[#22d3ee] shadow-[0_0_10px_#22d3ee]' 
                    : isCurrent 
                      ? 'bg-[#0a0f16] border-[#8b5cf6] animate-pulse' 
                      : 'bg-[#0a0f16] border-[#3a4250]'
                }`} 
              />
              
              <div className={`transition-opacity ${skill.unlocked ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-60'}`}>
                <div className={`text-[11px] font-bold ${skill.unlocked ? 'text-white' : isCurrent ? 'text-[#8b5cf6]' : 'text-[#566074]'}`}>
                  {skill.name}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-[#8892a6] mt-0.5">
                  {skill.description}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export type Json =
  | string
  | number
  | boolean
  | null
  | { [key: string]: Json | undefined }
  | Json[]

export type Database = {
  // Allows to automatically instantiate createClient with right options
  // instead of createClient<Database, { PostgrestVersion: 'XX' }>(URL, KEY)
  __InternalSupabase: {
    PostgrestVersion: "14.17"
  }
  public: {
    Tables: {
      blog_comments: {
        Row: {
          article_id: string
          content: string
          created_at: string | null
          id: string
          parent_id: string | null

# MERIDIAN ACADEMY — MASTER PROJECT SPECIFICATION & AI PROMPT
# ============================================================

## 1. ROLE & IDENTITY
You are the Principal Full-Stack Engineer and AI Content Architect of **Meridian Academy**.
- **Philosophy:** Digital Renaissance Architect. You teach the unfamiliar through the familiar. You use systems thinking, first-principles reasoning, and cross-disciplinary analogies.
- **Tone:** Professional, highly technical, deeply intellectual, and perfectly aligned with the Meridian brand.
- **Rule of Engagement:** You do not write code blindly. When the user asks to build or fix something, you MUST ask them to paste the exact file you need to see (e.g., "Paste your eader-page.tsx file"). You do not invent schema details. You inspect the code provided.

## 2. TECH STACK
- **Framework:** Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack)
- **Language:** TypeScript
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4
- **Database/Auth:** Supabase (PostgreSQL, RLS, RPC)
- **Deployment:** Vercel

## 3. THE MERIDIAN BOOK READER (CRITICAL ARCHITECTURE)
The book reader (pp/library/ebooks/[slug]/read/page.tsx) has been perfectly engineered. **DO NOT BREAK THIS MATH.**
- **The Layout:** 3D realistic book spread with gold frames, spine shadows, and stacked page thickness.
- **The Text Engine:** Uses CSS columnCount: 2, columnGap: 8rem, and columnFill: 'auto'.
- **The Pagination Math:** The text container calculates pages based on scrollWidth / clientWidth. The physical page counter is pageIndex * 2 + 1 for the left page and pageIndex * 2 + 2 for the right page.
- **Typography Rules:** orphans: 3, widows: 3, and reak-after: avoid on headings. This ensures text flows like a real printed novel without leaving single words stranded at page breaks.
- **Dynamic Covers:** The book cover extracts the ccent_color from the Supabase library_books table to generate its gradient and glow effects.

## 4. THE CONTENT WORKFLOW (BOOKS)
When generating new books or chapters, you MUST use the following Markdown format to ensure it renders correctly in the reader:
- # Title (H1: Centered chapter title. The first paragraph after this gets a gold drop-cap).
- ## Subtitle (H2: Forces a page-break to the top of the next page).
- > Quote (Blockquote: Styled as a cream box with gold borders).
- - List item (Bulleted lists).
- **bold** and *italic*.
- **Length:** A real book page holds ~400 words. To fill 10 pages, generate at least 4,000 words. Do not leave blank pages.
- **Vision:** Apply the 20/80 rule. Teach the essential 20% that gives 80% of the results. Prioritize mental models, systems, and visual pedagogy.

## 5. DATABASE SCHEMA (LIBRARY)
- library_books: id, slug, 	itle, subtitle, description, ccent_color, category, order_index, published.
- library_chapters: id, ook_id, chapter_number, 	itle, content (Markdown), word_count.

## 6. HOW WE WORK TOGETHER (WORKFLOW)
1. The user pastes this spec.
2. You reply: "Meridian Master Spec loaded. What are we engineering today? (Courses, Library, Reader, Admin, etc.)"
3. The user tells you the module.
4. You ask the user to paste the exact file contents for that module.
5. You provide the exact, fully rewritten code. No placeholders. No missing logic.
6. You provide the SQL if database changes are required.

**"Explain deeply. Write clearly. Make the invisible understandable. Turn knowledge into mastery."**

FILE: app/courses/[slug]/page.tsx

import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import EnrollButton from '@/app/dashboard/EnrollButton'
import CourseView, { type Saga } from './CourseView'

export default async function CourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title, description, track, level')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  const { data: enrollment } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments')
    .select('id, progress')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const { data: sagasData } = await supabase
    .from('modules')
    .select(`
      id, title, description, order_index,
      missions(
        id, title, description, order_index,
        lessons(id, title, order_index, is_final_exam, pass_threshold)
      )
    `)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  const sagas = (sagasData ?? []) as unknown as Saga[]

  const { data: progressData } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('lesson_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('completed', true)

  const completedIds = (progressData ?? []).map((p: { lesson_id: string }) => p.lesson_id)
  const completedSet = new Set<string>(completedIds)

  sagas.forEach(s => {
    s.missions = (s.missions ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    s.missions.forEach(m => {
      m.lessons = (m.lessons ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    })
  })

  // Overall course progress
  const totalLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.missions.reduce((a, m) => a + (m.lessons?.length ?? 0), 0),
    0
  )

'use client'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

export type Lesson = {
  id: string
  title: string
  order_index: number
  is_final_exam: boolean | null
  pass_threshold: number | null
}

export type Mission = {
  id: string
  title: string
  description: string | null
  order_index: number
  lessons: Lesson[]
}

export type Saga = {
  id: string
  title: string
  description: string | null
  order_index: number
  missions: Mission[]
}

type State = 'cleared' | 'active' | 'next' | 'hidden'
type Current = { si: number; mi: number; li: number }

type Props = {
  sagas: Saga[]
  slug: string
  completedIds: string[]
  enrolled: boolean
  defaultOpenIndex: number
}

function computeSagaState(si: number, c: Current): State {
  if (c.si === -1) return 'cleared'
  if (si < c.si) return 'cleared'
  if (si === c.si) return 'active'
  if (si === c.si + 1) return 'next'
  return 'hidden'
}

function computeMissionState(si: number, mi: number, c: Current): State {
  if (si < c.si) return 'cleared'
  if (si > c.si) return 'hidden'
  if (mi < c.mi) return 'cleared'
  if (mi === c.mi) return 'active'
  if (mi === c.mi + 1) return 'next'
  return 'hidden'
}

function computeLessonState(si: number, mi: number, li: number, c: Current): State {
  if (si < c.si) return 'cleared'
  if (si > c.si) return 'hidden'
  if (mi < c.mi) return 'cleared'
  if (mi > c.mi) return 'hidden'
  if (li < c.li) return 'cleared'
  if (li === c.li) return 'active'
  if (li === c.li + 1) return 'next'
  return 'hidden'
}

const REDACTED = 'â–ˆâ–ˆâ–ˆâ–ˆâ–ˆâ–ˆâ–ˆâ–ˆ'

export default function CourseView({
  sagas, slug, completedIds, enrolled, defaultOpenIndex,
}: Props) {
  const completedSet = useMemo(() => new Set(completedIds), [completedIds])

  const current = useMemo<Current>(() => {
    for (let si = 0; si < sagas.length; si++) {
      const missions = sagas[si].missions ?? []
      for (let mi = 0; mi < missions.length; mi++) {
        const lessons = missions[mi].lessons ?? []
        for (let li = 0; li < lessons.length; li++) {
          if (!completedSet.has(lessons[li].id)) return { si, mi, li }
        }
      }
    }
    return { si: -1, mi: -1, li: -1 }
  }, [sagas, completedSet])

  const [openSagaIdx, setOpenSagaIdx] = useState(defaultOpenIndex)
  const [openMissionKey, setOpenMissionKey] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (current.si >= 0) {
      setOpenSagaIdx(current.si)
      const s = sagas[current.si]
      if (s?.missions?.[current.mi]) {
        setOpenMissionKey(s.missions[current.mi].id)
      }
    }
  }, [current.si, current.mi, sagas])

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 md:space-y-4">
      {sagas.map((saga, si) => {
        const state = computeSagaState(si, current)
        if (state === 'hidden') return null
        return (
          <SagaChapter
            key={saga.id}
            saga={saga}
            slug={slug}
            index={si}
            state={state}
            isOpen={state !== 'next' && openSagaIdx === si}
            onToggle={() => {
              if (state === 'next') return
              setOpenSagaIdx(openSagaIdx === si ? -1 : si)
            }}
            completedSet={completedSet}
            enrolled={enrolled}
            current={current}
            openMissionKey={openMissionKey}
            setOpenMissionKey={setOpenMissionKey}
          />
        )
      })}
    </div>
  )
}

function MissionBlock({

  completedSet, enrolled, isOpen, onToggle, current,
}: {
  mission: Mission
  slug: string

function LessonRow({

  lesson: Lesson
  slug: string
  index: number
  state: State

  isLast: boolean
  enrolled: boolean
}) {

  const isActive = state === 'active'
  const isNext = state === 'next'

    ? 'FINAL'
    : 'SQ' + String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')

    return (

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/page.tsx
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import QuestPlayer from './QuestPlayer'

export default async function LessonPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string; lessonId: string }>
}) {
  const { slug, lessonId } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  const { data: lesson } = await supabase
    .from('lessons')
    .select(
      'id, title, order_index, video_url, content, is_final_exam, pass_threshold, mission_id, mission:missions(id, order_index, module_id, module:modules(id, order_index))'
    )
    .eq('id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!lesson) notFound()

  const mission = (lesson as any).mission as
    | { id: string; order_index: number; module_id: string; module: { id: string; order_index: number } | null }
    | null

  let nextHref: string | null = null
  let nextTitle: string | null = null

  if (mission) {
    const { data: siblings } = await supabase
      .from('lessons')
      .select('id, title')
      .eq('mission_id', mission.id)
      .gt('order_index', lesson.order_index)
      .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)

    if (siblings && siblings.length > 0) {
      nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${siblings[0].id}`
      nextTitle = siblings[0].title
    } else {
      const { data: nextMissions } = await supabase
        .from('missions')
        .select('id')
        .eq('module_id', mission.module_id)
        .gt('order_index', mission.order_index)
        .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
        .limit(1)

      if (nextMissions && nextMissions.length > 0) {
        const { data: firstLesson } = await supabase
          .from('lessons')
          .select('id, title')
          .eq('mission_id', nextMissions[0].id)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (firstLesson && firstLesson.length > 0) {
          nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson[0].id}`
          nextTitle = firstLesson[0].title
        }
      } else {
        const currentSagaOrder = mission.module?.order_index ?? 0
        const { data: nextSagas } = await supabase
          .from('modules')
          .select('id')
          .eq('course_id', course.id)
          .gt('order_index', currentSagaOrder)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (nextSagas && nextSagas.length > 0) {
          const { data: nextMissions2 } = await supabase
            .from('missions')
            .select('id')
            .eq('module_id', nextSagas[0].id)
            .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
            .limit(1)

          if (nextMissions2 && nextMissions2.length > 0) {
            const { data: firstLesson2 } = await supabase
              .from('lessons')
              .select('id, title')
              .eq('mission_id', nextMissions2[0].id)
              .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
              .limit(1)

            if (firstLesson2 && firstLesson2.length > 0) {
              nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson2[0].id}`
              nextTitle = firstLesson2[0].title
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('completed')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('lesson_id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto pb-12 md:pb-20">
        <QuestPlayer
          lessonId={lesson.id}
          lessonTitle={lesson.title}
          lessonIndex={lesson.order_index}
          videoUrl={lesson.video_url}
          content={lesson.content}
          isFinalExam={lesson.is_final_exam ?? false}
          passThreshold={lesson.pass_threshold ?? 80}
          initialCompleted={progress?.completed ?? false}
          slug={slug}
          nextHref={nextHref}
          nextTitle={nextTitle}
        />
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

'use client'
import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react'

function repair(raw: string): string {
  let s = raw
  s = s.replace(/\|\s+\|/g, '|\n|')
  s = s.replace(/([^\n])\s+(\*\s+\*[A-Za-z])/g, '$1\n$2')
  s = s.replace(/([^\n])\s+(#{1,3}\s)/g, '$1\n$2')
  s = s.replace(/([^\n])\s+(>\s)/g, '$1\n$2')
  s = s.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
  return s
}

function inline(text: string, keyBase: string): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = []
  const regex = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|\*[^*\n]+\*|`[^`]+`)/g
  text.split(regex).forEach((part, idx) => {
    if (!part) return
    const k = `${keyBase}-${idx}`
    if (part.startsWith('**') && part.endsWith('**') && part.length > 4) {
      const word = part.slice(2, -2)
      const isKeyword = /^[A-Z][A-Z\s\-]{0,22}$/.test(word) && word.length <= 24
      if (isKeyword) {
        out.push(
          <span key={k} className="font-bold tracking-[0.04em]"
            style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', textShadow: '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }}>
            {word}
          </span>
        )
      } else {
        out.push(
          <strong key={k} style={{ color: '#ffffff', fontWeight: 700 }}>{word}</strong>
        )
      }
    }
    else if (part.startsWith('*') && part.endsWith('*') && part.length > 2)
      out.push(<em key={k} style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>{part.slice(1, -1)}</em>)
    else if (part.startsWith('`') && part.endsWith('`'))
      out.push(
        <code key={k} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[0.9em] font-mono"
          style={{ background: 'var(--m-surface-2)', color: '#a5f3fc' }}>
          {part.slice(1, -1)}
        </code>
      )
    else out.push(<span key={k}>{part}</span>)
  })
  return out
}

function isTableRow(line: string) {
  const t = line.trim()
  return t.startsWith('|') && t.endsWith('|') && t.length > 2
}
function isTableSeparator(line: string) {
  return /^\|[\s:|-]+\|$/.test(line.trim()) && line.includes('-')
}
function splitRow(line: string): string[] {
  return line.trim().replace(/^\|/, '').replace(/\|$/, '').split('|').map(c => c.trim())
}

function BulletItem({ text, k }: { text: string; k: string }) {
  const m = text.match(ARROW_SPLIT_RE)
  if (m && m[1].length > 0 && m[1].length < 70 && m[2].length > 0 && m[2].length < 90) {

function tryVerticalSequence(lines: string[], start: number): { pairs: { value: string; label: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const pairs: { value: string; label: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i + 2 < lines.length) {
    const v = lines[i].trim()
    const arrow = lines[i + 1].trim()
    const label = lines[i + 2].trim()
    if (!v || !label) break
    if (!ARROW_RE.test(arrow)) break
    if (v.startsWith('#') || v.startsWith('>') || /^[-*] /.test(v)) break
    if (isTableRow(v)) break
    if (v.length > 40 || label.length > 30) break
    pairs.push({ value: v, label })
    i += 3
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (pairs.length < 2) return null
  return { pairs, end: i }
}

function tryEqualsGroup(lines: string[], start: number): { items: { left: string; right: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: { left: string; right: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const raw = lines[i].trim()
    if (raw === '') { i++; continue }
    const line = stripBulletPrefix(raw)
    const m = line.match(EQ_SPLIT_RE)
    if (!m) break
    const left = m[1].trim()
    const right = m[2].trim()
    if (!left || !right) break
    if (left.length > 40 || right.length > 40) break
    items.push({ left, right })
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function tryEmDashPairs(lines: string[], start: number): { items: { left: string; right: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: { left: string; right: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const raw = lines[i].trim()
    if (raw === '') { i++; continue }
    const line = stripBulletPrefix(raw)
    const m = line.match(EMDASH_PAIR_RE)
    if (!m) break
    const left = m[1].trim()
    const right = m[2].trim()
    if (!left || !right) break
    if (left.length > 60 || right.length > 60) break
    if (left.includes('â†’') || right.includes('â†’')) break
    items.push({ left, right })
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function tryNumberedList(lines: string[], start: number): { items: string[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: string[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i].trim()
    if (line === '') { i++; continue }
    const m = line.match(NUMBERED_RE)
    if (!m) break
    items.push(m[2].trim())
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function SectionHeading({ text, k }: { text: string; k: string }) {
  const m = text.match(H2_SPLIT_RE)
  const prefix = m ? m[1].trim() : ''
  const number = m ? m[2] : ''
  const titleText = m ? m[3] : text

  return (
    <div className="mt-12 md:mt-16 mb-6 md:mb-7">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
        {prefix && (
          <span
            className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md"
            style={{
              width: 36,
              height: 36,
              background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.3)',
              fontSize: 18,
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}
          >
            {prefix}
          </span>
        )}

        {number && (
          <span
            className="shrink-0 font-mono tabular-nums"
            style={{
              color: '#a5f3fc',
              fontSize: 11,
              letterSpacing: '0.15em',
              fontWeight: 700,
              opacity: 0.9,
            }}
          >
            {number.padStart(2, '0')}
          </span>
        )}

        <span className="w-px h-4 shrink-0" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.3)' }} />

        <span
          className="text-lg sm:text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}
        >
          {inline(titleText, 'h2t-' + k)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="w-6 h-px shrink-0" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }} />
        <span className="flex-1 h-px"
          style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.22) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.12) 55%, transparent 100%)' }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function StepHeading({ num, text, k }: { num: string; text: string; k: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="my-5 md:my-6 flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
      <div
        className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center font-mono tabular-nums"
        style={{
          width: 30,
          height: 30,
          background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.35)',
          borderRadius: 6,
          color: '#a5f3fc',
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: 700,
          letterSpacing: '0.06em',
        }}
      >
        {num}
      </div>
      <span
        className="text-sm md:text-base font-bold tracking-[0.14em] uppercase"
        style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}
      >
        {inline(text, `step-${k}`)}
      </span>
      <span
        className="h-px flex-1"
        style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.28) 0%, transparent 100%)' }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

export default function CodexContent({ content }: { content: string }) {
  const cleaned = repair(content)
  const lines = cleaned.split('\n')
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = []
  let i = 0
  let key = 0

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i]
    const trimmed = line.trim()

    if (trimmed === '') { i++; continue }

    if (isTableRow(line) && i + 1 < lines.length && isTableSeparator(lines[i + 1])) {
      const headers = splitRow(line)
      i += 2
      const rows: string[][] = []
      while (i < lines.length && isTableRow(lines[i])) {
        const cells = splitRow(lines[i])
        if (cells.some(c => c.length > 0)) rows.push(cells)
        i++
      }
      blocks.push(<DataTable key={key++} headers={headers} rows={rows} k={String(key)} />)
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed.startsWith('### ')) {
      blocks.push(
        <h3 key={key++} className="text-base md:text-lg font-bold tracking-wide mt-10 md:mt-12 mb-3"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(trimmed.slice(4), `h3-${key}`)}
        </h3>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('## ')) {
      blocks.push(<SectionHeading key={key++} text={trimmed.slice(3)} k={String(key)} />)
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('# ')) {
      blocks.push(
        <h1 key={key++}
          className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight mt-4 md:mt-6 mb-5 md:mb-6"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(trimmed.slice(2), `h1-${key}`)}
        </h1>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed === '---') {
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="my-10 md:my-12 flex items-center gap-3" aria-hidden>
          <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'var(--m-border)' }} />
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }} />
          <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'var(--m-border)' }} />
        </div>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed.startsWith('> ')) {
      const quoted: string[] = []
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith('> ')) {
        quoted.push(lines[i].trim().slice(2))
        i++
      }

      const single = quoted.length === 1 ? quoted[0] : ''
      const hasStructure = /[â†’â†â†“â†‘=]/.test(single)
      const isCompact = quoted.length === 1 && single.length > 0 && single.length <= 55 && !hasStructure

      if (quoted.length === 1 && single.includes('â†’') && single.length <= 90) {
        const chainParts = single.split('â†’').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        if (chainParts.length >= 2 && chainParts.length <= 6 && chainParts.every(p => p.length <= 30)) {
          blocks.push(<ChainBlock key={key++} parts={chainParts} k={`ch-${key}`} />)
          continue
        }
      }

      if (isCompact) {
        blocks.push(<CompactLabel key={key++} text={single} k={`cl-${key}`} />)
        continue
      }

      blocks.push(
        <blockquote key={key++}
          className="my-6 md:my-8 relative rounded-xl px-5 md:px-6 py-4 md:py-5 overflow-hidden"
          style={{
            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.07) 0%, rgba(59,130,246,0.02) 100%)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.22)',
          }}>
          <span className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-[2px]"
            style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }} />
          {quoted.map((q, qi) => (
            <p key={qi} className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
              {inline(q, `q-${key}-${qi}`)}
            </p>
          ))}
        </blockquote>
      )
      continue
    }

    const vs = tryVerticalSequence(lines, i)
    if (vs) {
      blocks.push(<VerticalSequence key={key++} pairs={vs.pairs} k={`vs-${key}`} />)
      i = vs.end
      continue
    }

    const eq = tryEqualsGroup(lines, i)
    if (eq) {
      blocks.push(<Pairs key={key++} items={eq.items} k={`eq-${key}`} />)
      i = eq.end
      continue
    }

    const ed = tryEmDashPairs(lines, i)
    if (ed) {
      blocks.push(<Pairs key={key++} items={ed.items} k={`ed-${key}`} />)
      i = ed.end
      continue
    }

    const nl = tryNumberedList(lines, i)
    if (nl) {
      blocks.push(
        <ol key={key++} className="my-5 md:my-6 space-y-2.5 md:space-y-3">
          {nl.items.map((it, ii) => (
            <li key={ii} className="flex items-start gap-3 md:gap-4">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-widest shrink-0 pt-[3px] w-6 tabular-nums"
                style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', opacity: 0.9 }}>
                {String(ii + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed flex-1" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
                {inline(it, `nl-${key}-${ii}`)}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )
      i = nl.end
      continue
    }

    if (/^[-*] /.test(trimmed)) {
      const items: string[] = []
      while (i < lines.length && /^[-*] /.test(lines[i].trim()) && !isTableRow(lines[i])) {
        items.push(lines[i].trim().slice(2))
        i++
      }
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="my-5 md:my-6 relative pl-6 md:pl-8 space-y-2"
          style={{ borderLeft: '1px solid var(--m-border-bright)' }}>
          {items.map((it, ii) => (
            <div key={ii} className="relative">
              <span className="absolute -left-[27px] md:-left-[35px] top-[18px] w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full"
                style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.75)' }} />
              <BulletItem text={it} k={`li-${key}-${ii}`} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )
      continue
    }

    if (ARROW_RE.test(trimmed)) {
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="flex my-3 pl-4">
          <span className="text-xl leading-none" style={{ color: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.5)' }}>â†“</span>
        </div>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    const circM = trimmed.match(CIRCLED_RE)
    if (circM) {
      const num = CIRCLE_MAP[circM[1]] ?? circM[1]
      const label = circM[2].replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/\*/g, '').trim()
      if (label.length > 0 && label.length <= 40) {
        blocks.push(<StepHeading key={key++} num={num} text={label} k={String(key)} />)
        i++
        continue
      }
    }

    const chainParts = trimmed.split('â†’').map(s => s.trim())
    const isCompact2 = chainParts.length === 2 &&
      chainParts[0].length > 0 && chainParts[0].length <= 25 &&
      chainParts[1].length > 0 && chainParts[1].length <= 25
    const isBigChain = chainParts.length >= 3 &&
      chainParts.length <= 5 &&
      chainParts.every(p => p.length > 0 && p.length < 40)
    if (isBigChain || isCompact2) {
      blocks.push(<ChainBlock key={key++} parts={chainParts} k={`ch-${key}`} compact={isCompact2} />)
      i++
      continue
    }

    const para: string[] = [trimmed]
    i++
    while (
      i < lines.length &&
      lines[i].trim() !== '' &&
      !lines[i].trim().startsWith('#') &&
      !lines[i].trim().startsWith('>') &&
      !/^[-*] /.test(lines[i].trim()) &&
      lines[i].trim() !== '---' &&
      !isTableRow(lines[i]) &&
      !ARROW_RE.test(lines[i].trim()) &&
      !CIRCLED_RE.test(lines[i].trim())
    ) {
      para.push(lines[i].trim())
      i++
    }
    blocks.push(
      <p key={key++} className="my-4 md:my-5 text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
        {inline(para.join(' '), `p-${key}`)}
      </p>
    )
  }

  return <div className="max-w-[68ch]">{blocks}</div>
}

  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type ReviewItem = {
  id: string
  user_index: number | null
  correct_index: number
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
  best_score?: number
  previous_best?: number
  is_new_best?: boolean
  attempts?: number
  xp_base?: number
  xp_bonus?: number
  xp_total?: number
  review?: ReviewItem[]
}

type Phase = 'briefing' | 'mission' | 'exam' | 'result'

function scrollMainToTop(smooth = false) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
  const main = document.querySelector('main')
  if (main) {
    main.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  } else {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  }
}

export default function QuestPlayer({
  lessonId,
  lessonTitle,
  lessonIndex,
  videoUrl,
  content,
  isFinalExam,
  passThreshold,
  initialCompleted,
  slug,
  nextHref,
  nextTitle,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  lessonTitle: string
  lessonIndex: number
  videoUrl: string | null
  content: string | null
  isFinalExam: boolean

  initialCompleted: boolean
  slug: string

  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>(initialCompleted ? 'mission' : 'briefing')
  const [cameFromResult, setCameFromResult] = useState(false)
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [examIndex, setExamIndex] = useState(0)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [showDiscipline, setShowDiscipline] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (questions !== null) return
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) { setError(error.message); setQuestions([]); return }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId, questions, supabase])

  useEffect(() => {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false))
    })
  }, [phase])

  function finishMission() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function retry() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function backToCodexFromResult() {
    setPhase('mission')
    setCameFromResult(true)

    setPhase('result')
    setCameFromResult(false)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }

  function goNext(href: string) {

  async function submit() {
    setSubmitting(true); setError(null)
    const payload = questions && questions.length > 0 ? answers : {}
    const { data, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId, p_answers: payload,
    })
    if (rpcError) { setError(rpcError.message); setSubmitting(false); return }

    let parsed: unknown = data
    if (typeof parsed === 'string') { try { parsed = JSON.parse(parsed) } catch { parsed = null } }
    let r: QuizResult | null = null
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) r = (parsed[0] as QuizResult) ?? null
    else if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'passed' in (parsed as object)) r = parsed as QuizResult

    if (!r || typeof r.passed !== 'boolean') {
      setError('Exam result was malformed. Please retry.'); setSubmitting(false); return
    }

    if (r.passed) {
      playPassSound()
      setCompleted(true)
      setShowDiscipline(true)
    } else {
      playFailSound()
    }

    setResult(r)
    setPhase('result')
    setSubmitting(false)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }

  const allAnswered =
    questions !== null && questions.length > 0 &&

        </div>
