            const isCorrect = userIdx === correctIdx
            return (
              <div key={q.id} className="m-panel relative p-4 sm:p-6"
                style={{ borderColor: isCorrect ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.4)' : 'rgba(239,68,68,0.4)' }}>
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderLeft: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderRight: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderLeft: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444'), borderRight: '1.5px solid ' + (isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444') }} />

                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 mb-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
                      Q{String(qi + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-lg" style={{ color: isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
                      {isCorrect ? 'âœ“' : 'âœ—'}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest"
                    style={{ color: isCorrect ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
                    {isCorrect ? 'CORRECT' : 'INCORRECT'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="text-sm md:text-base font-semibold mb-4 text-[var(--m-text)]">
                  {q.question}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {q.options.map((opt, oi) => {
                    const isUser = oi === userIdx
                    const isAnswer = oi === correctIdx
                    let border = 'var(--m-border)'
                    let bg = 'transparent'
                    let color = 'var(--m-text-muted)'
                    let marker = ''
                    if (isAnswer) { border = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.6)'; bg = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.08)'; color = '#10b981'; marker = 'âœ“ correct' }
                    else if (isUser && !isCorrect) { border = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.6)'; bg = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.08)'; color = '#ef4444'; marker = 'âœ— your answer' }
                    return (
                      <div key={oi} className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5"
                        style={{ border: '1px solid ' + border, background: bg, color }}>
                        <span className="font-mono shrink-0 w-5">{String.fromCharCode(65 + oi)}</span>
                        <span className="flex-1">{opt}</span>
                        {marker && <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-wider shrink-0">{marker}</span>}
                      </div>
                    )
                  })}
                </div>

                {!isCorrect && (
                  <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t text-xs md:text-sm" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.20)' }}>
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                      <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-mono tracking-widest shrink-0">ðŸ’¡ TIP</span>
                      <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">
                        Correct answer is <span style={{ color: '#10b981' }}>{String.fromCharCode(65 + correctIdx)}</span>. Re-read the question â€” the pattern matters.
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )
          })}

          <button onClick={backToResult}
            className="w-full border border-[var(--m-cyan)]/40 text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[var(--m-cyan-soft)] transition">
            â† BACK TO RESULT
          </button>
        </div>
      )
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-8 md:space-y-10">
        <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-px z-10" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #22d3ee 50%, transparent 100%)', opacity: 0.75 }} />

          <div className="px-5 md:px-7 py-4 md:py-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em]" style={{ color: '#22d3ee', textShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }}>
                  {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL EXAM' : 'SIDE QUEST ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-base md:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--m-text)] truncate">
                {lessonTitle}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[var(--m-cyan)] shrink-0">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] animate-pulse" />
              IN PROGRESS
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {videoUrl && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 md:mb-5">
              <span className="inline-block w-1 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ background: '#22d3ee', boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }} />
              <span className="text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>
                QUEST BRIEFING
              </span>
              <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.4) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black border border-[var(--m-border)]">
              {videoUrl.includes('youtube') || videoUrl.includes('youtu.be') ? (
                <iframe src={'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + extractYouTubeId(videoUrl)} title={lessonTitle}
                  allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
                  allowFullScreen className="w-full h-full" />
              ) : (<video src={videoUrl} controls className="w-full h-full" />)}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {content && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 md:mb-5">
              <span className="inline-block w-1 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ background: '#22d3ee', boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }} />
              <span className="text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>
                {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM INSTRUCTIONS' : 'QUEST CODEX'}
              </span>
              <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.4) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="m-hud-panel">
              <span className="m-hud-scan" />
              <div className="m-hud-header">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
                  CODEX
                  <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM BRIEF' : 'LESSON BODY'}</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ color: '#3a4250', opacity: 0.7 }}>MERIDIAN / v1</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 md:p-8"><CodexContent content={content} /></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {completed ? (
          <div className="m-panel border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/20 p-5 md:p-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
              <span className="text-2xl">âœ“</span>
              <span className="tracking-wider">MISSION COMPLETE</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3">
              <button onClick={finishMission}
                className="text-sm text-green-400/70 hover:text-green-400 underline text-center px-4 py-2">
                Retake exam
              </button>
              {nextHref && (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  NEXT: {(nextTitle?.toUpperCase() || 'CONTINUE')} â†’
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button onClick={finishMission}
            className="m-hud-corners w-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-10 py-4 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
            âœ“ FINISH MISSION â€” TAKE EXAM â†’
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  /* EXAM */
  if (phase === 'exam') {
    if (questions === null) {
      return (
        <div className="m-panel m-hud-corners p-12 text-center text-[var(--m-text-dim)] font-mono text-sm">
          LOADING EXAM...
        </div>
      )
    }
    if (questions.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="m-panel m-hud-corners p-6 md:p-8">
            <div className="m-label mb-2">{isFinalExam ? 'Final Exam' : 'Practice Exam'}</div>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-6">No questions yet. The instructor is preparing this exam.</p>
            <button onClick={submit} disabled={submitting}
              className="bg-white text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-neutral-200">
              {submitting ? 'COMPLETING...' : 'âœ“ COMPLETE MISSION'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }

    const answeredCount = Object.keys(answers).length
    const progressPct = Math.round((answeredCount / questions.length) * 100)
    const q = questions[examIndex]
    const isLast = examIndex === questions.length - 1
    const isFirst = examIndex === 0
    const selectedForQ = answers[q.id]

    return (
      <div className="space-y-3 md:space-y-6">
        <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

          <div className="px-4 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 border-b" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.15)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 md:mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[var(--m-cyan)]">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] animate-pulse" />
                {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL EXAM' : 'PRACTICE EXAM'}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
                Q{String(examIndex + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/{String(questions.length).padStart(2, '0')}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ background: '#1e2633' }}>
              <div className="h-full transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: progressPct + '%', background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)', boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
              <span>{answeredCount}/{questions.length} ANSWERED</span>
              <span>PASS {passThreshold}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="px-4 md:px-8 py-5 md:py-8">
            <div className="text-base md:text-xl font-bold mb-5 md:mb-6 leading-relaxed text-[var(--m-text)]">
              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = selectedForQ === idx
                return (
                  <button key={idx} type="button"
                    onClick={() => setAnswers(a => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))}
                    className={'w-full text-left text-sm md:text-base rounded-lg px-3 md:px-4 py-3 md:py-3.5 border transition-all flex items-center gap-3 ' + (selected ? 'border-[var(--m-cyan)] bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.10)] text-[var(--m-text)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:bg-white/[0.02]')}
                    style={{ boxShadow: selected ? '0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.20)' : 'none' }}>
                    <span className={'shrink-0 w-6 h-6 md:w-7 md:h-7 rounded flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[10px] md:text-xs border ' + (selected ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black border-[var(--m-cyan)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)]')}>
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex-1">{opt}</span>
                    {selected && <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--m-cyan)] shrink-0 hidden sm:inline">âœ“</span>}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && <div className="text-red-400 text-sm font-mono">ERROR: {error}</div>}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.max(0, i - 1)); scrollTop() }}
            disabled={isFirst}
            className="flex-1 border border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
            â† PREV
          </button>
          {isLast ? (
            <button onClick={submit} disabled={submitting}
              className={'flex-[2] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition ' + (submitting ? 'bg-[var(--m-surface)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)] border border-[var(--m-border)] cursor-not-allowed' : allAnswered ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black hover:bg-cyan-300 m-pulse' : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30')}>
              {submitting ? 'ANALYZING...' : allAnswered ? 'â–¸ SUBMIT' : 'â–¸ SUBMIT (' + unansweredCount + ')'}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.min(questions.length - 1, i + 1)); scrollTop() }}
              className="flex-[2] bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
              NEXT â†’
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  /* RESULT */
  if (phase === 'result' && result) {
    const passed = result.passed
    const isNewBest = !!result.is_new_best
    const previousBest = result.previous_best ?? 0
    const bestScore = result.best_score ?? result.score
    const attempts = result.attempts ?? 1
    const xpTotal = result.xp_total ?? 0
    const xpBase = result.xp_base ?? 0
    const xpBonus = result.xp_bonus ?? 0

    return (
      <>
        {showDiscipline && <DisciplineScreen onDone={() => {
          setShowDiscipline(false)
          requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
        }} />}
        <div className={'m-panel m-hud-corners p-8 md:p-14 text-center relative overflow-hidden ' + (passed ? 'border-green-700/50' : 'border-red-800/50')}>
          {isNewBest && passed && (
            <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md border"
              style={{ color: '#22d3ee', borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.5)', background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)' }}>
              âš¡ NEW HIGHSCORE
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-5xl md:text-6xl mb-4">{passed ? 'ðŸ†' : 'âœ—'}</div>
          <div className={'text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] mb-3 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION STATUS: CLEARED' : 'MISSION STATUS: FAILED'}
          </div>
          <h2 className={'text-2xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-8 md:mb-10 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION COMPLETE' : 'MISSION FAILED'}
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4 max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10">
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">SCORE</div>
              <div className={'text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>{result.score}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">CORRECT</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{result.correct}/{result.total}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">BEST</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>{bestScore}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">ATTEMPTS</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{attempts}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {passed && (
            <div className="max-w-md mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10 border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-4 text-left">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-3">XP BREAKDOWN</div>
              {xpBase > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">First clear</span>
                  <span className="text-green-400 font-mono">+{xpBase} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpBonus > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">New highscore bonus</span>
                  <span className="font-mono" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>+{xpBonus} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpTotal === 0 && <div className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">No new XP this attempt â€” already cleared.</div>}
              {xpTotal > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-[var(--m-border)] font-bold">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text)]">Total</span>
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-mono">+{xpTotal} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {previousBest > 0 && isNewBest && (
                <div className="text-xs mt-3" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>Beat your previous best of {previousBest}%</div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {passed ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
              <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REVIEW QUESTIONS
              </button>
              <button onClick={retry}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REPLAY FOR HIGHSCORE
              </button>
              {nextHref ? (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  NEXT: {(nextTitle?.toUpperCase() || 'CONTINUE')} â†’
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button onClick={() => goNext('/courses/' + slug)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  RETURN TO COURSE â†’
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-8 md:mb-10 max-w-md mx-auto">
                You need {passThreshold}% to clear this mission. Review your answers and try again.
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
                <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                  className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                  REVIEW QUESTIONS
                </button>
                <button onClick={retry}
                  className="bg-red-500 text-white font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-red-400 transition m-pulse">
                  RETRY MISSION
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </>
    )
  }

  return null
}

function extractYouTubeId(url: string): string | null {
  const match = url.match(
    /(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  )
  return match ? match[1] : null
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'

type Channel = {
  id: string
  slug: string
  name: string
  description: string | null
}

const CHANNEL_ACCENTS = ['#22d3ee', '#8b5cf6', '#10b981', '#f59e0b', '#3b82f6', '#ef4444']
const CHANNEL_ICONS  = ['â—ˆ', 'â—†', 'â–', 'â—‰', 'â–£', 'âœ¦']

export default async function CommunityPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data } = await supabase
    .from('channels')
    .select('id, slug, name, description')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })

  const channels = (data ?? []) as Channel[]

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        {/* Masthead */}
        <div className="mb-10 md:mb-12">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-3">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            COMMUNITY
            <span className="w-px h-3 mx-2" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
            <span className="text-[#3a4250]">CHANNELS / LIVE</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-[0.08em] text-[#e5e9f0] mb-4 leading-tight">
            CHANNELS
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">
              {channels.length} {channels.length === 1 ? 'discussion channel' : 'discussion channels'}. Ask, share, connect.
            </p>
            <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.35) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        {channels.length === 0 ? (
          <div
            className="rounded-2xl p-12 text-center relative"
            style={{
              border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.18)',
              background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
            }}
          >
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
              style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', opacity: 0.55 }} />
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
              style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', opacity: 0.55 }} />
            <div className="text-lg text-[#e5e9f0] mb-2">No channels yet.</div>
            <div className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">The community will appear here once channels are created.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {channels.map((ch, i) => {
              const accent = CHANNEL_ACCENTS[i % CHANNEL_ACCENTS.length]
              const icon = CHANNEL_ICONS[i % CHANNEL_ICONS.length]
              const isFirst = i === 0
              return (
                <Link
                  key={ch.id}
                  href={'/community/' + ch.slug}
                  className="group block relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:translate-x-1"
                  style={{
                    border: isFirst ? `1px solid ${accent}88` : '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.14)',
                    background: isFirst
                      ? `linear-gradient(90deg, ${accent}18 0%, rgba(6,10,16,0.72) 100%)`
                      : 'rgba(6,10,16,0.62)',
                    boxShadow: isFirst ? `0 0 50px ${accent}1f, inset 0 0 40px ${accent}08` : 'none',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
                  }}
                >
                  {/* HUD corners */}
                  <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3.5 h-3.5"
                    style={{ borderTop: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, borderLeft: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, opacity: isFirst ? 1 : 0.55 }} />
                  <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3.5 h-3.5"
                    style={{ borderTop: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, borderRight: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, opacity: isFirst ? 1 : 0.55 }} />
                  <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3.5 h-3.5"
                    style={{ borderBottom: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, borderLeft: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, opacity: isFirst ? 1 : 0.55 }} />
                  <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3.5 h-3.5"
                    style={{ borderBottom: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, borderRight: `1.5px solid ${accent}`, opacity: isFirst ? 1 : 0.55 }} />

                  {/* Scan line on active card */}
                  {isFirst && (
                    <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-px"
                      style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, ${accent} 50%, transparent 100%)`, opacity: 0.85 }} />
                  )}

                  <div className="p-5 md:p-7">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-5 md:gap-6">

                      {/* Icon column â€” matches library card structure */}
                      <div className="shrink-0 flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                        <span
                          className="text-2xl md:text-3xl transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"
                          style={{ color: accent, textShadow: `0 0 20px ${accent}99` }}
                        >
                          {icon}
                        </span>
                        <span
                          className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] tabular-nums"
                          style={{ color: accent, opacity: 0.65 }}
                        >
                          {String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Content */}
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                          <span
                            className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em]"
                            style={{ color: accent, textShadow: isFirst ? `0 0 10px ${accent}aa` : 'none' }}
                          >
                            CHANNEL
                          </span>
                          <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: `${accent}44` }} />
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
                            DISCUSSION
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <h2
                          className="text-lg md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight transition-colors group-hover:text-white"
                          style={{ color: '#e5e9f0' }}
                        >
                          <span style={{ color: accent }}>#</span>
                          {ch.name}
                        </h2>

                        {ch.description && (
                          <p className="text-xs md:text-sm text-[#8892a6] mt-2 leading-relaxed max-w-2xl">
                            {ch.description}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Chevron */}
                      <span
                        className="text-2xl shrink-0 pt-1 transition-all group-hover:translate-x-1"
                        style={{ color: accent, textShadow: isFirst ? `0 0 12px ${accent}aa` : 'none' }}
                      >
                        â–¸
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {isFirst && (
                    <div className="h-px"
                      style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, ${accent}99 50%, transparent 100%)` }} />
                  )}
                </Link>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-12 flex items-center justify-center gap-6 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] flex-wrap">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="inline-block w-3 h-3"
              style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
            <span>HOVER + â†â†‘â†“â†’</span>
            <span>NAVIGATE</span>
          </span>
          <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[#22d3ee]">â†µ</span>
            <span>ENTER</span>
            <span>SELECT</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'

const CATEGORIES = [
  { label: 'STUDY', title: 'Learning Specs', desc: 'Socratic learning. Test your own understanding.', count: 6, accent: '#22d3ee' },
  { label: 'RESEARCH', title: 'Research Specs', desc: 'Investigate any topic like a scholar.', count: 5, accent: '#8b5cf6' },
  { label: 'WRITING', title: 'Writing Specs', desc: 'Draft, edit, and polish any piece of writing.', count: 4, accent: '#10b981' },
  { label: 'BUSINESS', title: 'Business Specs', desc: 'Strategy, marketing, and operations.', count: 5, accent: '#f59e0b' },
  { label: 'AI', title: 'AI & Coding Specs', desc: 'Prompt engineering and systems thinking.', count: 4, accent: '#3b82f6' },
]

export default async function PromptsPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const total = CATEGORIES.reduce((s, c) => s + c.count, 0)

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <Link href="/library" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition mb-8">
          â† BACK TO LIBRARY
        </Link>

        <div className="mb-10 md:mb-12">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-3">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            LIBRARY
            <span className="w-px h-3 mx-2" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
            <span className="text-[#3a4250]">SPECS / 02</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-[0.08em] text-[#e5e9f0] mb-4 leading-tight">
            UNIVERSAL STUDY SPECS
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">
              {total} specs across {CATEGORIES.length} categories. Battle-tested for any AI.
            </p>
            <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.35) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          {CATEGORIES.map((c, i) => {
            const isFirst = i === 0
            return (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="relative rounded-xl p-5 md:p-6 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:translate-x-1 group"
                style={{
                  border: isFirst
                    ? `1px solid ${c.accent}88`
                    : '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.14)',
                  background: isFirst
                    ? `linear-gradient(90deg, ${c.accent}18 0%, rgba(6,10,16,0.72) 100%)`
                    : 'rgba(6,10,16,0.62)',
                  boxShadow: isFirst ? `0 0 40px ${c.accent}22` : 'none',
                  backdropFilter: 'blur(16px)',
                }}
              >
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
                  style={{ borderTop: `1.5px solid ${c.accent}`, borderLeft: `1.5px solid ${c.accent}`, opacity: isFirst ? 1 : 0.55 }} />
                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"

                {isFirst && (

// FILE: app/profile/ProfileClient.tsx
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Props = {
  email: string
  username: string
  fullName: string
  role: string
  joinedAt: string
}

export default function ProfileClient({
  email,
  username,
  fullName,
  role,
  joinedAt,
}: Props) {
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [name, setName] = useState(fullName)
  const [savingName, setSavingName] = useState(false)
  const [nameMsg, setNameMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [savingPw, setSavingPw] = useState(false)
  const [pwMsg, setPwMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  async function saveName() {
    setSavingName(true)
    setNameMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ full_name: name })
      .eq('email', email)

    if (error) {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Name updated.' })
    }
    setSavingName(false)
  }

  async function updatePassword() {
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: 'Password must be at least 6 characters.' })
      return
    }
    setSavingPw(true)
    setPwMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Password updated.' })
      setPassword('')
    }
    setSavingPw(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* IDENTITY */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.72)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          boxShadow: '0 0 60px rgba(34,211,238,0.10)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          IDENTITY
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <InfoRow label="EMAIL" value={email} mono />
          <InfoRow label="USERNAME" value={username || 'â€”'} mono />
          <InfoRow label="ROLE" value={role.toUpperCase()} />
          {joinedAt && (
            <InfoRow
              label="JOINED"
              value={new Date(joinedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
                day: 'numeric',
                month: 'long',
                year: 'numeric',
              })}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* DISPLAY NAME */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          DISPLAY NAME
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">FULL NAME</label>
        <input
          value={name}
          onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Your name"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={saveName}
            disabled={savingName || name === fullName}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingName ? 'SAVING...' : 'â–¸ SAVE'}
          </button>
          {nameMsg && (
            <span className="text-xs font-mono"
              style={{ color: nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{nameMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PASSWORD */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          SECURITY
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">NEW PASSWORD</label>
        <input
          type="password"
          value={password}
          onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="At least 6 characters"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={updatePassword}
            disabled={savingPw || password.length === 0}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingPw ? 'UPDATING...' : 'â–¸ UPDATE PASSWORD'}
          </button>
          {pwMsg && (
            <span className="text-xs font-mono"
              style={{ color: pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{pwMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* console hint */}
      <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-5 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] flex-wrap">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[#22d3ee]">TAB</span>
          <span>NAVIGATE FIELDS</span>
        </span>
        <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className="text-[#22d3ee]">CLICK</span>
          <span>SAVE</span>
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function InfoRow({
  label,
  value,
  mono = false,
}: {
  label: string
  value: string
  mono?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-2 border-b last:border-b-0"
      style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)' }}>
      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] shrink-0">
        {label}
      </span>
      <span
        className={`text-sm text-right min-w-0 truncate ${mono ? 'font-mono' : ''}`}
        style={{ color: '#e5e9f0' }}
      >
        {value}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: components/Sidebar.tsx

'use client'
import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import ThemeToggle from './ThemeToggle'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import { triggerNav } from './NavLoader'
import { unlockAudio, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound } from '@/lib/sounds'
import { getActiveZone, onZoneChange } from '@/lib/navZone'

const NAV = [
  { href: '/dashboard', label: 'OVERVIEW' },
  { href: '/courses', label: 'MY COURSES' },
  { href: '/community', label: 'COMMUNITY' },
  { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY' },
  { href: '/profile', label: 'PROFILE' },
]

export default function Sidebar({ userEmail }: { userEmail?: string }) {
  const path = usePathname()
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [zoneActive, setZoneActive] = useState(getActiveZone() === 'sidebar')
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<number | null>(null)

  const selectedRef = useRef(0)
  const routerRef = useRef(router)

  useEffect(() => { selectedRef.current = selected }, [selected])
  useEffect(() => { routerRef.current = router }, [router])

  useEffect(() => {
    const idx = NAV.findIndex(n => path === n.href || path?.startsWith(n.href + '/'))
    if (idx >= 0) setSelected(idx)
  }, [path])

  useEffect(() => {
    return onZoneChange(z => setZoneActive(z === 'sidebar'))
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!zoneActive) return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (active) {
        const tag = active.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || active.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setSelected(s => {
          const next = (s + 1) % NAV.length
          selectedRef.current = next
          return next
        })
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setSelected(s => {
          const next = (s - 1 + NAV.length) % NAV.length
          selectedRef.current = next
          return next
        })
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playConfirmSound()
        const item = NAV[selectedRef.current]
        if (item) {
          triggerNav()
          routerRef.current.push(item.href)
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  }, [zoneActive])

  async function quitToMainMenu() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    router.push('/')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <aside
      data-nav-zone="sidebar"
      className="hidden md:flex md:flex-col w-64 shrink-0 h-full relative overflow-hidden"
      style={{
        background:
          'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8,12,20,0.72) 0%, rgba(6,10,16,0.62) 40%, rgba(4,8,14,0.85) 100%)',
        borderRight: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.12)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(14px)',
      }}
    >
      {/* Top scan line */}
      <span
        className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-px z-20"
        style={{
          background:
            'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(34,211,238,0.85) 50%, transparent 100%)',
          opacity: 0.75,
        }}
      />

      {/* Faint grid overlay */}
      <span
        className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 z-0"
        style={{
          opacity: 0.06,
          backgroundImage:
            'linear-gradient(rgba(34,211,238,0.6) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.6) 1px, transparent 1px)',
          backgroundSize: '28px 28px',
          maskImage:
            'radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 25%, rgba(0,0,0,0.9) 0%, transparent 80%)',
          WebkitMaskImage:
            'radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 25%, rgba(0,0,0,0.9) 0%, transparent 80%)',
        }}
      />

      {/* Top-left corner bracket */}
      <span
        className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-20"
        style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)', borderLeft: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }}
      />
      {/* Bottom-right corner bracket */}
      <span
        className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-20"
        style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)', borderRight: '1.5px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }}
      />

      {/* LOGO / HEADER */}
      <div
        className="p-4 border-b shrink-0 relative z-10"
        style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.10)' }}
      >
        <Link
          href="/"
          onClick={() => {
            unlockAudio()
            playConfirmSound()
            triggerNav()
          }}
          className="flex items-center gap-3 group relative rounded-md px-2 py-2 -mx-1 transition-all hover:bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.04)]"
        >
          <span
            className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[2px] rounded-full transition-all duration-300"
            style={{
              height: 0,
              background: '#22d3ee',
              boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.8)',
            }}
          />
          <span className="relative shrink-0">
            <span
              className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none"
              style={{
                background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.28) 0%, transparent 70%)',
                filter: 'blur(10px)',
              }}
            />
            <LogoEmblem size={44} />
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.22em] text-[#e5e9f0] leading-none">
              MERIDIAN

FILE: components/ContentArrowNav.tsx

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { getActiveZone, setActiveZone, onZoneChange } from '@/lib/navZone'
import { unlockAudio, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

export default function ContentArrowNav({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0)
  const [zoneActive, setZoneActive] = useState(getActiveZone() === 'content')

  useEffect(() => {
    return onZoneChange(z => {
      setZoneActive(z === 'content')
      if (z !== 'content') setActiveIndex(-1)
    })
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!getActiveZone()) setActiveZone('content')
    setZoneActive(getActiveZone() === 'content')
    setActiveIndex(0)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!zoneActive) return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const el = ref.current
      if (!el) return
      const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
      if (items.length === 0) return

      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (active) {
        const tag = active.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || active.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i + 1 >= items.length ? 0 : i + 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i - 1 < 0 ? items.length - 1 : i - 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const idx = activeIndex < 0 ? 0 : activeIndex
        const target = items[idx]
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault()
          unlockAudio()
          playConfirmSound()
          target.click()
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  }, [zoneActive, activeIndex])

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
    items.forEach((it, i) => {
      if (zoneActive && i === activeIndex) {
        it.setAttribute('data-nav-active', 'true')
      } else {
        it.removeAttribute('data-nav-active')
      }
    })
  }, [activeIndex, zoneActive])

  return (
    <div ref={ref} data-nav-zone="content">
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import AcademyBackground from './AcademyBackground'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { triggerNav } from './NavLoader'
import {
  unlockAudio,
  isAudioUnlocked,
  playSelectSound,
  playConfirmSound,
  playInitializingSound,
  playTickSound,
  startAmbientHum,
} from '@/lib/sounds'

type MenuItem = {
  href: string
  label: string
  sub: string
  primary?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}

const LOADER_MS = 2500

export default function HomeScreen({
  loggedIn,
  continueHref = '/dashboard',
  continueLabel = 'CONTINUE',
  continueSub = 'Resume your journey',
}: {
  loggedIn: boolean
  continueHref?: string
  continueLabel?: string
  continueSub?: string
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'loading' | 'menu'>('loading')
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [pulse, setPulse] = useState(0)

  const lastTickRef = useRef(0)
  const soundPlayedRef = useRef(false)
  const stopAmbientRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)

  // Loading phase
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'loading') return

    // Play init sound if audio is already unlocked (returning visit).
    // If not, do NOT set the flag â€” wait for first gesture below.
    if (!soundPlayedRef.current && isAudioUnlocked()) {
      soundPlayedRef.current = true
      playInitializingSound(2200)
    }

    // Retry on first user gesture anywhere on the loading screen
    function retryOnGesture() {
      unlockAudio()
      if (!soundPlayedRef.current) {
        soundPlayedRef.current = true
        playInitializingSound(2200)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', retryOnGesture, { once: true })
    window.addEventListener('keydown', retryOnGesture, { once: true })

    const start = Date.now()
    const DURATION = 2000
    const tick = setInterval(() => {
      const p = Math.min(100, Math.round(((Date.now() - start) / DURATION) * 100))
      setProgress(p)

      const step = Math.floor(p / 12.5)
      if (step > lastTickRef.current && p < 100) {
        lastTickRef.current = step
        playTickSound(p)
      }

      if (p >= 100) {
        clearInterval(tick)
        setTimeout(() => setPhase('menu'), 320)
      }
    }, 40)

    const dt = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.')), 300)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', retryOnGesture)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', retryOnGesture)
      clearInterval(tick)
      clearInterval(dt)
    }
  }, [phase])

  // Ambient hum while on the menu
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'menu') return

    stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()

    function onGesture() {
      unlockAudio()
      if (!stopAmbientRef.current) {
        stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()
      } else {
        stopAmbientRef.current()
        stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onGesture, { once: true })
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onGesture, { once: true })

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onGesture)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onGesture)
      if (stopAmbientRef.current) {
        stopAmbientRef.current()
        stopAmbientRef.current = null
      }
    }
  }, [phase])

  const items: MenuItem[] = loggedIn
    ? [
        { href: continueHref, label: continueLabel, sub: continueSub, primary: true },
        { href: '/courses', label: 'COURSES', sub: 'Browse the curriculum' },
        { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY', sub: 'E-books Â· Specs Â· Vault' },
        { href: '/community', label: 'COMMUNITY', sub: 'Discussion channels' },
        { href: '/profile', label: 'PROFILE', sub: 'Account settings' },
      ]
    : [
        { href: '/signup', label: 'NEW GAME', sub: 'Create a free account', primary: true },
        { href: '/login', label: 'CONTINUE', sub: 'Log into an existing account' },
        { href: '/courses', label: 'COURSES', sub: 'Browse the curriculum' },
        { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY', sub: 'E-books Â· Specs Â· Vault' },
      ]

  function navigateWithLoader(href: string) {
    unlockAudio()
    playConfirmSound()
    triggerNav()
    setTimeout(() => router.push(href), LOADER_MS)
  }

  function moveSelection(delta: number) {
    unlockAudio()
    setSelected(s => (s + delta + items.length) % items.length)
    setPulse(p => p + 1)
    playSelectSound()
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'menu') return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const target = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (target) {
        const tag = target.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || target.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        moveSelection(1)
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        moveSelection(-1)
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault()
        const it = items[selected]
        if (!it.disabled) navigateWithLoader(it.href)
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [phase, selected, items.length])

  if (phase === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0"
          style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)' }}
        />
        <div
          className="absolute pointer-events-none"
          style={{
            top: '15%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
            width: '70vw', height: '70vw', maxWidth: 800, maxHeight: 800,
            background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0%, transparent 60%)',
          }}
        />
        <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center">
          <LogoEmblem size={280} className="mb-4" />
          <div className="w-72 md:w-96 mt-8">
            <div className="h-[2px] bg-[#1e2633] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full transition-all duration-75"
                style={{
                  width: `${progress}%`,
                  background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
                  boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.9)',
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between mt-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
              <span>INITIALIZING{dots}</span>
              <span>{progress}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-screen flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden">
      <AcademyBackground variant="landing" />

      <header
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b backdrop-blur-md shrink-0"
        style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.10)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#10b981] animate-pulse" />
          ONLINE
        </div>
        <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">

          <span>EU-WEST</span>
          <span>{new Date().getFullYear()}</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col items-center px-5 sm:px-6 py-4 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center my-auto">
          <LogoEmblem size={200} className="mb-4 sm:mb-6 shrink-0" />

          <div

function MenuRow({
  item, index, selected, pulseKey, onHover, onActivate,
}: {
  item: MenuItem
  index: number
  selected: boolean
  pulseKey: number
  onHover: () => void
  onActivate: () => void
}) {
  const isPrimary = item.primary

  if (item.disabled) {
    return (
      <li>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed"
          style={{ border: '1px solid transparent' }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono w-5 text-center text-[#3a4250]">
              {String(index).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-[#566074]">{item.label}</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#3a4250]">{item.sub}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#3a4250]">LOCKED</span>
        </div>
      </li>
    )
  }

  return (
    <li className="relative">
      {selected && (
        <>
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 z-10"

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { pickQuote, type DisciplineQuote } from '@/lib/discipline'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { unlockAudio, playTransitionSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

const EVENT_NAME = 'meridian:nav-start'

export function triggerNav() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
  const fn = (window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav
  if (typeof fn === 'function') {
    fn()
  } else {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT_NAME))
  }
}

export default function NavLoader() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
  const [fading, setFading] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<DisciplineQuote | null>(null)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')

  const prevPathRef = useRef(pathname)
  const startedAtRef = useRef(0)
  const progressRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)
  const fallbackRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function clearProgress() {
      if (progressRef.current) {
        clearInterval(progressRef.current)
        progressRef.current = null
      }
    }
    function clearFallback() {
      if (fallbackRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fallbackRef.current)
        fallbackRef.current = null
      }
    }

    function start() {
      clearProgress()
      clearFallback()
      setQuote(pickQuote())
      setProgress(0)
      setFading(false)
      setVisible(true)
      startedAtRef.current = Date.now()

      unlockAudio()
      playTransitionSound(1400)

      progressRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAtRef.current
        const p = Math.min(88, Math.round((elapsed / 2200) * 88))
        setProgress(p)
        if (p >= 88 && progressRef.current) {
          clearInterval(progressRef.current)
          progressRef.current = null
        }
      }, 30)

      fallbackRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setProgress(100)
        setFading(true)
        setTimeout(() => {
          setVisible(false)
          setFading(false)
        }, 320)
      }, 8000)
    }

    ;(window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav = start
    window.addEventListener(EVENT_NAME, start)

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(EVENT_NAME, start)
      delete (window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav
      clearProgress()
      clearFallback()
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevPathRef.current === pathname) return
    prevPathRef.current = pathname
    if (!visible) return

    const paintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setProgress(100)
      setFading(true)
      setTimeout(() => {
        setVisible(false)
        setFading(false)
      }, 400)
    }, 250)

    return () => clearTimeout(paintTimer)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return
    const id = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.')), 320)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [visible])

  if (!visible || !quote) return null

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-8 pointer-events-none"
      style={{
        zIndex: 9999,
        opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,
        transition: 'opacity 0.38s ease-out',
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0"
        style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)' }}
      />
      <div
        className="absolute pointer-events-none"
        style={{
          top: '15%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          width: '70vw', height: '70vw', maxWidth: 800, maxHeight: 800,
          background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0%, transparent 60%)',
        }}
      />

      <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center max-w-2xl text-center">
        <LogoEmblem size={180} className="mb-6" />

        <div
          className="text-xl md:text-2xl leading-relaxed italic mb-6"
          style={{
            fontFamily: 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif',
            color: '#e5e9f0',
            textShadow: '0 0 24px rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          }}
        >
          &ldquo;{quote.text}&rdquo;
        </div>

        <div
          className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.4em] uppercase"
          style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}
        >
          â€” {quote.author}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute bottom-16 flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
        <div
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            letterSpacing: '0.4em',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
            color: '#566074',
            fontWeight: 500,
          }}
        >
          LOADING{dots}
        </div>
        <div className="h-[2px] w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-full" style={{ background: '#1e2633' }}>
          <div
            className="h-full transition-all duration-75"
            style={{
              width: `${progress}%`,
              background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
              boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.9)',
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function getPanelMode(path: string | null): PanelMode {
  if (!path) return 'full'
  if (path.startsWith('/dashboard')) return 'full'

  return 'quiet'
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const TIERS = [
  { min: 0,  label: 'INITIATE', accent: '#566074' },
  { min: 1,  label: 'BRONZE',   accent: '#cd7c4a' },
  { min: 3,  label: 'SILVER',   accent: '#a5b4c4' },
  { min: 7,  label: 'GOLD',     accent: '#f59e0b' },
  { min: 14, label: 'PLATINUM', accent: '#22d3ee' },
  { min: 30, label: 'MERIDIAN', accent: '#a5f3fc' },
]
const WEEK_LABELS = ['M', 'T', 'W', 'T', 'F', 'S', 'S']

function getTier(days: number) {
  let t = TIERS[0]
  for (const tier of TIERS) if (days >= tier.min) t = tier
  return t
}

export default function StudyStreak() {
  const [streak, setStreak] = useState(0)
  const [best, setBest] = useState(0)
  const [total, setTotal] = useState(0)
  const [checkedIn, setCheckedIn] = useState(false)
  const [week, setWeek] = useState<boolean[]>(Array(7).fill(false))
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)

  function buildWeek(streakVal: number, todayDone: boolean) {
    const w = Array(7).fill(false)
    // index 0 = Monday ... 6 = Sunday
    const jsDay = new Date().getDay() // 0=Sun
    const displayIdx = jsDay === 0 ? 6 : jsDay - 1
    const effective = todayDone ? streakVal : Math.max(0, streakVal)
    for (let i = 0; i < 7 && i <= displayIdx; i++) {
      if (i < effective) w[displayIdx - i] = true
    }
    return w
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('m-streak')
    const lastCheck = localStorage.getItem('m-streak-last')
    const storedBest = localStorage.getItem('m-streak-best')
    const storedTotal = localStorage.getItem('m-streak-total')
    const parsed = stored ? parseInt(stored) : 0
    const bestVal = storedBest ? parseInt(storedBest) : 0
    const totalVal = storedTotal ? parseInt(storedTotal) : 0

    setBest(bestVal)
    setTotal(totalVal)

    if (lastCheck === today) {
      setStreak(parsed)
      setCheckedIn(true)
      setWeek(buildWeek(parsed, true))
    } else {
      const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toDateString()
      const carried = lastCheck === yesterday ? parsed : 0
      setStreak(carried)
      setCheckedIn(false)
      setWeek(buildWeek(carried, false))
    }
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  function checkIn() {
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const lastCheck = localStorage.getItem('m-streak-last')
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('m-streak')
    const parsed = stored ? parseInt(stored) : 0
    const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86400000).toDateString()
    const nextStreak = lastCheck === yesterday ? parsed + 1 : 1

    const newBest = Math.max(nextStreak, best)
    const newTotal = total + 1

    localStorage.setItem('m-streak', String(nextStreak))
    localStorage.setItem('m-streak-last', today)
    localStorage.setItem('m-streak-best', String(newBest))
    localStorage.setItem('m-streak-total', String(newTotal))

    setStreak(nextStreak)
    setBest(newBest)
    setTotal(newTotal)
    setCheckedIn(true)
    setWeek(buildWeek(nextStreak, true))
  }

  if (!mounted) return null
  const tier = getTier(streak)

  return (
    <div className="m-hud-panel">
      <span className="m-hud-scan" />
      <div className="m-hud-header">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" />
          STUDY STREAK
        </div>
        <span style={{ color: tier.accent, opacity: 0.9 }}>{tier.label}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        {/* Big number */}
        <div className="text-center mb-3">
          <div className="flex items-baseline justify-center gap-2">
            <div
              className="text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums leading-none"
              style={{ color: tier.accent, textShadow: '0 0 22px ' + tier.accent + '88' }}
            >
              {streak}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#566074]">
              {streak === 1 ? 'DAY' : 'DAYS'}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#3a4250] mt-1.5">
            CURRENT STREAK
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Week row */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1 mb-3 px-1">
          {WEEK_LABELS.map((label, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <div
                className="rounded-full transition-all"
                style={{
                  width: 8,
                  height: 8,
                  background: week[i] ? '#22d3ee' : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.12)',
                  boxShadow: week[i] ? '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' : 'none',
                }}
              />
              <span
                className="text-[8px] font-mono tracking-widest"
                style={{ color: week[i] ? '#a5f3fc' : '#3a4250' }}
              >
                {label}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Stats row */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-3">
          <div
            className="rounded-md px-3 py-2"
            style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.04)', border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.14)' }}
          >
            <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] mb-0.5">BEST</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[#a5f3fc] tabular-nums">{best} d</div>
          </div>
          <div
            className="rounded-md px-3 py-2"
            style={{ background: 'rgba(139,92,246,0.04)', border: '1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.14)' }}
          >
            <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] mb-0.5">TOTAL</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-[#c4b5fd] tabular-nums">{total} d</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* CTA */}
        {checkedIn ? (
          <div
            className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-[0.15em] text-center text-[#10b981] rounded-md py-2"
            style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.4)', background: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.06)' }}
          >
            âœ“ CHECKED IN
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button
            onClick={checkIn}
            className="w-full bg-[#22d3ee] text-black text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-md py-2.5 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition"
          >
            Check In Today
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: components/DailyGoal.tsx
