  )
}

function BulletItem({ text, k }: { text: string; k: string }) {
  const m = text.match(ARROW_SPLIT_RE)
  if (m && m[1].length > 0 && m[1].length < 70 && m[2].length > 0 && m[2].length < 90) {
    return (
      <div
        className="rounded-lg px-4 py-4 md:py-5 flex flex-col items-center text-center"
        style={{
          background: 'rgba(15,20,28,0.55)',
          border: '1px solid var(--m-border)',
          borderLeft: '2px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)',
        }}
      >
        <div className="text-[15px] md:text-base font-semibold tracking-wide leading-snug" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(m[1], `${k}-a`)}
        </div>
        <div className="my-2 text-base leading-none" style={{ color: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }}>â†“</div>
        <div className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-snug" style={{ color: '#a5f3fc' }}>
          {inline(m[2], `${k}-b`)}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
  return (
    <p className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed py-1.5" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
      {inline(text, k)}
    </p>
  )
}

function tryVerticalSequence(lines: string[], start: number): { pairs: { value: string; label: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const pairs: { value: string; label: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i + 2 < lines.length) {
    const v = lines[i].trim()
    const arrow = lines[i + 1].trim()
    const label = lines[i + 2].trim()
    if (!v || !label) break
    if (!ARROW_RE.test(arrow)) break
    if (v.startsWith('#') || v.startsWith('>') || /^[-*] /.test(v)) break
    if (isTableRow(v)) break
    if (v.length > 40 || label.length > 30) break
    pairs.push({ value: v, label })
    i += 3
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (pairs.length < 2) return null
  return { pairs, end: i }
}

function tryEqualsGroup(lines: string[], start: number): { items: { left: string; right: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: { left: string; right: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const raw = lines[i].trim()
    if (raw === '') { i++; continue }
    const line = stripBulletPrefix(raw)
    const m = line.match(EQ_SPLIT_RE)
    if (!m) break
    const left = m[1].trim()
    const right = m[2].trim()
    if (!left || !right) break
    if (left.length > 40 || right.length > 40) break
    items.push({ left, right })
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function tryEmDashPairs(lines: string[], start: number): { items: { left: string; right: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: { left: string; right: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const raw = lines[i].trim()
    if (raw === '') { i++; continue }
    const line = stripBulletPrefix(raw)
    const m = line.match(EMDASH_PAIR_RE)
    if (!m) break
    const left = m[1].trim()
    const right = m[2].trim()
    if (!left || !right) break
    if (left.length > 60 || right.length > 60) break
    if (left.includes('â†’') || right.includes('â†’')) break
    items.push({ left, right })
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function tryNumberedList(lines: string[], start: number): { items: string[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: string[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i].trim()
    if (line === '') { i++; continue }
    const m = line.match(NUMBERED_RE)
    if (!m) break
    items.push(m[2].trim())
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function SectionHeading({ text, k }: { text: string; k: string }) {
  const m = text.match(H2_SPLIT_RE)
  const prefix = m ? m[1].trim() : ''
  const number = m ? m[2] : ''
  const titleText = m ? m[3] : text

  return (
    <div className="mt-12 md:mt-16 mb-6 md:mb-7">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
        {prefix && (
          <span
            className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md"
            style={{
              width: 36,
              height: 36,
              background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.3)',
              fontSize: 18,
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}
          >
            {prefix}
          </span>
        )}

        {number && (
          <span
            className="shrink-0 font-mono tabular-nums"
            style={{
              color: '#a5f3fc',
              fontSize: 11,
              letterSpacing: '0.15em',
              fontWeight: 700,
              opacity: 0.9,
            }}
          >
            {number.padStart(2, '0')}
          </span>
        )}

        <span className="w-px h-4 shrink-0" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.3)' }} />

        <span
          className="text-lg sm:text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}
        >
          {inline(titleText, 'h2t-' + k)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="w-6 h-px shrink-0" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }} />
        <span className="flex-1 h-px"
          style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.22) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.12) 55%, transparent 100%)' }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function StepHeading({ num, text, k }: { num: string; text: string; k: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="my-5 md:my-6 flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
      <div
        className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center font-mono tabular-nums"
        style={{
          width: 30,
          height: 30,
          background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.35)',
          borderRadius: 6,
          color: '#a5f3fc',
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: 700,
          letterSpacing: '0.06em',
        }}
      >
        {num}
      </div>
      <span
        className="text-sm md:text-base font-bold tracking-[0.14em] uppercase"
        style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}
      >
        {inline(text, `step-${k}`)}
      </span>
      <span
        className="h-px flex-1"
        style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.28) 0%, transparent 100%)' }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

export default function CodexContent({ content }: { content: string }) {
  // Strip the ðŸŽ‰ side-quest-complete banner from all lessons
  const trimmedContent = stripCompleteBanner(content)
  const cleaned = repair(trimmedContent)
  const lines = cleaned.split('\n')
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = []
  let i = 0
  let key = 0

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i]
    const trimmed = line.trim()

    if (trimmed === '') { i++; continue }

    if (isTableRow(line) && i + 1 < lines.length && isTableSeparator(lines[i + 1])) {
      const headers = splitRow(line)
      i += 2
      const rows: string[][] = []
      while (i < lines.length && isTableRow(lines[i])) {
        const cells = splitRow(lines[i])
        if (cells.some(c => c.length > 0)) rows.push(cells)
        i++
      }
      blocks.push(<DataTable key={key++} headers={headers} rows={rows} k={String(key)} />)
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed.startsWith('### ')) {
      blocks.push(
        <h3 key={key++} className="text-base md:text-lg font-bold tracking-wide mt-10 md:mt-12 mb-3"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(trimmed.slice(4), `h3-${key}`)}
        </h3>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('## ')) {
      blocks.push(<SectionHeading key={key++} text={trimmed.slice(3)} k={String(key)} />)
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('# ')) {
      blocks.push(
        <h1 key={key++}
          className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight mt-4 md:mt-6 mb-5 md:mb-6"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(trimmed.slice(2), `h1-${key}`)}
        </h1>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed === '---') {
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="my-10 md:my-12 flex items-center gap-3" aria-hidden>
          <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'var(--m-border)' }} />
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }} />
          <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'var(--m-border)' }} />
        </div>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed.startsWith('> ')) {
      const quoted: string[] = []
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith('> ')) {
        quoted.push(lines[i].trim().slice(2))
        i++
      }

      const single = quoted.length === 1 ? quoted[0] : ''

      // âœï¸ WRITE THIS DOWN callout
      if (quoted.length === 1 && /^âœï¸/.test(single)) {
        const body = single.replace(/^âœï¸\s*(WRITE THIS DOWN[:\-â€”]?\s*)?/i, '').trim()
        blocks.push(<WriteDownBlock key={key++} text={body} k={`wd-${key}`} />)
        continue
      }

      const hasStructure = /[â†’â†â†“â†‘=]/.test(single)
      const isCompact = quoted.length === 1 && single.length > 0 && single.length <= 55 && !hasStructure

      if (quoted.length === 1 && single.includes('â†’') && single.length <= 90) {
        const chainParts = single.split('â†’').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        if (chainParts.length >= 2 && chainParts.length <= 6 && chainParts.every(p => p.length <= 30)) {
          blocks.push(<ChainBlock key={key++} parts={chainParts} k={`ch-${key}`} />)
          continue
        }
      }

      if (isCompact) {
        blocks.push(<CompactLabel key={key++} text={single} k={`cl-${key}`} />)
        continue
      }

      blocks.push(
        <blockquote key={key++}
          className="my-6 md:my-8 relative rounded-xl px-5 md:px-6 py-4 md:py-5 overflow-hidden"
          style={{
            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.07) 0%, rgba(59,130,246,0.02) 100%)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.22)',
          }}>
          <span className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-[2px]"
            style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }} />
          {quoted.map((q, qi) => (
            <p key={qi} className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
              {inline(q, `q-${key}-${qi}`)}
            </p>
          ))}
        </blockquote>
      )
      continue
    }

    const vs = tryVerticalSequence(lines, i)
    if (vs) {
      blocks.push(<VerticalSequence key={key++} pairs={vs.pairs} k={`vs-${key}`} />)
      i = vs.end
      continue
    }

    const eq = tryEqualsGroup(lines, i)
    if (eq) {
      blocks.push(<Pairs key={key++} items={eq.items} k={`eq-${key}`} />)
      i = eq.end
      continue
    }

    const ed = tryEmDashPairs(lines, i)
    if (ed) {
      blocks.push(<Pairs key={key++} items={ed.items} k={`ed-${key}`} />)
      i = ed.end
      continue
    }

    const nl = tryNumberedList(lines, i)
    if (nl) {
      blocks.push(
        <ol key={key++} className="my-5 md:my-6 space-y-2.5 md:space-y-3">
          {nl.items.map((it, ii) => (
            <li key={ii} className="flex items-start gap-3 md:gap-4">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-widest shrink-0 pt-[3px] w-6 tabular-nums"
                style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', opacity: 0.9 }}>
                {String(ii + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed flex-1" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
                {inline(it, `nl-${key}-${ii}`)}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )
      i = nl.end
      continue
    }

    if (/^[-*] /.test(trimmed)) {
      const items: string[] = []
      while (i < lines.length && /^[-*] /.test(lines[i].trim()) && !isTableRow(lines[i])) {
        items.push(lines[i].trim().slice(2))
        i++
      }
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="my-5 md:my-6 relative pl-6 md:pl-8 space-y-2"
          style={{ borderLeft: '1px solid var(--m-border-bright)' }}>
          {items.map((it, ii) => (
            <div key={ii} className="relative">
              <span className="absolute -left-[27px] md:-left-[35px] top-[18px] w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full"
                style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.75)' }} />
              <BulletItem text={it} k={`li-${key}-${ii}`} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )
      continue
    }

    if (ARROW_RE.test(trimmed)) {
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="flex my-3 pl-4">
          <span className="text-xl leading-none" style={{ color: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.5)' }}>â†“</span>
        </div>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    const circM = trimmed.match(CIRCLED_RE)
    if (circM) {
      const num = CIRCLE_MAP[circM[1]] ?? circM[1]
      const label = circM[2].replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/\*/g, '').trim()
      if (label.length > 0 && label.length <= 40) {
        blocks.push(<StepHeading key={key++} num={num} text={label} k={String(key)} />)
        i++
        continue
      }
    }

    const chainParts = trimmed.split('â†’').map(s => s.trim())
    const isCompact2 = chainParts.length === 2 &&
      chainParts[0].length > 0 && chainParts[0].length <= 25 &&
      chainParts[1].length > 0 && chainParts[1].length <= 25
    const isBigChain = chainParts.length >= 3 &&
      chainParts.length <= 5 &&
      chainParts.every(p => p.length > 0 && p.length < 40)
    if (isBigChain || isCompact2) {
      blocks.push(<ChainBlock key={key++} parts={chainParts} k={`ch-${key}`} compact={isCompact2} />)
      i++
      continue
    }

    const para: string[] = [trimmed]
    i++
    while (
      i < lines.length &&
      lines[i].trim() !== '' &&
      !lines[i].trim().startsWith('#') &&
      !lines[i].trim().startsWith('>') &&
      !/^[-*] /.test(lines[i].trim()) &&
      lines[i].trim() !== '---' &&
      !isTableRow(lines[i]) &&
      !ARROW_RE.test(lines[i].trim()) &&
      !CIRCLED_RE.test(lines[i].trim())
    ) {
      para.push(lines[i].trim())
      i++
    }
    blocks.push(
      <p key={key++} className="my-4 md:my-5 text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
        {inline(para.join(' '), `p-${key}`)}
      </p>
    )
  }

  return <div className="max-w-[68ch]">{blocks}</div>
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/CompleteButton.tsx  (quest completion)

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function CompleteButton({
  lessonId,
  completed: initial,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  completed: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initial)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleComplete() {
    if (completed || loading) return
    setLoading(true)

    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
    if (!user) {
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('lesson_progress')
      .upsert(
        {
          user_id: user.id,
          lesson_id: lessonId,
          completed: true,
          completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        { onConflict: 'user_id,lesson_id' }
      )

    if (!error) {
      setCompleted(true)
      router.refresh()
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  if (completed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
          <span className="text-xl">âœ“</span>
          <span>Quest Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm text-green-400 font-mono">+50 XP</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleComplete}
      disabled={loading}
      className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
    >
      {loading ? 'Completing...' : 'âœ“ Complete Side Quest'}
    </button>
  )
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/page.tsx
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import QuestPlayer from './QuestPlayer'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function LessonPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string; lessonId: string }>
}) {
  const { slug, lessonId } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  const { data: lesson } = await supabase
    .from('lessons')
    .select(
      'id, title, order_index, video_url, content, is_final_exam, pass_threshold, mission_id, mission:missions(id, order_index, module_id, module:modules(id, order_index))'
    )
    .eq('id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!lesson) notFound()

  const mission = (lesson as any).mission as
    | { id: string; order_index: number; module_id: string; module: { id: string; order_index: number } | null }
    | null

  let nextHref: string | null = null
  let nextTitle: string | null = null

  if (mission) {
    const { data: siblings } = await supabase
      .from('lessons')
      .select('id, title')
      .eq('mission_id', mission.id)
      .gt('order_index', lesson.order_index)
      .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)

    if (siblings && siblings.length > 0) {
      nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${siblings[0].id}`
      nextTitle = siblings[0].title
    } else {
      const { data: nextMissions } = await supabase
        .from('missions')
        .select('id')
        .eq('module_id', mission.module_id)
        .gt('order_index', mission.order_index)
        .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
        .limit(1)

      if (nextMissions && nextMissions.length > 0) {
        const { data: firstLesson } = await supabase
          .from('lessons')
          .select('id, title')
          .eq('mission_id', nextMissions[0].id)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (firstLesson && firstLesson.length > 0) {
          nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson[0].id}`
          nextTitle = firstLesson[0].title
        }
      } else {
        const currentSagaOrder = mission.module?.order_index ?? 0
        const { data: nextSagas } = await supabase
          .from('modules')
          .select('id')
          .eq('course_id', course.id)
          .gt('order_index', currentSagaOrder)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (nextSagas && nextSagas.length > 0) {
          const { data: nextMissions2 } = await supabase
            .from('missions')
            .select('id')
            .eq('module_id', nextSagas[0].id)
            .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
            .limit(1)

          if (nextMissions2 && nextMissions2.length > 0) {
            const { data: firstLesson2 } = await supabase
              .from('lessons')
              .select('id, title')
              .eq('mission_id', nextMissions2[0].id)
              .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
              .limit(1)

            if (firstLesson2 && firstLesson2.length > 0) {
              nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson2[0].id}`
              nextTitle = firstLesson2[0].title
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('completed')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('lesson_id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto pb-12 md:pb-20">
        <QuestPlayer
          lessonId={lesson.id}
          lessonTitle={lesson.title}
          lessonIndex={lesson.order_index}
          videoUrl={lesson.video_url}
          content={lesson.content}
          isFinalExam={lesson.is_final_exam ?? false}
          passThreshold={lesson.pass_threshold ?? 80}
          initialCompleted={progress?.completed ?? false}
          slug={slug}
          nextHref={nextHref}
          nextTitle={nextTitle}
        />
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

import DisciplineScreen from '@/components/DisciplineScreen'

type Question = {
  id: string
  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type ReviewItem = {
  id: string
  user_index: number | null
  correct_index: number
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
  best_score?: number
  previous_best?: number
  is_new_best?: boolean
  attempts?: number
  xp_base?: number
  xp_bonus?: number
  xp_total?: number
  review?: ReviewItem[]
}

type Phase = 'briefing' | 'mission' | 'exam' | 'result'

function scrollMainToTop(smooth = false) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
  const main = document.querySelector('main')
  if (main) {
    main.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  } else {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  }
}

export default function QuestPlayer({
  lessonId,
  lessonTitle,
  lessonIndex,
  videoUrl,
  content,
  isFinalExam,
  passThreshold,
  initialCompleted,
  slug,
  nextHref,
  nextTitle,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  lessonTitle: string
  lessonIndex: number
  videoUrl: string | null
  content: string | null
  isFinalExam: boolean
  passThreshold: number
  initialCompleted: boolean
  slug: string
  nextHref: string | null
  nextTitle: string | null
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>(initialCompleted ? 'mission' : 'briefing')
  const [cameFromResult, setCameFromResult] = useState(false)
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [examIndex, setExamIndex] = useState(0)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [showDiscipline, setShowDiscipline] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (questions !== null) return
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) { setError(error.message); setQuestions([]); return }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId, questions, supabase])

  useEffect(() => {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false))
    })
  }, [phase])

  function scrollTop() { scrollMainToTop(true) }
  function startMission() { setPhase('mission'); scrollTop() }
  function finishMission() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function retry() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function backToCodexFromResult() {
    setPhase('mission')
    setCameFromResult(true)
    setError(null)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }
  function backToResult() {
    setPhase('result')
    setCameFromResult(false)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }

  /** Hard navigate â€” bypasses router cache so the course page re-fetches fresh data */

    }, 300)
  }

  async function submit() {

    const payload = questions && questions.length > 0 ? answers : {}
    const { data, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId, p_answers: payload,
    })
    if (rpcError) { setError(rpcError.message); setSubmitting(false); return }

    let parsed: unknown = data
    if (typeof parsed === 'string') { try { parsed = JSON.parse(parsed) } catch { parsed = null } }
    let r: QuizResult | null = null
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) r = (parsed[0] as QuizResult) ?? null
    else if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'passed' in (parsed as object)) r = parsed as QuizResult

    if (!r || typeof r.passed !== 'boolean') {
      setError('Exam result was malformed. Please retry.'); setSubmitting(false); return
    }

    if (r.passed) {

      setShowDiscipline(true)

    setResult(r)

            â† BACK TO RESULT
          </button>
        </div>
      )
    }

    return (
      <div className="space-y-8 md:space-y-10">
        <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-px z-10" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #22d3ee 50%, transparent 100%)', opacity: 0.75 }} />

        )}

        {content && (

              <span className="text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>
                {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM INSTRUCTIONS' : 'QUEST CODEX'}

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                  <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM BRIEF' : 'LESSON BODY'}</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ color: '#3a4250', opacity: 0.7 }}>MERIDIAN / v1</span>

        )}

        {completed ? (

                className="text-sm text-green-400/70 hover:text-green-400 underline text-center px-4 py-2">
                Retake exam
              </button>
              {nextHref && (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">

  /* EXAM */
  if (phase === 'exam') {

    const answeredCount = Object.keys(answers).length
    const progressPct = Math.round((answeredCount / questions.length) * 100)

    const isFirst = examIndex === 0

    return (

              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ background: '#1e2633' }}>
              <div className="h-full transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: progressPct + '%', background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)', boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">

              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = selectedForQ === idx
                return (
                  <button key={idx} type="button"
                    onClick={() => setAnswers(a => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))}
                    className={'w-full text-left text-sm md:text-base rounded-lg px-3 md:px-4 py-3 md:py-3.5 border transition-all flex items-center gap-3 ' + (selected ? 'border-[var(--m-cyan)] bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.10)] text-[var(--m-text)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:bg-white/[0.02]')}
                    style={{ boxShadow: selected ? '0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.20)' : 'none' }}>
                    <span className={'shrink-0 w-6 h-6 md:w-7 md:h-7 rounded flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[10px] md:text-xs border ' + (selected ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black border-[var(--m-cyan)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)]')}>
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex-1">{opt}</span>
                    {selected && <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--m-cyan)] shrink-0 hidden sm:inline">âœ“</span>}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && <div className="text-red-400 text-sm font-mono">ERROR: {error}</div>}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.max(0, i - 1)); scrollTop() }}
            disabled={isFirst}
            className="flex-1 border border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
            â† PREV
          </button>
          {isLast ? (
            <button onClick={submit} disabled={submitting}
              className={'flex-[2] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition ' + (submitting ? 'bg-[var(--m-surface)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)] border border-[var(--m-border)] cursor-not-allowed' : allAnswered ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black hover:bg-cyan-300 m-pulse' : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30')}>
              {submitting ? 'ANALYZING...' : allAnswered ? 'â–¸ SUBMIT' : 'â–¸ SUBMIT (' + unansweredCount + ')'}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.min(questions.length - 1, i + 1)); scrollTop() }}
              className="flex-[2] bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
              NEXT â†’
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  /* RESULT */
  if (phase === 'result' && result) {
    const passed = result.passed
    const isNewBest = !!result.is_new_best
    const previousBest = result.previous_best ?? 0
    const bestScore = result.best_score ?? result.score
    const attempts = result.attempts ?? 1
    const xpTotal = result.xp_total ?? 0
    const xpBase = result.xp_base ?? 0
    const xpBonus = result.xp_bonus ?? 0

    return (
      <>
        {showDiscipline && <DisciplineScreen onDone={() => {
          setShowDiscipline(false)
          requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
        }} />}
        <div className={'m-panel m-hud-corners p-8 md:p-14 text-center relative overflow-hidden ' + (passed ? 'border-green-700/50' : 'border-red-800/50')}>
          {isNewBest && passed && (
            <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md border"
              style={{ color: '#22d3ee', borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.5)', background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)' }}>
              âš¡ NEW HIGHSCORE
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-5xl md:text-6xl mb-4">{passed ? 'ðŸ†' : 'âœ—'}</div>
          <div className={'text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] mb-3 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION STATUS: CLEARED' : 'MISSION STATUS: FAILED'}
          </div>
          <h2 className={'text-2xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-8 md:mb-10 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION COMPLETE' : 'MISSION FAILED'}
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4 max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10">
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">SCORE</div>
              <div className={'text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>{result.score}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">CORRECT</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{result.correct}/{result.total}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">BEST</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>{bestScore}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">ATTEMPTS</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{attempts}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {passed && (
            <div className="max-w-md mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10 border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-4 text-left">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-3">XP BREAKDOWN</div>
              {xpBase > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">First clear</span>
                  <span className="text-green-400 font-mono">+{xpBase} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpBonus > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">New highscore bonus</span>
                  <span className="font-mono" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>+{xpBonus} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpTotal === 0 && <div className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">No new XP this attempt â€” already cleared.</div>}
              {xpTotal > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-[var(--m-border)] font-bold">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text)]">Total</span>
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-mono">+{xpTotal} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {previousBest > 0 && isNewBest && (
                <div className="text-xs mt-3" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>Beat your previous best of {previousBest}%</div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {passed ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
              <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REVIEW QUESTIONS
              </button>
              <button onClick={retry}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REPLAY FOR HIGHSCORE
              </button>
              {nextHref ? (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  NEXT: {(nextTitle?.toUpperCase() || 'CONTINUE')} â†’
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button onClick={() => goNext('/courses/' + slug)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  RETURN TO COURSE â†’
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-8 md:mb-10 max-w-md mx-auto">
                You need {passThreshold}% to clear this mission. Review your answers and try again.
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
                <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                  className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                  REVIEW QUESTIONS
                </button>
                <button onClick={retry}
                  className="bg-red-500 text-white font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-red-400 transition m-pulse">
                  RETRY MISSION
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </>
    )
  }

  return null
}

function extractYouTubeId(url: string): string | null {
  const match = url.match(
    /(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  )
  return match ? match[1] : null
}

FILE: app\courses\[slug]\lessons\[lessonId]\QuizSection.tsx

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/QuizSection.tsx  (exam + progress gate)

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Question = {
  id: string
  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
}

export default function QuizSection({
  lessonId,
  initialCompleted,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  initialCompleted: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) {
        setError(error.message)
        setQuestions([])
        return
      }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId])

  async function submit(finalAnswers: Record<string, number>) {
    setSubmitting(true)
    setError(null)

    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      p_answers: finalAnswers,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setSubmitting(false)
      return
    }

    const r = (data as QuizResult[])[0]
    setResult(r)
    if (r.passed) {
      setCompleted(true)
      router.refresh()
    }
    setSubmitting(false)
  }

  // Completed
  if (completed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
          <span className="text-xl">âœ“</span>
          <span>Quest Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm text-green-400 font-mono">
          {result ? `${result.score}% Â· ` : ''}+50 XP
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Loading
  if (questions === null) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6 text-center text-[var(--m-text-dim)] text-sm">
        Loading practice exam...
      </div>
    )
  }

  // No quiz â€” one-click complete
  if (questions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-3 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => submit({})}
          disabled={submitting}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
        >
          {submitting ? 'Completing...' : 'âœ“ Complete Side Quest'}
        </button>
      </>
    )
  }

  // Failed state
  if (result && !result.passed) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-red-400 font-semibold mb-1">
          âœ— Not passed â€” {result.correct} / {result.total} ({result.score}%)
        </div>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5">
          You need 80% to unlock the next quest. Review the Codex and try again.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
            setStarted(true)
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Retake Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Intro state
  if (!started) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">
          {questions.length} question{questions.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
        </h3>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5 leading-relaxed">
          You need <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-semibold">80%</span>{' '}
          or higher to pass and unlock the next quest.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setStarted(true)
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Start Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Taking exam
  const allAnswered = questions.every((q) => answers[q.id] !== undefined)

  return (
    <div className="m-panel p-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] font-mono">
          {Object.keys(answers).length} / {questions.length} answered
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-6 mb-6">
        {questions.map((q, i) => (
          <div key={q.id}>
            <div className="text-sm font-medium mb-3 leading-relaxed">
              <span className="text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2 font-mono">
                Q{i + 1}.
              </span>
              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = answers[q.id] === idx
                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setAnswers((a) => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))
                    }
                    className={`w-full text-left text-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 border transition ${
                      selected
                        ? 'border-cyan-500/60 bg-cyan-500/[0.08] text-[var(--m-text)]'
                        : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2">
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    {opt}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && <div className="mb-4 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>}

      <button
        onClick={() => submit(answers)}
        disabled={!allAnswered || submitting}
        className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-40 transition"
      >
        {submitting
          ? 'Checking...'
          : allAnswered
          ? 'Submit Exam'
          : `Answer all ${questions.length} questions`}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/page.tsx
import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import EnrollButton from '@/app/dashboard/EnrollButton'
import CourseView, { type Saga } from './CourseView'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function CourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title, description, track, level')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  // Read is_admin directly off the profile row
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('is_admin')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const isAdmin = profile?.is_admin === true

  const { data: enrollment } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments')
    .select('id, progress')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const { data: sagasData } = await supabase
    .from('modules')
    .select(`
      id, title, description, order_index,
      missions(
        id, title, description, order_index,
        lessons(id, title, order_index, is_final_exam, pass_threshold)
      )
    `)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  const sagas = (sagasData ?? []) as unknown as Saga[]

  const { data: progressData } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('lesson_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('completed', true)

  const completedIds = (progressData ?? []).map((p: { lesson_id: string }) => p.lesson_id)
  const completedSet = new Set<string>(completedIds)

  sagas.forEach(s => {
    s.missions = (s.missions ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    s.missions.forEach(m => {
      m.lessons = (m.lessons ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    })
  })

  const totalLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.missions.reduce((a, m) => a + (m.lessons?.length ?? 0), 0),
    0
  )
  const doneLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) =>
      sum +
      s.missions.reduce(
        (a, m) => a + (m.lessons ?? []).filter(l => completedSet.has(l.id)).length,
        0
      ),
    0
  )
  const overallPct = totalLessons > 0 ? Math.round((doneLessons / totalLessons) * 100) : 0

  let defaultOpenIndex = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < sagas.length; i++) {
    const hasIncomplete = sagas[i].missions.some(m =>
      (m.lessons ?? []).some(l => !completedSet.has(l.id))
    )
    if (hasIncomplete) {
      defaultOpenIndex = i
      break
    }
    if (i === sagas.length - 1) defaultOpenIndex = i
  }

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <Link
          href="/courses"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition mb-8"
        >
          â† BACK TO COURSES
        </Link>

        <div className="mb-10 md:mb-14">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <span
              className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-2 py-1 rounded"
              style={{
                color: '#22d3ee',
                background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)',
                border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
              }}
            >
              {course.track === 'en_to_nl' ? 'EN â†’ NL' : course.track === 'nl_to_en' ? 'NL â†’ EN' : course.track?.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
              {course.level}
            </span>
            {enrollment && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#10b981] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#10b981]" />
                ENROLLED
              </span>
            )}
            {isAdmin && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#f59e0b] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#f59e0b]" />
                ADMIN Â· ALL UNLOCKED
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e5e9f0] mb-4 leading-tight">
            {course.title}
          </h1>

          {course.description && (
            <p className="text-sm md:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#8892a6] max-w-2xl mb-8">
              {course.description}
            </p>
          )}

          {!enrollment ? (
            <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} enrolled={false} />
          ) : (
            <div className="max-w-lg">
              <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
                  COURSE PROGRESS
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#22d3ee] tabular-nums">
                  {doneLessons} / {totalLessons} Â· {overallPct}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <div
                className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden"
                style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.9)' }}
              >
                <div
                  className="h-full"
                  style={{
                    width: `${overallPct}%`,
                    background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)',
                    transition: 'width 0.4s ease',
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {sagas.length === 0 ? (
          <div
            className="rounded-2xl p-8 md:p-12 text-center"
            style={{
              border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.18)',
              background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
            }}
          >
            <div className="text-base md:text-lg text-[#e5e9f0] mb-2">
              Curriculum coming soon.
            </div>
            <div className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">
              This course is being prepared.
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <CourseView
            sagas={sagas}
            slug={slug}
            completedIds={completedIds}
            enrolled={!!enrollment}
            defaultOpenIndex={defaultOpenIndex}
            isAdmin={isAdmin}
          />
        )}

        <div className="mt-14 md:mt-20 flex items-center justify-center gap-6 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] flex-wrap">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.6)' }} />
            <span>CLEARED</span>
          </span>
          <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { enrollInCourse } from '@/app/actions/enroll'

export default function EnrollButton({
  courseId,
  enrolled,
}: {
  courseId: string
  enrolled: boolean
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  if (enrolled) {
    return (
      <span className="text-green-400 text-sm font-semibold">âœ“ Enrolled</span>
    )
  }

  async function handleClick() {
    setLoading(true)
    await enrollInCourse(courseId)
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleClick}
      disabled={loading}
      className="bg-white text-black text-sm font-semibold rounded-full px-5 py-1.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      {loading ? 'Enrolling...' : 'Enroll'}
    </button>
  )
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import EnrollButton from './EnrollButton'

const DASHBOARD_HIDDEN_SLUGS = new Set<string>(['english-b1-fluency'])

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', user.id).single()

  const { data: courses } = await supabase
    .from('courses').select('*').eq('published', true)

  const visibleCourses = (courses ?? []).filter(
    (c) => !DASHBOARD_HIDDEN_SLUGS.has(c.slug)
  )

  const { data: enrollments } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments').select('course_id').eq('user_id', user.id)

  const enrolledIds = new Set(enrollments?.map((e) => e.course_id) || [])

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email}>
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-10 py-12">
        <div className="mb-12">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-3">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            DASHBOARD
            <span className="w-px h-3 mx-2" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
            <span className="text-[#3a4250]">OVERVIEW / LIVE</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-[0.06em] text-[#e5e9f0] mb-3 leading-tight">
            Welcome back, {profile?.full_name || 'learner'}
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">Pick a course and continue your journey.</p>
            <span className="flex-1 h-px max-w-md" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.35) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">AVAILABLE COURSES</span>
          <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.2)' }} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#3a4250]">
            {String(visibleCourses.length).padStart(2, '0')} LOADED
          </span>
        </div>

        {visibleCourses.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="m-hud-panel p-12 text-center">
            <span className="m-hud-scan" />
            <div className="text-base text-[#e5e9f0] mb-2">No courses available yet.</div>
            <div className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">New curriculum arrives soon.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
            {visibleCourses.map((course) => {
              const enrolled = enrolledIds.has(course.id)
              const trackLabel =
                course.track === 'en_to_nl' ? 'EN â†’ NL'
                : course.track === 'nl_to_en' ? 'NL â†’ EN'
                : course.track?.toUpperCase()
              return (
                <div key={course.id} className="m-hud-panel flex flex-col relative transition-all duration-300 hover:translate-x-1 group">
                  <span className="m-hud-scan" />
                  <div className="m-hud-header">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" />
                      <span style={{ color: '#22d3ee', textShadow: '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)' }}>{trackLabel}</span>
                      <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ COURSE</span>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ color: '#566074' }}>{course.level}</span>
                  </div>

                  <Link href={'/courses/' + course.slug} className="flex-1 block p-6 md:p-7">
                    <h3 className="text-lg md:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e5e9f0] group-hover:text-white transition-colors mb-3 leading-snug">
                      {course.title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[#8892a6] text-sm leading-relaxed">{course.description}</p>
                  </Link>

                  <div className="px-6 md:px-7 pb-6 md:pb-7">
                    {enrolled ? (
                      <Link href={'/courses/' + course.slug}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#22d3ee] text-black text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-md px-5 py-2.5 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
                        Continue Course
                        <span className="text-base leading-none">â†’</span>
                      </Link>
                    ) : (
                      <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} enrolled={false} />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

FILE: app\dashboard\SignOutButton.tsx

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function SignOutButton() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  async function handleSignOut() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    router.push('/')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleSignOut}
      className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition"
    >
      Sign out
    </button>
  )
}

// FILE: app/forgot-password/page.tsx  (URL: /forgot-password)

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
      redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/reset-password`,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-2">Reset your password</h1>

        {sent ? (
          <div className="mt-6">
            <div className="border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm text-green-400 mb-4">
              âœ“ Reset link sent to <strong>{email}</strong>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
              Check your inbox. The link will take you to a page where you can
              choose a new password.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-6">
              Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
            </p>

            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Email
            </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send reset link'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'

const BOOKS = [
  { n: 1, title: 'The Language Architect', sub: 'How to think in systems, not sentences.', tag: 'INCLUDED' },
  { n: 2, title: 'The Discipline Codex', sub: 'Focus, consistency, and the art of finishing.', tag: 'INCLUDED' },
  { n: 3, title: 'The Digital Renaissance', sub: 'Wide knowledge, deep understanding.', tag: 'INCLUDED' },
  { n: 4, title: 'Systems & Structure', sub: 'Mental models that transfer across domains.', tag: 'INCLUDED' },
  { n: 5, title: 'Foundations of Mastery', sub: 'How experts actually become experts.', tag: 'INCLUDED' },
]

export default async function EbooksPage() {

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl p-8"
      >
        <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300">
          â† Back
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-6">Log in</h1>

        {error && (
          <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Email</label>
        <input
          type="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-4 focus:border-neutral-600 outline-none"
        />

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Password</label>
        <input
          type="password"
          required
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-neutral-600 outline-none"
        />

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {loading ? 'Logging in...' : 'Log in'}
        </button>
<p className="text-sm text-center mt-4">
  <Link href="/forgot-password" className="text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] text-xs">
    Forgot your password?
  </Link>
</p>
        <p className="text-sm text-neutral-500 mt-4 text-center">
          No account?{' '}
          <Link href="/signup" className="text-white hover:underline">Sign up</Link>
        </p>
      </form>
    </main>
  )
}

export default async function Home() {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  let continueHref = '/dashboard'
  let continueLabel = 'CONTINUE'
  let continueSub = 'Resume your journey'

  if (user) {
    // 1. Prefer the course with the most recent lesson activity
    const { data: recent } = await supabase
      .from('lesson_progress')
      .select('lesson:lessons(course:courses(slug, title))')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .order('completed_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle()

    const recentCourse = (
      recent as unknown as {
        lesson: { course: { slug: string; title: string } | null } | null
      } | null
    )?.lesson?.course

    if (recentCourse?.slug) {
      continueHref = `/courses/${recentCourse.slug}`
      continueSub =
        recentCourse.title.length > 38
          ? recentCourse.title.slice(0, 36) + 'â€¦'
          : recentCourse.title
    } else {
      // 2. Fallback: most recent enrollment
      const { data: enrollment } = await supabase
        .from('enrollments')
        .select('course:courses(slug, title)')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .order('enrolled_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle()

      const course = (
        enrollment as unknown as {
          course: { slug: string; title: string } | null
        } | null
      )?.course

      if (course?.slug) {
        continueHref = `/courses/${course.slug}`
        continueSub =
          course.title.length > 38
            ? course.title.slice(0, 36) + 'â€¦'
            : course.title
      }
    }
  }

  return (
    <HomeScreen
      loggedIn={!!user}
      continueHref={continueHref}
      continueLabel={continueLabel}
      continueSub={continueSub}
    />
  )
}

// FILE: app/profile/ProfileClient.tsx
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Props = {
  email: string
  username: string
  fullName: string
  role: string
  joinedAt: string
}

export default function ProfileClient({
  email,
  username,
  fullName,
  role,
  joinedAt,
}: Props) {
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [name, setName] = useState(fullName)
  const [savingName, setSavingName] = useState(false)
  const [nameMsg, setNameMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [savingPw, setSavingPw] = useState(false)
  const [pwMsg, setPwMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  async function saveName() {
    setSavingName(true)
    setNameMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ full_name: name })
      .eq('email', email)

    if (error) {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Name updated.' })
    }
    setSavingName(false)
  }

  async function updatePassword() {
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: 'Password must be at least 6 characters.' })
      return
    }
    setSavingPw(true)
    setPwMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Password updated.' })
      setPassword('')
    }
    setSavingPw(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* IDENTITY */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.72)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          boxShadow: '0 0 60px rgba(34,211,238,0.10)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          IDENTITY
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <InfoRow label="EMAIL" value={email} mono />
          <InfoRow label="USERNAME" value={username || 'â€”'} mono />
          <InfoRow label="ROLE" value={role.toUpperCase()} />
          {joinedAt && (
            <InfoRow
              label="JOINED"
              value={new Date(joinedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
                day: 'numeric',
                month: 'long',
                year: 'numeric',
              })}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* DISPLAY NAME */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          DISPLAY NAME
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">FULL NAME</label>
        <input
          value={name}
          onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Your name"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={saveName}
            disabled={savingName || name === fullName}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingName ? 'SAVING...' : 'â–¸ SAVE'}
          </button>
          {nameMsg && (
            <span className="text-xs font-mono"
              style={{ color: nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{nameMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PASSWORD */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"

          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          SECURITY
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">NEW PASSWORD</label>
        <input
          type="password"

          placeholder="At least 6 characters"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={updatePassword}
            disabled={savingPw || password.length === 0}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingPw ? 'UPDATING...' : 'â–¸ UPDATE PASSWORD'}

          {pwMsg && (
            <span className="text-xs font-mono"
              style={{ color: pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{pwMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* console hint */}
      <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-5 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] flex-wrap">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

// FILE: app/reset-password/page.tsx  (URL: /reset-password)

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
      if (data.user) setReady(true)
    })
  }, [supabase])

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Passwords do not match')
      return
    }
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setError('Password must be at least 6 characters')
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }
    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-6">Choose a new password</h1>

        {!ready ? (
          <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
            Verifying reset link...
          </p>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              New password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-4 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Confirm password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Updating...' : 'Update password'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function SignupPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
      email,
      password,
      options: {
        data: { full_name: fullName, username: email.split('@')[0] },
      },
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl p-8"

        <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300">

        {error && (

        />

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Email</label>

        />

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Password</label>

          type="password"
          required
