'use client'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'

export type Lesson = {
  id: string
  title: string
  order_index: number
  is_final_exam: boolean | null
  pass_threshold: number | null
}

export type Mission = {
  id: string
  title: string
  description: string | null
  order_index: number
  lessons: Lesson[]
}

export type Saga = {
  id: string
  title: string
  description: string | null
  order_index: number
  missions: Mission[]
}

type State = 'cleared' | 'active' | 'next' | 'hidden'
type Current = { si: number; mi: number; li: number }

type Props = {
  sagas: Saga[]
  slug: string
  completedIds: string[]
  enrolled: boolean
  defaultOpenIndex: number
  isAdmin?: boolean
}

function computeSagaState(si: number, c: Current, isAdmin: boolean): State {
  if (isAdmin) return 'cleared'
  if (c.si === -1) return 'cleared'
  if (si < c.si) return 'cleared'
  if (si === c.si) return 'active'
  if (si === c.si + 1) return 'next'
  return 'hidden'
}

function computeMissionState(si: number, mi: number, c: Current, isAdmin: boolean): State {
  if (isAdmin) return 'cleared'
  if (si < c.si) return 'cleared'
  if (si > c.si) return 'hidden'
  if (mi < c.mi) return 'cleared'
  if (mi === c.mi) return 'active'
  if (mi === c.mi + 1) return 'next'
  return 'hidden'
}

function computeLessonState(si: number, mi: number, li: number, c: Current, isAdmin: boolean): State {
  if (isAdmin) return 'cleared'
  if (si < c.si) return 'cleared'
  if (si > c.si) return 'hidden'
  if (mi < c.mi) return 'cleared'
  if (mi > c.mi) return 'hidden'
  if (li < c.li) return 'cleared'
  if (li === c.li) return 'active'
  if (li === c.li + 1) return 'next'
  return 'hidden'
}

function sagaHasLessons(saga: Saga): boolean {
  return (saga.missions ?? []).some((m) => (m.lessons ?? []).length > 0)
}

export default function CourseView({
  sagas, slug, completedIds, enrolled, defaultOpenIndex, isAdmin = false,
}: Props) {
  const completedSet = useMemo(() => new Set(completedIds), [completedIds])

  const builtSagas = useMemo(
    () => (isAdmin ? sagas : sagas.filter(sagaHasLessons)),
    [sagas, isAdmin]
  )

  const current = useMemo<Current>(() => {
    for (let si = 0; si < builtSagas.length; si++) {
      const missions = builtSagas[si].missions ?? []
      for (let mi = 0; mi < missions.length; mi++) {
        const lessons = missions[mi].lessons ?? []
        for (let li = 0; li < lessons.length; li++) {
          if (!completedSet.has(lessons[li].id)) return { si, mi, li }
        }
      }
    }
    return { si: -1, mi: -1, li: -1 }
  }, [builtSagas, completedSet])

  const initialTab = isAdmin
    ? Math.min(defaultOpenIndex, Math.max(0, builtSagas.length - 1))
    : Math.max(0, current.si >= 0 ? current.si : builtSagas.length - 1)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(initialTab)

  const [openMissionKey, setOpenMissionKey] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAdmin) return
    if (current.si >= 0) setActiveTab(current.si)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [current.si, isAdmin])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAdmin) {
      setOpenMissionKey(null)
      return
    }
    const s = builtSagas[activeTab]
    if (s?.missions?.[current.mi]) {
      setOpenMissionKey(s.missions[current.mi].id)
    }
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [activeTab, isAdmin, current.mi])

  if (builtSagas.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="m-hud-panel p-12 text-center">
        <span className="m-hud-scan" />
        <div className="text-base text-[#e5e9f0] mb-2">Curriculum coming soon.</div>
        <div className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">This course is being prepared.</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  const activeSaga = builtSagas[activeTab]

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 md:space-y-6">
      {/* â•â•â• MISSION SELECTOR (top level = Missions) â•â•â• */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.24)',
          background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,20,28,0.85) 0%, rgba(10,14,20,0.96) 100%)',
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 border-b"
          style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.14)' }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.35em] text-[#22d3ee]">
              MISSION SELECTOR
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#3a4250]">
            {String(activeTab + 1).padStart(2, '0')} / {String(builtSagas.length).padStart(2, '0')}
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-1.5 p-1.5">
          {builtSagas.map((saga, si) => {
            const total = saga.missions.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.lessons?.length ?? 0), 0)
            const done = saga.missions.reduce(
              (sum, m) => sum + (m.lessons ?? []).filter(l => completedSet.has(l.id)).length,
              0
            )
            const cleared = total > 0 && done === total
            const isSelected = si === activeTab
            const state = computeSagaState(si, current, isAdmin)
            const isLocked = state === 'hidden' || (state === 'next' && !isAdmin)

            return (
              <button
                key={saga.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (isLocked) return
                  setActiveTab(si)
                }}
                className={
                  'group relative text-left rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 transition-all ' +
                  (isSelected ? '' : isLocked ? 'cursor-not-allowed' : 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/[0.03]')
                }
                style={{
                  border: isSelected
                    ? '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.55)'
                    : '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.10)',
                  background: isSelected
                    ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.14) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.05) 100%)'
                    : 'rgba(4,8,14,0.55)',
                  boxShadow: isSelected
                    ? '0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.18), inset 0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.03)'
                    : 'none',
                  opacity: isLocked && !isSelected ? 0.45 : 1,
                }}
              >
                {isSelected && (
                  <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 h-px"
                    style={{
                      background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, #22d3ee 50%, transparent 100%)',
                      opacity: 0.85,
                    }}
                  />
                )}

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                  <span
                    className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.28em] tabular-nums shrink-0"
                    style={{
                      color: isSelected ? '#22d3ee' : cleared ? '#10b981' : '#566074',
                      textShadow: isSelected ? '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)' : 'none',
                    }}
                  >
                    MISSION {String(si + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                  {cleared && !isSelected && (
                    <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#10b981' }}>âœ“</span>
                  )}
                  {isLocked && !isSelected && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-[#3a4250]">ðŸ”’</span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div
                  className="text-[11px] md:text-xs font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug mb-1.5 line-clamp-2"
                  style={{
                    color: isSelected ? '#ffffff' : isLocked ? '#3a4250' : '#e5e9f0',
                    minHeight: '2.6em',
                  }}
                >
                  {saga.title}
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="flex-1 h-[2px] rounded-full overflow-hidden"
                    style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.9)' }}>
                    <div
                      className="h-full transition-all"
                      style={{
                        width: (total > 0 ? (done / total) * 100 : 0) + '%',
                        background: cleared
                          ? '#10b981'
                          : 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className="text-[9px] font-mono tabular-nums shrink-0"
                    style={{ color: isSelected ? '#22d3ee' : '#566074' }}
                  >
                    {String(done).padStart(2, '0')}/{String(total).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* â•â•â• ACTIVE MISSION CONTENT â•â•â• */}
      {activeSaga && (
        <SagaChapter
          key={activeSaga.id}
          saga={activeSaga}
          slug={slug}
          index={activeTab}
          state={computeSagaState(activeTab, current, isAdmin)}
          isOpen={true}
          onToggle={() => {}}
          completedSet={completedSet}
          enrolled={enrolled}
          current={current}
          openMissionKey={openMissionKey}
          setOpenMissionKey={setOpenMissionKey}
          isAdmin={isAdmin}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function SagaChapter({
  saga, slug, index, state,
  completedSet, enrolled, current, openMissionKey, setOpenMissionKey, isAdmin,
}: {
  saga: Saga
  slug: string
  index: number
  state: State
  isOpen: boolean
  onToggle: () => void
  completedSet: Set<string>
  enrolled: boolean
  current: Current
  openMissionKey: string | null
  setOpenMissionKey: (k: string | null) => void
  isAdmin: boolean
}) {
  const isCleared = state === 'cleared'
  const isActive = state === 'active'
  const accent = isCleared ? '#10b981' : '#22d3ee'

  const total = saga.missions.reduce((sum, m) => sum + (m.lessons?.length ?? 0), 0)
  const done = saga.missions.reduce(
    (sum, m) => sum + (m.lessons ?? []).filter(l => completedSet.has(l.id)).length,
    0
  )
  const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((done / total) * 100) : 0

  return (
    <div
      className={`m-hud-panel relative overflow-hidden ${isActive ? 'm-active-pulse' : ''}`}
      style={{
        borderColor: accent + '66',
      }}
    >
      <span className="m-hud-scan" />
      <div className="px-4 md:px-6 py-4 md:py-5 flex items-start gap-4 md:gap-5">
        <div className="shrink-0 pt-0.5">
          {isCleared ? (
            <div
              className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-md"
              style={{
                width: 34, height: 34,
                border: '1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.5)',
                background: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.08)',
                color: '#10b981',
                fontSize: 14,
                fontWeight: 800,
              }}
            >
              âœ“
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div
              className="flex items-center justify-center rounded-md"
              style={{
                width: 34, height: 34,
                border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.55)',
                background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)',
                boxShadow: '0 0 16px rgba(34,211,238,0.25)',
              }}
            >
              <span
                className="inline-block"
                style={{
                  width: 9, height: 9,
                  background: '#22d3ee',
                  transform: 'rotate(45deg)',
                  boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.75)',
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1.5 flex-wrap">
            <span
              className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.35em]"
              style={{ color: accent }}
            >
              MISSION {String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
            {isCleared && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#10b981]">
                Â· CLEARED
              </span>
            )}
            {isActive && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                Â· <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" /> ACTIVE
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="text-lg md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-2" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
            {saga.title}
          </div>

          {saga.description && (
            <div className="text-xs md:text-sm leading-relaxed mb-3 text-[#8892a6]">
              {saga.description}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
            <div
              className="flex-1 h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden"
              style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.85)' }}
            >
              <div
                className="h-full transition-all duration-500"
                style={{
                  width: pct + '%',
                  background: pct === 100
                    ? '#10b981'
                    : 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
                  boxShadow: pct === 100
                    ? '0 0 8px rgba(16,185,129,0.5)'
                    : '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)',
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <span
              className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] tabular-nums shrink-0 w-14 text-right"
              style={{ color: isCleared ? '#10b981' : '#566074' }}
            >
              {String(done).padStart(2, '0')}/{String(total).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.10)' }}>
        <div className="py-3 md:py-4">
          {saga.missions.map((mission, mi) => {
            const mState = computeMissionState(index, mi, current, isAdmin)
            if (mState === 'hidden') return null
            return (
              <MissionBlock
                key={mission.id}
                mission={mission}
                slug={slug}
                sagaIndex={index}
                missionIndex={mi}
                state={mState}
                completedSet={completedSet}
                enrolled={enrolled}
                isOpen={isAdmin ? true : openMissionKey === mission.id && mState !== 'next'}
                onToggle={() => {
                  if (isAdmin) return
                  if (mState === 'next') return
                  setOpenMissionKey(openMissionKey === mission.id ? null : mission.id)
                }}
                current={current}
                isAdmin={isAdmin}
              />
            )
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'
import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react'

function repair(raw: string): string {
  let s = raw
  s = s.replace(/\|\s+\|/g, '|\n|')
  s = s.replace(/([^\n])\s+(\*\s+\*[A-Za-z])/g, '$1\n$2')
  s = s.replace(/([^\n])\s+(#{1,3}\s)/g, '$1\n$2')
  s = s.replace(/([^\n])\s+(>\s)/g, '$1\n$2')
  s = s.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n')
  return s
}

/** Strip everything from "# ðŸŽ‰ ..." onward â€” the "Side Quest Complete" banner. */
function stripCompleteBanner(raw: string): string {
  const idx = raw.search(/^#\s*ðŸŽ‰/m)
  return idx >= 0 ? raw.slice(0, idx).trimEnd() : raw
}

function inline(text: string, keyBase: string): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = []
  const regex = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|\*[^*\n]+\*|`[^`]+`)/g
  text.split(regex).forEach((part, idx) => {
    if (!part) return
    const k = `${keyBase}-${idx}`
    if (part.startsWith('**') && part.endsWith('**') && part.length > 4) {
      const word = part.slice(2, -2)
      const isKeyword = /^[A-Z][A-Z\s\-]{0,22}$/.test(word) && word.length <= 24
      if (isKeyword) {
        out.push(
          <span key={k} className="font-bold tracking-[0.04em]"
            style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', textShadow: '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }}>
            {word}
          </span>
        )
      } else {
        out.push(
          <strong key={k} style={{ color: '#ffffff', fontWeight: 700 }}>{word}</strong>
        )
      }
    }
    else if (part.startsWith('*') && part.endsWith('*') && part.length > 2)
      out.push(<em key={k} style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', fontStyle: 'italic' }}>{part.slice(1, -1)}</em>)
    else if (part.startsWith('`') && part.endsWith('`'))
      out.push(
        <code key={k} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[0.9em] font-mono"
          style={{ background: 'var(--m-surface-2)', color: '#a5f3fc' }}>
          {part.slice(1, -1)}
        </code>
      )
    else out.push(<span key={k}>{part}</span>)
  })
  return out
}

function isTableRow(line: string) {
  const t = line.trim()
  return t.startsWith('|') && t.endsWith('|') && t.length > 2
}
function isTableSeparator(line: string) {
  return /^\|[\s:|-]+\|$/.test(line.trim()) && line.includes('-')
}
function splitRow(line: string): string[] {
  return line.trim().replace(/^\|/, '').replace(/\|$/, '').split('|').map(c => c.trim())
}

    <div
      className="my-6 md:my-8 relative rounded-xl p-5 md:p-6 overflow-hidden"
      style={{
        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.10) 0%, rgba(34,211,238,0.04) 100%)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.35)',
        boxShadow: '0 0 30px rgba(245,158,11,0.08), inset 0 0 30px rgba(245,158,11,0.03)',
      }}
    >
      <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-[3px]"
        style={{ background: '#f59e0b', boxShadow: '0 0 14px rgba(245,158,11,0.6)' }} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
        <span className="text-base leading-none">âœï¸</span>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.35em] font-bold"
          style={{ color: '#f59e0b', textShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(245,158,11,0.5)' }}>
          WRITE THIS DOWN
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed font-semibold"
        style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
        {inline(text, k)}
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}

function VerticalSequence({ pairs, k }: { pairs: { value: string; label: string }[]; k: string }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="my-6 md:my-8 rounded-xl p-5 md:p-7 relative"
      style={{
        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,20,28,0.65) 0%, rgba(22,32,44,0.5) 100%)',
        border: '1px solid var(--m-border)',
        borderLeft: '2px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)',
      }}
    >
      {pairs.map((p, i) => (
        <Fragment key={i}>
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-baseline sm:gap-4 gap-0.5">
            <span className="text-lg md:text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
              {inline(p.value, `${k}-${i}-v`)}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.28em] uppercase"
              style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', opacity: 0.75 }}>
              {inline(p.label, `${k}-${i}-l`)}
            </span>
          </div>
          {i < pairs.length - 1 && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2" aria-hidden>
              <span className="w-[1px] h-5" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.35)' }} />
              <span className="text-[10px] leading-none" style={{ color: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }}>â–¼</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function Pairs({ items, k }: { items: { left: string; right: string }[]; k: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="my-6 md:my-8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden"
      style={{ border: '1px solid var(--m-border)', background: 'var(--m-surface)' }}>
      {items.map((it, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="grid grid-cols-2"
          style={{ borderTop: i === 0 ? 'none' : '1px solid var(--m-border)' }}>
          <div className="px-4 py-3 md:px-5 md:py-3.5" style={{ borderRight: '1px solid var(--m-border)' }}>
            <div className="text-base md:text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
              {inline(it.left, `${k}-${i}-l`)}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="px-4 py-3 md:px-5 md:py-3.5">
            <div className="text-base md:text-lg tracking-tight font-semibold"
              style={{ color: '#a5f3fc' }}>
              {inline(it.right, `${k}-${i}-r`)}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

function ChainBlock({ parts, k, compact = false }: { parts: string[]; k: string; compact?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className={compact ? 'my-3 md:my-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1.5' : 'my-5 md:my-7 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1.5'}>
      {parts.map((p, i) => (
        <Fragment key={i}>
          <span
            className={compact ? 'px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-sm font-semibold tracking-tight' : 'px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm md:text-base font-semibold tracking-tight'}
            style={{
              background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.22)',
              color: '#ffffff',
            }}
          >
            {inline(p, `${k}-${i}`)}
          </span>
          {i < parts.length - 1 && (
            <span className="text-sm leading-none" style={{ color: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }}>â†’</span>
          )}
        </Fragment>
      ))}
    </div>
  )
}

        {inline(text, k)}
      </span>
      <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.25) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />

}

function DataTable({ headers, rows, k }: { headers: string[]; rows: string[][]; k: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <div className="hidden md:block my-8 overflow-x-auto rounded-xl"
        style={{ border: '1px solid var(--m-border)', background: 'var(--m-surface)' }}>
        <table className="w-full text-sm min-w-[420px]">
          <thead>
            <tr style={{ background: 'var(--m-surface-2)' }}>
              {headers.map((h, hi) => (
                <th key={hi} className="text-left px-4 py-3.5 font-mono text-[11px] tracking-[0.15em] uppercase"
                  style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--m-border)' }}>
                  {inline(h, `th-${k}-${hi}`)}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.map((row, ri) => (
              <tr key={ri} style={{ borderTop: ri === 0 ? 'none' : '1px solid var(--m-border)' }}>
                {row.map((cell, ci) => (
                  <td key={ci} className="px-4 py-3 align-top" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
                    {inline(cell, `td-${k}-${ri}-${ci}`)}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <div className="md:hidden my-6 space-y-2">
        {rows.map((row, ri) => (
          <div key={ri} className="relative rounded-xl p-4"
            style={{
              border: '1px solid var(--m-border)',
              background: 'var(--m-surface)',
              borderLeft: '2px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.5)',
            }}>
            <span className="absolute top-3 right-3 text-[9px] font-mono tracking-widest" style={{ color: 'var(--m-text-dim)' }}>
              {String(ri + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
            <div className="space-y-2.5 pr-8">
              {row.map((cell, ci) => (
                <div key={ci}>
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.22em] uppercase mb-1"
                    style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', opacity: 0.75 }}>
                    {headers[ci] ?? ''}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[15px] leading-snug font-medium" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
                    {inline(cell, `mtd-${k}-${ri}-${ci}`)}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </>
  )
}

function BulletItem({ text, k }: { text: string; k: string }) {
  const m = text.match(ARROW_SPLIT_RE)
  if (m && m[1].length > 0 && m[1].length < 70 && m[2].length > 0 && m[2].length < 90) {
    return (
      <div
        className="rounded-lg px-4 py-4 md:py-5 flex flex-col items-center text-center"
        style={{
          background: 'rgba(15,20,28,0.55)',
          border: '1px solid var(--m-border)',
          borderLeft: '2px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.6)',
        }}
      >
        <div className="text-[15px] md:text-base font-semibold tracking-wide leading-snug" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(m[1], `${k}-a`)}
        </div>
        <div className="my-2 text-base leading-none" style={{ color: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }}>â†“</div>
        <div className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-snug" style={{ color: '#a5f3fc' }}>
          {inline(m[2], `${k}-b`)}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }
  return (
    <p className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed py-1.5" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
      {inline(text, k)}
    </p>
  )
}

function tryVerticalSequence(lines: string[], start: number): { pairs: { value: string; label: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const pairs: { value: string; label: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i + 2 < lines.length) {
    const v = lines[i].trim()
    const arrow = lines[i + 1].trim()
    const label = lines[i + 2].trim()
    if (!v || !label) break
    if (!ARROW_RE.test(arrow)) break
    if (v.startsWith('#') || v.startsWith('>') || /^[-*] /.test(v)) break
    if (isTableRow(v)) break
    if (v.length > 40 || label.length > 30) break
    pairs.push({ value: v, label })
    i += 3
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (pairs.length < 2) return null
  return { pairs, end: i }
}

function tryEqualsGroup(lines: string[], start: number): { items: { left: string; right: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: { left: string; right: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const raw = lines[i].trim()
    if (raw === '') { i++; continue }
    const line = stripBulletPrefix(raw)
    const m = line.match(EQ_SPLIT_RE)
    if (!m) break
    const left = m[1].trim()
    const right = m[2].trim()
    if (!left || !right) break
    if (left.length > 40 || right.length > 40) break
    items.push({ left, right })
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function tryEmDashPairs(lines: string[], start: number): { items: { left: string; right: string }[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: { left: string; right: string }[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const raw = lines[i].trim()
    if (raw === '') { i++; continue }
    const line = stripBulletPrefix(raw)
    const m = line.match(EMDASH_PAIR_RE)
    if (!m) break
    const left = m[1].trim()
    const right = m[2].trim()
    if (!left || !right) break
    if (left.length > 60 || right.length > 60) break
    if (left.includes('â†’') || right.includes('â†’')) break
    items.push({ left, right })
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function tryNumberedList(lines: string[], start: number): { items: string[]; end: number } | null {
  const items: string[] = []
  let i = start
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i].trim()
    if (line === '') { i++; continue }
    const m = line.match(NUMBERED_RE)
    if (!m) break
    items.push(m[2].trim())
    i++
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim() === '') i++
  }
  if (items.length < 2) return null
  return { items, end: i }
}

function SectionHeading({ text, k }: { text: string; k: string }) {
  const m = text.match(H2_SPLIT_RE)
  const prefix = m ? m[1].trim() : ''
  const number = m ? m[2] : ''
  const titleText = m ? m[3] : text

  return (
    <div className="mt-12 md:mt-16 mb-6 md:mb-7">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
        {prefix && (
          <span
            className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md"
            style={{
              width: 36,
              height: 36,
              background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.3)',
              fontSize: 18,
              lineHeight: 1,
            }}
          >
            {prefix}
          </span>
        )}

        {number && (
          <span
            className="shrink-0 font-mono tabular-nums"
            style={{
              color: '#a5f3fc',
              fontSize: 11,
              letterSpacing: '0.15em',
              fontWeight: 700,
              opacity: 0.9,
            }}
          >
            {number.padStart(2, '0')}
          </span>
        )}

        <span className="w-px h-4 shrink-0" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.3)' }} />

        <span
          className="text-lg sm:text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}
        >
          {inline(titleText, 'h2t-' + k)}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="w-6 h-px shrink-0" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }} />
        <span className="flex-1 h-px"
          style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.22) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.12) 55%, transparent 100%)' }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function StepHeading({ num, text, k }: { num: string; text: string; k: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="my-5 md:my-6 flex items-center gap-3 md:gap-4">
      <div
        className="shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center font-mono tabular-nums"
        style={{
          width: 30,
          height: 30,
          background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.35)',
          borderRadius: 6,
          color: '#a5f3fc',
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: 700,
          letterSpacing: '0.06em',
        }}
      >
        {num}
      </div>
      <span
        className="text-sm md:text-base font-bold tracking-[0.14em] uppercase"
        style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}
      >
        {inline(text, `step-${k}`)}
      </span>
      <span
        className="h-px flex-1"
        style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.28) 0%, transparent 100%)' }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

export default function CodexContent({ content }: { content: string }) {
  // Strip the ðŸŽ‰ side-quest-complete banner from all lessons
  const trimmedContent = stripCompleteBanner(content)
  const cleaned = repair(trimmedContent)
  const lines = cleaned.split('\n')
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = []
  let i = 0
  let key = 0

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i]
    const trimmed = line.trim()

    if (trimmed === '') { i++; continue }

    if (isTableRow(line) && i + 1 < lines.length && isTableSeparator(lines[i + 1])) {
      const headers = splitRow(line)
      i += 2
      const rows: string[][] = []
      while (i < lines.length && isTableRow(lines[i])) {
        const cells = splitRow(lines[i])
        if (cells.some(c => c.length > 0)) rows.push(cells)
        i++
      }
      blocks.push(<DataTable key={key++} headers={headers} rows={rows} k={String(key)} />)
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed.startsWith('### ')) {
      blocks.push(
        <h3 key={key++} className="text-base md:text-lg font-bold tracking-wide mt-10 md:mt-12 mb-3"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(trimmed.slice(4), `h3-${key}`)}
        </h3>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('## ')) {
      blocks.push(<SectionHeading key={key++} text={trimmed.slice(3)} k={String(key)} />)
      i++
      continue
    }
    if (trimmed.startsWith('# ')) {
      blocks.push(
        <h1 key={key++}
          className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight mt-4 md:mt-6 mb-5 md:mb-6"
          style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
          {inline(trimmed.slice(2), `h1-${key}`)}
        </h1>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed === '---') {
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="my-10 md:my-12 flex items-center gap-3" aria-hidden>
          <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'var(--m-border)' }} />
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }} />
          <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'var(--m-border)' }} />
        </div>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    if (trimmed.startsWith('> ')) {
      const quoted: string[] = []
      while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith('> ')) {
        quoted.push(lines[i].trim().slice(2))
        i++
      }

      const single = quoted.length === 1 ? quoted[0] : ''

      // âœï¸ WRITE THIS DOWN callout
      if (quoted.length === 1 && /^âœï¸/.test(single)) {
        const body = single.replace(/^âœï¸\s*(WRITE THIS DOWN[:\-â€”]?\s*)?/i, '').trim()
        blocks.push(<WriteDownBlock key={key++} text={body} k={`wd-${key}`} />)
        continue
      }

      const hasStructure = /[â†’â†â†“â†‘=]/.test(single)
      const isCompact = quoted.length === 1 && single.length > 0 && single.length <= 55 && !hasStructure

      if (quoted.length === 1 && single.includes('â†’') && single.length <= 90) {
        const chainParts = single.split('â†’').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
        if (chainParts.length >= 2 && chainParts.length <= 6 && chainParts.every(p => p.length <= 30)) {
          blocks.push(<ChainBlock key={key++} parts={chainParts} k={`ch-${key}`} />)
          continue
        }
      }

      if (isCompact) {
        blocks.push(<CompactLabel key={key++} text={single} k={`cl-${key}`} />)
        continue
      }

      blocks.push(
        <blockquote key={key++}
          className="my-6 md:my-8 relative rounded-xl px-5 md:px-6 py-4 md:py-5 overflow-hidden"
          style={{
            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.07) 0%, rgba(59,130,246,0.02) 100%)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.22)',
          }}>
          <span className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-[2px]"
            style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }} />
          {quoted.map((q, qi) => (
            <p key={qi} className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
              {inline(q, `q-${key}-${qi}`)}
            </p>
          ))}
        </blockquote>
      )
      continue
    }

    const vs = tryVerticalSequence(lines, i)
    if (vs) {
      blocks.push(<VerticalSequence key={key++} pairs={vs.pairs} k={`vs-${key}`} />)
      i = vs.end
      continue
    }

    const eq = tryEqualsGroup(lines, i)
    if (eq) {
      blocks.push(<Pairs key={key++} items={eq.items} k={`eq-${key}`} />)
      i = eq.end
      continue
    }

    const ed = tryEmDashPairs(lines, i)
    if (ed) {
      blocks.push(<Pairs key={key++} items={ed.items} k={`ed-${key}`} />)
      i = ed.end
      continue
    }

    const nl = tryNumberedList(lines, i)
    if (nl) {
      blocks.push(
        <ol key={key++} className="my-5 md:my-6 space-y-2.5 md:space-y-3">
          {nl.items.map((it, ii) => (
            <li key={ii} className="flex items-start gap-3 md:gap-4">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-widest shrink-0 pt-[3px] w-6 tabular-nums"
                style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', opacity: 0.9 }}>
                {String(ii + 1).padStart(2, '0')}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed flex-1" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
                {inline(it, `nl-${key}-${ii}`)}
              </span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      )
      i = nl.end
      continue
    }

    if (/^[-*] /.test(trimmed)) {
      const items: string[] = []
      while (i < lines.length && /^[-*] /.test(lines[i].trim()) && !isTableRow(lines[i])) {
        items.push(lines[i].trim().slice(2))
        i++
      }
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="my-5 md:my-6 relative pl-6 md:pl-8 space-y-2"
          style={{ borderLeft: '1px solid var(--m-border-bright)' }}>
          {items.map((it, ii) => (
            <div key={ii} className="relative">
              <span className="absolute -left-[27px] md:-left-[35px] top-[18px] w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full"
                style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.75)' }} />
              <BulletItem text={it} k={`li-${key}-${ii}`} />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )
      continue
    }

    if (ARROW_RE.test(trimmed)) {
      blocks.push(
        <div key={key++} className="flex my-3 pl-4">
          <span className="text-xl leading-none" style={{ color: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.5)' }}>â†“</span>
        </div>
      )
      i++
      continue
    }

    const circM = trimmed.match(CIRCLED_RE)
    if (circM) {
      const num = CIRCLE_MAP[circM[1]] ?? circM[1]
      const label = circM[2].replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/\*/g, '').trim()
      if (label.length > 0 && label.length <= 40) {
        blocks.push(<StepHeading key={key++} num={num} text={label} k={String(key)} />)
        i++
        continue
      }
    }

    const chainParts = trimmed.split('â†’').map(s => s.trim())
    const isCompact2 = chainParts.length === 2 &&
      chainParts[0].length > 0 && chainParts[0].length <= 25 &&
      chainParts[1].length > 0 && chainParts[1].length <= 25
    const isBigChain = chainParts.length >= 3 &&
      chainParts.length <= 5 &&
      chainParts.every(p => p.length > 0 && p.length < 40)
    if (isBigChain || isCompact2) {
      blocks.push(<ChainBlock key={key++} parts={chainParts} k={`ch-${key}`} compact={isCompact2} />)
      i++
      continue
    }

    const para: string[] = [trimmed]
    i++
    while (
      i < lines.length &&
      lines[i].trim() !== '' &&
      !lines[i].trim().startsWith('#') &&
      !lines[i].trim().startsWith('>') &&
      !/^[-*] /.test(lines[i].trim()) &&
      lines[i].trim() !== '---' &&
      !isTableRow(lines[i]) &&
      !ARROW_RE.test(lines[i].trim()) &&
      !CIRCLED_RE.test(lines[i].trim())
    ) {
      para.push(lines[i].trim())
      i++
    }
    blocks.push(
      <p key={key++} className="my-4 md:my-5 text-[15px] md:text-base leading-relaxed" style={{ color: '#ffffff' }}>
        {inline(para.join(' '), `p-${key}`)}
      </p>
    )
  }

  return <div className="max-w-[68ch]">{blocks}</div>
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/CompleteButton.tsx  (quest completion)

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function CompleteButton({
  lessonId,
  completed: initial,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  completed: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initial)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleComplete() {
    if (completed || loading) return
    setLoading(true)

    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
    if (!user) {
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('lesson_progress')
      .upsert(
        {
          user_id: user.id,
          lesson_id: lessonId,
          completed: true,
          completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        { onConflict: 'user_id,lesson_id' }
      )

    if (!error) {
      setCompleted(true)
      router.refresh()
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  if (completed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
          <span className="text-xl">âœ“</span>
          <span>Quest Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm text-green-400 font-mono">+50 XP</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleComplete}
      disabled={loading}
      className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
    >
      {loading ? 'Completing...' : 'âœ“ Complete Side Quest'}
    </button>
  )
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/page.tsx
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import QuestPlayer from './QuestPlayer'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function LessonPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string; lessonId: string }>
}) {
  const { slug, lessonId } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  const { data: lesson } = await supabase
    .from('lessons')
    .select(
      'id, title, order_index, video_url, content, is_final_exam, pass_threshold, mission_id, mission:missions(id, order_index, module_id, module:modules(id, order_index))'
    )
    .eq('id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!lesson) notFound()

  const mission = (lesson as any).mission as
    | { id: string; order_index: number; module_id: string; module: { id: string; order_index: number } | null }
    | null

  let nextHref: string | null = null
  let nextTitle: string | null = null

  if (mission) {
    const { data: siblings } = await supabase
      .from('lessons')
      .select('id, title')
      .eq('mission_id', mission.id)
      .gt('order_index', lesson.order_index)
      .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)

    if (siblings && siblings.length > 0) {
      nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${siblings[0].id}`
      nextTitle = siblings[0].title
    } else {
      const { data: nextMissions } = await supabase
        .from('missions')
        .select('id')
        .eq('module_id', mission.module_id)
        .gt('order_index', mission.order_index)
        .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
        .limit(1)

      if (nextMissions && nextMissions.length > 0) {
        const { data: firstLesson } = await supabase
          .from('lessons')
          .select('id, title')
          .eq('mission_id', nextMissions[0].id)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (firstLesson && firstLesson.length > 0) {
          nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson[0].id}`
          nextTitle = firstLesson[0].title
        }
      } else {
        const currentSagaOrder = mission.module?.order_index ?? 0
        const { data: nextSagas } = await supabase
          .from('modules')
          .select('id')
          .eq('course_id', course.id)
          .gt('order_index', currentSagaOrder)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (nextSagas && nextSagas.length > 0) {
          const { data: nextMissions2 } = await supabase
            .from('missions')
            .select('id')
            .eq('module_id', nextSagas[0].id)
            .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
            .limit(1)

          if (nextMissions2 && nextMissions2.length > 0) {
            const { data: firstLesson2 } = await supabase
              .from('lessons')
              .select('id, title')
              .eq('mission_id', nextMissions2[0].id)
              .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
              .limit(1)

            if (firstLesson2 && firstLesson2.length > 0) {
              nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson2[0].id}`
              nextTitle = firstLesson2[0].title
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('completed')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('lesson_id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto pb-12 md:pb-20">
        <QuestPlayer
          lessonId={lesson.id}
          lessonTitle={lesson.title}
          lessonIndex={lesson.order_index}
          videoUrl={lesson.video_url}
          content={lesson.content}
          isFinalExam={lesson.is_final_exam ?? false}
          passThreshold={lesson.pass_threshold ?? 80}
          initialCompleted={progress?.completed ?? false}
          slug={slug}
          nextHref={nextHref}
          nextTitle={nextTitle}
        />
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import CodexContent from './CodexContent'
import DisciplineScreen from '@/components/DisciplineScreen'
import { triggerNav } from '@/components/NavLoader'
import { playPassSound, playFailSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

type Question = {
  id: string
  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type ReviewItem = {
  id: string
  user_index: number | null
  correct_index: number
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
  best_score?: number
  previous_best?: number
  is_new_best?: boolean
  attempts?: number
  xp_base?: number
  xp_bonus?: number
  xp_total?: number
  review?: ReviewItem[]
}

type Phase = 'briefing' | 'mission' | 'exam' | 'result'

function scrollMainToTop(smooth = false) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
  const main = document.querySelector('main')
  if (main) {
    main.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  } else {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  }
}

export default function QuestPlayer({
  lessonId,
  lessonTitle,
  lessonIndex,
  videoUrl,
  content,
  isFinalExam,
  passThreshold,
  initialCompleted,
  slug,
  nextHref,
  nextTitle,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  lessonTitle: string
  lessonIndex: number
  videoUrl: string | null
  content: string | null
  isFinalExam: boolean
  passThreshold: number
  initialCompleted: boolean
  slug: string
  nextHref: string | null
  nextTitle: string | null
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>(initialCompleted ? 'mission' : 'briefing')
  const [cameFromResult, setCameFromResult] = useState(false)
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [examIndex, setExamIndex] = useState(0)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [showDiscipline, setShowDiscipline] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (questions !== null) return
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) { setError(error.message); setQuestions([]); return }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId, questions, supabase])

  useEffect(() => {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false))
    })
  }, [phase])

  function scrollTop() { scrollMainToTop(true) }
  function startMission() { setPhase('mission'); scrollTop() }
  function finishMission() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function retry() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function backToCodexFromResult() {
    setPhase('mission')
    setCameFromResult(true)
    setError(null)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }
  function backToResult() {
    setPhase('result')
    setCameFromResult(false)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }

  /** Hard navigate â€” bypasses router cache so the course page re-fetches fresh data */
  function goNext(href: string) {
    triggerNav()
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.location.href = href
    }, 300)
  }

  async function submit() {
    setSubmitting(true); setError(null)
    const payload = questions && questions.length > 0 ? answers : {}
    const { data, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId, p_answers: payload,
    })
    if (rpcError) { setError(rpcError.message); setSubmitting(false); return }

    let parsed: unknown = data
    if (typeof parsed === 'string') { try { parsed = JSON.parse(parsed) } catch { parsed = null } }
    let r: QuizResult | null = null
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) r = (parsed[0] as QuizResult) ?? null
    else if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'passed' in (parsed as object)) r = parsed as QuizResult

    if (!r || typeof r.passed !== 'boolean') {
      setError('Exam result was malformed. Please retry.'); setSubmitting(false); return
    }

    if (r.passed) {
      playPassSound()
      setCompleted(true)
      setShowDiscipline(true)
      // Refresh server component so `completedIds` updates on the course page
      router.refresh()
    } else {
      playFailSound()
    }

    setResult(r)
    setPhase('result')
    setSubmitting(false)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }

  const allAnswered =
    questions !== null && questions.length > 0 &&
    questions.every(q => answers[q.id] !== undefined)

  const unansweredCount =
    questions && questions.length > 0
      ? questions.length - Object.keys(answers).length
      : 0

  /* BRIEFING */
  if (phase === 'briefing') {
    return (
      <div className="m-hud-panel">
        <span className="m-hud-scan" />
        <div className="m-hud-header">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            MISSION BRIEF
            <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL' : 'SQ ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            STANDBY
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10">
        <div className="m-label m-label-cyan mb-3">
          {isFinalExam ? 'Final Exam' : 'Side Quest ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-8">{lessonTitle}</h2>
        <div className="border-t border-[var(--m-border)] mb-6" />

            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">BRIEFING</div>
            <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--m-text)]">{videoUrl ? 'READY' : 'TEXT ONLY'}</div>

          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">EXAM</div>
            <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--m-text)]">
              {questions === null ? '...' : questions.length === 0 ? 'NONE' : questions.length + ' Q'}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">PASS GATE</div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">

                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-base md:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--m-text)] truncate">
                {lessonTitle}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[var(--m-cyan)] shrink-0">
              <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] animate-pulse" />
              IN PROGRESS
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {videoUrl && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 md:mb-5">
              <span className="inline-block w-1 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ background: '#22d3ee', boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }} />
              <span className="text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>
                QUEST BRIEFING
              </span>
              <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.4) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="w-full aspect-video rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black border border-[var(--m-border)]">
              {videoUrl.includes('youtube') || videoUrl.includes('youtu.be') ? (
                <iframe src={'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + extractYouTubeId(videoUrl)} title={lessonTitle}
                  allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture"
                  allowFullScreen className="w-full h-full" />
              ) : (<video src={videoUrl} controls className="w-full h-full" />)}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {content && (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4 md:mb-5">
              <span className="inline-block w-1 h-5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ background: '#22d3ee', boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.7)' }} />
              <span className="text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.3em] uppercase" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>
                {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM INSTRUCTIONS' : 'QUEST CODEX'}
              </span>
              <span className="flex-1 h-px" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.4) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="m-hud-panel">
              <span className="m-hud-scan" />
              <div className="m-hud-header">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
                  CODEX
                  <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ {isFinalExam ? 'EXAM BRIEF' : 'LESSON BODY'}</span>
                </div>
                <span style={{ color: '#3a4250', opacity: 0.7 }}>MERIDIAN / v1</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 md:p-8"><CodexContent content={content} /></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {completed ? (
          <div className="m-panel border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/20 p-5 md:p-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
              <span className="text-2xl">âœ“</span>
              <span className="tracking-wider">MISSION COMPLETE</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-3">
              <button onClick={finishMission}
                className="text-sm text-green-400/70 hover:text-green-400 underline text-center px-4 py-2">
                Retake exam
              </button>
              {nextHref && (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  NEXT: {(nextTitle?.toUpperCase() || 'CONTINUE')} â†’
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button onClick={finishMission}
            className="m-hud-corners w-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-10 py-4 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
            âœ“ FINISH MISSION â€” TAKE EXAM â†’
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    )
  }

  /* EXAM */
  if (phase === 'exam') {
    if (questions === null) {
      return (
        <div className="m-panel m-hud-corners p-12 text-center text-[var(--m-text-dim)] font-mono text-sm">
          LOADING EXAM...
        </div>
      )
    }
    if (questions.length === 0) {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="m-panel m-hud-corners p-6 md:p-8">
            <div className="m-label mb-2">{isFinalExam ? 'Final Exam' : 'Practice Exam'}</div>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-6">No questions yet. The instructor is preparing this exam.</p>
            <button onClick={submit} disabled={submitting}
              className="bg-white text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-neutral-200">
              {submitting ? 'COMPLETING...' : 'âœ“ COMPLETE MISSION'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }

    const answeredCount = Object.keys(answers).length
    const progressPct = Math.round((answeredCount / questions.length) * 100)
    const q = questions[examIndex]
    const isLast = examIndex === questions.length - 1
    const isFirst = examIndex === 0
    const selectedForQ = answers[q.id]

    return (
      <div className="space-y-3 md:space-y-6">
        <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

          <div className="px-4 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 border-b" style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.15)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 md:mb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[var(--m-cyan)]">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[var(--m-cyan)] animate-pulse" />
                {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL EXAM' : 'PRACTICE EXAM'}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
                Q{String(examIndex + 1).padStart(2, '0')}/{String(questions.length).padStart(2, '0')}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ background: '#1e2633' }}>
              <div className="h-full transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: progressPct + '%', background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)', boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.6)' }} />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 text-[9px] md:text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">
              <span>{answeredCount}/{questions.length} ANSWERED</span>
              <span>PASS {passThreshold}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="px-4 md:px-8 py-5 md:py-8">
            <div className="text-base md:text-xl font-bold mb-5 md:mb-6 leading-relaxed text-[var(--m-text)]">
              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = selectedForQ === idx
                return (
                  <button key={idx} type="button"
                    onClick={() => setAnswers(a => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))}
                    className={'w-full text-left text-sm md:text-base rounded-lg px-3 md:px-4 py-3 md:py-3.5 border transition-all flex items-center gap-3 ' + (selected ? 'border-[var(--m-cyan)] bg-[rgba(34,211,238,0.10)] text-[var(--m-text)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:bg-white/[0.02]')}
                    style={{ boxShadow: selected ? '0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.20)' : 'none' }}>
                    <span className={'shrink-0 w-6 h-6 md:w-7 md:h-7 rounded flex items-center justify-center font-mono text-[10px] md:text-xs border ' + (selected ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black border-[var(--m-cyan)]' : 'border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)]')}>
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex-1">{opt}</span>
                    {selected && <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-wider text-[var(--m-cyan)] shrink-0 hidden sm:inline">âœ“</span>}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {error && <div className="text-red-400 text-sm font-mono">ERROR: {error}</div>}

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 md:gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.max(0, i - 1)); scrollTop() }}
            disabled={isFirst}
            className="flex-1 border border-[var(--m-border)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
            â† PREV
          </button>
          {isLast ? (
            <button onClick={submit} disabled={submitting}
              className={'flex-[2] font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 transition ' + (submitting ? 'bg-[var(--m-surface)] text-[var(--m-text-dim)] border border-[var(--m-border)] cursor-not-allowed' : allAnswered ? 'bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black hover:bg-cyan-300 m-pulse' : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30')}>
              {submitting ? 'ANALYZING...' : allAnswered ? 'â–¸ SUBMIT' : 'â–¸ SUBMIT (' + unansweredCount + ')'}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <button onClick={() => { setExamIndex(i => Math.min(questions.length - 1, i + 1)); scrollTop() }}
              className="flex-[2] bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs md:text-sm rounded-lg px-3 md:px-6 py-3 md:py-4 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
              NEXT â†’
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  /* RESULT */
  if (phase === 'result' && result) {
    const passed = result.passed
    const isNewBest = !!result.is_new_best
    const previousBest = result.previous_best ?? 0
    const bestScore = result.best_score ?? result.score
    const attempts = result.attempts ?? 1
    const xpTotal = result.xp_total ?? 0
    const xpBase = result.xp_base ?? 0
    const xpBonus = result.xp_bonus ?? 0

    return (
      <>
        {showDiscipline && <DisciplineScreen onDone={() => {
          setShowDiscipline(false)
          requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
        }} />}
        <div className={'m-panel m-hud-corners p-8 md:p-14 text-center relative overflow-hidden ' + (passed ? 'border-green-700/50' : 'border-red-800/50')}>
          {isNewBest && passed && (
            <div className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md border"
              style={{ color: '#22d3ee', borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.5)', background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)' }}>
              âš¡ NEW HIGHSCORE
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-5xl md:text-6xl mb-4">{passed ? 'ðŸ†' : 'âœ—'}</div>
          <div className={'text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] mb-3 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION STATUS: CLEARED' : 'MISSION STATUS: FAILED'}
          </div>
          <h2 className={'text-2xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-8 md:mb-10 ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>
            {passed ? 'MISSION COMPLETE' : 'MISSION FAILED'}
          </h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4 max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10">
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">SCORE</div>
              <div className={'text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums ' + (passed ? 'text-green-400' : 'text-red-400')}>{result.score}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">CORRECT</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{result.correct}/{result.total}</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">BEST</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>{bestScore}%</div>
            </div>
            <div className="border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-3 md:p-4">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">ATTEMPTS</div>
              <div className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-[var(--m-text)]">{attempts}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {passed && (
            <div className="max-w-md mx-auto mb-8 md:mb-10 border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg p-4 text-left">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-3">XP BREAKDOWN</div>
              {xpBase > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">First clear</span>
                  <span className="text-green-400 font-mono">+{xpBase} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpBonus > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mb-1">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)]">New highscore bonus</span>
                  <span className="font-mono" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>+{xpBonus} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {xpTotal === 0 && <div className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)]">No new XP this attempt â€” already cleared.</div>}
              {xpTotal > 0 && (
                <div className="flex justify-between text-sm mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-[var(--m-border)] font-bold">
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-text)]">Total</span>
                  <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-mono">+{xpTotal} XP</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {previousBest > 0 && isNewBest && (
                <div className="text-xs mt-3" style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}>Beat your previous best of {previousBest}%</div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {passed ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
              <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REVIEW QUESTIONS
              </button>
              <button onClick={retry}
                className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                REPLAY FOR HIGHSCORE
              </button>
              {nextHref ? (
                <button onClick={() => goNext(nextHref)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  NEXT: {(nextTitle?.toUpperCase() || 'CONTINUE')} â†’
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button onClick={() => goNext('/courses/' + slug)}
                  className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition text-center">
                  RETURN TO COURSE â†’
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-8 md:mb-10 max-w-md mx-auto">
                You need {passThreshold}% to clear this mission. Review your answers and try again.
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 justify-center">
                <button onClick={backToCodexFromResult}
                  className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-6 py-3 transition">
                  REVIEW QUESTIONS
                </button>
                <button onClick={retry}
                  className="bg-red-500 text-white font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-red-400 transition m-pulse">
                  RETRY MISSION
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </>
    )
  }

  return null
}

function extractYouTubeId(url: string): string | null {
  const match = url.match(
    /(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  )
  return match ? match[1] : null
}

FILE: app\courses\[slug]\lessons\[lessonId]\QuizSection.tsx

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/QuizSection.tsx  (exam + progress gate)

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Question = {
  id: string
  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
}

export default function QuizSection({
  lessonId,
  initialCompleted,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  initialCompleted: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) {
        setError(error.message)
        setQuestions([])
        return
      }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId])

  async function submit(finalAnswers: Record<string, number>) {
    setSubmitting(true)
    setError(null)

    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      p_answers: finalAnswers,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setSubmitting(false)
      return
    }

    const r = (data as QuizResult[])[0]
    setResult(r)
    if (r.passed) {
      setCompleted(true)
      router.refresh()
    }
    setSubmitting(false)
  }

  // Completed
  if (completed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
          <span className="text-xl">âœ“</span>
          <span>Quest Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm text-green-400 font-mono">
          {result ? `${result.score}% Â· ` : ''}+50 XP
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Loading
  if (questions === null) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6 text-center text-[var(--m-text-dim)] text-sm">
        Loading practice exam...
      </div>
    )
  }

  // No quiz â€” one-click complete
  if (questions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-3 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => submit({})}
          disabled={submitting}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
        >
          {submitting ? 'Completing...' : 'âœ“ Complete Side Quest'}
        </button>
      </>
    )
  }

  // Failed state
  if (result && !result.passed) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-red-400 font-semibold mb-1">
          âœ— Not passed â€” {result.correct} / {result.total} ({result.score}%)
        </div>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5">
          You need 80% to unlock the next quest. Review the Codex and try again.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
            setStarted(true)
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Retake Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Intro state
  if (!started) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">
          {questions.length} question{questions.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
        </h3>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5 leading-relaxed">
          You need <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-semibold">80%</span>{' '}
          or higher to pass and unlock the next quest.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setStarted(true)
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Start Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Taking exam
  const allAnswered = questions.every((q) => answers[q.id] !== undefined)

  return (
    <div className="m-panel p-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] font-mono">
          {Object.keys(answers).length} / {questions.length} answered
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-6 mb-6">
        {questions.map((q, i) => (
          <div key={q.id}>
            <div className="text-sm font-medium mb-3 leading-relaxed">
              <span className="text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2 font-mono">
                Q{i + 1}.
              </span>
              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = answers[q.id] === idx
                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setAnswers((a) => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))
                    }
                    className={`w-full text-left text-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 border transition ${
                      selected
                        ? 'border-cyan-500/60 bg-cyan-500/[0.08] text-[var(--m-text)]'
                        : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2">
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    {opt}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && <div className="mb-4 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>}

      <button
        onClick={() => submit(answers)}
        disabled={!allAnswered || submitting}
        className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-40 transition"
      >
        {submitting
          ? 'Checking...'
          : allAnswered
          ? 'Submit Exam'
          : `Answer all ${questions.length} questions`}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}
