// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/page.tsx
import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import EnrollButton from '@/app/dashboard/EnrollButton'
import CourseView, { type Saga } from './CourseView'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function CourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title, description, track, level')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  // Read is_admin directly off the profile row
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('is_admin')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const isAdmin = profile?.is_admin === true

  const { data: enrollment } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments')
    .select('id, progress')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const { data: sagasData } = await supabase
    .from('modules')
    .select(`
      id, title, description, order_index,
      missions(
        id, title, description, order_index,
        lessons(id, title, order_index, is_final_exam, pass_threshold)
      )
    `)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  const sagas = (sagasData ?? []) as unknown as Saga[]

  const { data: progressData } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('lesson_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('completed', true)

  const completedIds = (progressData ?? []).map((p: { lesson_id: string }) => p.lesson_id)
  const completedSet = new Set<string>(completedIds)

  sagas.forEach(s => {
    s.missions = (s.missions ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    s.missions.forEach(m => {
      m.lessons = (m.lessons ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    })
  })

  const totalLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.missions.reduce((a, m) => a + (m.lessons?.length ?? 0), 0),
    0
  )
  const doneLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) =>
      sum +
      s.missions.reduce(
        (a, m) => a + (m.lessons ?? []).filter(l => completedSet.has(l.id)).length,
        0
      ),
    0
  )
  const overallPct = totalLessons > 0 ? Math.round((doneLessons / totalLessons) * 100) : 0

  let defaultOpenIndex = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < sagas.length; i++) {
    const hasIncomplete = sagas[i].missions.some(m =>
      (m.lessons ?? []).some(l => !completedSet.has(l.id))
    )
    if (hasIncomplete) {
      defaultOpenIndex = i
      break
    }
    if (i === sagas.length - 1) defaultOpenIndex = i
  }

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <Link
          href="/courses"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition mb-8"
        >
          â† BACK TO COURSES
        </Link>

        <div className="mb-10 md:mb-14">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <span
              className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-2 py-1 rounded"
              style={{
                color: '#22d3ee',
                background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)',
                border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
              }}
            >
              {course.track === 'en_to_nl' ? 'EN â†’ NL' : course.track === 'nl_to_en' ? 'NL â†’ EN' : course.track?.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
              {course.level}
            </span>
            {enrollment && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#10b981] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#10b981]" />
                ENROLLED
              </span>
            )}
            {isAdmin && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#f59e0b] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#f59e0b]" />
                ADMIN Â· ALL UNLOCKED
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e5e9f0] mb-4 leading-tight">
            {course.title}
          </h1>

          {course.description && (
            <p className="text-sm md:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#8892a6] max-w-2xl mb-8">
              {course.description}
            </p>
          )}

          {!enrollment ? (
            <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} enrolled={false} />
          ) : (
            <div className="max-w-lg">
              <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
                  COURSE PROGRESS
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#22d3ee] tabular-nums">
                  {doneLessons} / {totalLessons} Â· {overallPct}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <div
                className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden"
                style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.9)' }}
              >
                <div
                  className="h-full"
                  style={{
                    width: `${overallPct}%`,
                    background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',

              This course is being prepared.

          </div>
        ) : (
          <CourseView
            sagas={sagas}
            slug={slug}

            isAdmin={isAdmin}

        )}

        <div className="mt-14 md:mt-20 flex items-center justify-center gap-6 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] flex-wrap">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.6)' }} />

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { enrollInCourse } from '@/app/actions/enroll'

export default function EnrollButton({
  courseId,
  enrolled,
}: {
  courseId: string
  enrolled: boolean
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  if (enrolled) {
    return (
      <span className="text-green-400 text-sm font-semibold">âœ“ Enrolled</span>
    )
  }

  async function handleClick() {
    setLoading(true)
    await enrollInCourse(courseId)
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleClick}
      disabled={loading}
      className="bg-white text-black text-sm font-semibold rounded-full px-5 py-1.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      {loading ? 'Enrolling...' : 'Enroll'}
    </button>
  )
}

            <span className="flex-1 h-px max-w-md" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.35) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">AVAILABLE COURSES</span>
          <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.2)' }} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#3a4250]">
            {String(visibleCourses.length).padStart(2, '0')} LOADED
          </span>
        </div>

        {visibleCourses.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="m-hud-panel p-12 text-center">
            <span className="m-hud-scan" />

            <div className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">New curriculum arrives soon.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
            {visibleCourses.map((course) => {
              const enrolled = enrolledIds.has(course.id)
              const trackLabel =
                course.track === 'en_to_nl' ? 'EN â†’ NL'
                : course.track === 'nl_to_en' ? 'NL â†’ EN'
                : course.track?.toUpperCase()
              return (
                <div key={course.id} className="m-hud-panel flex flex-col relative transition-all duration-300 hover:translate-x-1 group">
                  <span className="m-hud-scan" />
                  <div className="m-hud-header">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                      <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ COURSE</span>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ color: '#566074' }}>{course.level}</span>
                  </div>

                  <Link href={'/courses/' + course.slug} className="flex-1 block p-6 md:p-7">
                    <h3 className="text-lg md:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e5e9f0] group-hover:text-white transition-colors mb-3 leading-snug">
                      {course.title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[#8892a6] text-sm leading-relaxed">{course.description}</p>
                  </Link>

                  <div className="px-6 md:px-7 pb-6 md:pb-7">
                    {enrolled ? (
                      <Link href={'/courses/' + course.slug}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#22d3ee] text-black text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-md px-5 py-2.5 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
                        Continue Course
                        <span className="text-base leading-none">â†’</span>
                      </Link>
                    ) : (
                      <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} enrolled={false} />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function SignOutButton() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  async function handleSignOut() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    router.push('/')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleSignOut}
      className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition"
    >
      Sign out
    </button>
  )
}

// FILE: app/forgot-password/page.tsx  (URL: /forgot-password)

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
      redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/reset-password`,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-2">Reset your password</h1>

        {sent ? (
          <div className="mt-6">
            <div className="border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm text-green-400 mb-4">
              âœ“ Reset link sent to <strong>{email}</strong>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
              Check your inbox. The link will take you to a page where you can
              choose a new password.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-6">
              Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
            </p>

            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Email
            </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send reset link'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

// FILE: app/library/ebooks/[slug]/page.tsx
import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'

export default async function BookDetailPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: book } = await supabase
    .from('library_books')
    .select('*')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .eq('published', true)
    .maybeSingle()

  if (!book) notFound()

  const { data: chapters } = await supabase
    .from('library_chapters')
    .select('id, chapter_number, title, word_count')
    .eq('book_id', book.id)
    .order('chapter_number', { ascending: true })

  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('library_progress')
    .select('chapter_id, scroll_percentage')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('book_id', book.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const currentChapter = chapters?.find(c => c.id === progress?.chapter_id)
  const startChapterId = currentChapter ? currentChapter.id : chapters?.[0]?.id

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto pb-20">
        <Link href="/library/ebooks" className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition mb-8">
          â† BACK TO LIBRARY
        </Link>

        <div className="relative rounded-2xl p-8 md:p-12 overflow-hidden mb-10"
          style={{
            background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${book.accent_color}15 0%, rgba(6,10,16,0.8) 100%)`,
            border: `1px solid ${book.accent_color}40`
          }}
        >
          <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 bottom-0 w-3" style={{ background: book.accent_color }} />
          
          <div className="relative z-10">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] mb-3 block" style={{ color: book.accent_color }}>
              MERIDIAN MANUSCRIPT
            </span>
            <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white mb-3">
              {book.title}
            </h1>
            <h2 className="text-lg md:text-xl text-[#a5f3fc] mb-6 font-serif italic">
              {book.subtitle}
            </h2>

// FILE: app/library/ebooks/[slug]/read/page.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, use } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import LogoEmblem from '@/components/LogoEmblem'

// --- SYNTHESIZED PAGE FLIP SOUND ---
function playPageFlip() {
  try {
    const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext
    if (!AudioContext) return
    const ctx = new AudioContext()
    
    const bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * 0.4
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate)
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0)
    for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
      data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1
    }
    
    const noise = ctx.createBufferSource()
    noise.buffer = buffer
    
    const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
    filter.type = 'bandpass'
    filter.frequency.value = 1000
    filter.Q.value = 0.5
    
    const gain = ctx.createGain()
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime)
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.1, ctx.currentTime + 0.05)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.3)
    
    noise.connect(filter)
    filter.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(ctx.destination)
    
    noise.start()
  } catch (e) {
    // Ignore audio errors
  }
}

export default function ReaderPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = use(params)
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [book, setBook] = useState<any>(null)
  const [pages, setPages] = useState<string[][]>([])
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(0)
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
  const [fontSize, setFontSize] = useState(18)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data: b } = await supabase.from('library_books').select('*').eq('slug', slug).maybeSingle()
      if (!b) return
      setBook(b)

      const { data: chs } = await supabase
        .from('library_chapters')
        .select('title, content')
        .eq('book_id', b.id)
        .order('chapter_number', { ascending: true })
      
      if (chs) {
        let blocks: string[] = []
        chs.forEach((c: any) => {
          blocks.push(`# ${c.title}`)
          const cBlocks = (c.content || '').split(/\n\s*\n/).filter((block: string) => block.trim().length > 0)
          blocks.push(...cBlocks)
        })

        const chunkedPages: string[][] = []
        let currentPageBlocks: string[] = []
        let currentWordCount = 0

        blocks.forEach((block: string) => {
          const wordCount = block.split(/\s+/).length
          if (currentWordCount + wordCount > 180 && currentPageBlocks.length > 0) {
            chunkedPages.push(currentPageBlocks)
            currentPageBlocks = [block]
            currentWordCount = wordCount
          } else {
            currentPageBlocks.push(block)
            currentWordCount += wordCount
          }
        })
        if (currentPageBlocks.length > 0) chunkedPages.push(currentPageBlocks)
        
        setPages(chunkedPages)
      }
    }
    load()
  }, [slug, supabase])

  const turnPage = useCallback((direction: 'next' | 'prev') => {
    if (!isOpen) return
    
    if (direction === 'next' && currentPage + 2 < pages.length) {
      playPageFlip()
      setCurrentPage(p => p + 2)
    } else if (direction === 'prev' && currentPage > 0) {
      playPageFlip()
      setCurrentPage(p => p - 2)
    }
  }, [isOpen, currentPage, pages.length])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') turnPage('next')
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') turnPage('prev')
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
  }, [isOpen, turnPage])

  const renderBlock = (block: string, idx: number) => {
    const t = block.trim()
    if (!t) return null
    if (t.startsWith('# ')) return <h1 key={idx} className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold mt-4 mb-8 font-serif text-[#111] text-center">{t.slice(2)}</h1>
    if (t.startsWith('## ')) return <h2 key={idx} className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold mt-6 mb-4 font-serif text-[#222]">{t.slice(3)}</h2>
    if (t.startsWith('### ')) return <h3 key={idx} className="text-lg font-bold mt-4 mb-2 font-mono tracking-wide text-[#0891b2]">{t.slice(4)}</h3>
    if (t === '---') return <hr key={idx} className="my-8 border-[#e5e0d0]" />
    if (t.startsWith('> ')) return (
      <blockquote key={idx} className="border-l-4 border-[#22d3ee] pl-4 py-2 my-6 italic text-[#555] bg-[#f0ebd8] rounded-r-lg">
        {t.slice(2)}
      </blockquote>
    )
    let parsed = t.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong style="color: #000; font-weight: 700;">$1</strong>').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em style="color: #444;">$1</em>')
    return <p key={idx} className="mb-6 leading-[1.9] text-[#333] font-serif text-[1.05em] text-justify" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: parsed }} />
  }

  if (!book) return <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050810] flex items-center justify-center text-[#22d3ee] font-mono tracking-widest animate-pulse">ESTABLISHING CONNECTION...</div>

  // ðŸŽ¯ THE 3D CINEMATIC COVER (Reader View)
  if (!isOpen) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050810] flex items-center justify-center p-6" style={{ perspective: '2000px' }}>
        <div 
          className="relative w-full max-w-sm aspect-[2/3] rounded-r-lg rounded-l-md cursor-pointer group transition-all duration-700 hover:rotate-y-[-15deg] hover:scale-105"
          onClick={() => { setIsOpen(true); playPageFlip(); }}
          style={{ transformStyle: 'preserve-3d', transform: 'rotateY(0deg)' }}
        >
          {/* Deep Shadow */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 translate-x-2 translate-y-2 rounded-r-lg rounded-l-md bg-black/70 blur-2xl transition-all duration-700 group-hover:translate-x-8 group-hover:translate-y-4 group-hover:blur-3xl" />
          
          {/* Back Cover / Pages */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-r-lg rounded-l-md bg-[#e5e0d0] translate-x-1.5 translate-y-1.5" />

          {/* Front Cover */}
          <div 
            className="absolute inset-0 rounded-r-lg rounded-l-md overflow-hidden flex flex-col border border-white/10"
            style={{
              background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #0a121e 0%, #050810 100%)',
              boxShadow: `inset 6px 0 15px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9), 0 0 60px ${book.accent_color}30`
            }}
          >
            {/* Nebula Glow */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-70" style={{
              background: `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, ${book.accent_color}40 0%, transparent 70%)`
            }} />

            {/* Spine */}
            <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-0 w-6 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/90 to-transparent z-20 mix-blend-multiply" />
            <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-6 w-px bg-white/10 z-20" />

            {/* Foil Details */}
            <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 w-8 h-8 border-t border-r" style={{ borderColor: `${book.accent_color}60` }} />
            <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-6 w-8 h-8 border-b border-l" style={{ borderColor: `${book.accent_color}60` }} />

            <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col h-full p-10 pl-12 justify-between items-center text-center">
              <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.4em] text-white/60">MERIDIAN ACADEMY</div>

              <div>
                <div className="transform group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500">
                  <LogoEmblem size={100} className="drop-shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(34,211,238,0.6)]" />
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-serif font-bold text-white leading-tight mt-6 mb-4" style={{ textShadow: '0 2px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)' }}>
                  {book.title}
                </h2>
                <div className="h-px w-16 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#22d3ee] to-transparent mx-auto my-4" />
                <div className="text-xs font-serif italic text-white/60 max-w-[80%] mx-auto">{book.subtitle}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse">CLICK TO OPEN</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // ðŸŽ¯ THE OPEN BOOK (DOUBLE PAGE SPREAD)
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050810] flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden font-sans selection:bg-[#22d3ee] selection:text-black">
      
      <header className="h-16 bg-[#0a0e14]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#1e2633] z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-6 shrink-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition">â† CLOSE BOOK</button>
          <span className="text-[#1e2633]">|</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#e5e9f0] font-bold hidden sm:block">{book.title}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border border-[#1e2633] rounded bg-[#141b26] p-1">
            <button onClick={() => setFontSize(f => Math.max(14, f - 2))} className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#1e2633] rounded text-[#8892a6] text-xs font-mono">A-</button>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono w-6 text-center text-[#a5f3fc]">{fontSize}</span>

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl p-8"
      >
        <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300">
          â† Back
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-6">Log in</h1>

        {error && (
          <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Email</label>
        <input
          type="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-4 focus:border-neutral-600 outline-none"
        />

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Password</label>
        <input
          type="password"
          required
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-neutral-600 outline-none"
        />

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {loading ? 'Logging in...' : 'Log in'}
        </button>
<p className="text-sm text-center mt-4">
  <Link href="/forgot-password" className="text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)] text-xs">
    Forgot your password?
  </Link>
</p>
        <p className="text-sm text-neutral-500 mt-4 text-center">
          No account?{' '}
          <Link href="/signup" className="text-white hover:underline">Sign up</Link>
        </p>
      </form>
    </main>
  )
}

// FILE: app/page.tsx
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import HomeScreen from '@/components/HomeScreen'

export default async function Home() {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  let continueHref = '/dashboard'
  let continueLabel = 'CONTINUE'
  let continueSub = 'Resume your journey'

  if (user) {
    // 1. Prefer the course with the most recent lesson activity
    const { data: recent } = await supabase
      .from('lesson_progress')
      .select('lesson:lessons(course:courses(slug, title))')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .order('completed_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle()

    const recentCourse = (
      recent as unknown as {
        lesson: { course: { slug: string; title: string } | null } | null
      } | null
    )?.lesson?.course

    if (recentCourse?.slug) {
      continueHref = `/courses/${recentCourse.slug}`
      continueSub =
        recentCourse.title.length > 38
          ? recentCourse.title.slice(0, 36) + 'â€¦'
          : recentCourse.title
    } else {
      // 2. Fallback: most recent enrollment
      const { data: enrollment } = await supabase
        .from('enrollments')
        .select('course:courses(slug, title)')
        .eq('user_id', user.id)
        .order('enrolled_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle()

      const course = (
        enrollment as unknown as {
          course: { slug: string; title: string } | null
        } | null
      )?.course

      if (course?.slug) {
        continueHref = `/courses/${course.slug}`
        continueSub =
          course.title.length > 38
            ? course.title.slice(0, 36) + 'â€¦'
            : course.title
      }
    }
  }

  return (
    <HomeScreen
      loggedIn={!!user}
      continueHref={continueHref}
      continueLabel={continueLabel}
      continueSub={continueSub}
    />
  )
}

  return (

          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2 text-[#8892a6]">

        <ProfileClient

          fullName={profile?.full_name ?? ''}
          role={profile?.role ?? 'member'}
          joinedAt={profile?.created_at ?? ''}

      </div>

}

// FILE: app/profile/ProfileClient.tsx
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Props = {
  email: string
  username: string
  fullName: string
  role: string
  joinedAt: string
}

export default function ProfileClient({
  email,
  username,
  fullName,
  role,
  joinedAt,
}: Props) {
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [name, setName] = useState(fullName)
  const [savingName, setSavingName] = useState(false)
  const [nameMsg, setNameMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [savingPw, setSavingPw] = useState(false)
  const [pwMsg, setPwMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  async function saveName() {
    setSavingName(true)
    setNameMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ full_name: name })
      .eq('email', email)

    if (error) {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Name updated.' })
    }
    setSavingName(false)
  }

  async function updatePassword() {
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: 'Password must be at least 6 characters.' })
      return
    }
    setSavingPw(true)
    setPwMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Password updated.' })
      setPassword('')
    }
    setSavingPw(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* IDENTITY */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.72)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          boxShadow: '0 0 60px rgba(34,211,238,0.10)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          IDENTITY
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <InfoRow label="EMAIL" value={email} mono />
          <InfoRow label="USERNAME" value={username || 'â€”'} mono />
          <InfoRow label="ROLE" value={role.toUpperCase()} />

// FILE: app/reset-password/page.tsx  (URL: /reset-password)

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
      if (data.user) setReady(true)
    })
  }, [supabase])

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Passwords do not match')
      return
    }
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setError('Password must be at least 6 characters')
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }
    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-6">Choose a new password</h1>

        {!ready ? (
          <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
            Verifying reset link...
          </p>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              New password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-4 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Confirm password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Updating...' : 'Update password'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function SignupPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()

    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
      email,
      password,
      options: {
        data: { full_name: fullName, username: email.split('@')[0] },
      },
    })

      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return

    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (

        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl p-8"

        <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300">
          â† Back

        {error && (
          <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Full name</label>

        />

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Email</label>

          className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-4 focus:border-neutral-600 outline-none"
        />

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Password</label>
        <input
          type="password"
          required
          minLength={6}
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-neutral-600 outline-none"

          Already have one?{' '}
          <Link href="/login" className="text-white hover:underline">Log in</Link>
        </p>
      </form>
    </main>
  )
}

'use client'

type Variant = 'landing' | 'dashboard' | 'learning'

export default function AcademyBackground({
  variant = 'dashboard',
}: {
  variant?: Variant | string
}) {
  const v = (variant as Variant) || 'dashboard'
  const richer = v === 'landing'
  const quieter = v === 'learning'

  return (
    <div className="m-bg-root" aria-hidden>
      <div className="m-bg-base" />

      <div
        className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-a"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 0.75 : quieter ? 0.28 : 0.5,
        }}
      />
      <div
        className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-b"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 0.65 : quieter ? 0.22 : 0.42,
        }}
      />
      {!quieter && (
        <div
          className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-c"
          style={{ opacity: richer ? 0.5 : 0.28 }}
        />
      )}

      <div
        className="m-bg-grid"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 1 : quieter ? 0.35 : 0.7,
        }}
      />

      {!quieter && <div className="m-bg-horizon" />}

      <div className="m-bg-vignette" />
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: components\ContentArrowNav.tsx

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { getActiveZone, setActiveZone, onZoneChange } from '@/lib/navZone'
import { unlockAudio, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

export default function ContentArrowNav({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0)
  const [zoneActive, setZoneActive] = useState(getActiveZone() === 'content')

  useEffect(() => {
    return onZoneChange(z => {
      setZoneActive(z === 'content')
      if (z !== 'content') setActiveIndex(-1)
    })
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!getActiveZone()) setActiveZone('content')
    setZoneActive(getActiveZone() === 'content')
    setActiveIndex(0)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!zoneActive) return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const el = ref.current
      if (!el) return
      const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
      if (items.length === 0) return

      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (active) {
        const tag = active.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || active.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i + 1 >= items.length ? 0 : i + 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i - 1 < 0 ? items.length - 1 : i - 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const idx = activeIndex < 0 ? 0 : activeIndex
        const target = items[idx]
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault()
          unlockAudio()
          playConfirmSound()
          target.click()
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  }, [zoneActive, activeIndex])

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
    items.forEach((it, i) => {
      if (zoneActive && i === activeIndex) {
        it.setAttribute('data-nav-active', 'true')
      } else {
        it.removeAttribute('data-nav-active')
      }
    })
  }, [activeIndex, zoneActive])

  return (
    <div ref={ref} data-nav-zone="content">
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: components\DailyGoal.tsx

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const GOALS = [
  { label: 'Complete 1 Side Quest', xp: 20 },
  { label: 'Review Quest Codex',    xp: 10 },
  { label: 'Practice 15 minutes',   xp: 15 },
  { label: 'Post in Community',     xp: 10 },
  { label: 'Read 1 Library entry',  xp: 15 },
  { label: 'Flashcard session',     xp: 10 },
]

export default function DailyGoal() {
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState<boolean[]>([])
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('m-daily-goal')
    const storedDate = localStorage.getItem('m-daily-goal-date')
    if (storedDate === today && stored) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored) as boolean[]
        // pad if length mismatch (added goals over time)
        const normalised = GOALS.map((_, i) => !!parsed[i])
        setChecked(normalised)
      } catch {
        setChecked(GOALS.map(() => false))
      }
    } else {
      const fresh = GOALS.map(() => false)
      setChecked(fresh)
      localStorage.setItem('m-daily-goal', JSON.stringify(fresh))
      localStorage.setItem('m-daily-goal-date', today)
    }
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  function toggle(i: number) {
    const next = [...checked]
    next[i] = !next[i]
    setChecked(next)
    localStorage.setItem('m-daily-goal', JSON.stringify(next))
  }

  if (!mounted) return null

  const done = checked.filter(Boolean).length
  const earnedXp = GOALS.reduce((sum, g, i) => sum + (checked[i] ? g.xp : 0), 0)
  const totalXp = GOALS.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.xp, 0)
  const pct = (done / GOALS.length) * 100
  const allDone = done === GOALS.length

  return (
    <div className="m-hud-panel">
      <span className="m-hud-scan" />
      <div className="m-hud-header">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" />
          DAILY GOAL
        </div>
        <span style={{ color: allDone ? '#10b981' : '#566074' }}>
          {done}/{GOALS.length}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        {/* XP + progress */}
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074]">
            DAILY XP
          </span>
          <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: '#a5f3fc' }}>
            {earnedXp}
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#3a4250] font-normal"> / {totalXp}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-4"
          style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.9)' }}>
          <div
            className="h-full transition-all duration-500"
            style={{
              width: pct + '%',
              background: allDone
                ? '#10b981'
                : 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
              boxShadow: allDone
                ? '0 0 10px rgba(16,185,129,0.6)'
                : '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)',
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Goals */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {GOALS.map((goal, i) => (
            <button
              key={i}
              onClick={() => toggle(i)}
              className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 text-left text-xs group transition-colors rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 -mx-2 hover:bg-white/[0.02]"
            >
              <span
                className={
                  'shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] transition ' +
                  (checked[i]

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { pickQuote, type DisciplineQuote } from '@/lib/discipline'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'

export default function DisciplineScreen({
  onDone,
  duration = 6000,
}: {
  onDone: () => void
  duration?: number
}) {
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<DisciplineQuote | null>(null)
  const [fading, setFading] = useState(false)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')

  useEffect(() => {
    setQuote(pickQuote())
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setDots((d) => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.'))
    }, 400)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!quote) return
    const fadeTimer = setTimeout(() => setFading(true), duration - 900)
    const doneTimer = setTimeout(onDone, duration)
    return () => { clearTimeout(fadeTimer); clearTimeout(doneTimer) }
  }, [quote, duration, onDone])

  if (!quote) return null

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-8 pointer-events-none">
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0"
        style={{
          background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)',
          opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,
          transition: 'opacity 0.9s ease-out',
        }}
      />
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none"
        style={{
          background: 'radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(34,211,238,0.06) 0%, transparent 55%)',
          opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,
          transition: 'opacity 0.9s ease-out',
        }}
      />

        className="relative flex flex-col items-center max-w-3xl text-center"

type PanelMode = 'full' | 'focus' | 'progress' | 'quiet'

function getPanelMode(path: string | null): PanelMode {
  if (!path) return 'full'
  if (path.startsWith('/dashboard')) return 'full'
  if (/^\/courses\/[^/]+\/lessons\//.test(path)) return 'focus'
  if (path === '/courses' || /^\/courses\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return 'progress'
  return 'quiet'
}

export default function ExtensionsPanel() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const mode = getPanelMode(pathname)
  const [collapsed, setCollapsed] = useState(false)

  if (collapsed) {
    return (

  }

  return (
    <aside
      className="hidden xl:flex flex-col w-72 h-full overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar shrink-0"
      style={{
        background: 'rgba(10,14,20,0.55)',

          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse shrink-0" />
          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee]">
            EXTENSIONS

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import AcademyBackground from './AcademyBackground'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { triggerNav } from './NavLoader'
import {
  unlockAudio,
  isAudioUnlocked,
  playSelectSound,
  playConfirmSound,
  playInitializingSound,
  playTickSound,
  startAmbientHum,
} from '@/lib/sounds'

type MenuItem = {
  href: string
  label: string
  sub: string
  primary?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
}

const LOADER_MS = 2500

export default function HomeScreen({
  loggedIn,
  continueHref = '/dashboard',
  continueLabel = 'CONTINUE',
  continueSub = 'Resume your journey',
}: {
  loggedIn: boolean
  continueHref?: string
  continueLabel?: string
  continueSub?: string
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'loading' | 'menu'>('loading')
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(0)
  const [pulse, setPulse] = useState(0)

  const lastTickRef = useRef(0)
  const soundPlayedRef = useRef(false)
  const stopAmbientRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null)

  // Loading phase
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'loading') return

    // Play init sound if audio is already unlocked (returning visit).
    // If not, do NOT set the flag â€” wait for first gesture below.
    if (!soundPlayedRef.current && isAudioUnlocked()) {
      soundPlayedRef.current = true
      playInitializingSound(2200)
    }

    // Retry on first user gesture anywhere on the loading screen
    function retryOnGesture() {
      unlockAudio()
      if (!soundPlayedRef.current) {
        soundPlayedRef.current = true
        playInitializingSound(2200)
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', retryOnGesture, { once: true })
    window.addEventListener('keydown', retryOnGesture, { once: true })

    const start = Date.now()
    const DURATION = 2000
    const tick = setInterval(() => {
      const p = Math.min(100, Math.round(((Date.now() - start) / DURATION) * 100))
      setProgress(p)

      const step = Math.floor(p / 12.5)
      if (step > lastTickRef.current && p < 100) {
        lastTickRef.current = step
        playTickSound(p)
      }

      if (p >= 100) {
        clearInterval(tick)
        setTimeout(() => setPhase('menu'), 320)
      }
    }, 40)

    const dt = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.')), 300)
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', retryOnGesture)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', retryOnGesture)
      clearInterval(tick)
      clearInterval(dt)
    }
  }, [phase])

  // Ambient hum while on the menu
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'menu') return

    stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()

    function onGesture() {
      unlockAudio()
      if (!stopAmbientRef.current) {
        stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()
      } else {
        stopAmbientRef.current()
        stopAmbientRef.current = startAmbientHum()
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('pointerdown', onGesture, { once: true })
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onGesture, { once: true })

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onGesture)
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', onGesture)
      if (stopAmbientRef.current) {
        stopAmbientRef.current()
        stopAmbientRef.current = null
      }
    }
  }, [phase])

  const items: MenuItem[] = loggedIn
    ? [
        { href: continueHref, label: continueLabel, sub: continueSub, primary: true },
        { href: '/courses', label: 'COURSES', sub: 'Browse the curriculum' },
        { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY', sub: 'E-books Â· Specs Â· Vault' },
        { href: '/community', label: 'COMMUNITY', sub: 'Discussion channels' },
        { href: '/profile', label: 'PROFILE', sub: 'Account settings' },
      ]
    : [
        { href: '/signup', label: 'NEW GAME', sub: 'Create a free account', primary: true },
        { href: '/login', label: 'CONTINUE', sub: 'Log into an existing account' },
        { href: '/courses', label: 'COURSES', sub: 'Browse the curriculum' },
        { href: '/library', label: 'LIBRARY', sub: 'E-books Â· Specs Â· Vault' },
      ]

  function navigateWithLoader(href: string) {
    unlockAudio()
    playConfirmSound()
    triggerNav()
    setTimeout(() => router.push(href), LOADER_MS)
  }

  function moveSelection(delta: number) {
    unlockAudio()
    setSelected(s => (s + delta + items.length) % items.length)
    setPulse(p => p + 1)
    playSelectSound()
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'menu') return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const target = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (target) {
        const tag = target.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || target.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }
      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        moveSelection(1)
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        moveSelection(-1)
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault()
        const it = items[selected]
        if (!it.disabled) navigateWithLoader(it.href)
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [phase, selected, items.length])

  if (phase === 'loading') {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0"
          style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)' }}
        />
        <div
          className="absolute pointer-events-none"
          style={{
            top: '15%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
            width: '70vw', height: '70vw', maxWidth: 800, maxHeight: 800,
            background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0%, transparent 60%)',
          }}
        />
        <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center">
          <LogoEmblem size={280} className="mb-4" />
          <div className="w-72 md:w-96 mt-8">
            <div className="h-[2px] bg-[#1e2633] rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full transition-all duration-75"
                style={{
                  width: `${progress}%`,
                  background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
                  boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(34,211,238,0.9)',
                }}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-between mt-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
              <span>INITIALIZING{dots}</span>
              <span>{progress}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-screen flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden">
      <AcademyBackground variant="landing" />

      <header
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 border-b backdrop-blur-md shrink-0"
        style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.10)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
          <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#10b981] animate-pulse" />
          ONLINE
        </div>
        <div className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-8 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
          <span>BUILD v1.0</span>
          <span>EU-WEST</span>
          <span>{new Date().getFullYear()}</span>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main className="flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col items-center px-5 sm:px-6 py-4 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
        <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center my-auto">
          <LogoEmblem size={200} className="mb-4 sm:mb-6 shrink-0" />

          <div
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative shrink-0"
            style={{
              border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
              background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.78)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(24px)',
              boxShadow: '0 0 80px rgba(34,211,238,0.14), inset 0 0 80px rgba(34,211,238,0.04)',
            }}
          >
            <div
              className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-2.5 border-b"
              style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.15)' }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee]">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
                MAIN MENU
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#3a4250]">
                {items.length} OPTIONS
              </div>
            </div>

            <ul className="p-1.5">
              {items.map((item, i) => (
                <MenuRow
                  key={item.label}
                  item={item}
                  index={i + 1}
                  selected={selected === i}
                  pulseKey={pulse}
                  onHover={() => {
                    if (!item.disabled && selected !== i) {
                      unlockAudio()
                      setSelected(i)
                      setPulse(p => p + 1)
                      playSelectSound()
                    }
                  }}
                  onActivate={() => navigateWithLoader(item.href)}
                />
              ))}
            </ul>

            <div
              className="h-[1px]"
              style={{
                background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(34,211,238,0.5) 50%, transparent 100%)',
              }}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 mb-2 flex items-center gap-5 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] shrink-0">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-[#22d3ee]">â†â†‘â†“â†’</span>
              <span>NAVIGATE</span>
            </span>
            <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="text-[#22d3ee]">ENTER</span>
              <span>CONFIRM</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>

      <footer
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-2.5 border-t backdrop-blur-md shrink-0"
        style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.10)' }}
      >
        <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#566074]">
          Â© {new Date().getFullYear()} MERIDIAN
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-6 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest">
          <Link href="/about" className="text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition">
            ABOUT
          </Link>
          <Link href="/faq" className="text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition">
            FAQ
          </Link>
        </div>
      </footer>
    </div>

}

function MenuRow({
  item, index, selected, pulseKey, onHover, onActivate,
}: {
  item: MenuItem
  index: number
  selected: boolean
  pulseKey: number
  onHover: () => void
  onActivate: () => void
}) {
  const isPrimary = item.primary

  if (item.disabled) {
    return (
      <li>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed"
          style={{ border: '1px solid transparent' }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono w-5 text-center text-[#3a4250]">
              {String(index).padStart(2, '0')}
            </span>
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-[#566074]">{item.label}</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#3a4250]">{item.sub}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[#3a4250]">LOCKED</span>
        </div>
      </li>
    )
  }

  return (
    <li className="relative">
      {selected && (
        <>
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 z-10"
            style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 z-10"
            style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 z-10"
            style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
          <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 z-10"
            style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        </>
      )}

      <button
        type="button"
        onMouseEnter={onHover}
        onClick={onActivate}
        key={pulseKey}
        className={`group w-full text-left flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 transition-all duration-150 active:scale-[0.985] ${
          selected ? 'meridian-menu-flash' : ''
        }`}
        style={{
          border: selected ? '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' : '1px solid transparent',
          background: selected
            ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.22) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.08) 100%)'
            : 'transparent',
          boxShadow: selected
            ? '0 0 30px rgba(34,211,238,0.28), inset 0 0 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.06)'
            : 'none',
        }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 min-w-0">
          <span
            className="text-[11px] font-mono transition-all duration-150 shrink-0"
            style={{
              color: selected ? '#22d3ee' : '#3a4250',

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation'
import { pickQuote, type DisciplineQuote } from '@/lib/discipline'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'
import { unlockAudio, playTransitionSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

const EVENT_NAME = 'meridian:nav-start'

export function triggerNav() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
  const fn = (window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav
  if (typeof fn === 'function') {
    fn()
  } else {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event(EVENT_NAME))
  }
}

export default function NavLoader() {
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false)
  const [fading, setFading] = useState(false)
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0)
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<DisciplineQuote | null>(null)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')

  const prevPathRef = useRef(pathname)
  const startedAtRef = useRef(0)
  const progressRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)
  const fallbackRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    function clearProgress() {
      if (progressRef.current) {
        clearInterval(progressRef.current)
        progressRef.current = null
      }
    }
    function clearFallback() {
      if (fallbackRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fallbackRef.current)
        fallbackRef.current = null
      }
    }

    function start() {
      clearProgress()
      clearFallback()
      setQuote(pickQuote())
      setProgress(0)
      setFading(false)
      setVisible(true)
      startedAtRef.current = Date.now()

      unlockAudio()
      playTransitionSound(1400)

      progressRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        const elapsed = Date.now() - startedAtRef.current
        const p = Math.min(88, Math.round((elapsed / 2200) * 88))
        setProgress(p)
        if (p >= 88 && progressRef.current) {
          clearInterval(progressRef.current)
          progressRef.current = null
        }
      }, 30)

      fallbackRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setProgress(100)
        setFading(true)
        setTimeout(() => {
          setVisible(false)
          setFading(false)
        }, 320)
      }, 8000)
    }

    ;(window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav = start
    window.addEventListener(EVENT_NAME, start)

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener(EVENT_NAME, start)
      delete (window as unknown as { __meridianNav?: () => void }).__meridianNav
      clearProgress()
      clearFallback()
    }
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevPathRef.current === pathname) return
    prevPathRef.current = pathname
    if (!visible) return

    const paintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setProgress(100)
      setFading(true)
      setTimeout(() => {
        setVisible(false)
        setFading(false)
      }, 400)
    }, 250)

    return () => clearTimeout(paintTimer)
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [pathname])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return
    const id = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.')), 320)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [visible])

  if (!visible || !quote) return null

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-8 pointer-events-none"
      style={{
        zIndex: 9999,
        opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,
        transition: 'opacity 0.38s ease-out',
      }}
    >
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0"
        style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)' }}
      />
      <div
        className="absolute pointer-events-none"
        style={{
          top: '15%', left: '50%', transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          width: '70vw', height: '70vw', maxWidth: 800, maxHeight: 800,
          background: 'radial-gradient(circle, rgba(34,211,238,0.10) 0%, transparent 60%)',
        }}
      />

      <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center max-w-2xl text-center">
        <LogoEmblem size={180} className="mb-6" />

        <div
          className="text-xl md:text-2xl leading-relaxed italic mb-6"
          style={{
            fontFamily: 'Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif',
            color: '#e5e9f0',
            textShadow: '0 0 24px rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          }}
        >
          &ldquo;{quote.text}&rdquo;
        </div>

        <div
          className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.4em] uppercase"
          style={{ color: '#22d3ee' }}
        >
          â€” {quote.author}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute bottom-16 flex flex-col items-center gap-3">
        <div
          style={{
            fontSize: 10,
            letterSpacing: '0.4em',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
            color: '#566074',
            fontWeight: 500,
          }}
        >
          LOADING{dots}
        </div>
        <div className="h-[2px] w-56 overflow-hidden rounded-full" style={{ background: '#1e2633' }}>
          <div
            className="h-full transition-all duration-75"
            style={{
              width: `${progress}%`,
              background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
              boxShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.9)',
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: components\PomodoroTimer.tsx

'use client'

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'

type SessionType = 'quick' | 'focus' | 'deep'
const SESSIONS: Record<SessionType, { label: string; mins: number; accent: string }> = {
  quick: { label: '15', mins: 15, accent: '#10b981' },
  focus: { label: '25', mins: 25, accent: '#22d3ee' },
  deep:  { label: '50', mins: 50, accent: '#8b5cf6' },
}
const BREAK_MINS = 5

export default function PomodoroTimer() {
  const [type, setType] = useState<SessionType>('focus')
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'work' | 'break'>('work')
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(SESSIONS.focus.mins * 60)
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false)
  const [sessions, setSessions] = useState(0)
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const storedDate = localStorage.getItem('m-pomo-date')
    const storedCount = localStorage.getItem('m-pomo-count')
    if (storedDate === today && storedCount) {
      setSessions(parseInt(storedCount))
    } else {
      localStorage.setItem('m-pomo-date', today)
      localStorage.setItem('m-pomo-count', '0')
      setSessions(0)
    }
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      setSeconds((s) => {
        if (s <= 1) {
          if (mode === 'work') {
            // completed a work session
            const today = new Date().toDateString()
            const storedDate = localStorage.getItem('m-pomo-date')
            const storedCount = localStorage.getItem('m-pomo-count')
            const current = storedDate === today && storedCount ? parseInt(storedCount) : 0
            const next = current + 1
            localStorage.setItem('m-pomo-date', today)
            localStorage.setItem('m-pomo-count', String(next))
            setSessions(next)
            setMode('break')
            return BREAK_MINS * 60
          } else {
            setMode('work')
            return SESSIONS[type].mins * 60
          }
        }
        return s - 1
      })
    }, 1000)
    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current)
    }
  }, [running, mode, type])

  function selectType(t: SessionType) {
    setRunning(false)
    setType(t)
    setMode('work')
    setSeconds(SESSIONS[t].mins * 60)
  }

  function toggle() { setRunning((r) => !r) }

  function reset() {
    setRunning(false)
    setMode('work')
    setSeconds(SESSIONS[type].mins * 60)
  }

  if (!mounted) return null

  const total = mode === 'work' ? SESSIONS[type].mins * 60 : BREAK_MINS * 60
  const elapsed = total - seconds
  const pct = (elapsed / total) * 100
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60)
  const secs = seconds % 60
  const isWork = mode === 'work'
  const accent = isWork ? SESSIONS[type].accent : '#f59e0b'

  // ring
  const R = 40
  const C = 2 * Math.PI * R
  const dash = (pct / 100) * C

  return (
    <div className="m-hud-panel">
      <span className="m-hud-scan" />
      <div className="m-hud-header">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span
            className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full animate-pulse"
            style={{ background: accent }}
          />
          <span style={{ color: accent }}>{isWork ? 'FOCUS' : 'BREAK'}</span>
        </div>
        <span style={{ color: '#3a4250', opacity: 0.7 }}>{sessions} DONE</span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        {/* Session type tabs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 mb-4">
          {(Object.keys(SESSIONS) as SessionType[]).map((k) => {
            const s = SESSIONS[k]
            const active = k === type
            return (
              <button
                key={k}
                onClick={() => selectType(k)}
                className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] py-1.5 rounded transition-all"
                style={{
                  color: active ? s.accent : '#566074',
                  background: active ? 'rgba(34,211,238,0.06)' : 'transparent',
                  border: '1px solid ' + (active ? s.accent + '55' : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.12)'),
                }}
              >
                {s.label} MIN
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Ring + time */}
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center mb-4" style={{ height: 110 }}>
          <svg width="110" height="110" className="absolute -rotate-90">
            <circle cx="55" cy="55" r={R} fill="none" stroke="rgba(30,38,51,0.9)" strokeWidth="3" />
            <circle
              cx="55" cy="55" r={R}
              fill="none"
              stroke={accent}
              strokeWidth="3"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeDasharray={C}
              strokeDashoffset={C - dash}
              style={{
                transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 0.5s linear',
                filter: 'drop-shadow(0 0 6px ' + accent + 'aa)',
              }}
            />
          </svg>
          <div className="text-center relative">
            <div
              className="text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums leading-none"
              style={{ color: '#a5f3fc', textShadow: '0 0 20px ' + accent + '66' }}
            >
              {String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:{String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#3a4250] mt-1.5">
              {isWork ? 'WORK' : 'REST'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Controls */}
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={toggle}
            className="flex-1 text-black text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-md py-2.5 transition"
            style={{ background: accent }}
          >
            {running ? 'Pause' : 'Start'}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={reset}
            className="px-3 border border-[#2d3748] text-[#8892a6] hover:text-[#e5e9f0] hover:border-[#22d3ee]/40 text-xs rounded-md py-2 transition"
            aria-label="Reset"
          >
            â†º
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
