// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/CompleteButton.tsx  (quest completion)

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function CompleteButton({
  lessonId,
  completed: initial,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  completed: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initial)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleComplete() {
    if (completed || loading) return
    setLoading(true)

    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
    if (!user) {
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('lesson_progress')
      .upsert(
        {
          user_id: user.id,
          lesson_id: lessonId,
          completed: true,
          completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        },
        { onConflict: 'user_id,lesson_id' }
      )

    if (!error) {
      setCompleted(true)
      router.refresh()
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  if (completed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
          <span className="text-xl">âœ“</span>
          <span>Quest Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm text-green-400 font-mono">+50 XP</div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleComplete}
      disabled={loading}
      className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
    >
      {loading ? 'Completing...' : 'âœ“ Complete Side Quest'}
    </button>
  )
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/page.tsx
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import QuestPlayer from './QuestPlayer'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function LessonPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string; lessonId: string }>
}) {
  const { slug, lessonId } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  const { data: lesson } = await supabase
    .from('lessons')
    .select(
      'id, title, order_index, video_url, content, is_final_exam, pass_threshold, mission_id, mission:missions(id, order_index, module_id, module:modules(id, order_index))'
    )
    .eq('id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!lesson) notFound()

  const mission = (lesson as any).mission as
    | { id: string; order_index: number; module_id: string; module: { id: string; order_index: number } | null }
    | null

  let nextHref: string | null = null
  let nextTitle: string | null = null

  if (mission) {
    const { data: siblings } = await supabase
      .from('lessons')
      .select('id, title')
      .eq('mission_id', mission.id)
      .gt('order_index', lesson.order_index)
      .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)

    if (siblings && siblings.length > 0) {
      nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${siblings[0].id}`
      nextTitle = siblings[0].title
    } else {
      const { data: nextMissions } = await supabase
        .from('missions')
        .select('id')
        .eq('module_id', mission.module_id)
        .gt('order_index', mission.order_index)
        .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
        .limit(1)

      if (nextMissions && nextMissions.length > 0) {
        const { data: firstLesson } = await supabase
          .from('lessons')
          .select('id, title')
          .eq('mission_id', nextMissions[0].id)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (firstLesson && firstLesson.length > 0) {
          nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson[0].id}`
          nextTitle = firstLesson[0].title
        }
      } else {
        const currentSagaOrder = mission.module?.order_index ?? 0
        const { data: nextSagas } = await supabase
          .from('modules')
          .select('id')
          .eq('course_id', course.id)
          .gt('order_index', currentSagaOrder)
          .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
          .limit(1)

        if (nextSagas && nextSagas.length > 0) {
          const { data: nextMissions2 } = await supabase
            .from('missions')
            .select('id')
            .eq('module_id', nextSagas[0].id)
            .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
            .limit(1)

          if (nextMissions2 && nextMissions2.length > 0) {
            const { data: firstLesson2 } = await supabase
              .from('lessons')
              .select('id, title')
              .eq('mission_id', nextMissions2[0].id)
              .order('order_index', { ascending: true })
              .limit(1)

            if (firstLesson2 && firstLesson2.length > 0) {
              nextHref = `/courses/${slug}/lessons/${firstLesson2[0].id}`
              nextTitle = firstLesson2[0].title
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('completed')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('lesson_id', lessonId)
    .maybeSingle()

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto pb-12 md:pb-20">
        <QuestPlayer
          lessonId={lesson.id}
          lessonTitle={lesson.title}
          lessonIndex={lesson.order_index}
          videoUrl={lesson.video_url}
          content={lesson.content}
          isFinalExam={lesson.is_final_exam ?? false}
          passThreshold={lesson.pass_threshold ?? 80}
          initialCompleted={progress?.completed ?? false}
          slug={slug}
          nextHref={nextHref}
          nextTitle={nextTitle}
        />
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import CodexContent from './CodexContent'
import DisciplineScreen from '@/components/DisciplineScreen'
import { triggerNav } from '@/components/NavLoader'
import { playPassSound, playFailSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

type Question = {
  id: string
  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type ReviewItem = {
  id: string
  user_index: number | null
  correct_index: number
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
  best_score?: number
  previous_best?: number
  is_new_best?: boolean
  attempts?: number
  xp_base?: number
  xp_bonus?: number
  xp_total?: number
  review?: ReviewItem[]
}

type Phase = 'briefing' | 'mission' | 'exam' | 'result'

function scrollMainToTop(smooth = false) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return
  const main = document.querySelector('main')
  if (main) {
    main.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  } else {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto' })
  }
}

export default function QuestPlayer({
  lessonId,
  lessonTitle,
  lessonIndex,
  videoUrl,
  content,
  isFinalExam,
  passThreshold,
  initialCompleted,
  slug,
  nextHref,
  nextTitle,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  lessonTitle: string
  lessonIndex: number
  videoUrl: string | null
  content: string | null
  isFinalExam: boolean
  passThreshold: number
  initialCompleted: boolean
  slug: string
  nextHref: string | null
  nextTitle: string | null
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>(initialCompleted ? 'mission' : 'briefing')
  const [cameFromResult, setCameFromResult] = useState(false)
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [examIndex, setExamIndex] = useState(0)
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [showDiscipline, setShowDiscipline] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (questions !== null) return
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) { setError(error.message); setQuestions([]); return }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId, questions, supabase])

  useEffect(() => {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false))
    })
  }, [phase])

  function scrollTop() { scrollMainToTop(true) }
  function startMission() { setPhase('mission'); scrollTop() }
  function finishMission() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function retry() {
    setPhase('exam'); setAnswers({}); setResult(null); setError(null)
    setExamIndex(0); setCameFromResult(false); scrollTop()
  }
  function backToCodexFromResult() {
    setPhase('mission')
    setCameFromResult(true)
    setError(null)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }
  function backToResult() {
    setPhase('result')
    setCameFromResult(false)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }

  /** Hard navigate â€” bypasses router cache so the course page re-fetches fresh data */
  function goNext(href: string) {
    triggerNav()
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.location.href = href
    }, 300)
  }

  async function submit() {
    setSubmitting(true); setError(null)
    const payload = questions && questions.length > 0 ? answers : {}
    const { data, error: rpcError } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId, p_answers: payload,
    })
    if (rpcError) { setError(rpcError.message); setSubmitting(false); return }

    let parsed: unknown = data
    if (typeof parsed === 'string') { try { parsed = JSON.parse(parsed) } catch { parsed = null } }
    let r: QuizResult | null = null
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) r = (parsed[0] as QuizResult) ?? null
    else if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'passed' in (parsed as object)) r = parsed as QuizResult

    if (!r || typeof r.passed !== 'boolean') {
      setError('Exam result was malformed. Please retry.'); setSubmitting(false); return
    }

    if (r.passed) {
      playPassSound()
      setCompleted(true)
      setShowDiscipline(true)
      // Refresh server component so `completedIds` updates on the course page
      router.refresh()
    } else {
      playFailSound()
    }

    setResult(r)
    setPhase('result')
    setSubmitting(false)
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => scrollMainToTop(false)))
  }

  const allAnswered =
    questions !== null && questions.length > 0 &&
    questions.every(q => answers[q.id] !== undefined)

  const unansweredCount =
    questions && questions.length > 0
      ? questions.length - Object.keys(answers).length
      : 0

  /* BRIEFING */
  if (phase === 'briefing') {
    return (
      <div className="m-hud-panel">
        <span className="m-hud-scan" />
        <div className="m-hud-header">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            MISSION BRIEF
            <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL' : 'SQ ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            STANDBY
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10">
        <div className="m-label m-label-cyan mb-3">
          {isFinalExam ? 'Final Exam' : 'Side Quest ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight mb-8">{lessonTitle}</h2>
        <div className="border-t border-[var(--m-border)] mb-6" />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-5 mb-10">
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">BRIEFING</div>
            <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--m-text)]">{videoUrl ? 'READY' : 'TEXT ONLY'}</div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">EXAM</div>
            <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--m-text)]">
              {questions === null ? '...' : questions.length === 0 ? 'NONE' : questions.length + ' Q'}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-widest text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mb-1">PASS GATE</div>
            <div className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--m-cyan)]">{passThreshold}%</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="m-label mb-4">Objectives</div>

          â–¶ START MISSION
        </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    )

  /* MISSION */
  if (phase === 'mission') {
    const showReview = cameFromResult && result?.review && questions

    if (showReview) {
      return (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="m-panel relative overflow-hidden">
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
            <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-4 h-4 z-10" style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

            <div className="px-5 md:px-7 py-4 md:py-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">

                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em]" style={{ color: '#22d3ee', textShadow: '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.55)' }}>
                    {isFinalExam ? 'FINAL EXAM' : 'SIDE QUEST ' + String(lessonIndex).padStart(2, '0')}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-base md:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--m-text)] truncate">
                  {lessonTitle}

              </button>

          {questions.map((q, qi) => {

                </button>
                <button onClick={retry}
                  className="bg-red-500 text-white font-bold tracking-widest text-sm rounded-lg px-8 py-3 hover:bg-red-400 transition m-pulse">
                  RETRY MISSION
                </button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </>
    )
  }

  return null
}

function extractYouTubeId(url: string): string | null {
  const match = url.match(
    /(?:youtube\.com\/(?:watch\?v=|embed\/|shorts\/)|youtu\.be\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  )
  return match ? match[1] : null
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/lessons/[lessonId]/QuizSection.tsx  (exam + progress gate)

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Question = {
  id: string
  question: string
  options: string[]
  order_index: number
}

type QuizResult = {
  score: number
  passed: boolean
  correct: number
  total: number
}

export default function QuizSection({
  lessonId,
  initialCompleted,
}: {
  lessonId: string
  initialCompleted: boolean
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<Question[] | null>(null)
  const [completed, setCompleted] = useState(initialCompleted)
  const [started, setStarted] = useState(false)
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
  const [result, setResult] = useState<QuizResult | null>(null)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_quiz_questions', {
        p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      })
      if (error) {
        setError(error.message)
        setQuestions([])
        return
      }
      setQuestions((data as Question[]) || [])
    }
    load()
  }, [lessonId])

  async function submit(finalAnswers: Record<string, number>) {
    setSubmitting(true)
    setError(null)

    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('submit_quiz', {
      p_lesson_id: lessonId,
      p_answers: finalAnswers,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setSubmitting(false)
      return
    }

    const r = (data as QuizResult[])[0]
    setResult(r)
    if (r.passed) {
      setCompleted(true)
      router.refresh()
    }
    setSubmitting(false)
  }

  // Completed
  if (completed) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-green-400 font-semibold">
          <span className="text-xl">âœ“</span>
          <span>Quest Complete</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-sm text-green-400 font-mono">
          {result ? `${result.score}% Â· ` : ''}+50 XP
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Loading
  if (questions === null) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6 text-center text-[var(--m-text-dim)] text-sm">
        Loading practice exam...
      </div>
    )
  }

  // No quiz â€” one-click complete
  if (questions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <>
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-3 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => submit({})}
          disabled={submitting}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
        >
          {submitting ? 'Completing...' : 'âœ“ Complete Side Quest'}
        </button>
      </>
    )
  }

  // Failed state
  if (result && !result.passed) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-red-400 font-semibold mb-1">
          âœ— Not passed â€” {result.correct} / {result.total} ({result.score}%)
        </div>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5">
          You need 80% to unlock the next quest. Review the Codex and try again.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
            setStarted(true)
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Retake Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Intro state
  if (!started) {
    return (
      <div className="m-panel p-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">
          {questions.length} question{questions.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}
        </h3>
        <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-5 leading-relaxed">
          You need <span className="text-[var(--m-cyan)] font-semibold">80%</span>{' '}
          or higher to pass and unlock the next quest.
        </p>
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            setStarted(true)
            setResult(null)
            setAnswers({})
          }}
          className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 transition"
        >
          Start Exam â†’
        </button>
      </div>
    )
  }

  // Taking exam
  const allAnswered = questions.every((q) => answers[q.id] !== undefined)

  return (
    <div className="m-panel p-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 m-label">
          <span>ðŸ§ </span> Practice Exam
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] font-mono">
          {Object.keys(answers).length} / {questions.length} answered
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-6 mb-6">
        {questions.map((q, i) => (
          <div key={q.id}>
            <div className="text-sm font-medium mb-3 leading-relaxed">
              <span className="text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2 font-mono">
                Q{i + 1}.
              </span>
              {q.question}
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {q.options.map((opt, idx) => {
                const selected = answers[q.id] === idx
                return (
                  <button
                    key={idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setAnswers((a) => ({ ...a, [q.id]: idx }))
                    }
                    className={`w-full text-left text-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 border transition ${
                      selected
                        ? 'border-cyan-500/60 bg-cyan-500/[0.08] text-[var(--m-text)]'
                        : 'border-[var(--m-border)] hover:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] text-[var(--m-text-muted)]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="font-mono text-xs text-[var(--m-text-dim)] mr-2">
                      {String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}
                    </span>
                    {opt}
                  </button>
                )
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {error && <div className="mb-4 text-red-400 text-sm">Error: {error}</div>}

      <button
        onClick={() => submit(answers)}
        disabled={!allAnswered || submitting}
        className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-lg py-3.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-40 transition"
      >
        {submitting
          ? 'Checking...'
          : allAnswered
          ? 'Submit Exam'
          : `Answer all ${questions.length} questions`}
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

// FILE: app/courses/[slug]/page.tsx
import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect, notFound } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import EnrollButton from '@/app/dashboard/EnrollButton'
import CourseView, { type Saga } from './CourseView'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function CourseDetailPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ slug: string }>
}) {
  const { slug } = await params
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: course } = await supabase
    .from('courses')
    .select('id, slug, title, description, track, level')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle()
  if (!course) notFound()

  // Read is_admin directly off the profile row
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('is_admin')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const isAdmin = profile?.is_admin === true

  const { data: enrollment } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments')
    .select('id, progress')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  const { data: sagasData } = await supabase
    .from('modules')
    .select(`
      id, title, description, order_index,
      missions(
        id, title, description, order_index,
        lessons(id, title, order_index, is_final_exam, pass_threshold)
      )
    `)
    .eq('course_id', course.id)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  const sagas = (sagasData ?? []) as unknown as Saga[]

  const { data: progressData } = await supabase
    .from('lesson_progress')
    .select('lesson_id')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)
    .eq('completed', true)

  const completedIds = (progressData ?? []).map((p: { lesson_id: string }) => p.lesson_id)
  const completedSet = new Set<string>(completedIds)

  sagas.forEach(s => {
    s.missions = (s.missions ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    s.missions.forEach(m => {
      m.lessons = (m.lessons ?? []).sort((a, b) => a.order_index - b.order_index)
    })
  })

  const totalLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) => sum + s.missions.reduce((a, m) => a + (m.lessons?.length ?? 0), 0),
    0
  )
  const doneLessons = sagas.reduce(
    (sum, s) =>
      sum +
      s.missions.reduce(
        (a, m) => a + (m.lessons ?? []).filter(l => completedSet.has(l.id)).length,
        0
      ),
    0
  )
  const overallPct = totalLessons > 0 ? Math.round((doneLessons / totalLessons) * 100) : 0

  let defaultOpenIndex = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < sagas.length; i++) {
    const hasIncomplete = sagas[i].missions.some(m =>
      (m.lessons ?? []).some(l => !completedSet.has(l.id))
    )
    if (hasIncomplete) {
      defaultOpenIndex = i
      break
    }
    if (i === sagas.length - 1) defaultOpenIndex = i
  }

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto">
        <Link
          href="/courses"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition mb-8"
        >
          â† BACK TO COURSES
        </Link>

        <div className="mb-10 md:mb-14">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <span
              className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] px-2 py-1 rounded"
              style={{
                color: '#22d3ee',
                background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.08)',
                border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
              }}
            >
              {course.track === 'en_to_nl' ? 'EN â†’ NL' : course.track === 'nl_to_en' ? 'NL â†’ EN' : course.track?.toUpperCase()}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
              {course.level}
            </span>
            {enrollment && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#10b981] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#10b981]" />
                ENROLLED
              </span>
            )}
            {isAdmin && (
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#f59e0b] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#f59e0b]" />
                ADMIN Â· ALL UNLOCKED
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e5e9f0] mb-4 leading-tight">
            {course.title}
          </h1>

          {course.description && (
            <p className="text-sm md:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#8892a6] max-w-2xl mb-8">
              {course.description}
            </p>
          )}

          {!enrollment ? (
            <EnrollButton courseId={course.id} enrolled={false} />
          ) : (
            <div className="max-w-lg">
              <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">
                  COURSE PROGRESS
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#22d3ee] tabular-nums">
                  {doneLessons} / {totalLessons} Â· {overallPct}%
                </span>
              </div>
              <div
                className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden"
                style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.9)' }}

                  className="h-full"
                  style={{

                    background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',

                    transition: 'width 0.4s ease',

          <span className="flex items-center gap-2">

            <span className="inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ border: '1px solid #566074' }} />
            <span>LOCKED</span>
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { enrollInCourse } from '@/app/actions/enroll'

export default function EnrollButton({
  courseId,
  enrolled,
}: {
  courseId: string
  enrolled: boolean
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  if (enrolled) {
    return (
      <span className="text-green-400 text-sm font-semibold">âœ“ Enrolled</span>
    )
  }

  async function handleClick() {
    setLoading(true)
    await enrollInCourse(courseId)
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleClick}
      disabled={loading}
      className="bg-white text-black text-sm font-semibold rounded-full px-5 py-1.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      {loading ? 'Enrolling...' : 'Enroll'}
    </button>
  )
}

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import EnrollButton from './EnrollButton'

const DASHBOARD_HIDDEN_SLUGS = new Set<string>(['english-b1-fluency'])

export default async function DashboardPage() {
  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser()

  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', user.id).single()

  const { data: courses } = await supabase
    .from('courses').select('*').eq('published', true)

  const visibleCourses = (courses ?? []).filter(
    (c) => !DASHBOARD_HIDDEN_SLUGS.has(c.slug)
  )

  const { data: enrollments } = await supabase
    .from('enrollments').select('course_id').eq('user_id', user.id)

  const enrolledIds = new Set(enrollments?.map((e) => e.course_id) || [])

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email}>
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto px-6 md:px-10 py-12">
        <div className="mb-12">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-3">
            <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
            DASHBOARD
            <span className="w-px h-3 mx-2" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.25)' }} />
            <span className="text-[#3a4250]">OVERVIEW / LIVE</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-[0.06em] text-[#e5e9f0] mb-3 leading-tight">
            Welcome back, {profile?.full_name || 'learner'}
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <p className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">Pick a course and continue your journey.</p>
            <span className="flex-1 h-px max-w-md" style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.35) 0%, transparent 100%)' }} />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074]">AVAILABLE COURSES</span>
          <span className="w-px h-3" style={{ background: 'rgba(34,211,238,0.2)' }} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#3a4250]">
            {String(visibleCourses.length).padStart(2, '0')} LOADED
          </span>
        </div>

        {visibleCourses.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="m-hud-panel p-12 text-center">
            <span className="m-hud-scan" />
            <div className="text-base text-[#e5e9f0] mb-2">No courses available yet.</div>
            <div className="text-sm text-[#8892a6]">New curriculum arrives soon.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
            {visibleCourses.map((course) => {
              const enrolled = enrolledIds.has(course.id)
              const trackLabel =
                course.track === 'en_to_nl' ? 'EN â†’ NL'
                : course.track === 'nl_to_en' ? 'NL â†’ EN'
                : course.track?.toUpperCase()
              return (
                <div key={course.id} className="m-hud-panel flex flex-col relative transition-all duration-300 hover:translate-x-1 group">
                  <span className="m-hud-scan" />
                  <div className="m-hud-header">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" />
                      <span style={{ color: '#22d3ee', textShadow: '0 0 8px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)' }}>{trackLabel}</span>
                      <span style={{ color: '#3a4250' }}>/ COURSE</span>
                    </div>
                    <span style={{ color: '#566074' }}>{course.level}</span>
                  </div>

                  <Link href={'/courses/' + course.slug} className="flex-1 block p-6 md:p-7">
                    <h3 className="text-lg md:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#e5e9f0] group-hover:text-white transition-colors mb-3 leading-snug">
                      {course.title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[#8892a6] text-sm leading-relaxed">{course.description}</p>
                  </Link>

                  <div className="px-6 md:px-7 pb-6 md:pb-7">
                    {enrolled ? (
                      <Link href={'/courses/' + course.slug}
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#22d3ee] text-black text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase rounded-md px-5 py-2.5 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition">
                        Continue Course
                        <span className="text-base leading-none">â†’</span>

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function SignOutButton() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()

  async function handleSignOut() {
    await supabase.auth.signOut()
    router.push('/')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={handleSignOut}
      className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition"
    >
      Sign out
    </button>
  )
}

// FILE: app/forgot-password/page.tsx  (URL: /forgot-password)

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [sent, setSent] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
      redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/reset-password`,
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
    } else {
      setSent(true)
    }
    setLoading(false)
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-2">Reset your password</h1>

        {sent ? (
          <div className="mt-6">
            <div className="border border-green-800/50 bg-green-950/30 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm text-green-400 mb-4">
              âœ“ Reset link sent to <strong>{email}</strong>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
              Check your inbox. The link will take you to a page where you can
              choose a new password.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm mb-6">
              Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
            </p>

            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Email
            </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Sending...' : 'Send reset link'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

// FILE: app/library/ebooks/[slug]/read/page.tsx
'use client'

import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, use } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'
import LogoEmblem from '@/components/LogoEmblem'

function playPageFlip() {
  try {
    const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext
    if (!AudioContext) return
    const ctx = new AudioContext()
    const bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * 0.4
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate)
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0)
    for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1
    const noise = ctx.createBufferSource()
    noise.buffer = buffer
    const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
    filter.type = 'bandpass'
    filter.frequency.value = 1000
    filter.Q.value = 0.5
    const gain = ctx.createGain()
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime)
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.1, ctx.currentTime + 0.05)
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.3)
    noise.connect(filter)
    filter.connect(gain)
    gain.connect(ctx.destination)
    noise.start()
  } catch (e) {}
}

// ðŸŽ¯ PERFECT MATH PAGINATION (1250 chars, sentence-level splitting)
function paginateBook(chapters: any[]): string[][] {
  const pages: string[][] = []
  let currentPage: string[] = []
  let currentCharCount = 0
  const MAX_CHARS_PER_PAGE = 1250 

  const pushPage = () => {
    if (currentPage.length > 0) {
      pages.push(currentPage)
      currentPage = []
      currentCharCount = 0
    }
  }

  chapters.forEach((chapter) => {
    pushPage() 
    currentPage.push(`# ${chapter.title}`)
    currentCharCount += chapter.title.length + 10

    const blocks = (chapter.content || '').split(/\n\s*\n/).map((b: string) => b.trim()).filter((b: string) => b.length > 0)

    blocks.forEach((block: string) => {
      const blockLength = block.length

      // Keep headings with their content
      if (block.startsWith('## ') || block.startsWith('### ')) {
        if (currentCharCount + blockLength > MAX_CHARS_PER_PAGE - 150) pushPage()
        currentPage.push(block)
        currentCharCount += blockLength + 5
        return
      }

      if (currentCharCount + blockLength < MAX_CHARS_PER_PAGE) {
        currentPage.push(block)
        currentCharCount += blockLength
      } else {
        // Split by sentence to perfectly fill the page
        const sentences = block.match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]+/g) || [block]
        sentences.forEach((sentence: string) => {
          if (currentCharCount + sentence.length > MAX_CHARS_PER_PAGE) {
            pushPage()
          }
          currentPage.push(sentence.trim())
          currentCharCount += sentence.length
        })
      }
    })
  })

  pushPage()
  return pages
}

export default function ReaderPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = use(params)
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [book, setBook] = useState<any>(null)
  const [pages, setPages] = useState<string[][]>([])
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(0)
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
  const [fontSize, setFontSize] = useState(15) // Default 15px to fit more

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      const { data: b } = await supabase.from('library_books').select('*').eq('slug', slug).maybeSingle()
      if (!b) return
      setBook(b)

      const { data: chs } = await supabase
        .from('library_chapters')
        .select('title, content')
        .eq('book_id', b.id)
        .order('chapter_number', { ascending: true })
      
      if (chs) {
        setPages(paginateBook(chs))
      }
    }
    load()
  }, [slug, supabase])

  const turnPage = useCallback((direction: 'next' | 'prev') => {
    if (!isOpen) return
    if (direction === 'next' && currentPage + 2 < pages.length) {
      playPageFlip(); setCurrentPage(p => p + 2)
    } else if (direction === 'prev' && currentPage > 0) {
      playPageFlip(); setCurrentPage(p => p - 2)
    }
  }, [isOpen, currentPage, pages.length])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') turnPage('next')
      if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') turnPage('prev')
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)
  }, [isOpen, turnPage])

  const renderBlock = (block: string, idx: number) => {
    const t = block.trim()
    if (!t) return null

    let parsed = t.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g, '<strong style="color: #111; font-weight: 700;">$1</strong>').replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g, '<em style="color: #444;">$1</em>')

    if (t.startsWith('# ')) return <h1 key={idx} className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold mb-6 mt-4 font-serif text-[#111] text-center tracking-tight" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: parsed.slice(2) }} />
    if (t.startsWith('## ')) return <h2 key={idx} className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold mt-8 mb-4 font-serif text-[#1a1a1a]" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: parsed.slice(3) }} />
    if (t.startsWith('### ')) return <h3 key={idx} className="text-lg md:text-xl font-bold mt-6 mb-3 font-serif text-[#1a1a1a]" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: parsed.slice(4) }} />
    
    if (t.startsWith('> ')) return (
      <p key={idx} className="mb-4 leading-[1.7] font-serif italic text-[#444] text-justify pl-4 border-l-2 border-[#ccc]">
        <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: parsed.slice(2) }} />
      </p>
    )
    
    return (
      <p 
        key={idx} 
        className="mb-4 leading-[1.7] text-[#2a2a2a] font-serif text-[1em] text-justify" 
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: parsed }} 
      />
    )
  }

  if (!book) return <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0a0f16] flex items-center justify-center text-[#22d3ee] font-mono tracking-widest animate-pulse">ESTABLISHING CONNECTION...</div>

  if (!isOpen) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#050810] flex items-center justify-center p-6" style={{ perspective: '2000px' }}>
        <div className="relative w-full max-w-md aspect-[2/3] rounded-r-xl rounded-l-md cursor-pointer group transition-all duration-700 hover:rotate-y-[-15deg] hover:scale-105"
          onClick={() => { setIsOpen(true); playPageFlip(); }}>
          <div className="absolute inset-0 translate-x-3 translate-y-3 rounded-r-xl rounded-l-md bg-black/80 blur-2xl transition-all duration-700 group-hover:translate-x-10 group-hover:translate-y-5 group-hover:blur-3xl" />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-r-xl rounded-l-md bg-[#e5e0d0] translate-x-2 translate-y-2" />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-r-xl rounded-l-md overflow-hidden flex flex-col border border-[#22d3ee]/30"
            style={{ background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #0a121e 0%, #050810 100%)', boxShadow: `inset 10px 0 25px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.95), 0 0 100px rgba(34,211,238,0.15)` }}>
            <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-40" style={{ background: `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%, #22d3ee30 0%, transparent 70%)` }} />
            <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-0 w-10 bg-gradient-to-r from-black/95 to-transparent z-20 mix-blend-multiply" />
            <div className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 left-10 w-px bg-white/5 z-20" />
            <div className="absolute top-10 right-10 w-12 h-12 border-t border-r border-[#22d3ee]/50" />
            <div className="absolute bottom-10 left-10 w-12 h-12 border-b border-l border-[#22d3ee]/50" />
            
            <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col h-full p-12 pl-16 justify-between items-center text-center">
              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-[0.5em] text-[#22d3ee]/80 border-b border-[#22d3ee]/30 pb-3 w-full">MERIDIAN ACADEMY</div>
              <div>
                <div className="transform group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-500 relative flex justify-center">
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#22d3ee] blur-[50px] opacity-20 rounded-full" />
                  <LogoEmblem size={140} className="relative z-10" />
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-4xl font-serif font-bold text-white leading-tight mt-10 mb-6">{book.title}</h2>
                <div className="h-px w-24 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#22d3ee] to-transparent mx-auto my-6" />
                <div className="text-base font-serif italic text-[#8892a6]">{book.subtitle}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono tracking-[0.5em] text-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse">CLICK TO OPEN</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-screen w-screen bg-[#050810] flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden font-sans selection:bg-[#22d3ee] selection:text-black">
      <header className="h-14 bg-[#0a0f16] border-b border-[#1e2633] flex items-center justify-between px-6 shrink-0 z-50">
        <button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#566074] hover:text-[#22d3ee] transition">â† CLOSE BOOK</button>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-[#e5e9f0] uppercase">{book.title}</span>
        
        <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border border-[#1e2633] rounded bg-[#141b26] p-1">
            <button onClick={() => setFontSize(f => Math.max(12, f - 1))} className="w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#1e2633] rounded text-[#8892a6] text-xs font-mono">A-</button>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono w-6 text-center text-[#22d3ee]">{fontSize}</span>

// FILE: app/library/ebooks/page.tsx
import Link from 'next/link'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import LogoEmblem from '@/components/LogoEmblem'

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'
export const revalidate = 0

export default async function EbooksPage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: books } = await supabase
    .from('library_books')
    .select('*')
    .eq('published', true)
    .order('order_index', { ascending: true })

  const { data: progress } = await supabase
    .from('library_progress')
    .select('book_id, chapter_id, scroll_percentage')
    .eq('user_id', user.id)

  const progressMap = new Map(progress?.map(p => [p.book_id, p]) || [])

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
import { getCurrentUser } from '@/lib/auth'
import AppShell from '@/components/AppShell'
import ProfileClient from './ProfileClient'

export default async function ProfilePage() {
  const user = await getCurrentUser()
  if (!user) redirect('/login')

  const supabase = await createClient()
  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id, email, full_name, username, role, created_at')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle()

  return (
    <AppShell userEmail={user.email ?? undefined}>
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        {/* header */}
        <div className="mb-8 md:mb-10">

            OPERATOR
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm mt-2 text-[#8892a6]">
            Your account and identity inside Meridian Academy.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ProfileClient
          email={profile?.email ?? user.email ?? ''}
          username={profile?.username ?? ''}
          fullName={profile?.full_name ?? ''}
          role={profile?.role ?? 'member'}
          joinedAt={profile?.created_at ?? ''}
        />
      </div>
    </AppShell>
  )
}

// FILE: app/profile/ProfileClient.tsx
'use client'
import { useState } from 'react'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

type Props = {
  email: string
  username: string
  fullName: string
  role: string
  joinedAt: string
}

export default function ProfileClient({
  email,
  username,
  fullName,
  role,
  joinedAt,
}: Props) {
  const supabase = createClient()

  const [name, setName] = useState(fullName)
  const [savingName, setSavingName] = useState(false)
  const [nameMsg, setNameMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [savingPw, setSavingPw] = useState(false)
  const [pwMsg, setPwMsg] = useState<{ type: 'ok' | 'err'; text: string } | null>(null)

  async function saveName() {
    setSavingName(true)
    setNameMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .update({ full_name: name })
      .eq('email', email)

    if (error) {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setNameMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Name updated.' })
    }
    setSavingName(false)
  }

  async function updatePassword() {
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: 'Password must be at least 6 characters.' })
      return
    }
    setSavingPw(true)
    setPwMsg(null)
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'err', text: error.message })
    } else {
      setPwMsg({ type: 'ok', text: 'Password updated.' })
      setPassword('')
    }
    setSavingPw(false)
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* IDENTITY */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.28)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.72)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          boxShadow: '0 0 60px rgba(34,211,238,0.10)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderTop: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3 h-3"
          style={{ borderBottom: '1.5px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1.5px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          IDENTITY
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <InfoRow label="EMAIL" value={email} mono />
          <InfoRow label="USERNAME" value={username || 'â€”'} mono />
          <InfoRow label="ROLE" value={role.toUpperCase()} />
          {joinedAt && (
            <InfoRow
              label="JOINED"
              value={new Date(joinedAt).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
                day: 'numeric',
                month: 'long',
                year: 'numeric',
              })}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* DISPLAY NAME */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderRight: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#22d3ee] mb-5">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          DISPLAY NAME
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">FULL NAME</label>
        <input
          value={name}
          onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Your name"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={saveName}
            disabled={savingName || name === fullName}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingName ? 'SAVING...' : 'â–¸ SAVE'}
          </button>
          {nameMsg && (
            <span className="text-xs font-mono"
              style={{ color: nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {nameMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{nameMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PASSWORD */}
      <div
        className="relative rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 overflow-hidden"
        style={{
          border: '1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.15)',
          background: 'rgba(6,10,16,0.6)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        }}
      >
        <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 left-0 w-2.5 h-2.5"
          style={{ borderTop: '1px solid #22d3ee', borderLeft: '1px solid #22d3ee' }} />

          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee] animate-pulse" />
          SECURITY
        </div>

        <label className="o-label block mb-2 text-[10px]">NEW PASSWORD</label>

          type="password"

          placeholder="At least 6 characters"
          className="o-input"
        />

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={updatePassword}
            disabled={savingPw || password.length === 0}
            className="bg-[var(--m-cyan)] text-black font-bold tracking-widest text-xs rounded-lg px-6 py-3 hover:bg-cyan-300 transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            {savingPw ? 'UPDATING...' : 'â–¸ UPDATE PASSWORD'}

              style={{ color: pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444' }}>
              {pwMsg.type === 'ok' ? 'âœ“ ' : 'âœ— '}{pwMsg.text}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* console hint */}
      <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-5 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.3em] text-[#566074] flex-wrap">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">

// FILE: app/reset-password/page.tsx  (URL: /reset-password)

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function ResetPasswordPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('')
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false)
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase.auth.getUser().then(({ data }) => {
      if (data.user) setReady(true)
    })
  }, [supabase])

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('Passwords do not match')
      return
    }
    if (password.length < 6) {
      setError('Password must be at least 6 characters')
      return
    }
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }
    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-[var(--m-bg)] text-[var(--m-text)] m-grid-bg flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md m-panel p-8">
        <Link
          href="/login"
          className="text-sm text-[var(--m-text-dim)] hover:text-[var(--m-text)]"
        >
          â† Back to login
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-6">Choose a new password</h1>

        {!ready ? (
          <p className="text-[var(--m-text-muted)] text-sm">
            Verifying reset link...
          </p>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
            {error && (
              <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              New password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-4 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <label className="block text-sm text-[var(--m-text-muted)] mb-1">
              Confirm password
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={6}
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-[var(--m-bg)] border border-[var(--m-border)] rounded-lg px-3 py-2 mb-6 focus:border-[var(--m-border-bright)] outline-none"
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="w-full bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-full py-2.5 hover:bg-neutral-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition"
            >
              {loading ? 'Updating...' : 'Update password'}
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useState } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import Link from 'next/link'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export default function SignupPage() {
  const router = useRouter()
  const supabase = createClient()
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('')
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState('')
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)

    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
      email,
      password,
      options: {
        data: { full_name: fullName, username: email.split('@')[0] },
      },
    })

    if (error) {
      setError(error.message)
      setLoading(false)
      return
    }

    router.push('/dashboard')
    router.refresh()
  }

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 text-white flex items-center justify-center px-6">
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl p-8"
      >
        <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300">
          â† Back
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold mt-4 mb-6">Create your account</h1>

        {error && (
          <p className="bg-red-950 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-sm rounded-lg p-3 mb-4">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Full name</label>
        <input

        />

        <label className="block text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-1">Email</label>
        <input

        <input
          type="password"

'use client'

type Variant = 'landing' | 'dashboard' | 'learning'

export default function AcademyBackground({
  variant = 'dashboard',
}: {
  variant?: Variant | string
}) {
  const v = (variant as Variant) || 'dashboard'
  const richer = v === 'landing'
  const quieter = v === 'learning'

  return (
    <div className="m-bg-root" aria-hidden>
      <div className="m-bg-base" />

      <div
        className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-a"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 0.75 : quieter ? 0.28 : 0.5,
        }}
      />
      <div
        className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-b"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 0.65 : quieter ? 0.22 : 0.42,
        }}
      />
      {!quieter && (
        <div
          className="m-bg-orb m-bg-orb-c"
          style={{ opacity: richer ? 0.5 : 0.28 }}
        />
      )}

      <div
        className="m-bg-grid"
        style={{
          opacity: richer ? 1 : quieter ? 0.35 : 0.7,
        }}
      />

      {!quieter && <div className="m-bg-horizon" />}

      <div className="m-bg-vignette" />
    </div>
  )
}

FILE: components\ContentArrowNav.tsx

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { getActiveZone, setActiveZone, onZoneChange } from '@/lib/navZone'
import { unlockAudio, playSelectSound, playConfirmSound } from '@/lib/sounds'

export default function ContentArrowNav({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0)
  const [zoneActive, setZoneActive] = useState(getActiveZone() === 'content')

  useEffect(() => {
    return onZoneChange(z => {
      setZoneActive(z === 'content')
      if (z !== 'content') setActiveIndex(-1)
    })
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!getActiveZone()) setActiveZone('content')
    setZoneActive(getActiveZone() === 'content')
    setActiveIndex(0)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!zoneActive) return

    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      const el = ref.current
      if (!el) return
      const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
      if (items.length === 0) return

      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null
      if (active) {
        const tag = active.tagName.toLowerCase()
        if (tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || active.isContentEditable) {
          return
        }
      }

      if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i + 1 >= items.length ? 0 : i + 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
        e.preventDefault()
        unlockAudio()
        playSelectSound()
        setActiveIndex(i => (i - 1 < 0 ? items.length - 1 : i - 1))
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const idx = activeIndex < 0 ? 0 : activeIndex
        const target = items[idx]
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault()
          unlockAudio()
          playConfirmSound()
          target.click()
        }
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true)
  }, [zoneActive, activeIndex])

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current
    if (!el) return
    const items = el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-nav-item]')
    items.forEach((it, i) => {
      if (zoneActive && i === activeIndex) {
        it.setAttribute('data-nav-active', 'true')
      } else {
        it.removeAttribute('data-nav-active')
      }
    })
  }, [activeIndex, zoneActive])

  return (
    <div ref={ref} data-nav-zone="content">
      {children}
    </div>
  )
}

'use client'

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

const GOALS = [
  { label: 'Complete 1 Side Quest', xp: 20 },
  { label: 'Review Quest Codex',    xp: 10 },
  { label: 'Practice 15 minutes',   xp: 15 },
  { label: 'Post in Community',     xp: 10 },
  { label: 'Read 1 Library entry',  xp: 15 },
  { label: 'Flashcard session',     xp: 10 },
]

export default function DailyGoal() {
  const [checked, setChecked] = useState<boolean[]>([])
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)

  useEffect(() => {
    const today = new Date().toDateString()
    const stored = localStorage.getItem('m-daily-goal')
    const storedDate = localStorage.getItem('m-daily-goal-date')
    if (storedDate === today && stored) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(stored) as boolean[]
        // pad if length mismatch (added goals over time)
        const normalised = GOALS.map((_, i) => !!parsed[i])
        setChecked(normalised)
      } catch {
        setChecked(GOALS.map(() => false))
      }
    } else {
      const fresh = GOALS.map(() => false)
      setChecked(fresh)
      localStorage.setItem('m-daily-goal', JSON.stringify(fresh))
      localStorage.setItem('m-daily-goal-date', today)
    }
    setMounted(true)
  }, [])

  function toggle(i: number) {
    const next = [...checked]
    next[i] = !next[i]
    setChecked(next)
    localStorage.setItem('m-daily-goal', JSON.stringify(next))
  }

  if (!mounted) return null

  const done = checked.filter(Boolean).length
  const earnedXp = GOALS.reduce((sum, g, i) => sum + (checked[i] ? g.xp : 0), 0)
  const totalXp = GOALS.reduce((sum, g) => sum + g.xp, 0)
  const pct = (done / GOALS.length) * 100
  const allDone = done === GOALS.length

  return (
    <div className="m-hud-panel">
      <span className="m-hud-scan" />
      <div className="m-hud-header">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-[#22d3ee]" />
          DAILY GOAL
        </div>
        <span style={{ color: allDone ? '#10b981' : '#566074' }}>
          {done}/{GOALS.length}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        {/* XP + progress */}
        <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between mb-2">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-[#566074]">
            DAILY XP
          </span>
          <span className="text-sm font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: '#a5f3fc' }}>
            {earnedXp}
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#3a4250] font-normal"> / {totalXp}</span>
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-[3px] rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-4"
          style={{ background: 'rgba(30,38,51,0.9)' }}>
          <div
            className="h-full transition-all duration-500"
            style={{
              width: pct + '%',
              background: allDone
                ? '#10b981'
                : 'linear-gradient(90deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6)',
              boxShadow: allDone
                ? '0 0 10px rgba(16,185,129,0.6)'
                : '0 0 10px rgba(34,211,238,0.5)',
            }}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Goals */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {GOALS.map((goal, i) => (
            <button
              key={i}
              onClick={() => toggle(i)}
              className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 text-left text-xs group transition-colors rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 -mx-2 hover:bg-white/[0.02]"
            >
              <span
                className={
                  'shrink-0 w-4 h-4 rounded border flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] transition ' +
                  (checked[i]
                    ? 'bg-[#22d3ee] border-[#22d3ee] text-black'
                    : 'border-[#2d3748] group-hover:border-[#22d3ee]/60')
                }
              >
                {checked[i] && 'âœ“'}
              </span>
              <span
                className={
                  'flex-1 transition ' +
                  (checked[i] ? 'text-[#3a4250] line-through' : 'text-[#e5e9f0]')
                }
              >
                {goal.label}
              </span>
              <span
                className="text-[9px] font-mono tabular-nums shrink-0"
                style={{ color: checked[i] ? '#10b981' : '#3a4250' }}
              >
                +{goal.xp}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {allDone && (
          <div
            className="mt-3 text-[10px] font-mono tracking-[0.2em] text-center text-[#10b981] rounded-md py-2"
            style={{ border: '1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.4)', background: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.06)' }}
          >
            âœ“ ALL GOALS COMPLETE
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { pickQuote, type DisciplineQuote } from '@/lib/discipline'
import LogoEmblem from './LogoEmblem'

export default function DisciplineScreen({
  onDone,
  duration = 6000,
}: {
  onDone: () => void
  duration?: number
}) {
  const [quote, setQuote] = useState<DisciplineQuote | null>(null)
  const [fading, setFading] = useState(false)
  const [dots, setDots] = useState('')

  useEffect(() => {
    setQuote(pickQuote())
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      setDots((d) => (d.length >= 3 ? '' : d + '.'))
    }, 400)
    return () => clearInterval(id)
  }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!quote) return
    const fadeTimer = setTimeout(() => setFading(true), duration - 900)
    const doneTimer = setTimeout(onDone, duration)
    return () => { clearTimeout(fadeTimer); clearTimeout(doneTimer) }
  }, [quote, duration, onDone])

  if (!quote) return null

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-8 pointer-events-none">
      <div
        className="absolute inset-0"
        style={{
          background: 'radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #0a1620 0%, #050810 60%, #000 100%)',
          opacity: fading ? 0 : 1,

type PanelMode = 'full' | 'focus' | 'progress' | 'quiet'

function getPanelMode(path: string | null): PanelMode {
  if (!path) return 'full'
  if (path.startsWith('/dashboard')) return 'full'
  if (/^\/courses\/[^/]+\/lessons\//.test(path)) return 'focus'
  if (path === '/courses' || /^\/courses\/[^/]+$/.test(path)) return 'progress'
  return 'quiet'
}
